stories.label: Storms targeting both US coasts threaten to snarl Thanksgiving travel for millions

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [ABC Australia](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-27/thanksgiving-floods-storms-across-us/107433308) reported that nearly 200,000 homes and businesses lost power in Virginia and another 177,000 in Maryland due to major Thanksgiving storms, with flights also affected.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/previsao-de-tempestade-adia-tradicional-desfile-de-acao-de-gracas-de-nova-york-pela-primeira-vez-em-cem-anos.shtml), [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/blogs/clima-extremo/post/2026/11/tempestade-historica-cancela-desfiles-de-acao-de-gracas-nos-eua-e-adia-parada-centenaria-de-nova-york.ghtml) reported that the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade in New York was postponed to Saturday due to weather conditions for the first time in a hundred years.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/26/thanksgiving-storms-flood-us-coasts-and-disrupt-holiday-travel) reported that Macy's postponed its 100th parade in Manhattan and more than 600,000 homes and businesses lost power.

On 26 Nov 2026, [BBC](https://www.bbc.com/pidgin/articles/c87524d22xppo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that massive storms descended on both US coasts as about 80 million Americans traveled for the Thanksgiving holiday.

On 26 Nov 2026, [MercoPress](https://en.mercopress.com/2026/11/26/storms-on-both-us-coasts-leave-840-000-without-power-and-disrupt-thanksgiving-travel?utm_source=feed&utm_medium=rss&utm_content=main&utm_campaign=rss) reported that severe storms left more than 840,000 without power and disrupted Thanksgiving travel.

On 26 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics/thanksgiving-parade-mamdani-laura-loomer-b3092323.html) reported that a MAGA confidant went on a Muslim mayor tirade over the Macy's Thanksgiving parade.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/americas/thanksgiving-storm-triggers-state-of-emergency-in-new-york) reported that New York declared a state of emergency for southern areas, including New York City and Long Island.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/new-york-new-jersey-declare-emergencies-as-powerful-storm-hits-us/) reported that New York and New Jersey declared states of emergency as a powerful storm swept across the United States East Coast.

On 26 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/thanksgiving-travel-chaos-storms-coasts-b3092174.html) reported that storms on the East Coast led to the postponement of the annual Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade alongside travel chaos involving over 360 canceled flights.

On 26 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/eeuu-y-canada/tormentas-inundaciones-y-nieve-azotan-a-estados-unidos-en-pleno-dia-de-accion-de-gracias-3604527) reported that storms, floods, and snow hit the United States during Thanksgiving, leading New Jersey and New York to postpone parades.

On 26 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/26/storm-thanksgiving-parade-cancellations-severe-weather) reported that severe weather brought heavy rain, winds, flooding, and high tides, leading the New York governor to declare a state of emergency.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/thanksgiving-storm-disrupts-flights-in-new-york-dc-as-820-flights-cancelled-across-us-101795701667456.html) reported that 820 flights were canceled across the US and the Commodore Barry Bridge was closed due to Thanksgiving storms.

On 26 Nov 2026, [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/estados-unidos/nueva-york/alcalde-mamdani-por-las-tormentas-severas-en-nyc-el-dia-de-accion-de-gracias-ahora-es-el-momento-de-nid26112026/) reported that New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani urged residents to prepare for severe Thanksgiving storms and follow security recommendations.

On 26 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/tormentas-inundaciones-y-nevadas-amenazan-a-eu-en-dia-de-accion-de-gracias-declaran-emergencias-en-estados/) reported that storms, floods, and snow threatened the US for Thanksgiving, leading to declared states of emergency in several states.

On 26 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/thanksgiving-macy-parade-postponed-new-york-city-b3092083.html) reported that New Yorkers, tourists, and social media users shared disappointment regarding the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade postponement.

On 26 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/artanddesign/gallery/2026/nov/26/thanksgiving-day-parade-pictures-between-the-balloons) reported on the publication of a photography book titled Between the Balloons: My Thanksgiving Parade by Aperture Kids.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/new-jersey-declares-state-of-emergency-ahead-of-thanksgiving-storm-3726013) reported that New Jersey Governor Mikie Sherrill announced a statewide state of emergency ahead of a Thanksgiving storm.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/new-york-governor-kathy-hochul-declares-state-of-emergency-after-thanksgiving-storm-delays-macys-parade-mayor-zohran-mamdani-issues-safety-tips-video-101795666541831.html) reported that New York Governor Kathy Hochul declared a state of emergency for New York City and Nassau, Suffolk, and Westchester counties ahead of a powerful Thanksgiving storm.

On 25 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/eeuu-y-canada/alerta-en-estados-unidos-por-fuerte-tormenta-costera-para-el-dia-de-accion-de-gracias-este-es-el-pronostico-de-vientos-inundaciones-y-nevadas-3604298) reported that meteorological services issued alerts regarding a strong coastal storm bringing winds, floods, and snow along the US east coast from Florida to New England for Thanksgiving.

On 26 Nov 2026, [TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/9bf6da5ac81d), a state-run outlet, reported that parade sponsor Macy's stated the 100th March of Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade will move to Saturday, November 28, due to expected severe weather.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Jowhar](https://jowhar.com/macys-delays-thanksgiving-day-parade-as-powerful-storm-looms/) reported that a powerful storm bearing down on the US east coast forced New York to postpone the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade in an unprecedented move.

On 25 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/nueva-york-pospone-desfile-de-accion-de-gracias-por-previsiones-de-mal-tiempo-33311101) reported that New York postponed the Macy's Thanksgiving Day parade due to bad weather forecasts, affecting up to 80 million travelers.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/26/storms-push-macys-thanksgiving-day-parade-in-new-york-city-to-saturday?traffic_source=rss) reported that the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade in New York City was moved to Saturday due to incoming storms.

On 25 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/americas/20261126-powerful-us-storm-forces-historic-postponement-of-thanksgiving-day-parade-in-new-york), [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/united-states-canada/article/3375820/macys-thanksgiving-day-parade-postponed-new-york-braces-huge-storm), [RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/us/2026/1126/1600707-thanksgiving-parade-us/), [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/bad-weather-postpones-macys-100th-thanksgiving-day-parade-for-first-time-ever/article71745030.ece) reported that the historic postponement marks a first in the event's 100-year history.

On 25 Nov 2026, [The Washington Times](https://www.washingtontimes.com/news/2026/nov/25/major-airlines-issue-thanksgiving-travel-waivers-east-coast-storms/) reported that major airlines including United, American, and Delta issued preemptive Thanksgiving Day travel waivers ahead of fierce storms expected in California and on the East Coast.

On 25 Nov 2026, [The Washington Times](https://www.washingtontimes.com/news/2026/nov/25/macys-thanksgiving-day-parade-moved-saturday-due-high-winds-storms/) reported that the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade was postponed to Saturday due to high winds from a nor'easter hitting the New York City area.

On 25 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/25/macys-thanksgiving-day-parade-postponed-weather) reported that New York City's Macy's Thanksgiving Day parade was postponed to Saturday due to high winds.

On 25 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/macys-thanksgiving-parade-postponed-weather-b3091779.html) reported that a network source said the decision was made for the safety of performers and spectators.

On 24 Nov 2026, [The Washington Times](https://www.washingtontimes.com/news/2026/nov/24/thanksgiving-travel-could-messy-storms-coming-week-filled-airline/) reported that Thanksgiving travel could be messy with storms arriving after airline glitches.

On 24 Nov 2026, [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/videos/c5742n4741keo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that BBC Weather's Elizabeth Rizzini reviewed the weather impacting travel over US Thanksgiving.

On 24 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/24/thanksgiving-travel-storms-weather) reported that storm systems across the US are expected to produce periods of heavy rain and strong winds before the holiday, potentially disrupting travel for tens of millions.

On 24 Nov 2026, [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/weather/articles/c5742nplemnno?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that storms targeting both US coasts, including a major Nor'easter, threaten to disrupt Thanksgiving travel for millions.

On 24 Nov 2026, [El País](https://english.elpais.com/usa/2026-11-24/more-than-80-million-people-in-the-us-expected-to-travel-for-thanksgiving.html) reported that more than 80 million people in the US are expected to travel for Thanksgiving while airline technical problems and rising ticket prices discourage flying.

stories.label: DR Congo Ebola outbreak aid concerns

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/44de564b66e4) reported that the WHO stated nearly $1.6 billion is needed over the next six months to strengthen disease detection and care and contain the spread of the virus.

On 26 Nov 2026, [teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/dr-congo-ebola-12000-cases-5900-deaths/) reported that health authorities stated the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo surpassed 12,000 infections and 5,900 deaths.

On 26 Nov 2026, [CBC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifEFVX3lxTE5Cdk1qbkU5dEpLRVNybXVHcU1LNGdGQngxRGwwUzk1WG9KWVUzRWROM04yUXhaZjViazBISWptSkg2SFNubG56TEFQYUZBY3A0NjFxWFowNUNDemMyNktFQmRWU0RRTmdyTkxfLUY1ZV83b2FTQ0NKdlVKQmM?oc=5) reported that Ebola cases reached 12,000 in Congo as the second-largest outbreak on record grows.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/26/ebola-un-says-outbreak-driving-spike-in-gender-based-violence-in-congo/) reported that the UN stated the Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo is driving a spike in gender-based violence.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/democratic-republic-of-congos-confirmed-ebola-cases-top-12000-3726019) reported that Health Ministry data showed 12,021 cumulative Ebola cases including 5,904 deaths as the virus spread to eight provinces.

On 26 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261126-fighting-in-eastern-congo-forces-ebola-workers-to-evacuate-disrupts-outbreak-response) reported that escalating fighting in eastern Congo forced Ebola response workers to leave affected areas and disrupted containment efforts.

On 26 Nov 2026, [The East African](https://www.theeastafrican.co.ke/tea/sustainability/health/un-peacekeepers-evacuate-ebola-response-workers-trapped-by-fighting-in-eastern-congo-5685428) reported that UN peacekeepers evacuated Ebola response workers trapped by clashes in Ituri province.

On 26 Nov 2026, [UN News](https://news.un.org/feed/view/en/story/2026/11/1168883) reported that UN peacekeepers in the Democratic Republic of the Congo stepped up efforts to protect civilians in the Ebola-hit Ituri province amid renewed fighting.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/africa/congo-ebola-cases-cross-12000-while-clashes-hinder-containment), [RT](https://rt-english.com/africa/649377-dr-congo-fighting-forces-ebola-response-teams-evacuation/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS) reported that confirmed Ebola cases in eastern Congo surpassed 12,000 as clashes between rebels and government troops forced response teams to evacuate and hindered containment efforts.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/26/dr-congo-ebola-cases-surpass-12000-as-fighting-disrupts-response-in-east?traffic_source=rss), [Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/rest-of-world/congo-ebola-outbreak-crosses-12000-cases-as-fighting-disrupts-response/articleshow/136187000.cms) reported that confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo surpassed 12,000.
On 26 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/26/ebola-cases-in-congo-surpass-12000-in-fastest-growing-outbreak) reported that the ongoing outbreak is the fastest-growing in history.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikwFBVV95cUxOODk5TW1rbDA5Ml84Vzh3OWVzdW12UkFLbXJzQlZSbG9rNTQxZGl1bjBPQ1FsNURnQ21MU3FFX1RqZFVDdzJrSXR5YkRTTndHcERGWUpyaklFeWxlQ2l4aXhKT1ctM1cwMDdtOHg5RHQ3ZmhqVTIyWFVHUWdHSG40WExZWkJSM1lZNndDSFBlbEdNNnM?oc=5) reported that the Ebola outbreak in Congo reached 12,000 cases as violence forced some responders to evacuate.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipAFBVV95cUxNRDFtT0M3ampBX21sZVc4a0VHSDhwMjcwdm16S2ltOE1SUnBEN29UbmhFQVg2d0U0cmVLTVdrU3k5TS15eWNsUGZKekFqYWFUdGlkTlpWTG93ZHlEUE5CRkJYV2ZfU3lQcUpYcEpiT2g2MXN1OHJWSzhPNWdsX2hwbHJPQVlvQm41UFBNZE5ES1N1d1FMZEkybDJ0ZVp0cHRpSWVibA?oc=5) reported that fighting in eastern Congo forced Ebola workers to evacuate, threatening the outbreak response.

On 25 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/society/2224841) reported that the African Union and WHO estimated the cost of the Ebola response in Africa at nearly $1.6 billion for the Bundibugyo virus outbreak.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Arab News](https://www.arabnews.com/world/ebola-fight-runs-up-against-customs-rites-in-remote-dr-congo-3014028) reported that health workers facing the Ebola outbreak in the eastern Democratic Republic of Congo encounter challenges due to local customs and suspicions.

On 24 Nov 2026, [CGTN](https://newsaf.cgtn.com/news/2026-11-24/DR-Congo-Ebola-deaths-near-5-800-as-infections-rise-1SkCcAykyVG/p.html?UTM_Source=cgtn&UTM_Medium=rss&UTM_Campaign=World) reported that the death toll from the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo reached 5,779 with 11,793 confirmed infections.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/africa/ebola-death-toll-in-congo-far-higher-than-official-figures-suggest) reported that gravediggers in Bunia have been burying far more people than official Ebola death records indicate.

On 25 Nov 2026, [The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/25/world/science-health/ebola-violence-women-congo-unicef/) reported that UNICEF stated the Ebola epidemic in Congo has been tied to rising violence against women and girls and has killed more than 5,800 people since May.

On 24 Nov 2026, [The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/24/japan/japan-first-ebola-response-drill/) reported that the Japanese government held its first infectious disease response drill addressing Ebola amid the outbreak in Congo.
On 24 Nov 2026, [UN News](https://news.un.org/feed/view/en/story/2026/11/1168865) reported that WHO staff and Ebola responders remain trapped in a hospital in Ituri province due to heavy fighting.

On 24 Nov 2026, [The Telegraph](https://www.telegraph.co.uk/global-health/science-and-disease/trapped-ebola-health-workers-rescued-in-congo/) reported that trapped Ebola health workers were evacuated from a hospital under very challenging circumstances after three days of fighting.

On 23 Nov 2026, [CGTN](https://newsaf.cgtn.com/news/2026-11-23/DRC-fighting-traps-health-workers-disrupts-Ebola-response-1SiVz3ihhQI/p.html?UTM_Source=cgtn&UTM_Medium=rss&UTM_Campaign=World) reported that the WHO chief called for an immediate cessation of hostilities after heavy fighting broke out near a hospital in northeast Democratic Republic of the Congo, disrupting Ebola response efforts.

On 23 Nov 2026, [UN News](https://news.un.org/feed/view/en/story/2026/11/1168858) reported that the WHO stated heavy fighting near a hospital in Ituri province has disrupted Ebola response work and forced emergency evacuations.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Reuters](https://news.google.?oc=5), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/23/who-chief-calls-for-peace-amid-heavy-fighting-in-ebola-hit-dr-congo-region?traffic_source=rss), [Punch](https://punchng.com/who-chief-pleads-for-peace-in-ebola-hit-dr-congo-area/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the WHO chief stated that fighting near the Ebola outbreak area in the DR Congo disrupts response efforts.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Arab News](https://www.arabnews.com/world/geography-violence-distrust-hitting-dr-congo-ebola-fight-handicap-international-3013396) reported that Handicap International stated geography, violence, and distrust are three major challenges hampering efforts to quell the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Arab News](https://www.arabnews.com/world/scientists-are-learning-more-about-the-rare-ebola-virus-in-congo-outbreak-3013248) reported that researchers gained insights into the rare Bundibugyo strain during the ongoing Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo.

On 20 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/africa/congo-ebola-outbreak-africa-chidlren-b3088643.html) reported that more than 1,200 children under five contracted the rare Bundibugyo strain in the Democratic Republic of Congo.

On 18 Nov 2026, [RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/en/africa/20261118-strain-specific-ebola-vaccines-to-be-trialled-in-drc-who-announces) reported that two vaccines against the Bundibugyo Ebola strain are set to enter trials in the outbreak's epicentre next week.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Foreign Policy](https://foreignpolicy.com/2026/11/18/congo-ebola-outbreak-budnibugyo-constitution-conflict-m23/) reported that six months in, the out of control Ebola outbreak shows no sign of slowing down.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/a-hunger-crisis-is-making-ebola-even-deadlier-101794971716235.html) reported that an Ebola outbreak sweeping East Africa is fueling a hunger crisis that increases the chances of death for infected individuals.

On 17 Nov 2026, [UN News](https://news.un.org/feed/view/en/story/2026/11/1168827) reported that the UN announced the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo more than doubled in three months, with over 11,000 cases and 5,400 deaths reported.

On 17 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/africa/ebola-congo-six-months-radio-children-b3086362.html) reported that children in DR Congo are sharing information on the airwaves to fight myths as the Ebola outbreak passes the six-month mark.

stories.title: Turkey's Erdogan says COP31 laid groundwork for more climate talks despite lack of deal
stories.label: COP31 climate talks in Turkey

reports.text: On 25 Nov 2026, [Times of Malta](https://timesofmalta.com/article/dalli-disappointed-cop31-outcome-hits-oil-industry-lobbying.1137671) reported that Maltese Minister Miriam Dalli expressed disappointment over the COP31 outcome and criticized oil industry lobbying.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/mundo/preocupante-leon-xiv-cuestiono-fracaso-cop31-advirtio-crisis-climatica-compromete-generaciones-futuras_0_YMCAumBO2v.html) reported that Pope Leo XIV questioned the failure of COP31 and warned that the climate crisis compromises future generations.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Diario Co Latino](https://www.diariocolatino.com/jefe-de-onu-expresa-decepcion-por-resultado-de-cop31/) reported that UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres expressed disappointment with the result of the 31st UN Climate Change Conference.

On 24 Nov 2026, [La Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/2026/11/24/mundo/023n3mun?partner=rss) reported that China expressed disappointment over the failure of the UN climate conference to reach an agreement.

On 23 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/africa-disappointed-with-cop31-outcome), [Jamaica Observer](https://www.jamaicaobserver.com/2026/11/24/caricom-disappointed-outcome-cop31/) reported that the COP31 climate summit in Turkey failed to reach an agreement, exposing divisions over fossil fuels and climate finance.

On 23 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/fracaso-de-la-cop31-desata-criticas-y-reclamos-de-reforma-de-las-negociaciones-climaticas-33278860) reported that the COP31 climate summit's failure sparked criticism and calls to reform climate negotiations over petrostate vetoes on fossil fuel references.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/24/is-no-deal-better-than-a-bad-deal-why-some-see-hope-in-cop31s-collapse), [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/tv-shows/spotlight/20261124-collapse-of-cop31-this-deal-was-a-bad-deal-and-better-no-deal-than-a-bad-deal) reported that COP31 collapsed after the EU, UK, and small nations rejected a pact that promoted carbon capture and omitted fossil fuel phase-outs.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/turkeys-erdogan-says-cop31-laid-groundwork-more-climate-talks-despite-lack-deal) reported that Turkish President Tayyip Erdogan stated the COP31 climate summit established a valuable foundation for more climate talks despite lacking a deal.

On 23 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/news/audio/2026/nov/23/cop31-collapses-why-did-climate-talks-fall-apart-the-latest) reported that countries at the COP31 climate summit failed to reach a keystone agreement for the first time in 17 years.

On 23 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/science/video/2026/nov/23/cop31-failed-what-happens-now-video) reported that the longest ever COP climate talks ended in failure with the key sticking point being the omission of fossil fuels.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/23/cop31-ends-without-agreement-as-divisions-deepen-over-fossil-fuels/) reported that UN climate chief Simon Stiell expressed disappointment over the outcome.

On 23 Nov 2026, [teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/cop31-ends-without-deal-on-fossil-fuel-transition/) reported that nearly 40 countries rejected the proposed outcome over fossil fuel commitments and climate finance.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Times of Malta](https://timesofmalta.com/article/cop31-ends-deal-eu-not-endorse-text-omitting-fossil-fuels.1137494), [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/eu-will-not-endorse-climate-deal-throwing-cop31-outcome-into-doubt/article71731355.ece) reported that Ireland's Climate and Energy Minister Darragh O'Brien stated that the EU and its member states object to the pact because it omits fossil fuels.

On 23 Nov 2026, [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/23/cop31-ends-in-deadlock-as-guterres-blasts-fossil-fuel-interests-demands-urgent-climate-action-2/) reported that United Nations Secretary-General António Guterres expressed deep disappointment over the failure of the climate change conference.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/turkiye/cop31-president-closes-climate-summit-without-deal-blames-some-countries-3725882) reported that COP31 President Murat Kurum closed the summit without a deal and stated that some countries failed to show the required effort and flexibility.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/23/europe-today-cop31-talks-collapsed-over-omission-of-fossil-fuels) reported that the COP31 meeting in Antalya ended without reaching consensus after talks collapsed over the omission of fossil fuels.

On 22 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/environment/20261121-latest-cop31-deal-sidesteps-fossil-fuels-amid-growing-divisions) reported that COP31 ended without a deal as the EU rejected the text for omitting any mention of fossil fuels.

On 22 Nov 2026, [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/cop31-turkiyes-final-draft-doesnt-mention-the-words-fossil-fuels-that-cause-global-warming/article71730648.ece), a local outlet, reported that COP31 President Murat Kurum gave negotiators about three hours to make objections or ask for changes before the wording goes before the conference plenary.

On 22 Nov 2026, [RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/en/international/20261122-cop31-draft-deal-sparks-backlash-as-france-warns-of-step-backward) reported that France warned the last-ditch agreement at the Cop31 climate summit was a step backward.

On 23 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261123-cop31-climate-talks-collapse) reported that EU member states objected to adopting an 11th-hour deal that omitted explicit references to fossil fuels.

On 22 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/la-cumbre-climatica-cop31-fracasa-y-refleja-las-fisuras-del-multilateralismo-33263826) reported that the COP31 climate summit concluded without a global pact and revived debate over reforming consensus.

On 22 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/mas-regiones/la-cop31-fracasa-por-falta-de-cosenso-sobre-combustibles-fosiles-en-un-duro-golpe-para-la-lucha-contra-el-cambio-climatico-muy-decepcionante-3603138) reported that Climate Change Summit co-president Chris Bowen assumed his quota of responsibility after COP31 failed due to a lack of consensus on fossil fuels.

On 22 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/fracasa-cumbre-climatica-cop31-financiamiento-clave-en-el-estancamiento/) reported that leaders failed to agree on measures to combat global warming, leading to the failure of the COP31 climate summit.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/mundo/cumbre-clima-borde-fracaso-union-europea-rechaza-acuerdo-menciona-salida-combustibles-fosiles_0_iKvfHaF62A.html) reported that the European Union rejected the COP31 draft agreement in Turkey because it did not mention the exit from fossil fuels.

On 22 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/europa/reino-unido-puede-revertir-el-brexit-y-regresar-a-la-union-europea-3602883) reported that Prime Minister Andy Burnham raised the debate on whether it is convenient for the United Kingdom to reverse Brexit and return to the European Union.

On 22 Nov 2026, [TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/d3d58f2cabbb), a state-run outlet, reported that COP31 chief Murat Kurum stated Türkiye exhausted all possibilities to secure consensus during two weeks of negotiations at the Antalya summit.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/national/climate-conference-ends-without-agreement-20261123-p61gcg.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that the COP31 climate conference ended in Turkey with no agreement reached.

On 22 Nov 2026, [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cq7827z2841zo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that the UN COP31 meeting in Turkey entered a second day of overtime as countries struggled to reach an agreement.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/22/new-cop31-draft-deal-tabled-as-countries-scramble-to-salvage-climate-talks) reported that the latest draft again failed to mention fossil fuels.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/22/countries-react-after-cop31-climate-talks-end-in-collapse?traffic_source=rss) reported that oil-producing countries opposed the term 'fossil fuels' in the draft text.

On 22 Nov 2026, [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/cop31-fails-to-agree-on-climate-deal-in-chaotic-finale/article71731651.ece) reported that COP31 President Murat Kurum announced there was no agreement on the text and the decisions were not adopted.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/climate-deal-collapses-chaotic-end-cop31), [RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/en/international/20261122-cop31-climate-talks-collapse-as-eu-rejects-deal-that-omits-fossil-fuels), [The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/mena/2026/11/22/climate-talks-collapse-without-deal-at-cop31-in-turkey/), [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/article/3375393/cop31-climate-talks-collapse-eu-and-others-reject-deal), [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/environment-and-climate-change/article-915721) reported that the COP31 climate talks collapsed after the European Union and several other countries rejected a proposed global agreement that failed to mention fossil fuels.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/climat/article/2026/11/22/climat-l-ue-et-ses-membres-s-opposent-a-l-adoption-de-la-decision-finale-proposee-a-la-cop31_6814199_1652613.html), [Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/sciences/cop31-l-union-europeenne-s-oppose-frontalement-au-dernier-projet-de-declaration-finale-20261122) reported that Turkey's COP31 presidency announced the rejection of the final decision draft because it omitted the phaseout of fossil fuels.

On 22 Nov 2026, [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/22/climate/cop31-climate-summit-ends-climate.html), [The Korea Herald](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10945295) reported that European and vulnerable nations rejected a proposed agreement after Saudi Arabia and other oil producers blocked mention of phasing out fossil fuels.

On 22 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/cop31-climate-deal-not-adopted-summit-president-says/live-79999516?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf), [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/cop31-summit-becomes-longest-ever-un-climate-conference-as-eu-rejects-cover-decision-agreement-omitting-fossil-fuels-101795345916381.html) reported that COP31 became the longest-running UN climate summit as nations failed to reach an agreement.

On 22 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/environment/20261121-latest-cop31-deal-sidesteps-fossil-fuels-amid-growing-divisions), [Times of Malta](https://timesofmalta.com/article/cop31-ends-deal-eu-not-endorse-text-omitting-fossil-fuels.1137494) reported that the EU and its member states rejected and refused to endorse the COP31 text for omitting mentions of fossil fuels.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Times of Malta](https://timesofmalta.com/article/cop31-ends-deal-eu-not-endorse-text-omitting-fossil-fuels.1137494) reported that Ireland's Climate and Energy Minister Darragh O'Brien stated the EU objects to the pact.

On 22 Nov 2026, [RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/en/international/20261122-cop31-draft-deal-sparks-backlash-as-france-warns-of-step-backward) reported that the latest COP31 agreement at the summit in Turkey drew criticism from France for failing to explicitly address fossil fuels.

On 22 Nov 2026, [ABC Australia](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-22/cop31-at-odds-over-fossil-fuels/107414330), [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/cop31-fossil-fuels-still-missing-from-draft-deal-at-un-climate-summit/live-79999516?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf), [Times of Malta](https://timesofmalta.com/article/fossil-fuels-still-missing-latest-cop31-draft-deal.1137485), [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/cop31-turkiyes-final-draft-doesnt-mention-the-words-fossil-fuels-that-cause-global-warming/article71730648.ece), [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/cop31-faces-collapse-threat-as-latest-draft-fails-to-mention-fossil-fuels/) reported that the latest COP31 draft text released by Turkey and Australia omits explicit references to fossil fuels as negotiations extend past the deadline.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/no-headway-even-in-overtime-cop-chief-seeks-compromise-101795312540164.html) reported that the second draft of the summit dropped both proposed fossil fuel references and the annual adaptation finance target.

reports.text: On 25 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/11000-messages-11-teams-chats-why-microsoft-launched-code-red-101795582254379.html) reported that Microsoft plans to strengthen system reliability, improve crisis coordination, and use AI agents to help engineers identify problems faster following its Code Red launch.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitAFBVV95cUxOZWlZRm9kdXdaMDkwUWdXZVZPM2NTakFfZTFDa3Iwcm5yNXh4enZZVWRpWjBuc2ZpVERzOElVc0h5NjY4eXZnb0w5YUZ4Wm1nRmUwd04xQmNKZDQxOFlQWk12N0FCd3hSQTVLVFFWZmJKbm01S0pCM1AwRXVRZklpdWJfdkJ1N0FDdS1EZGNqTzd4WjZoUy1qZ1QwNktXdUlMWlBDYW9jYlozNEVDV01DSGZlVVc?oc=5) reported that internal memos show Microsoft declared a Code Red after its historic outage.

On 24 Nov 2026, [The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2642123/microsoft-declares-code-red-after-historic-outage-internal-memos-show) reported that Microsoft's Code Red sought urgent fixes to engineering flaws.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/ekonomija/privreda/Microsoft-proglasio-crveni-alarm/994080) reported that Microsoft declared a Code Red alert and launched an urgent action to improve systems.

On 25 Nov 2026, [The Washington Times](https://www.washingtontimes.com/news/2026/nov/25/microsoft-declares-code-red-review-365-software-outage/) reported that Microsoft announced it will conduct a rare code red review following the Microsoft 365 software outage.

On 24 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/chicago-ohare-ground-stop-outage-faa-b3091030.html) reported that Chicago O’Hare’s ground stop was downgraded to a delay stop with some flights paused.

On 25 Nov 2026, [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/us-chicago-o-hare-international-airport-flight-delays-november-2026-updates/article71740881.ece) reported that technicians are working to repair a piece of air traffic equipment.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/biznis/ai-crypto/microsoft-proglasio-najvisi-stepen-uzbune-uvode-se-hitne-promjene-nakon-sloma/) reported that Microsoft declared the highest level of alert and announced urgent changes following a service collapse.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/microsoft-president-warns-global-technology-outage-risks-could-persist-for-months-amid-security-upgrades-101795426683717.html) reported that Microsoft President Brad Smith stated global efforts to fix software vulnerabilities and upgrade infrastructure could take months.

On 16 Nov 2026, [The Washington Times](https://www.washingtontimes.com/news/2026/nov/16/microsoft-blames-outage-software-defect-introduced-july/) reported that Microsoft blamed a costly outage of its 365 services on complications related to a software defect introduced in July.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/microsoft-says-bug-undetected-in-data-centres-since-july-triggered-worldwide-outage-101794878116415.html) reported that Charles Lamanna, Microsoft's executive vice president, noted that the incident was caused by three main factors triggering a global outage.

On 16 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/nov/16/microsoft-global-outage-cause) reported that Microsoft identified a months-old bug, malfunctioning internal connections, and server capacity as root causes of the global outage.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/microsoft-apologises-for-global-outlook-outage-blames-hidden-server-defect-increased-traffic-and-reduced-capacity-101794851196756.html) reported that Microsoft apologized for the global Outlook outage and blamed a hidden server defect, increased network traffic, and reduced server capacity.

On 14 Nov 2026, [teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/microsoft-announces-the-full-restoration-of-its-service-after-the-technical-crash/) reported that technology company Microsoft announced the full restoration of its services following a technical crash.

On 14 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/microsoft-s-widespread-outages-caused-global-chaos-including-in-the-healthcasre-industry) reported that Microsoft stated it is seeing improvements in service availability after an hours-long disruption affecting platforms including Outlook and Teams.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Egypt Independent](https://www.egyptindependent.com/massive-microsoft-outage-disrupts-businesses-schools-and-governments-around-the-world/) reported that a massive Microsoft outage disrupted businesses, schools, and governments globally by cutting access to Outlook and Teams.

On 14 Nov 2026, [CGTN](https://news.cgtn.com/news/2026-11-14/Microsoft-apologizes-for-global-outage-rules-out-cyberattack-1S3I9qOB6F2/p.html?UTM_Source=cgtn&UTM_Medium=rss&UTM_Campaign=World) reported that Microsoft apologized for a global outage and ruled out a cyberattack.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/14/microsoft-apologises-for-global-outage-and-rules-out-cyberattack/) reported that Microsoft stated service has been restored across Teams, Outlook, and other products.

reports.text: On 25 Nov 2026, [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/seguridad/yo-voy-a-matar-al-papa-procesaron-al-vecino-de-pilar-que-amenazo-con-un-atentado-contra-leon-xiv-en-nid25112026/) reported that a neighbor in Pilar was prosecuted by Federal Judge Adrián González Charvay for making threats and public intimidation regarding an assassination threat against Pope Leo XIV during his visit to the country.

On 25 Nov 2026, [GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/regions/1010768/pope-leo-xiv-approves-elevation-of-la-union-marian-shrine-to-minor-basilica/story/) reported that a Marian shrine located in La Union province has been elevated to a minor basilica.

On 22 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/papa-leon-xvi-pide-a-lideres-de-paises-en-guerra-que-se-comprometan-a-encontrar-la-paz-recemos-por-las-victimas/) reported that Pope Leo XVI asked leaders of countries in war to commit to finding peace and prayed for victims and populations affected by drought.

On 22 Nov 2026, [GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/regions/1010379/pope-leo-xiv-names-oblates-priest-as-new-jolo-apostolic-vicar/story/) reported that Pope Leo XIV appointed Father Gerry Gamaliel Sebastian Delos Reyes as the new apostolic vicar of Jolo.

On 21 Nov 2026, [La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/castilla-y-leon/papa-leon-xiv-nombra-arzobispo-vallisoletano-aurelio-garcia_202611216b01e337c0d5c85b96c4077e.html) reported that Pope Leo XIV named Aurelio García, secretary of the Dicastery for Divine Worship and the Discipline of the Sacraments in Rome, as archbishop.

On 21 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/papa-leon-alerta-sobre-riesgos-enormes-de-la-tecnologia-sin-regulacion-pide-proteger-el-espacio-ultraterrestre-de-usos-no-pacificos/), [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/europa/el-papa-leon-xiv-advierte-sobre-el-enorme-riesgo-para-la-humanidad-que-representa-el-desarrollo-tecnologico-sin-etica-3603007) reported that Pope Leo XIV warned against the enormous risks to humanity posed by unethically regulated technology.

On 20 Nov 2026, [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/sociedad/nelson-castro-respondio-a-las-criticas-que-recibio-por-su-cobertura-de-la-visita-del-papa-leon-xiv-a-nid20112026/) reported that journalist Nelson Castro responded to criticism he received regarding his coverage of Pope Leo XIV's visit to Peru.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/pope-leo-forgives-person-who-hit-him-in-eye-with-rosary/news) reported that Pope Leo XIV forgave the person who threw a rosary that hit him in the eye before his final Mass in Peru.

On 17 Nov 2026, [MercoPress](https://en.mercopress.com/2026/11/17/leo-xiv-after-his-tour-there-is-no-need-to-hate-each-other-or-use-such-violent-language?utm_source=feed&utm_medium=rss&utm_content=main&utm_campaign=rss) reported that Pope Leo XIV criticized aggressive political debate and polarization.

On 17 Nov 2026, [teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/peru-to-investigate-technical-failures-at-pope-leo-xivs-mass-in-lima/) reported that Peru's Foreign Ministry announced an investigation into technical failures involving audio systems and giant screens during Pope Leo XIV's mass in Lima.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/17/pope-leo-xivs-visit-shines-global-spotlight-on-perus-afro-peruvian-heritage-and-cultural-d/) reported that Pope Leo XIV visited the town of Zaña during his tour of Peru.

On 17 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/latinoamerica/del-papacoptero-al-golpe-de-una-pulsera-en-el-ojo-los-momentos-insolitos-del-viaje-del-papa-por-suramerica-3601655) reported that Pope Leo XIV completed a 12-day tour visiting Uruguay, Argentina, and Peru, which featured incidents including being struck in the eye by a rosary bracelet.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/video/2026/11/17/video-shows-pope-leo-xiv-struck-in-the-face-by-rosary-bracelet) reported that Pope Leo XIV was struck in the face by a rosary bracelet thrown from the crowd in Lima.

On 17 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/latinoamerica/cancilleria-de-peru-investiga-fallas-tecnicas-durante-la-ultima-misa-del-papa-leon-xiv-en-lima-empresas-contratistas-podrian-recibir-sanciones-3601533) reported that the Peruvian Chancellery is investigating technical failures during the Pope's final mass in Lima.

On 17 Nov 2026, [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/el-mundo/el-papa-leon-xiv-no-levantara-las-restricciones-de-francisco-a-la-misa-en-el-antiguo-rito-en-latin-nid17112026/) reported that Pope Leo XIV stated he will not lift restrictions on the old Latin mass during his flight back to the Vatican.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Nation (Kenya)](https://nation.africa/kenya/news/world/pope-leo-dispels-health-concerns-with-marathon-south-america-tour-5673476), [GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/world/1009819/after-south-america-tour-pope-leo-jokes-reporters-are-more-tired-than-him/story/) reported that Pope Leo XIV completed his South America tour following lung adenocarcinoma surgery, joking that reporters were more tired than he was.

On 17 Nov 2026, [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/lnmas/el-analisis-de-jorge-fernandez-diaz-sobre-la-visita-de-leon-xiv-vino-a-romper-una-burbuja-nid17112026/) reported that journalist Jorge Fernandez Diaz analyzed the impact of Pope Leo XIV's visit during a discussion on Argentine politics.

On 16 Nov 2026, [GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/world/1009739/pope-leo-ends-south-america-tour-that-drew-millions-with-one-final-vast-crowd/story/) reported that Pope Leo XIV wrapped up a 12-day South America trip by leading a farewell Mass in Peru, closing a three-nation tour that drew 13 million people.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Diario Co Latino](https://www.diariocolatino.com/papa-leon-xiv-se-despidio-de-peru-con-emotivo-mensaje/) reported that Pope Leo XIV said goodbye to the Peruvian people after a massive mass and a brief message of affection.

On 16 Nov 2026, [teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/pope-leo-ends-latin-america-tour-lima/), a state-media outlet, reported that Pope Leo XIV departed Lima after celebrating a farewell mass that concluded his first apostolic tour through Latin America.

On 16 Nov 2026, [El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/mundo/diez-momentos-viaje-papa-leon-xiv-uruguay-argentina-peru_1794859260) reported that Pope Leo XIV's tour of Uruguay, Argentina, and Peru left numerous displays of affection from the population.

On 16 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/americas/20261116-pope-concludes-south-america-homecoming-reassures-faithful-after-cancer-scare) reported that Pope Leo XIV finished his 12-day tour of Uruguay, Argentina, and Peru reiterating his advocacy for social justice and environmental protection.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/16/pope-leo-xiv-struck-in-eye-by-rosary-during-tour-of-south-america) reported that Pope Leo XIV was struck in the eye by a rosary during his tour of South America but continued with his schedule.

On 16 Nov 2026, [ANSA](https://www.ansa.it/vaticano/notizie/2026/11/16/il-papa-lascia-il-suo-peru-ultima-tappa-di-una-visita-storica_0b44c651-3815-40b4-8ddd-75d5bc576fc1.html) reported that the pope concluded an 11-day visit followed by 15 million faithful.

On 16 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261116-pope-leo-wraps-up-south-america-tour-that-tested-recovery-from-cancer-surgery), [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/pope-leo-peru-south-america-trip-cancer-surgery-b3085837.html) reported that Pope Leo XIV concluded his 12-day South America tour following lung cancer surgery.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/international/article/2026/11/16/des-andes-a-l-amazonie-leon-xiv-insiste-sur-la-protection-des-peuples-et-de-l-environnement-le-cri-de-la-terre-et-le-cri-des-pauvres-s-elevent-ensemble_6812198_3210.html) reported that Pope Leo XIV met with Andean and Amazonian peoples threatened by environmental destruction during his Latin America trip.

On 16 Nov 2026, [MercoPress](https://en.mercopress.com/2026/11/16/leo-xiv-denounces-market-and-exploitation-logics-threatening-the-amazon?utm_source=feed&utm_medium=rss&utm_content=main&utm_campaign=rss) reported that Pope Leo XIV denounced market and exploitation logics threatening the Amazon rainforest and its peoples during a visit to Pucallpa.

On 16 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/mundo/epoca/noticia/2026/11/16/papa-leao-xiv-e-atingido-no-rosto-por-objeto-religioso-enquanto-andava-no-papamovel-no-peru.ghtml), [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/el-mundo/el-papa-leon-xiv-recibio-el-golpe-de-un-objeto-mientras-iba-en-el-papamovil-en-peru-nid16112026/) reported that Pope Leo XIV was struck in the face by a religious object while riding in the popemobile at Las Palmas Air Base in Peru.

On 16 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/papa-leon-xiv-se-despide-de-peru-con-misa-multitudinaria-pide-no-olvidar-a-los-pobres-en-una-misa-multitudinaria/) reported that the Vatican stated about 1.5 million people attended the mass.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/16/pope-leo-xiv-in-visit-to-peruvian-rainforest-demands-justice-for-slain-amazon-defenders), [teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/pope-leo-xiv-calls-for-protection-of-nature-and-workers-at-massive-pucallpa-mass/) reported that Pope Leo XIV called for justice for slain Amazon defenders and denounced labor exploitation and environmental depredation during a mass in Pucallpa.

On 16 Nov 2026, [RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/2026/1116/1599306-families-disappeared-meet-pope/), [The Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/ireland/2026/11/16/families-of-the-disappeared-to-meet-pope-leo-on-wednesday/) reported that families of the Disappeared are scheduled to meet Pope Leo XIV.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/video/2026/11/16/peruvians-honour-pope-leo-xiv-with-procession-through-lima) reported that Peruvians honored Pope Leo XIV with a procession through Lima and camped outside Las Palmas Air Base.

On 16 Nov 2026, [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/el-mundo/papa-leon-xiv-en-peru-en-vivo-las-ultimas-actividades-antes-del-fin-del-viaje-minuto-a-minuto-nid16112026/) reported that Pope Leo XIV continued his agenda on the final day of his South American tour with a visit and a mass before departure from Cal Airdrome.

On 15 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/papa-leon-xiv-regresa-a-lima-para-culminar-su-gira-por-latinoamerica-33154320) reported that a mass will serve as the finale for Pope Leo XIV's visit to Peru and his first tour of Latin America.

On 16 Nov 2026, [El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/internacional/leon-xiv-llama-oir-el-grito-de-la-tierra-en-la-amazonia-de-peru) reported that Pope Leo XIV called to hear the cry of the earth in the Peruvian Amazon after flying from Cusco to Pucallpa.

On 15 Nov 2026, [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/el-mundo/en-el-cierre-de-un-dia-extenuante-leon-xiv-denuncio-la-devastacion-de-la-amazonia-y-reclamo-justicia-nid15112026/), [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/16/pope-leo-speech-peru-justice-for-amazon-activists-environment) reported that Pope Leo XIV condemned the devastation of the Amazon, deforestation, illegal mining, pollution, and drug trafficking, and demanded justice for indigenous populations and environmental defenders.

On 16 Nov 2026, [MercoPress](https://en.mercopress.com/2026/11/16/leo-xiv-rides-in-a-peruvian-military-helicopter-cockpit-and-reaches-cusco?utm_source=feed&utm_medium=rss&utm_content=main&utm_campaign=rss) reported that Pope Leo XIV shared the cockpit with Peruvian Air Force pilots during a helicopter journey to Cusco.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/bih/1088234/papa-lav-xiv-predvodio-misu-na-3-700-metara-nadmorske-visine) reported that Pope Leo XIV led a mass at 3,700 meters above sea level attended by tens of thousands of people.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/svijet/papa-predvodio-misu-na-3-700-metara-hiljade-vjernika-stigle-do-drevne-utvrde/) reported that thousands of believers reached an ancient fortress where the Pope led a mass at 3,700 meters.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/actualite-france/en-amazonie-leon-xiv-denonce-l-abandon-des-populations-autochtones-et-lance-une-alerte-pour-la-preservation-de-la-nature-20261116) reported that Pope Leo XIV travelled from Cusco to Pucallpa in the Peruvian Amazon, where he denounced the abandonment of indigenous populations.

stories.title: Rwanda: Rwanda, Five EU Countries Announce Migration Partnership
stories.label: EU Rwanda migrant return hub

reports.text: On 25 Nov 2026, [AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611250226.html) reported that offshore deportation deals risk producing opacity, shielding authoritarian governments, and acting as political signalling rather than reducing migration pressures.

On 17 Nov 2026, [RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/en/international/20261117-five-eu-member-states-open-talks-with-rwanda-on-deportation-centre) reported that Austria, Germany, the Netherlands, Denmark, and Greece are jointly spearheading a project to open talks with Rwanda on a deportation centre.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Africa Report](https://www.theafricareport.com/436787/rwanda-migrant-deportation-centre-what-we-know-about-europes-five-nation-plan/) reported that the plan involves an open welcome centre, residence permits, and a path into Rwandan society, though NGOs expressed fears.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/17/migration-partnership-with-rwanda-sparks-eu-backlash-over-human-rights-record) reported that Rwanda's interior minister rejected criticism regarding the country's human rights record as it prepares to host the first EU return hubs outside the bloc.

On 17 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/rwanda-asylum-seekers-migrants-eu-uk-b3086442.html) reported that Rwanda's interior minister positioned the East African nation as a welcoming country for refugees and migrants.

On 17 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261117-5-european-countries-aim-to-send-rejected-asylum-seekers-to-rwanda), [RT](https://rt-english.com/africa/648950-eu-states-seek-deport-asylum-seekers-rwanda/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS) reported that five European countries announced plans to establish a return hub in Rwanda starting in 2027 to send rejected asylum seekers.

On 17 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/germany-news-plans-for-rwanda-migrant-hub-come-under-fire/live-79965639?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/17/why-are-five-eu-countries-reviving-plans-to-deport-migrants-to-rwanda?traffic_source=rss) reported that human rights groups slammed plans by Germany and four other EU states to send rejected asylum seekers to Rwanda as a return hub.

On 17 Nov 2026, [AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611170105.html), [Jowhar](https://jowhar.com/eu-countries-present-rwanda-agreement-to-create-migrant-return-center-hub/) reported that Rwanda and five European Union member states announced a partnership to establish a migrant return hub in Rwanda.

On 17 Nov 2026, [The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/17/world/politics/european-nations-rwanda-hub-migrants/) reported that Germany, Denmark, Austria, Greece, and the Netherlands planned a Rwanda migrant hub despite human rights protests and a UNHCR warning.

On 16 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/germany-eu-states-open-talks-on-rwanda-deportation-scheme/a-79959158?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that Germany joined four other EU states to open talks on establishing a migrant deportation hub in Rwanda following the approval of EU regulations easing deportations.

On 16 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/rwanda-to-host-hub-for-rejected-eu-migrants) reported that five European countries are negotiating a deal to deport rejected asylum seekers to Rwanda to host a hub.

On 16 Nov 2026, [teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/rwanda-to-create-return-center-for-asylum-seekers/), a state-media outlet, reported that Austrian Chancellor Christian Stocker announced the plan aims to avoid human trafficking networks and reduce deaths on migration routes.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivwFBVV95cUxOZFh2TV8xR3JSejFkM0c0RjBIVmVsWXhkZUtTWHlsLTY4WEI0Q0hVZDJFQURQaWdpM3JtRFdocXFpcW85RTJGeVgzaGhyODNTTUxIcHc5YUl4SWVQU0dwb0d3XzRzZFB0QjBrY2VGQWFSUVRWLTZNeUZZd1dSdnNJTG1zRzI2VXN3TGFTM092MEhRMjRkblBmeXZJSVhacS1aQXg5cG5tOEw2T2MxTjNkdjVOSUtLR1dELUtSdlYwWQ?oc=5) reported that Austria stated five EU countries are starting talks with Rwanda on a deportation hub.

reports.text: On 25 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/25/us-court-convicts-huawei-of-theft-a-history-of-chinese-firms-global-woes?traffic_source=rss) reported that a US court convicted Huawei of theft following legal problems for the Chinese firm from Europe to Asia.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Arab News](https://www.arabnews.com/world/us-jury-convicts-china-tech-giant-huawei-of-stealing-trade-secrets-media-3013927) reported that a US jury found Huawei guilty of stealing trade secrets after an 11-week trial in Brooklyn, though the company was cleared of a racketeering charge.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Egypt Independent](https://www.egyptindependent.com/us-court-convicts-chinas-huawei-for-fraud-conspiring-to-steal-trade-secrets-in-sprawling-trial-over-iran-business/) reported that Chinese telecommunications equipment maker Huawei was convicted in a New York City court on charges including fraud and conspiring to steal trade secrets in a sprawling case over Iran business.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/china-lashes-out-at-us-for-suppressing-chinese-companies-after-huawei-conviction-101795592357087.html) reported that Beijing criticized the US for suppressing Chinese companies after a jury found Huawei guilty of 10 criminal counts including trade secrets theft and bank fraud.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/business/economy/huawei-found-guilty-on-10-counts-in-sprawling-us-criminal-case) reported that Chinese tech giant Huawei was convicted by a jury in New York on 10 counts in a US criminal case.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/svijet/porota-u-sad-u-proglasila-huawei-krivim-za-kradu-poslovnih-tajni-i-krsenje-sankcija-iranu/261125006), [Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/globus/1090774/huawei-proglasen-krivim-u-sad-u-otkrivena-spijunaza-kradja-tajni-i-milionske-prevare) reported that the US Department of Justice announced that a federal jury in New York found Huawei and three of its subsidiaries guilty of stealing trade secrets and violating sanctions on Iran.

On 25 Nov 2026, [The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/chinese-tech-giant-huawei-convicted-of-bank-fraud-sanctions-violations-industrial-espionage/) reported that Huawei was convicted in the United States on 10 criminal counts involving bank fraud, sanctions violations against Iran, and conspiracy to steal trade secrets.

On 25 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/asia/china/huawei-guilty-trump-us-iran-trade-secrets-b3091109.html), [The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/future/technology/2026/11/25/huawei-found-guilty-of-money-laundering-and-conspiracy-to-steal-trade-secrets-in-us-case/) reported that Huawei was found guilty in a US landmark case of multiple criminal charges including money laundering and conspiracy to steal trade secrets, while noting the company was acquitted of racketeering charges.

On 25 Nov 2026, [CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/east-asia/china-huawei-us-conviction-baseless-6580336), [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/huawei-says-us-conviction-against-chinese-company-has-no-legal-or-factual-merit-trade-secrets-iran-bank-fraud-rico-charges-101795575522827.html), [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/sci-tech/technology/huawei-says-us-conviction-without-legal-or-factual-merit/article71740978.ece) reported that Huawei called its US conviction without legal or factual merit while welcoming its acquittal on racketeering charges.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimAFBVV95cUxQZWtkSWZheUoxZG9WeXhxQmEtNFUySnZraXdadXdHQzRsaDdqbldkRUdOMXRZRngwT3VjMXFVYXBVU0lYZG8ySmRzelRsZzRKWFZNbDBzc2FOaVdFRDlfN2Y5b1NET0lLajYzTmVEWXVha29URkZLSGdiMGx1VXFtOU4yM3lpdWpVU3NqbjhkRGRobHNTdTdKLQ?oc=5) reported that a US jury found Chinese tech giant Huawei guilty of conspiracy to steal trade secrets.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2026/11/24/chinese-tech-giant-huawei-found-guilty-of-conspiracy-to-steal-trade-secrets?traffic_source=rss) reported that jurors acquitted the company of the most serious charge of engaging in a criminal racketeering conspiracy.

On 24 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/nov/24/huawei-china-convicted-deceiving-banks-stealing-us-trade-secrets) reported that the tech giant was found guilty on 10 of 12 criminal counts in a case that began in 2018.

On 24 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/cartera/huawei-es-declarado-culpable-de-robar-secretos-comerciales-y-fraude-bancario-en-eu-evita-cargos-mas-graves/), [Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/estados-unidos/jurado-de-nueva-york-declara-culpable-a-huawei-de-robo-de-secretos-industriales_0_KaAaTqHwke.html) reported that a New York federal jury found Huawei guilty of bank fraud and stealing trade secrets from competitors.

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/video/2026/11/26/images-show-kim-jong-un-inspecting-north-korean-nuclear-facilities) reported that North Korean leader Kim Jong Un inspected nuclear material production facilities and a weapons research institute.

On 26 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics/pete-hegseth-jensen-huang-nvidia-b3092097.html) reported that US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth considered using the Defense Production Act of 1950 to compel chipmaker Nvidia to reinstate its scandal-hit CEO on national security grounds.

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [Sky News World](https://news.sky.com/story/driver-of-car-suspected-of-causing-fuel-tanker-to-overturn-in-egypt-detained-13616933), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/26/egypt-detains-driver-over-cairo-fuel-tanker-fire-that-killed-31?traffic_source=rss) reported that Egyptian authorities detained a 21-year-old driver suspected of causing a fuel tanker to overturn in Egypt resulting in 31 deaths, with prosecutors ordering drug tests for the suspect.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipwFBVV95cUxNU2w0bC1tN2k4SU92bG9kc3U2U053dGZvZEh5WEs4U2IzRnVkRk9RdDlYSGZkekNQNy1WYmtKaHhWblI0U1F6SmxmVHJuWmhkRFJQV0xTaXRQRGFxUnd2b0tNMlNNZkszZy00cDNzazdNR1k4WElZTk5lSWNmR1dnQ1l1N2tCa1dtYmNoZmdZS21nd3NDVENDQ01XcDRCQXpocEpIeVhiMA?oc=5) reported that Egypt detained a driver suspected of causing a Cairo tanker crash that killed 31.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/egypt-arrests-man-suspected-of-causing-tanker-crash-fire-that-killed-31-3726032) reported that Egypt's Public Prosecution said a suspect admitted during questioning to causing the collision with a fuel tanker in Giza governorate.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/turkiye-extends-condolences-to-egypt-over-deadly-tanker-fire-3726028) reported that the Turkish Foreign Ministry shared Egypt's grief over a fuel tanker fire in Giza province that killed 31 people and injured 21 others.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/egypt-prosecutors-announce-arrest-man-over-deadly-truck-disaster) reported that Egyptian prosecutors announced the arrest of a man accused of causing a massive fire from an overturned fuel tanker on a highway.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/26/egypt-says-31-dead-in-cairo-fuel-truck-inferno-one-man-arrested/) reported that 31 people were killed in a Cairo fuel truck inferno and one man was arrested.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261126-31-killed-21-injured-in-fuel-tanker-fire-in-giza-egypt/) reported that at least 31 people were killed and 21 injured when a fuel tanker caught fire on Cairo’s Ring Road in the Al-Warraq area of Giza province.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/world/africa/dozens-of-people-killed-in-egypt-highway-blaze-after-vehicle-overturns-20261126-p61hdo.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that the truck overturned when a high-voltage electricity cable fell in front of it.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Asharq News](https://asharq.com/reports/204343/%D9%85%D8%B5%D8%B1-%D8%B6%D8%AD%D8%A7%D9%8A%D8%A7-%D9%88%D9%85%D8%B5%D8%A7%D8%A8%D9%88%D9%86-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%AD%D8%B1%D9%8A%D9%82-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%88%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%82-%D9%82%D8%B1%D8%A8-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B7%D8%B1%D9%8A%D9%82-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AF%D8%A7%D8%A6%D8%B1%D9%8A-%D8%A8%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AC%D9%8A%D8%B2%D8%A9/), [Sada El Balad](https://www.elbalad.news/7194625) reported that civil protection forces in Egypt controlled a fire that broke out after a petroleum tanker collided near the Ring Road in the Warraq area of Giza, causing casualties.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Sada El Balad](https://www.elbalad.news/7194609) reported that the Financial Regulatory Authority directed swift disbursement of compensation for the Ring Road accident victims under the Unified Insurance Law.
On 25 Nov 2026, [Sada El Balad](https://www.elbalad.news/7194605) reported that TV presenter Ahmed Moussa stated victims died while attempting to rescue the petroleum tanker driver.

On 25 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/africa/egypt-fire-vehicle-flip-deaths-b3091723.html), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/25/at-least-30-killed-in-egypt-vehicle-fire-health-ministry-says?traffic_source=rss), [Arab News](https://www.arabnews.com/middle-east/at-least-30-killed-in-blaze-after-vehicle-overturns-in-egypt-health-ministry-says-3014042) reported that at least 30 people were killed and 15 injured in Egypt when a vehicle carrying petroleum products overturned and caught fire on a highway.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2046527/7-killed-2-injured-as-stone-laden-truck-overturns-onto-mini-truck-in-bahawalpur), [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1585679/stone-laden-truck-overturns-onto-parked-mini-truck-in-bahawalpur-killing-seven/) reported that seven people were killed and two others injured when a stone-laden truck overturned onto a stationary mini-truck in Bahawalpur’s Uch Sharif.

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/israel-intensifica-ataques-em-gaza-e-mata-3o-chefe-do-hamas-em-3-dias.shtml), [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/mundo/noticia/2026/11/26/israel-intensifica-ataques-contra-lideres-do-hamas-e-ameaca-deslocar-mais-1-milhao-em-gaza-eua-cobram-avanco-do-plano-de-paz.ghtml) reported that Israel intensified its attacks against Hamas leaders and commanders in the Gaza Strip, with Israeli strikes killing nine Palestinians according to the local health ministry.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/16/8063172/) reported that U.S. envoy Jared Kushner stated preparations are underway for a multilateral meeting on the war in Ukraine and that he discussed next steps with Putin's aide Yuri Ushakov.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/16/8063174/) reported that Dmitry Peskov backed Donald Trump's remarks about Russia's military actions in Ukraine and confirmed the main topics for an upcoming meeting.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/17/ukraine-holds-peace-talks-with-us-europe-as-conflict-escalates?traffic_source=rss) reported that Ukraine held peace talks with the US and Europe as the conflict escalates, with Kushner reporting progress towards a deal while Moscow stated it has not agreed to European participation in the next talks.

On 16 Nov 2026, [The Moscow Times](https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/11/16/kremlin-aide-denies-russia-agreed-to-include-europe-in-ukraine-peace-talks-a94279), [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/16/kremlin-says-the-next-u-s-russia-ukraine-peace-talks-will-be-trilateral-without-europe), [RT](https://rt-english.com/russia/648921-putin-aide-reveals-moscow-stance-europe-talks/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS) reported that Kremlin aide Yury Ushakov stated Moscow has not agreed to include a European delegation in upcoming Ukraine peace talks.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/16/8063169/) reported that Kremlin aide Yuri Ushakov stated Russia was not consulted on Europe's involvement in peace talks and wants Europe to present constructive proposals.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/europe/us-ukraine-europeans-discuss-how-to-draw-russia-into-peace-talks) reported that European officials joined talks with Ukrainian and U.S. negotiators to discuss ways to bring Russia into direct engagement on ending the war.

On 16 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/russia-ukraine-kaja-kallas-brussels-europe-b3085569.html) reported that European Union countries accused Russia of delaying peace talks in Ukraine while continuing attacks on civilian infrastructure.

reports.text: On 23 Nov 2026, [Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249642/Iranian-Army-downs-US-Lucas-drone-east-of-Hormuz), a state-media outlet, reported that an American Lucas drone was intercepted and destroyed by the Iranian Army east of Hormuz.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Egypt Independent](https://www.egyptindependent.com/bahrain-strongly-condemns-irans-continued-attacks-calls-for-reparations/) reported that the Kingdom of Bahrain condemned Iranian air attacks on its territories, including a strike on a civilian industrial facility.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249601/IRGC-downs-20th-US-MQ-1-drone-in-eastern-Hormuz-Strait) reported that the Islamic Revolutionary Guards Corps announced it shot down the 20th US MQ-1C ER drone in the eastern Strait of Hormuz.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Tehran Times](https://www.tehrantimes.com/news/532436/IRGC-strikes-US-patriot-radar-systems-in-Bahrain-downs-20th), a state-media outlet, reported that Iran's Islamic Revolution Guard Corps announced strikes on two US Patriot air defense radar systems at military bases in Bahrain and downed a drone.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Pakistan Today](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisAFBVV95cUxOQmxucGxWRlJjTzI0Wm4yamZNaU8tY2hZdk5HNzNzV0lsTUVSbmNJQ3I1TGVlT3RUSFZGNkNlVHFIOGhOY1NzYUNqc1I1Wm5iTDdjSkxlclBGTFJmNEt2NnR4UlRsZjJONVduUjRDZnk2YmJKWFR1YTlJOWFLRDZDS083dVJiaWhoUTd1QW1iekttVnhsZTdEREU4eFJSdTdsOGFDWU9Uc1V5ckV6aEI4cQ?oc=5) reported that a Pakistani national was critically injured in Iranian strikes on Bahrain.

On 22 Nov 2026, [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/bahrain-says-iran-struck-industrial-site-as-tankers-hit-in-hormuz/article71730497.ece) reported that Bahrain stated two people were wounded in an attack on a civilian industrial site while Iran's Revolutionary Guards stated they targeted US air defence systems.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/bahrain-says-2-wounded-in-iranian-attacks-on-saturday-3725847) reported that Bahrain's Interior Ministry stated a Bahraini citizen and a Pakistani resident were wounded in Saturday's Iranian attacks, with one in critical condition.

On 22 Nov 2026, [The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/bahrain-slams-criminal-attacks-after-iranian-strikes-wound-two) reported that smoke was seen rising above Bahrain's Sitra Island, which hosts industrial facilities including a state-owned oil refinery.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2046321/pakistani-among-two-injured-in-iranian-attacks-bahrain-says) reported that authorities in Bahrain stated a Pakistani citizen was among two injured in Iranian attacks.
On 22 Nov 2026, [La Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/2026/11/22/mundo/019n2mun?partner=rss) reported that Iran claimed it struck US Patriot radar systems in Bahrain with missiles and drones.

On 22 Nov 2026, [CGTN](https://news.cgtn.com/news/2026-11-22/IRGC-targets-US-radars-in-Bahrain-as-Trump-seeks-permanent-deal--1SgRClAT5x6/p.html?UTM_Source=cgtn&UTM_Medium=rss&UTM_Campaign=World), [Hasht-e Subh](https://8am.media/eng/iran-irgc-attack-us-radars-bahrain/), [IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86328844/IRGC-hits-two-US-patriot-radar-systems-in-Bahrain) reported that Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps claimed it struck two US Patriot air defense radars in Bahrain.

On 17 Nov 2026, [IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86324097/IRGC-seizes-ninth-US-MQM-170-drone-in-electronic-warfare-operation), a state-media outlet, reported that the Islamic Revolution Guards Corps seized another US MQM-170 drone in an electronic warfare operation.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249449/Iran-s-IRGC-Navy-seizes-4th-US-MQM-170-drone-intact), [IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86323487/US-drone-captured-intact-IRGC-Navy) reported that Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guards Corps Navy seized a US MQM-170 drone intact using electronic warfare south of Qeshm.

reports.text: On 25 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-politics/2026-11-25/ty-article-magazine/.premium/leader-of-israels-largest-arab-party-makes-his-case-for-jewish-arab-partnership/000001a2-0e3b-d089-a1fe-2f7fd90a0000) reported that Joint List leader Yousef Jabareen discussed his prospective support for an Eisenkot government and prospects for peace.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-politics/2026-11-24/ty-article/.premium/barbaric-camel-riders-netanyahu-minister-lashes-out-at-arab-lawmakers/000001a2-0def-dba8-adea-3def82780000) reported that Heritage Minister Amichay Eliyahu hurled racist remarks at Arab lawmakers during a Knesset debate, accusing them of failing to educate.

On 23 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/article-915807) reported that the Joint List chairman condemned the October 7 massacre and accused Benjamin Netanyahu of fueling racism against Arabs.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-politics/2026-11-23/ty-article/.premium/abbas-urges-arab-mks-to-act-wisely-after-tibi-meets-jordanian-politician/000001a2-0776-d17b-a1b3-5f77490a0000) reported that UAL party leader Abbas criticized Joint List MK Tibi for meeting with a former Jordanian lawmaker who burned an Israeli flag and praised a Palestinian attacker.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261122-israels-lieberman-says-ousting-netanyahu-remains-his-main-goal/) reported that Avigdor Lieberman reiterated that ousting Benjamin Netanyahu remained his main goal.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/lieberman-says-ousting-netanyahu-remains-his-main-goal-3725826) reported that Yisrael Beytenu leader Avigdor Lieberman stated removing caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu remains his priority and ruled out any government that re-elects him.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261119-netanyahu-planned-to-accuse-arabs-of-stealing-elections-investigation-released-by-israeli-broadcaster-claims/) reported that an investigation by Israeli public broadcaster KAN claimed Benjamin Netanyahu and Likud devised a plan to accuse Arabs of stealing elections.

On 17 Nov 2026, [teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/eisenkot-netanyahu-must-leave-office/) reported that Israeli opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot demanded Benjamin Netanyahu's immediate departure and an investigation into allegations that his aides were involved in a school scheme.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-security/2026-11-17/ty-article/.premium/eisenkot-may-have-to-oust-security-chiefs-over-netanyahus-stolen-election-drive/000001a1-e623-d3ad-a5e3-e7fb6aa10000) reported that reports claimed the prime minister's office pushed allegations that Arab parties stole the vote and the Shin Bet chief sought to wiretap Joint List lawmakers.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2045063/israeli-leaders-slam-netanyahus-attempted-election-coup) reported that Israeli leaders criticized Benjamin Netanyahu over reports that his office tried to frame Arab-Israeli party members ahead of polls.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/16/is-israels-opposition-less-right-wing-than-netanyahu?traffic_source=rss) reported that an Israeli government without Prime Minister Netanyahu may be close, but a government without his politics is far less certain.

On 16 Nov 2026, [The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/joint-list-calls-criminal-probe-netanyahu-after-expose) reported that the Joint List called for a criminal probe into caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu following allegations of attempting to falsely incriminate Arab officials ahead of the election.

stories.title: Epstein and Deutsche Bank: “The Filings Identfied Payments Made to Women”
