reports.text: On 25 Nov 2026, [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/25/russian-billionaire-and-senator-suleiman-kerimov-moved-1-16-billion-from-russia-to-switzerland-through-deutsche-bank-in-2020-investigation-finds) reported that an investigation found Russian senator Suleiman Kerimov moved more than a billion euros from Russia to Switzerland through Deutsche Bank in 2020.

On 23 Nov 2026, [The Africa Report](https://www.theafricareport.com/437231/deutsche-bank-leaks-how-ecobank-got-caught-in-the-crossfire/) reported that fifteen million internal files revealed lax checks on African clients at Deutsche Bank.

On 19 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/periodismo-de-investigacion/documentos-filtrados-revelan-como-deutsche-bank-dio-la-espalda-a-sus-promesas-climaticas/) reported that leaked documents revealed Deutsche Bank turned its back on climate promises regarding emissions reduction.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Der Spiegel International](https://www.spiegel.de/international/business/epstein-and-deutsche-bank-the-filings-identfied-payments-made-to-women-a-e8f529f6-c583-4c99-a432-d0684c6697d7#ref=rss) reported that documents from Deutsche Bank show the financial institution processed many more payments for Jeffrey Epstein than previously known.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/88667080) reported that Deutsche Bank is at the center of a scandal following an investigation based on millions of internal documents leaked to the press involving Russian oligarchs, Epstein, and Trump.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Der Spiegel International](https://www.spiegel.de/international/business/the-bank-and-the-oligarchs-how-deutsche-bank-continued-expanding-in-russia-despite-the-warning-signs-a-668c08a5-0383-4d66-86b5-671b3c348774#ref=rss) reported that Deutsche Bank decided to continue expanding operations in Russia despite Putin's aggression following the Donbas, Crimea, and European attacks.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://c-level.folha.uol.com.br/financas/2026/11/deutsche-bank-autorizou-transacoes-potencialmente-ilicitas-na-colombia-mostram-documentos.shtml) reported that documents show Deutsche Bank authorized thousands of potentially illicit transactions in Colombia.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/deutsche-bank-chair-backs-ceo-after-reports-expose-past-lapses-trump-calls-tax-leak-illegal/article71715150.ece) reported that the Deutsche Bank chair backed the CEO after leaked records exposed past financial lapses, and the German Finance Minister called for an investigation.

On 18 Nov 2026, [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/politica/los-papeles-del-deutsche-bank-exponen-operaciones-que-vinculan-a-trump-con-rusia-y-us5819-millones-nid18112026/) reported that the leaked Deutsche Bank papers exposed operations linking Donald Trump to Russia and millions related to Jeffrey Epstein.

On 18 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/europa/el-banco-aleman-deutsche-bank-es-senalado-de-procesar-transacciones-sospechosas-por-casi-600-millones-de-dolares-vinculadas-a-epstein-y-donald-trump-3601659) reported that Deutsche Bank faces accusations of allowing corruption and ignoring internal controls after being signaled for processing nearly $600 million in suspicious transactions linked to Jeffrey Epstein.

On 17 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/deutsche-bank-acusada-de-permitir-corrupcion-vinculada-a-epstein-trump-y-oligarcas-rusos-33175792) reported that an international investigation led by CLIP and Barracuda Media documented Deutsche Bank links with high-risk clients and suspicious transactions based on a leak of 15 million files.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://c-level.folha.uol.com.br/financas/2026/11/deutsche-bank-falhou-em-controle-e-prevencao-a-lavagem-de-dinheiro-mostram-documentos-vazados.shtml), [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/17/deutsche-bank-falhou-na-prevencao-a-lavagem-de-dinheiro-apesar-de-alertas-internos-revela-investigacao.ghtml) reported that an investigation based on more than 15 million leaked documents revealed that Deutsche Bank maintained serious flaws in its anti-money laundering controls and compliance.

On 17 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20261117-deutsche-bank-shares-drop-after-reports-on-mass-data-leak) reported that Deutsche Bank shares plunged after international media published reports based on millions of leaked emails and documents.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/17/deutsche-bank-shares-fall-as-leak-reveals-trump-tax-document-error) reported that Deutsche Bank shares fell more than 6% after reports based on 15 million leaked records shed light on dealings with clients including Donald Trump and revealed a tax document error.

On 17 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/nov/17/deutsche-bank-dimissed-warnings-risky-clients-reports-claim) reported that an international investigation using leaked internal data claimed the German bank overlooked compliance concerns regarding risky clients to safeguard profits.

On 17 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261117-deutsche-bank-shares-drop-after-reports-exposing-epstein-payments-russia-dealings) reported that Deutsche Bank shares fell more than 6% following media reports detailing dealings with Jeffrey Epstein and Russian oligarchs.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Tehran Times](https://www.tehrantimes.com/news/532266/Deutsche-Bank-processed-582-million-for-Epstein-despite-explicit), [RT](https://rt-english.com/news/648963-whistleblowers-expose-deutsche-bank-dealings-epstein/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS) reported that leaked internal documents indicate Deutsche Bank processed nearly $600 million in suspicious payments linked to Jeffrey Epstein.

On 17 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261117-deutsche-bank-leaks-german-lender-s-dealings-with-russian-oligarchs-under-scrutiny) reported that Germany's finance minister urged full transparency from Deutsche Bank following the leaked records.

On 17 Nov 2026, [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/17/world/europe/deutsche-bank-russia-oligarchs-leaked-documents.html) reported that leaked records showed Deutsche Bank courting wealthy Russian clients while bracing for sanctions.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/feature/2026/11/17/deutsche-bank-moved-wealthy-russian-clients-to-switzerland-and-luxembourg-before-the-full-scale-war-helping-shield-their-financial-records-from-the-doj) reported that Deutsche Bank moved wealthy Russian clients to Switzerland and Luxembourg after 2014 to protect banking secrecy and avoid disclosing information to the Department of Justice.

On 17 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/deutsche-bank-under-fire-after-internal-documents-made-public/a-79974543?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf), [Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/les-decodeurs/article/2026/11/17/inside-deutsche-bank-les-documents-secrets-qui-lient-donald-trump-a-l-argent-sale-azerbaidjanais_6812989_4355770.html) reported that an international journalistic investigation published internal records detailing Deutsche Bank's dealings with Jeffrey Epstein, Donald Trump, and Azerbaijani and Russian figures.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2044722/inside-deutsche-bank-leak-of-15-million-files-exposes-secrets-scandals-and-double-standards-of-global-financial-giant), [Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/les-decodeurs/article/2026/11/17/inside-deutsche-bank-les-secrets-inavouables-du-geant-bancaire-reveles-par-15-millions-de-documents-confidentiels_6812911_4355770.html) reported that an international journalistic investigation leaked over 15 million internal files from Deutsche Bank detailing scandals, suspicious transactions, sanctioned Russian oligarchs, and Jeffrey Epstein links.

On 16 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261116-francophonie-summit-avoids-major-disaster-after-clash-over-leadership) reported that the Francophonie summit postponed the election of a new chief following a row between DR Congo and Rwanda.

On 16 Nov 2026, [CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/world/dr-congo-rwanda-row-derails-francophone-summit-vote-6555176) reported that the DR Congo-Rwanda row derailed the vote for a new secretary general of the Organisation Internationale de la Francophonie during talks in Phnom Penh.

On 15 Nov 2026, [La Presse (Tunisia)](https://www.lapresse.tn/2026/11/15/a-phnom-penh-au-royaume-du-cambodge-la-tunisie-au-sommet-de-la-francophonie-aujourdhui/) reported that Dhia Khaled led the Tunisian delegation to the International Organization of La Francophonie summit in Phnom Penh.

On 15 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261115-francophone-summit-opens-in-cambodia-overshadowed-by-tensions-in-africa) reported that the 20th Francophonie Summit opened in Phnom Penh, Cambodia, overshadowed by a leadership dispute.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/15/francophone-summit-opens-in-cambodia-amid-rwanda-dr-congo-rift?traffic_source=rss) reported that the Francophone summit opened in Cambodia amidst a clash between the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Rwanda over leadership.

On 15 Nov 2026, [The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/15/world/politics/francophone-summit-congo-rwanda/) reported that the Organisation Internationale de la Francophonie summit opened with a Congo-Rwanda clash.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/dr-congo-rwanda-clash-over-leadership-as-francophone-summit-opens/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that a summit of French-speaking nations opened amid a clash between DR Congo and Rwanda over the organization's leadership, with DR Congo threatening to quit.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/85895265), [Al Wihda (Chad)](https://www.alwihdainfo.com/phnom-penh-accueille-la-48e-conference-ministerielle-de-la-francophonie/) reported that Moldovan Prime Minister Vasile Tofan will attend the International Organization of La Francophonie summit in Phnom Penh.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Rio Times](https://www.riotimesonline.com/congo-rwanda-clash-over-francophonie-vote/) reported that DR Congo stated it will consider dropping its Francophonie candidate while Rwanda refused, and spokesman Patrick Muyaya responded ahead of the leadership vote.

On 14 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/africa/20261114-dr-congo-rwanda-clash-over-francophonie-leadership-as-macron-seeks-compromise), [Punch](https://punchng.com/dr-congo-rwanda-clash-over-francophone-top-job/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that DR Congo and Rwanda clashed over the leadership of the Francophonie.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Jowhar](https://jowhar.com/trump-floats-stephen-miller-as-potential-2028-presidential-candidate/) reported that US President Donald Trump publicly mused about his chief of staff, Stephen Miller, running for the White House.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Egypt Independent](https://www.egyptindependent.com/trump-defends-putin-floats-a-stephen-miller-presidential-run-and-says-hed-work-with-dems-news-briefing-takeaways/) reported that US President Donald Trump defended Putin and floated a Stephen Miller presidential run during a news briefing.

stories.title: Trump and Rutte urge Russia to avoid actions expanding war beyond Ukraine
stories.label: US and Ukraine NATO and territory discussions

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [Politico](https://www.politico.eu/article/donald-trump-diverges-from-nato-statement-emphasizing-ukraine-mustnt-expand-war/?utm_source=RSS_Feed&utm_medium=RSS&utm_campaign=RSS_Syndication), [Hasht-e Subh](https://8am.media/eng/trump-and-nato-secretary-general-discuss-ukraine-war-and-iran-conflicts/) reported that U.S. President Donald Trump emphasized that Ukraine must not expand the war during discussions with NATO Secretary-General Mark Rutte that also covered Iran conflicts and NATO defense spending.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/26/8064852/) reported that Donald Trump's version of a joint statement with NATO chief Mark Rutte urges both Russia and Ukraine to avoid actions that could expand the war.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4188805-trump-and-rutte-urge-putin-not-to-expand-war-in-ukraine.html) reported that U.S. President Donald Trump and NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte issued a joint statement following their meeting in Florida calling on Russia not to expand its war in Ukraine.

On 26 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20261126-live-eu-leaders-face-showdown-over-ukraine-funding-as-divisions-deepen), [RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/ukraine/2026/1126/1600710-trump-nato-ukraine/) reported that US President Donald Trump and NATO chief Mark Rutte urged Russia not to expand its war with Ukraine.
On 26 Nov 2026, [TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/c642559300f1) reported that Rutte stated Trump is testing Putin on his willingness to negotiate.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1586845/kremlin-accuses-estonia-of-aiding-ukrainian-drone-strikes/) reported that the Kremlin accused Estonia of supporting Ukrainian drone strikes, warning that the actions could bring both countries closer to open war.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/ukraine-tells-putin-to-stop-complaining-over-oil-refinery-strikes-says-ending-war-can-stop-attacks-101795611179460.html) reported that Ukraine's Andrii Sybiha told Vladimir Putin to end the war instead of complaining about attacks on Russian oil refineries.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/91134) reported that the Kremlin accused Estonia of aiding Ukrainian drone strikes and warned that the countries were brought to the brink of open war.

On 25 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/russia-tax-increases-putin-ukraine-b3091143.html) reported that Russian President Vladimir Putin has increasingly sought to squeeze tax revenue out of businesses and consumers to support his war in Ukraine.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/90696711) reported that Moscow's Foreign Ministry accused Estonia of a series of hostile actions that are on the verge of triggering an open war, according to Reuters.

On 24 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/ukraine-russia-war-live-nato-estonia-warship-casualties-map-b3090337.html) reported that Estonia decided to close its border with Russia for six months starting from December 1.

On 23 Nov 2026, [OilPrice](https://oilprice.com/Geopolitics/Europe/US-Weighs-NATO-Style-Security-Guarantees-for-Ukraine-as-Russia-Pushes-Back.html) reported that US President Donald Trump may consider offering Ukraine security guarantees modeled on NATO's collective-defense commitments.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/cards/putin-is-reportedly-open-to-article-5-style-security-guarantees-for-ukraine-but-what-does-article-5-actually-say-would-the-guarantees-require-nato-members-to-go-to-war-if-russia-attacks-again) reported that sources close to the U.S. negotiating team stated Putin is open to Article 5-style security guarantees for Ukraine.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Jowhar](https://jowhar.com/russia-warns-estonias-moves-are-close-to-spark-an-open-war/) reported that rhetoric between Moscow and Tallinn spiked sharply after Estonia moved to shut down key border crossings.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/90370831), [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4187592-kushner-says-trump-ready-to-back-article-5like-security-guarantees-for-ukraine-only-if-they-serve-us-interests.html) reported that U.S. presidential envoy Jared Kushner stated that President Donald Trump would approve NATO Article 5-style security guarantees for Ukraine only if they serve American national interests.

On 22 Nov 2026, [RFE/RL](https://www.rferl.org/a/kushner-trump-nato-ukraine-russia-security/33903834.html), [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/22/8064102/) reported that US presidential envoy Jared Kushner stated that US President Donald Trump would consider NATO-style security guarantees for Ukraine if they served American national interests and wider European security.

On 22 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/world/2223081), a Russian state-media outlet, reported that U.S. presidential envoy Kushner shared his vision for future relations between Russia and the North Atlantic Alliance.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/svijet/putin-prelomio-uz-jedan-uslov-pristaje-na-garancije-u-stilu-nato-a-za-ukrajinu/), [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/svet/putin-navodno-pristao-na-snazne-bezbednosne-garancije-za-ukrajinu-po-ugledu-na-nato/xfb82pn) reported that Russian President Vladimir Putin has privately agreed to the idea of post-war security guarantees for Ukraine from the United States and Europe under certain conditions.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4187146-zelensky-ukraines-nato-membership-being-discussed.html) reported that President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said that Ukraine's membership in NATO would be the best security guarantee for the country.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4187167-zelensky-says-ukraine-not-yet-received-official-security-guarantees-equivalent-to-nato-article-5.html) reported that President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Ukraine has not yet officially been offered security guarantees equivalent to NATO Article 5.

On 21 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/internationalrussia-ukraine-war/article-915627) reported that according to The Wall Street Journal, Jared Kushner discussed offering Ukraine NATO membership if it cedes Donbas to Russia during peace talks.

On 20 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/us-zelensky-ukraine-russia-land-swap-b3088764.html) reported that Donald Trump previously ruled out NATO membership for Ukraine while struggling to reach a breakthrough in mediated talks.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90709) reported that the Wall Street Journal stated Washington discussed giving Ukraine full NATO membership if it relinquished part of its territory.
On 20 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/world/2222305) reported that Finnish politician Armando Mema stated the EU pushes Ukraine's NATO membership while ignoring Russia's concerns.

On 20 Nov 2026, [TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/c8f00a762b65) reported that Washington is exploring alternative peace arrangements involving territorial concessions or front-line freezes coupled with NATO membership or international security guarantees.

On 20 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/world/2222153) reported that lawmaker Alexander Dubinsky stated Zelensky lied about coalition support for Ukraine's NATO membership, noting Germany's statement mentioned only security guarantees and continued support.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90651) reported that US envoy Jared Kushner said President Donald Trump wants Europe involved in any Ukraine peace agreement rather than imposing a unilateral settlement.

On 16 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/tv-shows/the-debate/20261116-should-ukraine-trade-donbas-for-nato-membership) reported that President Volodymyr Zelensky stated the United States asked him about a swap where Russia gets the Donbas and the rest of Ukraine gets NATO membership.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/zelenskyy-us-proposal-donbas-withdrawal-nato-membership/) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated US negotiators raised the possibility of Ukraine withdrawing from the eastern Donbas region in exchange for NATO membership.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/international/live/2026/11/16/en-direct-guerre-en-ukraine-volodymyr-zelensky-annonce-la-preparation-d-une-reunion-de-la-coalition-des-volontaires-qui-pourrait-s-averer-historique_6810982_3210.html) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky announced the preparation of a coalition of volunteers meeting to define the European position in future talks with Moscow.

On 15 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/russias-foreign-policy/2218325), a Russian state-media outlet, reported that Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov stated that all participants in the Abu Dhabi talks viewed them positively, with the exception of Volodymyr Zelenskyy.

On 14 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2218191), a Russian state-media outlet, reported that Moscow believes staying out of EANA and other European forums serves the interests of Russian organizations.

On 15 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/ukraine-donbas-russia-war-map-frontline-update-b3085148.html) reported that fresh peace talks in Abu Dhabi failed to reach a meaningful breakthrough.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Burkina 24](https://burkina24.com/2026/11/15/guerre-en-ukraine-washington-evoque-le-donbass-en-echange-dune-adhesion-a-lotan-selon-zelensky/) reported according to Zelensky that Washington raised a possible withdrawal of Ukrainian forces from Donbas in exchange for NATO membership.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/15/give-donbas-take-nato-seat-could-new-us-pitch-work-for-ukraine-russia?traffic_source=rss) reported that a US pitch involving Ukraine ceding Donbas to take a NATO seat is being considered.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Rappler (Philippines)](https://www.rappler.com/world/europe/us-floated-ukraine-ceding-donbas-nato-membership/) reported that President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated Kyiv would not concede territory but would put the question to a national referendum if Ukraine received security guarantees.
On 14 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2218183), a Russian state outlet, reported that Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov took part in a conference on political affairs in Abu Dhabi.

On 14 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2218209), a Russian state outlet, reported that Russian and UAE foreign ministers met in Abu Dhabi to discuss bilateral relations and Persian Gulf tensions.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Politico](https://www.politico.eu/article/finland-rejects-reported-russian-demand-to-leave-nato-as-part-of-peace-talks/?utm_source=RSS_Feed&utm_medium=RSS&utm_campaign=RSS_Syndication) reported that Finnish Defense Minister Antti Häkkänen called the reported Russian demand for Finland to leave NATO outrageous.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90105) reported that Russia revived late-2021 security demands during peace talks with US envoys in Moscow, calling for NATO to withdraw troops to its 1997 borders.

stories.title: Myanmar says it will not comply with 'inappropriate' ICJ genocide orders
stories.label: ICJ ruling on Myanmar Rohingya genocide

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/asia-pacific/myanmar-wont-fully-comply-with-icjs-rohingya-genocide-verdict) reported that Myanmar's military-backed leader stated the government will refuse to comply with parts of the ICJ genocide ruling.

On 26 Nov 2026, [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c61wr87wyg5wo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that the International Court of Justice issued a landmark ruling convicting Myanmar of genocide against its Rohingya minority.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Sky News World](https://news.sky.com/story/myanmar-says-it-will-not-comply-with-inappropriate-icj-genocide-orders-13616762) reported that Myanmar's leader stated the government will not comply with all measures ordered by the international court.

On 26 Nov 2026, [The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/uk-wont-say-if-it-will-enforce-icj-ruling-genocide-gaza) reported that British Prime Minister Andy Burnham has previously resisted political and parliamentary pressure to recognise that Israel has committed genocide in Gaza.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Jowhar](https://jowhar.com/myanmar-rejects-inappropriate-elements-of-genocide-court-ruling/) reported that Myanmar President Min Aung Hlaing stated his government will refuse to follow parts of a United Nations court judgment he deems inappropriate.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/myanmar-says-it-will-not-fully-comply-with-icj-orders-on-rohingya-genocide-verdict-101795679521134.html), [TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/05ec3dec0e08) reported that Myanmar President Min Aung Hlaing stated the country will not fully comply with International Court of Justice orders regarding the Rohingya genocide verdict, adding that the ruling seriously affected the country's reputation.

On 26 Nov 2026, [RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/world/2026/1126/1600718-myanmar-genocide/) reported that Myanmar President Min Aung Hlaing stated his government will not comply with inappropriate aspects of a UN genocide ruling.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261125-icjs-myanmar-genocide-ruling-is-terrible-news-for-israel-palestine-this-week/) reported that the International Court of Justice found a state responsible for committing genocide for the first time in its ruling against Myanmar over the Rohingya.

On 24 Nov 2026, [The Diplomat](https://thediplomat.com/2026/11/uk-announces-fresh-myanmar-sanctions-following-icj-genocide-ruling/) reported that London announced fresh sanctions against Myanmar following the ICJ genocide ruling and stated it will work with international partners to ensure meaningful action.

On 24 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/myanmar-anwar-ibrahim-malaysia-kuala-lumpur-min-aung-hlaing-b3090485.html) reported that Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim stated Malaysia plans to repatriate another 6,803 Myanmar nationals next month.

On 24 Nov 2026, [CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/singapore/mfa-singapore-icj-myanmar-rohingya-genocide-judgment-6577611) reported that Singapore's Ministry of Foreign Affairs stated the country is studying the implications after the ICJ found Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/myanmar-urged-to-comply-with-international-law-after-icj-genocide-ruling-3725925) reported that foreign ministers of 14 countries urged Myanmar to comply with international law following the ICJ judgment.

On 23 Nov 2026, [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c6wy4ng1rznxo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that the UK joined several other nations in sanctioning top Myanmar military leaders following the ICJ genocide ruling.

On 23 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/asia-pacific/20261123-14-countries-acknowledge-icj-ruling-of-genocide-against-rohingya) reported that 14 countries from Europe, Africa, and Oceania acknowledged the ICJ ruling that Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Aravot](https://en.aravot.am/2026/11/23/383020/) reported that Armenians in Armenia and the diaspora have a particular stake in welcoming affirmations of international justice regarding genocide.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Global New Light of Myanmar](https://www.gnlm.com.mm/president-u-min-aung-hlaing-and-spouse-daw-kyu-kyu-hla-open-2026-tazaungdine-mathoe-lotus-robe-weaving-contest/) reported that Myanmar President U Min Aung Hlaing and his wife opened the 2026 Tazaungdine Mathoe lotus robe-weaving contest.

On 23 Nov 2026, [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/europe/article/3375529/uk-sanctions-myanmar-president-military-figures-after-genocide-ruling) reported that Britain announced sanctions against five people under its Myanmar and global human rights sanctions regimes, including senior members of the military government, following the genocide ruling.

On 23 Nov 2026, [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/china/diplomacy/article/3375454/how-will-chinas-ties-myanmar-change-icjs-genocide-ruling) reported that an international court genocide ruling against Myanmar might complicate Beijing's diplomatic engagement with Naypyidaw and cast a shadow over Belt and Road Initiative projects.

On 23 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/law/2026/nov/23/icj-ruling-duty-to-prevent-genocide-international-court-of-justice) reported that experts stated the ICJ ruling on the duty to prevent genocide closes an incoherent gap and has implications for countries such as the UK and Germany regarding arming Israel.

On 23 Nov 2026, [The Diplomat](https://thediplomat.com/2026/11/how-asean-responded-to-the-icjs-myanmar-genocide-ruling/) reported that the region's response to the November 19 judgment against Naypyidaw has been muted.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Le Soleil (Senegal)](https://lesoleil.sn/actualites/genocide-des-rohingyas-la-cij-condamne-le-myanmar-a-linitiative-de-la-gambie/) reported that the International Court of Justice recognized that Myanmar had committed genocide against the Rohingya in Rakhine State, following an initiative by Gambia.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/malaysia-to-engage-un-oic-asean-after-icj-myanmar-genocide-ruling-3725855) reported that Malaysia's Foreign Ministry stated that Kuala Lumpur respects the International Court of Justice judgment holding Myanmar responsible for genocide.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/rohingya-groups-urge-global-action-after-icj-genocide-ruling-on-myanmar-3725837) reported that Rohingya organizations worldwide, in a statement endorsed by 64 groups, demanded immediate international action to enforce the International Court of Justice ruling.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Bangkok Post](https://www.bangkokpost.com/thailand/general/3358955/ties-with-myanmar-stay-despite-icj-ruling-pm) reported that Thailand's Prime Minister stated relations with Myanmar will be maintained despite the ICJ ruling.

On 21 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-915642) reported that France stated it would seek UN Security Council action after Myanmar refused to accept an ICJ ruling finding that its military committed atrocities against the Rohingya.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Egypt Independent](https://www.egyptindependent.com/azhar-welcomes-historic-international-court-of-justice-ruling-on-genocide-against-rohingya-muslims/) reported that Al-Azhar welcomed the historic International Court of Justice ruling regarding Myanmar's genocide against Rohingya Muslims.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/suljagic-nakon-presude-mijanmaru-sud-u-hagu-ne-bi-dosudio-u-korist-bih-ni-da-su-nas-sve-pobili/261121059) reported that Srebrenica Memorial Center Director Emir Suljagic stated the International Court of Justice would not have ruled in favor of Bosnia and Herzegovina against Serbia.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/bih/sta-bi-icj-danas-odlucio-o-genocidu-i-predmetu-bi-h-protiv-srbije/), [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/slucaj-mijanmar-otvorio-pitanje-drukcijeg-ishoda-tuzbe-bih-protiv-srbije-mozda-bi-genocid-bio-utvrden-i-u-prijedoru/261121040) reported that the International Court of Justice ruling holding Myanmar responsible for genocide against the Rohingya raised questions about a different potential outcome in Bosnia's lawsuit against Serbia.

On 21 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/21/rohingya-who-escaped-myanmars-genocide-tell-their-stories) reported that Rohingya survivors who escaped Myanmar's genocide recounted rivers red with blood and burning nearby villages.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/analysis-myanmar-genocide-judgment-may-bolster-gaza-case-against-israel) reported that the International Court of Justice's ruling that Myanmar committed genocide may bolster the Gaza case against Israel.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/world-news/asia-and-australia/2026-11-20/ty-article-magazine/.premium/the-icj-has-found-a-country-guilty-of-genocide-israel-should-be-worried/000001a1-f85f-d5b4-a3bd-f97f72a30000) reported that the International Court of Justice has found a state responsible for genocide for the first time in history, worsening Israel's legal standing.

On 19 Nov 2026, [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c6ly58ndgd0no?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that the BBC's international editor wrote that the Myanmar genocide verdict is historic and could have far-reaching implications.

On 20 Nov 2026, [CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/myanmar-rohingya-genocide-un-icj-6568711), [UN News](https://news.un.org/feed/view/en/story/2026/11/1168853) reported that UN General Assembly President Khalilur Rahman told Rohingya refugees that a judgment on paper must be given effect.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/20/what-does-the-icjs-rohingya-genocide-ruling-mean-for-gaza?traffic_source=rss) reported that the ICJ Rohingya genocide case sets a precedent for establishing a state's intent to commit genocide beyond explicitly written orders.

On 26 Nov 2026, [teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/bangladesh-workers-reject-minimum-wage/), a state-run outlet, reported that at least 320 garment factories remained shut amid labor protests.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1587387/bangladesh-workers-protest-despite-36-wage-increase/) reported that garment workers clashed with police in Bangladesh despite securing a minimum wage increase a day earlier.

On 26 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/global-development/video/2026/nov/26/bangladeshi-garment-workers-clash-with-police-during-protests-video) reported that Bangladeshi garment workers in Gazipur protested over stagnant minimum wages and rising living costs by blocking roads and setting fires.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixwFBVV95cUxQemRiN3hJQ0RYZkhZSi14QkplRnhIVC1SNHAtS0pYM2dBUlpuMExGTWxVVTFzN3JFX0ZSYXVQeTJEaGNtNl9rRDRDcnFYbExFeFRpWjNmRW9RLXZ6eGppaUZLbFdBVV9VeXBTZ0FqNmhQb21FS0R4a3hxVmFLeXo5a2EwZnZfcC1leFg3aUo3aUIzR0pIZnRSQUc5QjhsbjlKcTJjYnJkRzRtaTJhWW5KTDB4Z2VZRXNTVk85Tjc0NThJMGlCZG9n?oc=5) reported that police used tear gas to disperse fresh Bangladesh garment worker protests.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/asia-pacific/police-quell-bangladesh-garment-worker-protests-after-pay-hike) reported that police in Bangladesh fired tear gas and stun grenades to disperse protesting garment workers attempting to block a major highway over wage demands.

On 25 Nov 2026, [The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2642352/bangladesh-raises-minimum-wage-by-36) reported that Bangladesh raised the minimum wage by 36% to 17,000 taka, falling short of worker demands and triggering clashes.

On 25 Nov 2026, [RT](https://rt-english.com/news/649348-bangladesh-garment-workers-protest/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS), [Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/asia-pacific/bangladesh-garment-wage-hike-sparks-fresh-clashes-near-dhaka) reported that fresh clashes erupted between police and garment workers on the outskirts of Dhaka following the approval of the new minimum wage structure.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/bangladesh-raises-garment-workers-minimum-wage-by-36-to-17-000-taka-after-weeks-of-protests-101795577923884.html), [CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/bangladesh-raises-garment-workers-minimum-wage-after-protests-6580411), [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/bangladesh-garment-workers-win-36-wage-rise/article71741049.ece) reported that Bangladesh raised the minimum monthly wage for garment workers by 36 percent to 17,000 taka following weeks of protests.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiywFBVV95cUxOSk9tZVJkeVE3S3BJa0RXYlBQTWl5b3hndUYzNTUtSHRKUjUwTmI0dGN2clF6MUFRNms5djczY1FYeWhBWk41WW1jZFp1Z214ZlIwb1hzNUg0Tzh1N3ZiTUdnNXdDUWtBeW1sSlI5d2lMMThSb05RNkhUaWUyVWVOVWJDWUI0eUNSZmNPTWNidG8zWVV1bGRBWWZfWEVlRWdrU1dpLTBDTTdscVVkOUdJcmVCNmFtUG9TZHBXYnpxdHFiMmlZeElydmxNMA?oc=5) reported that Bangladesh garment workers clashed with police as pay protests forced factories to shut down.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/23/protesting-bangladesh-garment-workers-reject-pay-offer?traffic_source=rss) reported that protesting Bangladesh garment workers rejected a pay offer.

On 23 Nov 2026, [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/bangladesh-garment-makers-eye-15-wage-hike-far-short-of-workers-demand/article71734242.ece) reported that workers are demanding a raise in the minimum monthly wage to 30,000 taka from 12,500 taka, citing soaring costs.

On 26 Nov 2026, [El País](https://english.elpais.com/usa/2026-11-26/judge-rejects-trumps-latest-attempt-to-restrict-birthright-citizenship.html) reported that Magistrate Christopher Cooper rejected Donald Trump's latest attempt to restrict birthright citizenship, reminding the White House it cannot impose exceptions to that right.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/us-judge-bars-trump-administration-from-enforcing-revised-birthright-citizenship-limits-101795657842779.html) reported that two federal judges have blocked enforcement of President Donald Trump's revised order seeking to limit birthright citizenship.

On 25 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics/trump-birthright-citizenship-ruling-supreme-court-b3091774.html), [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/us/politics/article/3375818/us-federal-court-blocks-new-trump-birthright-citizenship-executive-order), [TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/e1a99e76f4b1) reported that a US federal judge blocked President Donald Trump's executive order aimed at restricting birthright citizenship.

stories.title: Russian Strikes Kill 15 in Kyiv Region as Rescuers Search Rubble for Survivors
stories.label: Russian strikes on Ukrainian energy and industrial facilities

reports.text: On 25 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/25/8064615/) reported that Svitlana Kuropiatnik, who was injured in a Russian attack on central Kryvyi Rih on November 20, died in hospital.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/24/8064376/) reported that 33-year-old Kateryna Bovtunenko and her 11-year-old daughter Kira were killed in Dymer when a Russian drone struck a multi-storey residential building.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/24/8064333/) reported that a 79-year-old woman rescued from under the rubble of a residential building in Dymer died in the hospital, bringing the death toll to 12.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90969) reported that search and rescue operations at a destroyed residential building in Dymer concluded with 11 dead following a Russian drone strike.
On 23 Nov 2026, [Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/90456346) reported that a Russian drone strike on an apartment building in Dymer killed at least 11 people.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/23/8064241/) reported that rescue workers found a cat completely buried under the rubble of a building destroyed in Dymer.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187821-russian-strike-on-dymer-claims-11-lives-emergency-rescue-operations-completed.html) reported that emergency rescue operations in Dymer have been completed.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/video/2026/11/23/ukraine-dramatic-night-rescue-pulls-woman-from-rubble-after-22-hours) reported that an elderly woman was rescued alive after spending 22 hours trapped beneath concrete slabs in Dymer.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187563-death-toll-from-russian-strike-on-apartment-building-in-kyiv-regions-dymer-rises-to-11.html), [Daily Maverick](https://www.dailymaverick.co.za/article/2026-11-23-russian-attack-on-ukraines-dymer-in-kyiv-region-kills-11-official-says/) reported that the death toll from a Russian attack on an apartment building in the town of Dymer in the Kyiv region has risen to 11.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187609-two-people-still-missing-after-russian-strike-on-dymer-zelensky-says.html) reported that two people are still missing after the strike on Dymer.

On 23 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/ukraine-kyiv-dymer-russian-strike-b3089574.html) reported that a seven-year-old boy was pulled alive from rubble 14 hours after a Russian strike killed 11 in a residential building, and that Ukraine's interior minister reported over 70 strikes across 10 regions over the weekend.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/russian-attack-on-ukraine-dymer-in-kyiv-region-kills-11-amid-escalating-tensions-101795416493879.html) reported that a Russian attack on Dymer in the Kyiv region killed 11.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/23/russian-air-strikes-kill-at-least-15-people-across-kyiv-region-ukraine-says), [RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/ukraine/2026/1123/1600244-russian-strike-ukraine/), [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90880) reported that Russian air strikes killed at least 15 people across the Kyiv region.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/apartment-building-destroyed-in-kyiv-oblast-following-russian-drone-attack/) reported that a five-story residential building was damaged in the Vyshhorod district of Kyiv Oblast following a Russian drone attack, leaving at least 2 injured.

On 23 Nov 2026, [RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/2026/1123/1600244-russian-attack/) reported that the death toll from a Russian attack rose to 14 in Ukraine as rescuers search for residents trapped under the rubble of a block of flats.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187483-russia-tries-to-cut-off-odesa-and-dnipropetrovsk-regions-from-energy-sources-zelensky.html) reported that President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated Russian forces are attempting to disconnect the Odesa and Dnipropetrovsk regions from their energy sources.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187471-death-toll-from-russian-strike-on-supermarket-in-vyshneve-rises-to-three.html) reported that the death toll from the Russian attack on a store in Vyshneve rose to three, with fifteen people injured.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187474-death-toll-from-russian-attack-in-dymer-rises-to-four-zelensky.html) reported that the death toll from the Russian attack in Dymer rose to four as rescue operations continue.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187456-death-toll-from-russian-attack-on-supermarket-in-vyshneve-rises-to-two.html) reported that the death toll from a Russian attack on a store in Vyshneve in the Bucha district rose to two.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187437-body-of-third-victim-recovered-from-rubble-of-building-in-dymer-kyiv-region.html) reported that the death toll from a Russian attack on Dymer in the Kyiv region rose to three after the body of a third victim was recovered from the rubble.

On 22 Nov 2026, [RFE/RL](https://www.rferl.org/a/ukraine-dymer-russian-strike-apartment-building/33903592.html) reported that rescuers searched for victims after Russian drone strikes destroyed a residential building in the town of Dymer, leaving at least two dead.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/22/8064074/) reported that Tymur Tkachenko stated one person was killed and three were injured after a Russian strike damaged a store in Vyshneve.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187442-russian-forces-pound-dnipropetrovsk-region-with-over-40-attacks-one-killed-several-injured.html) reported that a woman was killed and several other people were injured in Russian attacks on the Dnipropetrovsk region.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/22/8064090/) reported that following a strike on a store in Vyshneve, Volodymyr Zelenskyy reported three dead and 13 injured while Mayor Illia Dikov noted 15 injured.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/22/8064075/) reported that Tymur Tkachenko confirmed a third body was recovered from a partially destroyed five-storey apartment building in Dymer following a Russian drone strike.

On 22 Nov 2026, [RFE/RL](https://www.rferl.org/a/russia-ukraine-apartment-survivors-attack-war/33903536.html) reported that rescuers pulled a second body from the rubble of a Kyiv-region apartment building battered by Russian drones.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187424-woman-injured-in-russian-drone-attack-on-bila-tserkva-district-in-kyiv-region.html) reported that a woman was injured in an attack by Russian drones in the Bila Tserkva district of the Kyiv region.

On 22 Nov 2026, [The Moscow Times](https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/11/22/at-least-4-killed-in-russian-drone-attacks-on-kyiv-region-officials-say-a94345) reported that at least four people were killed in Russian drone attacks on Ukraine's Kyiv region.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187354-body-of-person-killed-in-russian-drone-attack-recovered-from-rubble-of-apartment-building-in-dymer.html), [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/22/8064040/) reported that the body of a person killed in a Russian drone attack was recovered from the rubble of an apartment building in Dymer, Kyiv region.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/22/8064047/) reported that a 10-storey apartment building in the Peremoha residential area of Dnipro was damaged in a Russian drone attack.
On 22 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/22/8064040/) reported that four people have been injured in the attack on Dymer.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187322-russians-attack-energy-infrastructure-in-zhytomyr-region-four-times-in-one-day.html) reported that Russian forces attacked energy infrastructure facilities in the Zhytomyr region four times over the past 24 hours.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/22/8064022/) reported that President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated 14 people may be trapped under the rubble of a five-storey building in Dymer, Kyiv Oblast, hit by a Russian drone.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/russian-attacks-across-ukraine-injure-30-over-past-day-as-rescue-operation-continues-near-kyiv-after-drone-strike/) reported that Ukraine's Air Force said Russian troops launched 186 attack drones overnight, of which 161 were shot down.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/apartment-building-destroyed-in-kyiv-oblast-following-russian-drone-attack/), [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187278-residential-building-damaged-in-russian-drone-attack-in-vyshhorod-district-residents-evacuated.html), [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90829), [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/22/8064011/) reported that a Russian drone attack destroyed part of a five-story residential building in the Vyshhorod district of Kyiv Oblast.
On 22 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/22/8064009/) reported that Russian forces struck 22 settlements in Sumy Oblast, injuring nine people in drone attacks.
On 22 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/22/8064014/) reported that Russian strikes injured five people in Sloviansk and six in Kherson Oblast.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/21/8063987/) reported that Russian drone, artillery, and air strikes injured 11 people in Dnipropetrovsk and Kherson oblasts.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187232-russian-forces-launch-nearly-30-attacks-on-dnipropetrovsk-region-injuring-five.html) reported that Russian forces launched nearly 30 attacks on six districts of the Dnipropetrovsk region, injuring five civilians.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/21/8063945/) reported that President Zelenskyy confirmed a Russian attack on a railway station in Krolevets, Sumy Oblast, that injured three people.

stories.title: Vance stops short of endorsing Trump’s claim that Iran was close to nuclear weapon

reports.text: On 25 Nov 2026, [Military Times](https://www.militarytimes.com/news/your-military/2026/11/25/all-carrier-strike-group-5-sailors-returning-from-deployment-to-be-provided-ashore-accommodations/) reported that sailors from the USS George Washington carrier strike group will be provided ashore accommodations in off-ship beds upon returning from their deployment.

On 21 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/21/vance-trump-iran-nuclear-weapon) reported that US Vice President JD Vance stopped short of endorsing Donald Trump's claim that Iran was close to a nuclear weapon.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Tehran Times](https://www.tehrantimes.com/news/532390/Lula-says-Iran-has-no-intention-of-developing-nuclear-weapons), a state-media outlet, reported that Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva challenged Washington's justification for war against Iran, calling US claims fabricated.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Pakistan Today](https://news.google.?oc=5) reported that US Vice President JD Vance declined to back Donald Trump's Iran strikes despite the president's demand for public endorsement.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1584922/vance-avoids-endorsing-trumps-iran-strike-decision/) reported that US Vice President JD Vance declined to say whether he would have ordered military strikes against Iran as President Donald Trump urged him.

On 20 Nov 2026, [The Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/world/us/2026/11/20/us-vice-president-jd-vance-declines-to-say-he-would-have-ordered-iran-strikes/) reported that US Vice President JD Vance declined to say whether he would have ordered strikes on Iran and called for the US to exit the conflict.

On 20 Nov 2026, [TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/cd9e5cc2714e) reported that US Vice President JD Vance stated the decision to attack Iran was Donald Trump's call and his role is to support the president.

On 20 Nov 2026, [The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/us-vice-president-vance-declines-say-he-would-have-ordered-iran-strikes) reported that JD Vance avoided directly endorsing US strikes on Iran.

On 19 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/uss-george-washington-carrier-iran-b3087975.html) reported that the U.S. military returned to having two aircraft carriers supporting Iran war operations after the USS George Washington departed the Middle East.

On 19 Nov 2026, [The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2641168/us-carrier-uss-george-washington-leaves-middle-east-after-3-months-report) reported that the US carrier USS George Washington left the Middle East after three months, while the USS Theodore Roosevelt and USS George HW Bush carrier strike groups remain in the region.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/donald-trump-calls-jd-vances-iran-ceasefire-memorandum-a-waste-of-time-after-midterm-losses-101795076049336.html) reported that Donald Trump criticized a June memorandum negotiated by Vice President JD Vance regarding an Iran ceasefire, saying he preferred a formal agreement.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/svijet/americki-nosac-aviona-uss-george-washington-nakon-tri-mjeseca-napustio-bliski-istok/261119009) reported that the US aircraft carrier USS George Washington left the Middle East after a three-month deployment in the region.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqwFBVV95cUxPZnlZbjhYV1JEWk1EQ3dZVXZtWG14LW5RT3hwakkyeTZzMzJQcktfM19vZHFkZGc1blFHRFUzTkM0Nko1bVhQNWYwMms5UDVLb0p6NlFkZS1EX21WTjNmTXVQSTlsNDBLN0pvU3h4Y096N3VCMHEwbVZlQ2R2NHBoQ0FKY2xEZXpzakMyZU5hdkxsRk5jbzlUbnpvRHFSUUYxeVRhc0pvVjMtTEU?oc=5) reported that the US military returned to two aircraft carriers in the Middle East.

reports.text: On 23 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/23/police-investigating-bomb-threats-against-schools-in-germany-and-denmark?traffic_source=rss) reported that police are investigating bomb threats against schools in Germany and Denmark following hoax emails sent to schools across Europe earlier in November.

On 23 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/german-police-respond-to-multiple-school-bomb-threats/a-80018842?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that German police are responding to bomb threats against a series of schools but do not believe them to be credible.

On 23 Nov 2026, [NZ Herald](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/world/bomb-threats-emailed-to-german-schools/CIWF7D7MORBVXH54XTOGHHDLRA/) reported that more than 450 schools in Baden-Wuerttemberg received the emailed bomb threats.

On 20 Nov 2026, [TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/8703d9468de5), a state-media outlet, reported that Italian authorities stated school bomb threats were aimed at destabilising institutions and posed no concrete danger.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Pajhwok Afghan News](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimgFBVV95cUxPbjZhbFk0amM2UzJvb1FIRXRrMjhhLWJmUVBUTkZXUExtLXp1VExsR0tKZmQzbFQxT2VpWDk5MDh3TElwdC03bmlZVjktcThjMEs2eWRRbWxWZ0cyRVd5c3lMLXFBSUVEUmMxaGRhcWtRb19YR2tLb01Dem5mX3ROSWpMMXZCY2hOYU5fdXMxajl6aDNNWVdxaW5R?oc=5) reported that Italy received fake bomb threats targeting nearly 7,500 schools.

On 18 Nov 2026, [ANSA](https://www.ansa.it/sito/notizie/speciali/ansa-newsroom/2026/11/18/ansa-newsroom-fuori-tutti-allarme-bomba-nelle-scuole-caos-e-evacuazioni_732f890a-dda9-4cbc-9dca-a464e6d7c70b.html) reported that bomb alarms caused chaos and evacuations at schools.

On 17 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-915187) reported that more than 8,000 bomb hoaxes targeted schools, airlines, and media outlets across Europe, disrupting flights and classes.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/16/italian-schools-hit-by-new-wave-of-bomb-and-poison-threats) reported that under new security guidelines, Italian schools are no longer automatically evacuated for vague mass threats, leaving the decision to schools.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Egypt Independent](https://www.egyptindependent.com/europe-scrambles-to-respond-to-wave-of-bomb-threats-disrupting-transport-media-and-schools/) reported that an unprecedented wave of bomb threats disrupted transport, media, and schools across Europe.

On 12 Nov 2026, [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cr894w453e90o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that schools across Italy received bomb threats for the second day in a row, sparking evacuations.

On 12 Nov 2026, [ANSA](https://www.ansa.it/sito/notizie/cronaca/2026/11/12/nuovi-allarmi-bomba-in-3.800-scuole-ma-si-resta-in-classe_8e554317-0de6-4431-82f1-76e9da9afb9d.html) reported that new bomb alarms hit 3,800 schools in Italy while classes continued.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimwFBVV95cUxQSFJJaFJoR2JHVWdTZmVzdkw2MDhTc29qU0pDRmdmaXpwWjN2Q3VyYjlFUWJkRmJHTmlaNFFYdWIxdTFHR3p5VGlTaGExYzFwZ3BTRjV6dTJuQWdibllJN1lwd3E1RThuUEU2ekpfbU1GSUJwU2tyMkd5a3daSEkwNm5YU19zUEIxLWpSNjNDS0lzT1NCd2ZQRG1COA?oc=5), [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/italian-schools-hit-by-fresh-bomb-threats-premiers-office-targeted-3725511) reported that Italian schools remained open despite a fresh wave of email bomb threats that led to evacuations and security inspections in several regions.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/12/italy-hit-by-second-day-of-school-bomb-threats-as-meloni-summons-opposition) reported that bomb threats hit schools in Italy and France, and French President Emmanuel Macron stated it is too soon to blame foreign powers.

On 12 Nov 2026, [ANSA](https://www.ansa.it/sito/notizie/politica/2026/11/12/nel-pomeriggio-riunione-tecnica-sul-protocollo-di-gestione-degli-allarmi_935b5bfb-8d1b-47fb-b1f5-5bec809755af.html) reported that an official circular was issued to schools stating that evacuations should not occur in the absence of concrete dangers, while prefects retain the authority to order them.

On 12 Nov 2026, [ANSA](https://www.ansa.it/sito/notizie/cronaca/2026/11/12/nuovo-allarme-bomba-nelle-scuole-controlli-e-evacuazioni-liveblog_97a3c6b7-93f4-44a2-940b-dd33198f2f91.html) reported that a new bomb alarm hit schools across various regions via emails signed by Mikhail Andropov.

On 12 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261112-hybrid-warfare-hoax-bomb-alerts-sent-to-schools-in-italy-uk-in-latest-disruption) reported that hoax bomb alerts were sent to schools in Italy and the UK.

On 12 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261112-thousands-of-schools-evacuated-in-italy-as-bomb-threats-spread-across-europe) reported that thousands of schools were evacuated across Italy following a series of hoax bomb threats.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/hoax-bomb-alerts-sent-schools-italy-uk-and-ireland-latest-disruption) reported that schools across Italy were evacuated after around 6,300 of them received bomb warnings.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/europe/hoax-bomb-threats-target-italys-schools-with-over-300-evacuated) reported that Italian authorities evacuated hundreds of schools following a bomb threat sent via email.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/international/article/2026/11/11/les-ecoles-italiennes-irlandaises-et-ecossaises-visees-par-des-alertes-a-la-bombe_6809033_3210.html) reported that thousands of schools in Italy, Ireland, and Scotland received threatening emails.

On 11 Nov 2026, [ANSA](https://www.ansa.it/sito/videogallery/italia/2026/11/11/allarme-bomba-nelle-scuole-italiane-evacuazioni-a-roma-milano-liguria-e-venezia_7aa42fc1-bbfb-4057-a24a-320286389ef8.html) reported bomb alarms across Italian schools with evacuations in Rome, Milan, Liguria, and Venice.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Novaya Gazeta Europe](https://novayagazeta.eu/articles/2026/11/11/tysiachi-shkol-v-italii-velikobritanii-i-irlandii-poluchili-soobshcheniia-s-ugrozami-vzryva-news) reported that thousands of schools in Italy, Great Britain, and Ireland received false bomb threat messages.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/centenas-de-escolas-na-italia-irlanda-do-norte-e-escocia-recebem-ameacas-de-bomba-alunos-sao-retirados.shtml) reported that hundreds of schools across Italy received bomb threats by email.

On 12 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/europa/amenazas-falsas-de-bomba-siguen-alertando-a-europa-italia-irlanda-y-reino-unido-desalojan-escuelas-ante-presuntas-amenazas-3600148) reported that false bomb threats also alerted schools in the UK and Ireland, prompting evacuations.

On 11 Nov 2026, [ANSA](https://www.ansa.it/sito/notizie/cronaca/2026/11/11/allarme-bomba-in-oltre-6000-scuole-in-italia-evacuazioni-e-controlli.-meloni-grande_870b0024-72d2-4b15-bab5-0c74dcc1d653.html) reported that false bomb threats sent via an anonymous email led to evacuations and controls in over 6,000 schools in Italy.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Times of Malta](https://timesofmalta.com/article/threatening-hoax-messages-sent-hundreds-schools-italy-uk-ireland.1136937) reported that threatening hoax messages were sent to hundreds of schools in Italy, the UK, and Ireland.

On 11 Nov 2026, [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cwz0k79pr8z2o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that false warnings containing bomb threats were sent via email to schools in Rome, Naples, Vicenza, Florence, Pisa, Trieste, and other Italian cities.

On 11 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/giorgia-meloni-italian-milan-antonio-tajani-rome-b3083120.html) reported that Italian authorities evacuated around 300 schools after receiving bomb threats via email.

On 11 Nov 2026, [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/europe/article/3374103/over-300-italian-schools-evacuated-after-receiving-same-emailed-bomb-alert) reported that at least 300 schools in Italy were evacuated after receiving the same bomb alert message.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/bomb-threat-emails-trigger-evacuation-of-300-schools-across-italy-101794396853871.html) reported that bomb threat emails triggered the evacuation of 300 schools across Italy amid rising concerns over hybrid warfare threats.
On 11 Nov 2026, [24 Chasa](https://www.24chasa.bg/mezhdunarodni/article/23911182) reported that around 300 schools in Italy received bomb threats sent via email.

On 11 Nov 2026, [De Telegraaf](https://www.telegraaf.nl/buitenland/bommeldingen-op-honderden-scholen-in-italie-ierland-en-schotland/164394527.html) reported that hundreds of schools were evacuated in Italy, Ireland, and Scotland following anonymous bomb threat emails.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/mundo/vuelven-evacuar-cientos-escuelas-italia-falsas-amenazas-bomba-segunda-vez-mes_0_7GXzyxNE7g.html) reported that hundreds of schools in Italy were evacuated for the second time in less than a month following anonymous emails containing bomb threats directed at principals.

On 11 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/mundo/noticia/2026/11/11/pais-correm-para-buscar-filhos-apos-ameacas-de-bomba-em-ao-menos-312-escolas-na-italia-governo-descarta-perigo-iminente.ghtml) reported that at least 312 institutions were affected by the sequence of bomb threats against Italian schools, causing anxiety among parents.

On 11 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-914575) reported that at least 300 Italian schools were evacuated after receiving email bomb alerts signed by Mikhail Andropov.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Echorouk](https://www.echoroukonline.com/%d8%a5%d9%8a%d8%b7%d8%a7%d9%84%d9%8a%d8%a7-%d8%a5%d8%ae%d9%84%d8%a7%d8%a1-%d8%a3%d9%83%d8%ab%d8%b1-%d9%85%d9%86-300-%d9%85%d8%af%d8%b1%d8%b3%d8%a9-%d8%a8%d8%b3%d8%a8%d8%a8-%d8%b1%d8%b3%d8%a7%d8%a6) reported that at least 300 schools in Italy were evacuated after receiving identical emails warning of bombs inside educational institutions.

reports.text: On 24 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/24/fisioterapia-respiratoria-exercicios-motores-e-visitas-de-carlos-e-michelle-a-rotina-de-bolsonaro-na-uti.ghtml) reported that former Brazilian president Jair Bolsonaro follows a routine of respiratory and motor physiotherapy, medical evaluations, and family visits in the ICU.

On 23 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/latinoamerica/expresidente-de-brasil-jair-bolsonaro-es-diagnosticado-con-neumonia-y-seguira-en-cuidados-intensivos-esto-es-lo-que-se-sabe-sobre-su-estado-de-salud-3603546) reported that Bolsonaro was diagnosed with bilateral bronchoaspiration pneumonia and will remain in intensive care after experiencing chills, pain, and vomiting.

On 21 Nov 2026, [O Dia](https://odia.ig.com.br/brasil/2026/11/7324608-moraes-autoriza-filhos-visitarem-bolsonaro-em-internacao.html) reported that Moraes authorized Carlos, Jair Renan, Laura, and the stepdaughter of former president Jair Bolsonaro to visit him in the hospital without mobile devices or other electronic equipment.

On 21 Nov 2026, [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/el-mundo/jair-bolsonaro-esta-internado-en-terapia-intensiva-por-una-obstruccion-intestinal-y-podria-ser-nid21112026/) reported that a tomography scan detected an almost total small bowel obstruction and doctors are evaluating a possible new surgery.

On 21 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/21/bolsonaro-esta-internado-na-uti-com-abdomen-obstruido-em-estado-estavel-e-sem-previsao-de-alta-diz-hospital.ghtml) reported that DF Star hospital stated former Brazilian president Jair Bolsonaro is in the intensive care unit with an obstructed abdomen in stable condition without a discharge date.

On 21 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/21/moraes-autoriza-visita-de-filhos-de-bolsonaro-em-hospital-durante-internacao.ghtml) reported that Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes authorized daily hospital visits for Jair Bolsonaro's children but prohibited the use of mobile phones and other electronic devices during the visits.

On 21 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/jair-bolsonaro-en-cuidados-intensivos-por-una-obstruccion-intestinal-33247549) reported that Jair Bolsonaro is in intensive care due to an intestinal obstruction.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/mundo/jair-bolsonaro-internado-cuidados-intensivos-obstruccion-intestinal-dice-primer-parte-medico_0_IMGmDv1K84.html) reported that the former Brazilian president entered the hospital on Friday and there is no prediction for medical discharge.

On 21 Nov 2026, [MercoPress](https://en.mercopress.com/2026/11/21/former-brazilian-president-jair-bolsonaro-hospitalised-in-brasilia-with-abdominal-pain?utm_source=feed&utm_medium=rss&utm_content=main&utm_campaign=rss) reported that former Brazilian President Jair Bolsonaro was admitted to a hospital in Brasília with abdominal pain and distension.

On 21 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/brazil-ex-president-jair-bolsonaro-taken-to-hospital-over-abdominal-pain/a-80007648?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that former Brazilian president Jair Bolsonaro was taken to a hospital in Brasilia with intestinal obstruction.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Arab News](https://www.arabnews.com/world/brazil-ex-president-bolsonaro-taken-to-hospital-with-abdominal-pain-son-says-3013246) reported that Jair Bolsonaro's son stated the condition was related to past injuries from a 2018 stabbing.

On 20 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/20/bolsonaro-e-internado-em-hospital-apos-episodio-de-dor-abdominal.ghtml) reported that former president Jair Bolsonaro was taken to the DF Star hospital in Brasília after experiencing severe abdominal pain.

On 20 Nov 2026, [O Dia](https://odia.ig.com.br/brasil/2026/11/7324429-bolsonaro-e-internado-com-quadro-de-dor-e-distensao-abdominal.html) reported that Jair Bolsonaro was admitted to a hospital in Brasília with abdominal pain and distension while serving house arrest.

On 20 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/jair-bolsonaro-expresidente-de-brasil-es-hospitalizado-por-fuertes-dolores-abdominales-33236011), [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/jair-bolsonaro-expresidente-de-brasil-es-hospitalizado-de-nuevo-tiene-dolores-en-el-abdomen-dice-su-hijo-carlos/), [El País](https://elpais.com/america/2026-11-20/hospitalizado-el-expresidente-jair-bolsonaro-con-dolores-abdominales-en-brasilia.html) reported that former Brazilian president Jair Bolsonaro was hospitalized in Brasilia due to severe abdominal pains.

On 21 Nov 2026, [El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/mundo/jair-bolsonaro-hospitalizado-fuertes-dolores-abdominales-causados-obstruccion_1795222172), [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/el-mundo/jair-bolsonaro-fue-internado-en-un-hospital-de-brasilia-tras-sufrir-un-fuerte-dolor-abdominal-nid20112026/) reported that Bolsonaro was admitted to the DF Star hospital and remains under house arrest.

stories.label: Cape Verde presidential election

reports.text: On 23 Nov 2026, [AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611230163.html) reported that Cape Verde's elections were loud while its voters are increasingly silent.

On 21 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/mundo/noticia/2026/11/21/jose-maria-neves-e-reeleito-presidente-de-cabo-verde-com-quase-64percent-dos-votos.ghtml) reported that Cape Verde's National Electoral Commission confirmed the re-election of President Jose Maria Neves for a second five-year term with nearly 64 percent of the vote.

On 16 Nov 2026, [CGTN](https://newsaf.cgtn.com/news/2026-11-16/Cape-Verde-s-incumbent-president-declares-re-election-victory-1S7pTVdY97q/p.html?UTM_Source=cgtn&UTM_Medium=rss&UTM_Campaign=World), a state-media outlet, reported that Cape Verde's incumbent president received 80,018 votes, or 63.8 percent, with nearly 97 percent of polling stations reporting.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Le Pays (Burkina Faso)](https://lepays.bf/victoire-du-president-sortant-au-cap-vert-ces-defis-qui-attendent-jose-maria-neves/) reported that incumbent President José Maria Neves was elected without surprise in the first round with nearly 64 percent of the vote.

On 16 Nov 2026, [AMAP (Mali)](https://amap.ml/2026/11/16/cap-vert-le-president-sortant-jose-maria-neves-en-tete-avec-pres-de-64-des-voix/), [Le Soleil (Senegal)](https://lesoleil.sn/international/infos-afrique/cap-vert-le-president-sortant-jose-maria-neves-reelu-pour-un-second-mandat/) reported that incumbent President José Maria Neves won re-election with 63.8 percent of the vote.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/16/cape-verdes-president-neves-projected-to-win-re-election-with-64-of-vote/) reported that preliminary results based on 98 percent of counted ballots showed incumbent President Jose Maria Neves won re-election with 64 percent of the vote.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiuwFBVV95cUxNcWxnVEpfWXdSVkNERnExVXJGbFJzUW5MTFR3MEtGWHBYMFZWZkZHRldTal9oLS00VnJQdnM1MmNJVkhkRFlkVjJEYjVMLWo4Tk5xUzV1OG9Xa1BxYUdmZ3FSaVp5Q0htZGYwcFpZSFZCYnFrR0szX1FRRk1yNHcteXRWWkpvZkFvck5scnFydzRnME55WktPVngxTklNSWxwVUl5Z3B3TWJHZVQwNDY0NG5CbGNuNmphV0o4?oc=5), [Nation (Kenya)](https://nation.africa/kenya/news/africa/cape-verde-president-neves-wins-second-term--5672296) reported that challenger Joana Rosa conceded defeat in the Cape Verde presidential election.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/jos-maria-neves-re-elected-president-of-cape-verde-for-second-five-year-term-101794809266807.html) reported that José Maria Neves was re-elected for a second five-year term in a campaign focused on jobs for young people.

On 16 Nov 2026, [RT](https://rt-english.com/africa/648895-cape-verde-president-wins-second-term/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS), a Russian state outlet, reported that provisional results show Cape Verdean President Jose Maria Neves won a second presidential term.

On 16 Nov 2026, [RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/fr/afrique/20261116-pr%C3%A9sidentielle-au-cap-vert-jos%C3%A9-mar%C3%ADa-neves-rempile-pour-un-second-mandat-de-cinq-ans) reported that provisional results from the presidential election in Cape Verde gave incumbent President Jose Maria Neves a victory for a second five-year term in the first round.

On 15 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/cape-verde-election-jose-maria-neves-set-to-win-second-term/a-79952606?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf), [Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/afrique/article/2026/11/16/au-cap-vert-jose-maria-neves-reelu-president-des-le-premier-tour_6811072_3212.html) reported that provisional results showed incumbent President Jose Maria Neves won a second term in office, winning over 63% of the vote in the first round.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/15/presidential-polls-open-in-cape-verde-with-first-female-candidate/) reported that presidential polls opened in Cape Verde with incumbent Jose Maria Neves favored to win a second term.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMingFBVV95cUxQUWI3OGxfWTRxVTVMY3diaEZFMWZmRlZGYnZ0dnJKSzZqYjN4U2xmMTIyMVJ4U3QxcnI1VEVSblhZck40NTZCaGVhamRFQ2l0VDZnNXhYLTRTRUNRSDNqVW9FQ2pHZXRfQzNQOUEzRG9vaU82Q094M2J0eGo4T3N3QWdadEVmQ3BJR3FPRGNHUXdmcWpWcWItVl9LVERRUQ?oc=5) reported that Cape Verde voted in an election with emigration in focus.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipgFBVV95cUxNNEZaaVg2di1CeGcyQlpLZjBmeHpaYXQ5YTRGMk8xM0NyZkVtSmFuX2d1ckFqOExOMVhmbzk4U0lEYk96VVd3OENPVTd6bERTNTJDQl8tR3ZxS2JZX2xER3JfSHdCRF9JQkxLMm11bnFTYmN1LUN4R3lfRy15MmJsSS04VUEzX183SDFYSVFDaHJIaTJFT1VQeHljX2FFbkYwV0hmY1VB?oc=5) reported that Cape Verde voted in an election that could yield its first woman president since independence in 1975.

On 15 Nov 2026, [The Rio Times](https://www.riotimesonline.com/cabo-verde-polls-open-neves-favored-rosa-challenger/) reported that voting is underway in Cabo Verde with President José Maria Neves favored among six candidates, and a potential run-off scheduled for 29 November.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/15/cape-verde-heads-to-the-polls-in-presidential-election), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/15/polls-open-in-cape-verde-in-race-with-first-female-presidential-candidate?traffic_source=rss) reported that voters in Cape Verde went to the polls for a presidential election where incumbent President José Maria Neves faces opposition candidates including Joana Rosa.

On 15 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/africa/20261115-cape-verde-could-make-election-history-with-first-female-president), [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/cape-verde-could-elect-first-woman-president-since-gaining-independence-in-1975/article71704206.ece) reported that six candidates are competing in the presidential election, which could result in the nation's first female president.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Daily Maverick](https://www.dailymaverick.co.za/article/2026-11-13-cape-verde-president-eyes-new-term-as-party-builds-on-legislative-win/) reported that Cape Verde President Jose Maria Neves is expected to win a second term in office.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/13/cape-verde-presidential-election-neves-seeks-second-term/) reported that the island nation off the coast of Senegal is regarded as one of Africa's strongest democracies.

stories.label: 53 countries, organizations urge Israel to allow rapid humanitarian access to Gaza

reports.text: On 24 Nov 2026, [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261124-eu-must-speak-with-one-voice-to-press-israel-on-humanitarian-access-to-gaza-commissioner/) reported that a European Union commissioner stated the bloc must speak with one voice to pressure Israel into lifting restrictions on humanitarian aid deliveries to Gaza.

On 24 Nov 2026, [The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2642032/us-senators-urge-rubio-to-press-israel-on-winter-aid-for-gaza) reported that US senators urged Secretary of State Marco Rubio to press Israel on winter aid for Gaza.
On 24 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/middle-east/article-915903) reported that the COGAT chief met UN officials to discuss a winter preparedness plan for Gazans.

On 21 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/middle-east/israel-block-aid-gaza-floods-rain-humanitarian-crisis-b3085824.html) reported that 150,000 tents continue to be denied entry into Gaza as the enclave faces flooding.

On 17 Nov 2026, [UN News](https://news.un.org/feed/view/en/story/2026/11/1168821) reported that winter rains are deepening the crisis in Gaza by flooding makeshift shelters, destroying scarce food supplies, and affecting displaced people.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249477/WHO-chief-urges-unrestricted-access-to-aid-in-Gaza), a state-media outlet, reported that World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus stated Palestinians in Gaza need unrestricted access to shelter materials and aid.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261116-german-foreign-minister-calls-on-israel-to-allow-more-aid-to-reach-gaza-before-winter/) reported that German Foreign Minister Johann Wadephul called on Israel to allow significantly more humanitarian aid into the Gaza Strip before winter.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261116-eu-commissioner-calls-on-israel-to-ease-gaza-aid-restrictions-as-winter-deepens-crisis/) reported that European Commissioner Hadja Lahbib called on Israel to ease Gaza aid restrictions on more days as winter deepens the crisis.

On 16 Nov 2026, [The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/australia-uk-canada-italy-urge-israel-rapid-gaza-aid-access) reported that Australia, the UK, Canada, and Italy urged the Israeli government to immediately allow rapid and unimpeded humanitarian access throughout Gaza.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/gaza/2026-11-15/ty-article/.premium/israels-own-numbers-reveal-gaza-aid-deliveries-fell-far-short-of-commitments/000001a1-de03-d1ce-a9a3-fe1371dd0000) reported that IDF data obtained by Haaretz show that since March, the number of trucks entering Gaza has fallen short of the 18,000 monthly target under the cease-fire deal, with shortages in medical supplies and tents.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/australia-canada-italy-uk-urge-israel-to-allow-150000-tents-into-gaza-3725626), [Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/politics/federal/stop-the-delays-wong-counterparts-blast-israel-over-gaza-humanitarian-crisis-20261116-p61eeh.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that the foreign ministers of Australia, Canada, Italy, and the United Kingdom issued a joint statement urging Israel to allow the immediate entry of 150,000 tents and vital aid into Gaza.

On 16 Nov 2026, [El País](https://elpais.com/internacional/2026-11-16/el-reino-unido-australia-canada-e-italia-exigen-al-gobierno-de-israel-que-permita-la-entrada-de-ayuda-humanitaria-en-gaza.html) reported that the UK, Australia, Canada, and Italy demanded that the Israeli government allow the entry of humanitarian aid into Gaza.

On 16 Nov 2026, [The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/europe/2026/11/16/four-foreign-ministers-urge-israel-to-allow-rapid-and-unimpeded-aid-into-gaza/) reported that four foreign ministers urged Israel to allow rapid and unimpeded aid into Gaza.

On 15 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/australia-canada-italia-y-reino-unido-instan-a-israel-a-permitir-acceso-rapido-de-ayuda-para-gaza-se-registran-5-muertos-por-lluvias/) reported that five deaths were registered due to rains and that the WHO stated 950,000 displaced people live under the risk of floods.
