On 14 Nov 2026, [The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/states-urge-israel-open-gaza-land-crossings-winter-hits) reported that at least 50 countries demanded that Israel open land crossings and allow urgent aid as winter approaches.
On 13 Nov 2026, [UN News](https://news.un.org/feed/view/en/story/2026/11/1168799) reported that humanitarians issued an urgent appeal for the swift entry of winter supplies into the Gaza Strip.

On 12 Nov 2026, [The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/mena/2026/11/13/a-group-of-53-countries-urge-israel-to-open-gaza-to-unrestricted-aid/) reported that a group of 53 countries urged Israel to open Gaza to unrestricted aid.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261112-53-countries-organizations-urge-israel-to-allow-rapid-humanitarian-access-to-gaza/), [IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86320364/53-countries-organizations-call-for-unrestricted-humanitarian), [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/53-countries-urge-israel-to-open-gaza-access-3725512) reported that a group of 53 countries and organizations urged Israel to allow rapid and unimpeded humanitarian access to Gaza.

stories.title: At least 490,000 Russian soldiers killed in Ukraine, Rosstat data leak reveals
stories.label: EU foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas says Russian soldiers’ data would be ‘quite easy’ to obtain for

reports.text: On 25 Nov 2026, [The Moscow Times](https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/11/25/kremlin-dismisses-leaked-data-on-russian-troop-losses-a812368) reported that the Kremlin dismissed leaked data on Russian troop losses and has not released an official military death toll since September 2022.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/25/kremlin-dismisses-meduza-s-estimate-of-720-000-russian-war-dead-tells-public-to-trust-defense-ministry-numbers), [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/91188) reported that Kremlin press secretary Dmitry Peskov called for disregarding estimates that more than 700,000 Russian troops have died in the war with Ukraine.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/feature/2026/11/25/more-than-700-000-russian-soldiers-have-died-in-ukraine-more-than-the-u-s-lost-in-world-war-ii-or-the-number-of-boys-born-in-russia-in-a-single-year) reported that journalists at Meduza and Mediazona estimate that at least 700,000 Russian troops have died over nearly five years of the war.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Egypt Independent](https://www.egyptindependent.com/one-every-four-minutes-720000-russian-soldiers-killed-since-start-of-ukraine-war-new-data-suggests/), [Defense News](https://www.defensenews.com/global/europe/2026/11/25/estimates-of-russians-killed-in-ukraine-surpass-all-combined-us-war-deaths-since-wwi/), [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261125-russian-casualties-in-ukraine-war-new-reports-suggest-death-toll-as-high-as-700-000) reported that new analysis of leaked data suggests approximately 700,000 Russian soldiers have been killed since the full-scale invasion of Ukraine.

On 25 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20261125-kremlin-declines-comment-reports-700-000-russian-soldiers-killed-ukraine-war) reported that Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov declined to comment on the casualty reports.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/24/at-least-490000-russian-soldiers-killed-in-ukraine-rosstat-data-leak-reveals) reported that two hacking groups extracted death certificate data from the Russian statistics agency's systems on 1 November.

On 24 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/24/russian-fighters-killed-in-mali-africa-leaked-data), a British state-media outlet, reported that leaked records list 349 deaths in three years in Mali.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/feature/2026/11/24/a-leak-from-russia-s-federal-statistics-agency-made-it-possible-to-estimate-the-country-s-military-death-toll-in-the-war-against-ukraine-what-else-did-it-reveal) reported that journalists from Meduza and Mediazona reached a figure of at least 700,000 Russian service members who have died in the war.

On 24 Nov 2026, [The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/24/world/hacked-ukraine-russian-death-toll/), [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/russia-central-asia/article/3375557/hacked-russian-data-suggests-nearly-500000-soldiers-dead-reports-say) reported that data allegedly stolen by hackers from Russia's statistics agency Rosstat shows the recorded Russian military death toll approaching 500,000.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/russia-ukraine-war-soldiers-killed-on-battlefield-military-suicide-rates-putin-zelenskyy-latest-news-101795515459237.html) reported that a report indicated Russia lost more than 460,000 people from February 2022 to September 2026, with over 1,000 soldiers dying by suicide.

On 24 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-915962) reported that leaked data showed more than 1,000 Russian soldiers died by suicide since the Ukraine invasion, with experts believing the actual number is higher.
On 24 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90999) reported that a study of hacked Rosstat records found at least 490,000 Russian military deaths in Ukraine by September 2026.

On 23 Nov 2026, [RFE/RL](https://www.rferl.org/a/russia-ukraine-war-casualty-estimate-killed/33904373.html) reported that a new analysis found that more than 700,000 Russian soldiers have been killed during the war on Ukraine.

On 23 Nov 2026, [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/23/world/europe/russia-ukraine-war-deaths.html) reported that hacked government data underscored the casualties in the war of attrition.

On 23 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/23/leaked-data-shows-more-than-1000-russian-military-suicides-during-ukraine-war) reported that leaked data showed more than 1,000 Russian military suicides during the Ukraine war.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/russian-war-death-toll-likely-near-700-000-media-reports-after-studying-leaked-government-data/) reported that the Mediazona investigative team reached a figure of nearly 700,000 Russian war deaths after studying leaked government data.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/23/at-least-720-000-russian-soldiers-killed-in-ukraine-by-fall-2026-meduza-and-mediazona-estimate-in-new-analysis-that-includes-missing-troops-for-the-first-time) reported that Meduza and Mediazona estimated at least 720,000 Russian armed forces personnel died in the war in Ukraine by fall 2026.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/18/russia-s-state-duma-approves-law-restricting-library-access-to-books-by-foreign-agents) reported that Russia's State Duma passed a law restricting access to books by foreign agents in libraries in its second and third readings.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/17/eu-foreign-policy-chief-kaja-kallas-says-russian-soldiers-data-would-be-quite-easy-to-obtain-for-an-entry-ban-russia-s-state-duma-speaker-threatens-her-with-20-years-in-prison), [RT](https://rt-english.com/news/648945-kallas-wants-steal-russia-data/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS) reported that EU foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas proposed using intelligence services to obtain personal data of Russian soldiers for an entry ban, prompting a 20-year prison threat from Russia's State Duma speaker.

reports.text: On 25 Nov 2026, [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261125-ghalibaf-says-iran-will-not-negotiate-with-us-until-seven-conditions-are-met-warns-of-wider-war/) reported that Iranian Parliament Speaker Mohammad Baqer Ghalibaf stated Tehran will not negotiate with the United States until seven conditions are met.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Tehran Times](https://www.tehrantimes.com/news/532512/Iran-has-no-reason-to-reopen-Hormuz-US-congressman), a state-media outlet, reported that US Democratic Congressman Richard Ojeda stated the United States cannot portray itself as the gendarme and condemned attacks on schools and hospitals in Iran.

On 24 Nov 2026, [teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/iran-orders-tighter-closure-hormuz/), a state-media outlet, reported that Army Commander Major General Amir Hatami ordered the navy chief to intensify the closure of the Strait of Hormuz.

On 24 Nov 2026, [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/iran-rules-out-talks-with-us-until-its-seven-conditions-are-met/article71739875.ece) reported that three oil tankers had struck naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz and caught fire despite U.S. aerial protection.

On 24 Nov 2026, [IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86330981/No-negotiation-before-Iran-s-seven-conditions-are-met-Ghalibaf), [Tehran Times](https://www.tehrantimes.com/news/532510/Qalibaf-rules-out-action-or-negotiations-until-Iran-s-seven-conditions) reported that Iranian Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf stated that no negotiations will take place until seven conditions set by Iran are met.

On 23 Nov 2026, [OilPrice](https://oilprice.com/Latest-Energy-News/World-News/South-Korea-Asks-Qatar-for-Priority-LNG-Once-Hormuz-Reopens.html) reported that South Korea asked Qatar to prioritize liquefied natural gas supply to the Asian nation when traffic through the Strait of Hormuz normalizes.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261122-iran-says-reopening-hormuz-not-difficult-if-us-accepts-tehrans-conditions/) reported that Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said that reopening the Strait of Hormuz was not difficult if the United States accepted Tehran's conditions.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/usiran-talks-araghchi-says-hormuz-reopening-is-not-difficult-as-qatar-steps-up-mediation-efforts-101795301397814.html) reported that Abbas Araghchi stated the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz is not difficult while Qatar steps up mediation efforts.

On 21 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/world/2222921), a state-media outlet, reported that the foreign minister stated the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz is off the table until Iran's demands are met, and a Qatari delegation held talks in Tehran.

On 21 Nov 2026, [IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86328562/Enemy-spy-drone-downed-off-Iran-s-southern-coast-IRGC), [Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249585/IRGC-says-downed-yet-another-US-reconnaissance-drone), a state-media outlet, reported that the Islamic Revolutionary Guards Corps announced the interception and destruction of an enemy spy and reconnaissance drone off the coast of Bushehr in the northern Persian Gulf.

On 21 Nov 2026, [IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86328309/Iran-s-seven-conditions-basis-for-reopening-Strait-of-Hormuz), a state-media outlet, reported that Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi stated the Islamabad Memorandum of Understanding is no longer on the table and Iran's 'Seven Conditions' proposal forms the basis for reopening the Strait of Hormuz and negotiations.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/21/irans-irgc-downs-us-drone-over-hormuz-as-efforts-to-end-war-remain-stalled?traffic_source=rss), [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1584857/iran-hits-58th-us-drone-sets-seven-hormuz-conditions/) reported that Iran announced seven conditions for reopening the Strait of Hormuz and rejected any transfer of enriched uranium abroad.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249559/Iran-shoots-down-58th-US-MQ-9-drone-over-Hormuz-IRGC) reported that the Islamic Revolutionary Guards Corps announced the destruction of a 58th US-made military MQ-9 drone in the skies of the Strait of Hormuz.

reports.text: On 25 Nov 2026, [IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86332726/Israeli-forces-launch-fresh-drone-artillery-strikes-on-southern) reported that Israeli forces launched fresh drone and artillery strikes on southern Lebanon.

On 24 Nov 2026, [The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2642067/israeli-airstrikes-artillery-shelling-hit-southern-lebanon-as-violations-of-us-deal-continue) reported that Israeli airstrikes and artillery shelling hit areas in Nabatieh, Marjayoun, Bint Jbeil and Tyre districts in southern Lebanon.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/israeli-strikes-hit-southern-lebanon-despite-us-mediated-deal-3725945) reported that Israeli airstrikes, shelling and machine-gun fire hit southern Lebanon despite a US-mediated framework agreement with no casualties reported.

On 23 Nov 2026, [The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/mena/2026/11/23/israeli-military-accused-of-exploiting-lebanese-schoolchildren-in-propaganda-video/) reported that the Israeli military was accused of exploiting Lebanese schoolchildren in a propaganda video.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Naharnet](https://www.naharnet.com/stories/en/323948-lebanon-denounces-israeli-military-official-s-visit-to-school-in-south) reported that Lebanese officials denounced a visit by an Israeli military spokesperson to a school in a Christian village in an Israeli-occupied area of southern Lebanon.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/lebanon-pm-condemns-israeli-army-over-use-of-schoolchildren-in-propaganda-video/), [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261123-lebanon-condemns-israeli-army-raid-on-southern-school-as-hostile-show/) reported that Lebanese Prime Minister Nawaf Salam condemned the Israeli army's entry into Debel Public School in southern Lebanon.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/23/israeli-forces-continue-house-demolitions-in-southern-lebanon?traffic_source=rss) reported that Israeli forces continue house demolitions in southern Lebanon.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/israeli-army-attacks-southern-lebanon-towns-on-saturday-3725824), [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261121-israeli-army-launches-renewed-attacks-on-southern-lebanese-towns/) reported that the Israeli army carried out artillery shelling and gunfire on towns across Nabatieh, Bint Jbeil, and Marjayoun in southern Lebanon.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Arab News](https://www.arabnews.com/middle-east/unifil-records-2840-israeli-artillery-shells-90-airstrikes-in-southern-lebanon-in-october-alone-3013261) reported that the United Nations Interim Force in Lebanon stated Israeli violations continued across southern Lebanon in October, including 2,840 artillery shells and 90 airstrikes.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261120-israeli-attacks-hit-4-districts-in-southern-lebanon-cause-fires-damage/) reported that Israeli forces carried out attacks across four districts in southern Lebanon causing fires and material damage.
On 20 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/world/2222611), a state-media outlet, reported that Israeli reconnaissance drones were heard flying over Beirut at medium altitude for several hours.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261119-israeli-airstrikes-hit-eastern-lebanon-target-homes-buildings-in-south/) reported that Israeli warplanes carried out five airstrikes on a mountainous area in eastern Lebanon while additional airstrikes, drone attacks, and artillery shelling hit the south.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261120-israeli-airstrikes-hit-southern-lebanon-as-drones-fly-over-beirut-sidon/) reported that Israeli warplanes carried out two airstrikes on a town in southern Lebanon and an Israeli military drone flew at medium altitude over Beirut and Sidon.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/15/israeli-drone-filmed-flying-low-outside-homes-in-southern-lebanon?traffic_source=rss) reported that video showed an Israeli drone flying at low altitude over a residential area in southern Lebanon.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/israeli-forces-shell-5-southern-lebanon-towns-as-drones-fly-low-over-beirut-3725535), [Naharnet](https://www.naharnet.com/stories/en/323762-low-flying-drones-buzz-beirut-as-israeli-shelling-targets-southern-towns) reported that Israeli forces shelled five southern Lebanon towns and low-flying drones buzzed Beirut.

stories.label: Israel: Coalition Formation Talks and Political Transitions

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/haaretz-today/2026-11-26/ty-article/.highlight/will-this-man-de-ben-gvirize-israel/000001a2-17d8-d22a-a1bb-17fb613f0000) reported that Yair Golan's coalition deal with Eisenkot brings Netanyahu's ouster closer.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/report-libermans-party-would-take-defense-justice-immigration-posts-3726016) reported that Israel's Channel 13 stated the party of former Israeli Defense Minister Avigdor Liberman would take three ministries under a coalition deal with the Yashar party.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/mid-east/israels-eisenkot-strikes-coalition-deal-with-left-wing-ally) reported that Gadi Eisenkot's centrist party reached a coalition agreement with a left-wing ally.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/international/article/2026/11/26/israel-gadi-eisenkot-et-le-parti-de-gauche-les-democrates-nouent-un-accord-de-coalition-premier-pas-vers-la-formation-d-un-gouvernement_6815576_3210.html) reported that discussions between the two parties had previously been halted due to a lack of agreement on ministerial portfolio distribution.

On 26 Nov 2026, [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/israels-gadi-eisenkot-reaches-deal-with-left-wing-parties/article71747775.ece) reported that the left-leaning Democrats agreed to a coalition deal with Yashar.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/israels-eisenkot-resumes-meetings-left-wing-faction-coalition-talks-gain-steam) reported that ex-military chief Gadi Eisenkot stated he resolved a dispute with a left-wing faction that had posed a challenge to coalition talks.

On 26 Nov 2026, [ABC Australia](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-26/eisenkot-vows-to-form-israeli-government-by-end-of-week/107429976) reported that opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot stated he hopes to form a government within a week following an inconclusive Israeli election.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/mid-east/israels-eisenkot-set-to-announce-new-government-next-week) reported that Israeli Prime Minister-designate Gadi Eisenkot is expected to notify President Isaac Herzog next week that he has formed a government.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261125-israels-eisenkot-plans-to-nominate-golan-for-public-security-post-report/) reported that Israeli Prime Minister-designate Gadi Eisenkot plans to nominate Yair Golan for the public security portfolio.

On 25 Nov 2026, [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/25/world/middleeast/israel-opposition-netanyahu-new-government.html) reported that Gadi Eisenkot set December 6 as the deadline to form a new Israeli government, with ally Avigdor Liberman stating he was on track.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/elections/2026-11-25/ty-article/.premium/eisenkot-aims-to-hold-vote-to-swear-in-minority-government-next-week/000001a2-1324-d52d-afe2-db2432840000) reported that Gadi Eisenkot aims to hold a vote to swear in a minority government next week with ultra-Orthodox lawmakers expected to join and Mansour Abbas abstaining.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Arab News](https://www.arabnews.com/middle-east/israeli-left-wing-party-halts-coalition-talks-with-eisenkot-3013936), [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/israels-eisenkot-faces-new-coalition-challenge-left-wing-faction-suspends-talks) reported that Israel's left-leaning Democrats party announced it was halting coalition talks with Gadi Eisenkot's Yashar party.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/israels-democrats-leader-golan-deletes-post-halting-talks-with-eisenkots-party-3725973) reported that Yair Golan announced the suspension of coalition talks on X before deleting the post.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/eisenkot-bloc-planning-to-form-new-israel-government-by-end-of-next-week-reports-101795598840828.html) reported that the Eisenkot bloc is planning to form a new Israeli government by the end of next week.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1586672/israels-gadi-eisenkot-signs-first-coalition-deal-with-avigdor-lieberman-in-bid-to-form-government/), [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2046976/eisenkot-clinches-first-coalition-agreement-in-bid-to-form-israels-government) reported that Israel’s Yashar party leader Gadi Eisenkot signed his first coalition agreement with right-wing opposition leader Avigdor Lieberman.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-politics/2026-11-25/ty-article/.premium/eisenkot-allies-doubt-a-government-with-likud-the-democrats-are-done-waiting/000001a2-0f74-d9a3-abea-7f76cd310000) reported that Eisenkot allies doubt a government with Likud will materialize and that The Democrats are done waiting.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/25/israels-eisenkot-secures-first-coalition-partner-in-bid-to-form-government?traffic_source=rss) reported that Israel's Eisenkot secured his first coalition partner after the Yashar party agreed to sign a coalition pact with Avigdor Lieberman's Our Home party.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/israels-democrats-party-pauses-coalition-talks-with-gadi-eisenkots-bloc-yair-golan-101795557258994.html) reported that Israel's Democrats party paused coalition talks with Eisenkot's bloc.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Long War Journal](https://www.longwarjournal.org/archives/2026/11/eisenkot-nears-government-formation-deadline-hamas-and-other-groups-violate-ceasefire-20-times-nov-6-24.php) reported that Israeli Prime Minister-designate Gadi Eisenkot intends to announce the formation of Israel’s next government next week.

On 24 Nov 2026, [TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/3b4505297184) reported that Eisenkot aims to conclude coalition talks with Likud and ultra-Orthodox parties this week, ahead of the December 6 deadline.

On 24 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/article-916020) reported that the Democrats halted coalition talks with Yashar due to progress in unity government talks between Gadi Eisenkot's Yashar and Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's Likud.

On 24 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/politics-and-diplomacy/article-916022) reported that Communications Minister Shlomo Karhi warned haredi parties against joining an Eisenkot-led government, stating they would be used and discarded.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-politics/2026-11-23/ty-article/.premium/yashar-and-likud-meet-again-for-unity-government-talks/000001a2-0998-d7ca-abf6-6fdc550f0000) reported that dozens of protesters gathered outside Gadi Eisenkot's home urging him to keep Netanyahu out of the next government as Yashar and Likud met for unity government talks.

On 23 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/politics-and-diplomacy/article-915874) reported that B'Yachad leader Naftali Bennett warned Netanyahu he would face consequences if he deliberately stalled efforts to form a unity government under Eisenkot's leadership.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/netanyahu-eisenkot-parties-end-coalition-talks-in-deadlock/) reported that coalition negotiations between Likud and Yashar parties ended in a deadlock.

On 23 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/politics-and-diplomacy/article-915811) reported that a right-wing official warned that haredi talks with Eisenkot could end a long-standing political alliance.

On 23 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/politics-and-diplomacy/article-915780) reported that Gadi Eisenkot has been holding discussions with Likud, haredi parties, and Arab parties to establish a majority coalition.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/eisenkot-netanyahu-parties-to-meet-again-for-israel-coalition-talks/), [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-politics/2026-11-23/ty-article/.premium/democrats-party-head-urges-eisenkot-to-stop-deceitful-likud-coalition-talks/000001a2-07a0-d43a-adbe-0fed12bd0000) reported that the parties of caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Gadi Eisenkot resumed coalition talks for a joint government, with Democrats party leader Yair Golan urging Eisenkot to stop the negotiations.

On 23 Nov 2026, [La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/internacional/eisenkot-likud-netanyahu-negocian-formulas-gobernar-arabes_202611236b03ee99f6da642efef8784c.html) reported that Gadi Eisenkot and Netanyahu's Likud negotiated formulas to govern without the Arabs on topics including judicial reform, ultra-Orthodox military recruitment, and a committee.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Jowhar](https://jowhar.com/netanyahu-and-eisenkot-factions-fail-to-strike-a-coalition-agreement/) reported that caretaker prime minister Benjamin Netanyahu's Likud and rival Gadi Eisenkot's Yashar party ended another round of coalition talks without reaching an agreement.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261122-unity-government-with-netanyahu-stab-in-the-back-israeli-opposition-leader/) reported that Israeli opposition leader Yair Golan called for forming a minority government and described forming a unity government with caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu as a stab in the back.

On 22 Nov 2026, [NZ Herald](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/world/netanyahu-and-eisenkot-still-deadlocked-over-israeli-government-formation/TWVTQHPPU5BLNBH6TZ4NNAEZZA/) reported that Benjamin Netanyahu and Gadi Eisenkot are deadlocked over Israeli government formation and may end up sharing the role.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/22/netanyahus-likud-eisenkots-yashar-end-coalition-talks-without-deal?traffic_source=rss) reported that the parties remain split over who will lead the next government and whether far-right minister Itamar Ben-Gvir will join.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/israels-netanyahu-and-eisenkot-parties-fail-to-reach-agreement-in-second-round-of-coalition-talks-101795376000592.html) reported that representatives from Eisenkot's Yashar Party and Netanyahu's Likud held a four-hour meeting at a hotel in Herzliya, near Tel Aviv.

On 22 Nov 2026, [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/netanyahu-eisenkot-parties-resume-talks-to-form-israel-government/article71732120.ece) reported that Likud laid down conditions for a unity government including no Arab parties and rejection of a Palestinian state.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261122-netanyahus-likud-eisenkots-yashar-end-unity-government-talks-without-deal-israeli-media/) reported that representatives of Benjamin Netanyahu's Likud party and Gadi Eisenkot's Yashar party ended about four hours of unity government talks without a deal.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/netanyahu-and-eisenkot-parties-resume-talks-form-israel-govt) reported that the parties of caretaker Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and rival Gadi Eisenkot launched a new round of talks on Sunday regarding whether to form a coalition government.

On 22 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/politics-and-diplomacy/article-915687) reported that Yashar stated the planned talks were part of efforts to form a new government and exhaust every possible avenue.

On 21 Nov 2026, [ABC Australia](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-22/gadi-eisenkot-invites-benjamin-netanyahu-israeli-coalition-talks/107413714), [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/middle-east/20261121-eisenkot-invites-netanyahu-s-party-for-marathon-israeli-coalition-talks), [RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/world/2026/1121/1600152-israeli-coalition-talks/), [TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/566b53a9a3ec), [Arab News](https://www.arabnews.com/middle-east/eisenkot-invites-netanyahus-party-for-israeli-coalition-talks-3013421), [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/israel-government-formation-eisenkots-yashar-party-reaches-out-to-netanyahus-camp-for-coalition-talks-101795295951548.html) reported that Gadi Eisenkot's Yashar party has invited Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's Likud party to coalition talks.

On 21 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/politics-and-diplomacy/article-915647) reported that Naftali Bennett confirmed ongoing talks with Likud, ruled out joining Benjamin Netanyahu, and set three conditions for a coalition while urging Eisenkot's bloc to seek a Zionist unity government.

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/video/2026/11/26/aerial-footage-shows-diesel-tanker-sinking-off-ibiza) reported that aerial footage showed a tanker carrying around 7,000 tonnes of diesel capsizing off Ibiza, prompting Spanish authorities to assess marine pollution risks.

On 26 Nov 2026, [OilPrice](https://oilprice.com/Latest-Energy-News/World-News/One-Crew-Member-Dies-as-Diesel-Tanker-Sinks-off-Ibiza.html) reported that local emergency services and authorities stated one crew member died as the diesel tanker sank off the coast of Ibiza in the early hours of Thursday.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/26/vulnerable-waters-spain-scrambles-to-stop-huge-oil-spill-after-ship-sinks-near-ibiza) reported that any pollution entering the water could impact Mediterranean seagrasses that absorb carbon dioxide.

On 26 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/crew-member-dies-after-diesel-tanker-sinks-off-ibiza-coast/a-80059054?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that authorities rescued 17 crew members, but one later died in the hospital.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/26/ship-transporting-7000-tonnes-of-diesel-sinks-off-ibiza-one-crewman-dead), [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/1-dead-after-diesel-tanker-sinks-off-ibiza-coast-spain-launches-pollution-plan-to-control-spill-101795679448475.html) reported that the Malta-flagged chemical tanker Med Emre sank off the coast of Ibiza while transporting up to 7,000 metric tons of diesel, resulting in one crew member dead and Spanish authorities activating an emergency pollution plan.

On 26 Nov 2026, [20 Minuten](https://www.20min.ch/story/ein-toter-oel-notfall-im-mittelmeer-tanker-sinkt-vor-ibiza-103674049), [BILD](https://www.bild.de/news/ausland/mehr-als-1-mio-liter-rohoel-an-bord-ein-toter-oeltanker-sinkt-vor-ibiza-6b07d1c5d4a4a3142c57418a) reported that the oil tanker Med Emre sank off the coast of the Balearic island of Ibiza with over a million liters of crude oil on board.

On 26 Nov 2026, [BILD](https://www.bild.de/news/ausland/mehr-als-1-mio-liter-rohoel-an-bord-ein-toter-oeltanker-sinkt-vor-ibiza-6b07d1c5d4a4a3142c57418a) reported that one crew member died in the incident and an environmental catastrophe is threatened.

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [Egypt Independent](https://www.egyptindependent.com/putin-showed-restraint-by-not-using-nuclear-weapons-kushner-says/) reported that White House envoy Jared Kushner stated Russian President Vladimir Putin showed restraint by not using nuclear weapons.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/feature/2026/11/26/jared-kushner-says-putin-has-shown-restraint-in-ukraine-and-promised-not-to-use-nuclear-weapons) reported that Jared Kushner claimed Vladimir Putin promised not to use nuclear weapons in Ukraine during an interview.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/grandmaster-of-politics-who-wants-peace-jared-kushner-interview-reveals-how-trumps-envoy-sees-putin-2/) reported that US President Donald Trump's envoy and son-in-law, Jared Kushner, praised Russian President Vladimir Putin and repeated Kremlin claims about the war during an interview.

On 26 Nov 2026, [RT](https://rt-english.com/news/649384-kushner-putin-dmitriev-ukraine/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS) reported that Jared Kushner stated Russian leader Vladimir Putin is a grandmaster of politics with a deep understanding of issues.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/26/trump-envoy-jared-kushner-calls-putin-a-historic-figure-and-a-grandmaster-of-politics-praises-his-deep-understanding-of-the-issues) reported that US presidential envoy Jared Kushner called Vladimir Putin a historic figure and a grandmaster of politics.

On 26 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/kushner-putin-witkoff-ukraine-war-b3091967.html) reported that Donald Trump's peace envoy accused European countries of having no plan to end the war in Ukraine.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/26/8064710/), [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/26/kushner-blames-stalled-peace-talks-on-alleged-ukrainian-attack-on-putin-s-residence-an-attack-both-u-s-intelligence-and-trump-say-did-not-happen) reported that US Special Envoy Jared Kushner claimed an alleged Ukrainian attack on Vladimir Putin's residence in December 2025 hindered peace negotiations.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/26/8064714/) reported that Kushner praised Vladimir Putin's approach to negotiations and his assurances that he has no intention of using nuclear weapons.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/26/8064720/) reported that Kushner described the war in Ukraine as Europe's proxy war, claiming Europe is funding and arming Ukraine.

On 22 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/22/intelligence-chief-jay-clayton-trump-putin-my-friend) reported that US Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton was pressed on Trump's characterization of Putin during media appearances on Sunday.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/us-intelligence-chief-jay-clayton-says-putin-is-not-americas-friend-amid-trumps-friend-remark-101795375469720.html) reported that Jay Clayton stated Putin is 'not America's friend in Ukraine.'
On 22 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-915743) reported that US intelligence chief Clayton stated Putin is not America's friend in Ukraine.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/21/8063962/) reported that Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated Ukraine needs security guarantees for decades rather than just for Donald Trump's term.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/20/8063891/) reported that US President Donald Trump declined to outline security guarantees for Kyiv, stating an agreement must come first.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Jamaica Gleaner](http://jamaica-gleaner.com/article/world-news/20261121/takeaways-historic-summit-among-trump-xi-and-putin) reported that United States President Donald Trump, China's Xi Jinping, and Russia's Vladimir Putin held their first-ever meeting in Shenzhen.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/trump-claims-friend-putin-told-him-ukraine-war-wouldnt-have-started-if-he-were-potus-then-101795198522163.html), [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90774) reported that US President Donald Trump claimed Vladimir Putin told him the Ukraine war would not have started if he were president and expressed a desire for peace.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/trump-cites-good-talks-putin-ukraine-holds-back-security-guarantees) reported that US President Donald Trump said he and Russian leader Vladimir Putin held very good talks on Ukraine but held back on security guarantees.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90735) reported that Russia has rejected proposals for NATO-style security guarantees for Ukraine, calling arrangements resembling membership unacceptable.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/europe/us-says-russia-open-to-nato-style-security-guarantees-for-ukraine) reported that U.S. envoy Jared Kushner stated Russia appears willing to accept NATO-style security guarantees for Ukraine after the war.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90681) reported that Jared Kushner stated Russia is becoming comfortable with security guarantees modeled on NATO's collective defense clause.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/20/8063771/), [The Moscow Times](https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/11/20/russia-pushes-back-against-us-idea-of-nato-style-security-guarantees-for-ukraine-a94326) reported that Russian Deputy Foreign Minister Sergei Ryabkov called US ideas for NATO-style security guarantees for Ukraine unacceptable and demanded acknowledgment that Ukraine will not join the alliance, while confirming discussions on a potential visit to Moscow by British, German, and French representatives.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/19/8063712/) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy met with Steve Witkoff, Jared Kushner, and European advisers to discuss security guarantees.
On 20 Nov 2026, [Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/89357897) reported that US envoy Jared Kushner stated the United States is willing to offer Ukraine NATO-style security guarantees.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/20/kushner-trump-open-to-nato-like-security-guarantees-for-ukraine?traffic_source=rss) reported that US envoy Jared Kushner stated President Donald Trump is open to offering NATO-like security guarantees to Ukraine.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/19/european-leaders-unite-in-berlin-to-reaffirm-support-for-ukraine?traffic_source=rss) reported that Russian President Vladimir Putin vowed to retaliate for Kerch Bridge strikes.

On 20 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/20/ukraine-war-briefing-trump-open-to-kyiv-getting-nato-like-mutual-defence-guarantee-says-kushner) reported that France called for a fresh look at Ukraine joining NATO.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249555/Shenzhen-summit-proved-US-can-no-longer-rally-states-on-Iran), [IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86327535/Shenzhen-summit-proved-US-no-longer-able-to-forge-alliance-against), state-media outlets, reported that senior Iranian leader adviser Mohammad Mokhber stated the Shenzhen summit proved the US is no longer able to forge an alliance or rally states against Iran.

On 20 Nov 2026, [La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/internacional/trump-admite-que-reducir-arsenal-nuclear-sumamente-dificil-pese-acuerdo-rusia-china_202611206b00990c5cb1082f89b0ff45.html) reported that US President Trump described his relationship with the leaders of China and Russia as fantastic following the first trilateral meeting between the three powers.

On 19 Nov 2026, [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/19/world/europe/trump-xi-putin-nuclear-weapons-ukraine.html) reported that after their summit, the leaders of Russia, the United States, and China agreed that a nuclear war cannot be won and must never be fought.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisAFBVV95cUxNdERQSHBUWVRvbktIZEo4ZDFTS2FKNzZjRUwzamQ5VjkwUE9RQl9KSkoxdmJ2QmNnT2tzNkdKc2dYNjNNQ2Q3RVNERlB3X1NOa3FUTU5XdmNocGtRdWdSSzIyelZhd3Mwc0JEd0t6dXhicEd4TVRPclNPcy1TTkQwcFE5OVV1WFBrUmNEcWFRenA0TGJYMDh2OWMtaV9PZmd1LXJWa0hUMWU1bE5JSjcwTw?oc=5), [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2045885/trumps-personalised-diplomacy-hits-its-limits-with-3-way-summit) reported that US President Donald Trump's personalized diplomacy has hit its limits with a 3-way summit.

On 19 Nov 2026, [TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/f493945e3c26) reported that President Trump stated a deal with Xi and Putin to limit nuclear weapons will be difficult but he will keep pushing, and that President Xi agreed on limiting nuclear weapons.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Pajhwok Afghan News](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiowFBVV95cUxPX3RYQ05XU192RjlmR2lPUTdzYTEwVHdETC0xdklDNF9kUm5VYzl6ckgzMHN6SHU1RlJPOUFqNUxBQWZYajJvbTFDX0ZSX3NHZllNSVBhLUtEbER2OU40WWpHZzcwajh4eEdFbEl1VGk4djZkR3MzWDU2LUM0WjBFU2tSbEZzaHZBMkJSVmIySURqMjhLM0M1ZmxoT01KSjl0RF9R?oc=5), [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1584282/trump-xi-and-putin-sign-symbolic-peace-declaration-at-unprecedented-shenzhen-summit/) reported that China published a 4-point peace declaration after the meeting between Xi, Putin, and Trump.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/19/xi-jinping-calls-for-total-elimination-of-nuclear-weapons-at-meeting-with-trump-and-putin) reported that Chinese President Xi Jinping called for nuclear weapons to be banned and destroyed entirely during a meeting with Trump and Putin.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Rappler (Philippines)](https://www.rappler.com/world/asia-pacific/trump-xi-putin-peace-declaration-unprecedented-summit/), [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/20/trump-xi-putin-hold-historic-3-way-summit-pledge-peaceful-use-of-nuclear-weapons/) reported that China, the U.S., and Russia issued a symbolic peace declaration emphasizing that nuclear war should never be fought.
On 19 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2221925), a Russian state outlet, reported that Vladimir Putin stated Russia did not start the war in Ukraine and is trying to end it.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/19/u-s-warns-russia-it-should-make-peace-with-ukraine-now-while-trump-still-has-room-to-negotiate-the-kyiv-independent-reports) reported that U.S. President Donald Trump's special envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner told Russian and Ukrainian negotiators that current talks may be the last chance.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90606) reported that after a trilateral meeting in China, Vladimir Putin claimed Russia did not start the war and accused Kyiv of blocking peace.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4186570-kushner-reports-progress-on-security-guarantees-for-ukraine-and-postwar-reconstruction.html) reported that U.S. President Donald Trump's son-in-law Jared Kushner said talks with Ukraine and European partners made progress on future security guarantees and postwar reconstruction.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/20/zelensky-questions-whether-kyiv-and-washington-mean-the-same-thing-by-nato-style-guarantees-and-reiterates-that-postwar-ukraine-would-need-foreign-troops-on-its-soil) reported that Jared Kushner stated the United States persuaded Russia to accept security guarantees for Ukraine based on Article 5 of NATO.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4186578-kushner-confirms-us-considering-nato-article-5like-security-guarantees-for-ukraine.html) reported that the United States is prepared to consider providing Ukraine with security guarantees modeled on Article 5 of the North Atlantic Treaty if they serve U.S. interests.

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-crime/2026-11-26/ty-article-magazine/.premium/netanyahu-trial-bombshell-could-the-charges-collapse/000001a2-141c-d62f-a5ff-df5da9360000) reported on the allegations facing Netanyahu over the last decade and recommendations by judges.

On 26 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/podcast/article-916262) reported that defense attorney Ben-Nun stated the prosecution relied heavily on former Communications Ministry director-general and state witness Shlomo Filber in Case 4000.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Baltic News Network](https://bnn-news.com/world/israeli-judges-suggest-dropping-most-serious-corruption-charges-against-netanyahu-y6x2wsv) reported that Israeli judges suggested dropping the most serious corruption charges against Netanyahu due to a negligible likelihood of conviction.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/benjamin-netanyahu-corruption-trial-israeli-judges-urge-dropping-one-case-raise-doubt-on-another-101795662082804.html) reported that Israeli judges urged dropping one case and raised doubts on another in Benjamin Netanyahu's corruption trial.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/26/judges-recommend-prosecutors-end-corruption-case-against-netanyahu?traffic_source=rss) reported that Israeli judges recommended that prosecutors end the corruption case against Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu due to little prospect of conviction.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/2026-11-25/ty-article/.premium/netanyahus-judges-want-an-exit-the-attorney-general-must-not-give-them-one/000001a2-1413-d0bc-a1bb-1efb19a40000) reported criticism that Netanyahu's judges have become blind to his corruption.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/25/netanyahu-says-corruption-trial-must-end-as-court-suggests-dropping-case?traffic_source=rss), [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/25/world/middleeast/judges-israel-corruption-case-netanyahu.html) reported that judges in Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's trial recommended dropping a key corruption case, prompting Netanyahu to demand that the trial must end.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/2026-11-25/ty-article/.premium/netanyahu-allies-hail-judges-proposals-to-drop-reconsider-cases-in-pms-trial/000001a2-1268-dded-a5f6-f379f37f0000), [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/article-916110) reported that senior Israeli ministers and allies of Benjamin Netanyahu hailed judges' recommendations to drop Case 4000 and called for an end to the corruption trial.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/boost-netanyahu-judges-question-corruption-trial-charges), [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261125-israeli-court-proposes-dropping-bribery-charge-against-netanyahu/) reported that judges at the Jerusalem District Court recommended that the prosecution drop the bribery charge against caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/netanyahu-says-corruption-trial-must-end-after-court-casts-doubt-charges) reported that Netanyahu called for an immediate end to his long-running corruption trial following the court's doubts regarding the charges.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-politics/2026-11-25/ty-article/.premium/netanyahu-says-truth-has-come-to-light-after-judges-urge-dropping-key-charges/000001a2-13a7-d577-a3ea-bfefd5bc0000) reported that Netanyahu criticized a bill that could disqualify indicted candidates for prime minister, comparing it to practices in Iran.

stories.label: US-Iran Tensions: Regional Diplomacy and Maritime Incidents

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [Hasht-e Subh](https://8am.media/eng/tehran-strait-of-hormuz-is-fully-under-irans-control/) reported that Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps Navy commander Ali Azmaei claimed the Strait of Hormuz is fully under Iran's control.

On 26 Nov 2026, [OilPrice](https://oilprice.com/Latest-Energy-News/World-News/Iran-Says-LNG-Carrier-Exploded-After-Hitting-a-Mine-in-Hormuz.html) reported that an LNG vessel caught fire and exploded after hitting a naval mine in the Strait of Hormuz.

On 26 Nov 2026, [IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86333327/Two-more-offending-oil-tankers-hit-naval-mines-in-Strait-of-Hormuz), [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261126-iran-says-2-oil-tankers-hit-naval-mines-catch-fire-near-omans-khasab-port/) reported that the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps Navy stated that two oil tankers hit naval mines and caught fire while traveling near Oman's Khasab port.

On 26 Nov 2026, [IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86333233/Iran-can-sustain-Hormuz-blockade-expand-missile-capabilities), an Iranian state-run outlet, reported that the Islamic Revolution Guards Corps stated Iran has sufficient firepower to keep the Strait of Hormuz closed and is improving its missile capabilities.

On 26 Nov 2026, [OilPrice](https://oilprice.com/Latest-Energy-News/World-News/Oil-Rallies-as-Hormuz-Mine-Strikes-Rattle-Global-Markets.html) reported that crude oil prices rose following fresh reports of oil tankers hitting mines in the Strait of Hormuz.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261125-oil-tanker-catches-fire-after-hitting-naval-mine-in-strait-of-hormuz-iranian-navy/) reported that the Iranian Navy stated an oil tanker caught fire and was left immobilized after striking a naval mine east of the Strait of Hormuz.

On 25 Nov 2026, [OilPrice](https://oilprice.com/Latest-Energy-News/World-News/Iran-Reports-Fresh-Tanker-Explosions-as-Hormuz-Attacks-Intensify.html) reported that two oil tankers exploded after hitting naval mines while attempting to transit the Strait of Hormuz on unauthorized routes.

On 25 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/world/2224855), [Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249700/LNG-carrier-strikes-sea-mine-explodes-in-Hormuz-IRGC) reported that an LNG carrier struck a sea mine and exploded in the Strait of Hormuz after using a route not authorized by Iran.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Tehran Times](https://www.tehrantimes.com/news/532558/Iran-reports-naval-mine-strikes-on-two-tankers-downs-US-drones) reported that Iran's military and maritime authorities stated they downed US drones and reported naval mine strikes on two tankers.

On 25 Nov 2026, [IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86332270/Iran-tightens-security-measures-in-Strait-of-Hormuz-Army), a state-media outlet, reported that Iran's Army spokesperson said the military stepped up surveillance and control of the Strait of Hormuz.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249692/Iran-Army-to-impose-stricter-control-over-Hormuz-Strait-Spox), a state-media outlet, reported that Iran's Army spokesman stated the military enhanced its readiness and tightened control over the Strait of Hormuz.
On 25 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/world/2224405), a Russian state outlet, reported that two oil tankers struck mines in the Strait of Hormuz and fire broke out in their engine rooms.

On 25 Nov 2026, [The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2642226/irgc-navy-says-two-oil-tankers-hit-mines-caught-fire-in-strait-of-hormuz-state-media), [Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249679/Two-more-oil-tankers-explode-in-Strait-of-Hormuz-unsafe-route), [IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86331897/Two-violating-oil-tankers-explode-on-unauthorized-route-in-Strait) reported that the IRGC Navy said two violating oil tankers struck naval mines and exploded in the Strait of Hormuz.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261124-iran-blacklists-26-tugboats-operating-in-strait-of-hormuz/) reported that Iran blacklisted 26 tugboats operating in the Strait of Hormuz for providing services to vessels using an alternative southern route.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Tehran Times](https://www.tehrantimes.com/news/532514/Strait-of-Hormuz-to-become-increasingly-closed-army-chief), a state-media outlet, reported that Iran's Army chief warned the Strait of Hormuz will remain closed and come under increasingly tighter Iranian control until the country's seven conditions are met.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/oil-prices-hit-three-month-lows-as-rising-global-supply-and-surplus-fears-outweigh-strait-of-hormuz-risks-101795523176752.html) reported that oil prices hit three-month lows as rising crude supply, Russian oil imports, and surplus fears outweighed shipping risks in the Strait of Hormuz.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249668/Fourth-oil-tanker-explodes-east-of-Hormuz-Tues-IRGC) reported that the IRGC Navy reported an explosion and fire aboard an oil tanker east of the Strait of Hormuz after hitting a naval mine.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/iran-insists-7-demands-hormuz-crisis-deepens-irgc-targets-tankers) reported that Iranian officials insist the US meet seven conditions, including lifting sanctions, before Tehran agrees to terms.

On 24 Nov 2026, [UK Defence Journal](https://ukdefencejournal.org.uk/us-pulls-more-tankers-out-of-europe-and-the-middle-east/) reported that 17 US KC-135 and KC-46 tankers left Europe and the Middle East with only four replacements sent according to flight tracking.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Hasht-e Subh](https://8am.media/eng/us-and-qatar-stress-ensuring-freedom-of-navigation-in-the-strait-of-hormuz/) reported that Qatari Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al Thani and US Secretary of State Marco Rubio stressed the need to ensure freedom of navigation in the Strait of Hormuz.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261124-qatar-urges-restoration-of-hormuz-navigation-return-to-us-iran-talks/) reported that Qatar called for restoring freedom of navigation through the Strait of Hormuz and a return to negotiations between the US and Iran.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249667/2-violating-oil-tankers-catch-fire-in-east-of-Hormuz-Strait), an Iranian state outlet, reported that the Iranian Army Force announced that two non-compliant oil tankers caught fire after hitting naval mines on an unauthorized route in the Hormuz Strait.

On 24 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/world/2223805), [IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86331202/Strait-of-Hormuz-will-remain-closed-until-Iran-s-conditions-are) reported that Iranian Army Chief Commander Major General Amir Hatami stated the Strait of Hormuz will remain closed until Iran's conditions are fulfilled.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Pajhwok Afghan News](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqAFBVV95cUxOX2xsTTJRZjRhMmNKWmRuOG5KN3NKby13a2tqSzk0SktnTnFFRzR4eGJQN29IbkF5MEh2a2R3SkhRVTRZY1liQ1U2di1JV2p5WmZLcmxpemJhRThJXzAySlNDcXhuZ3djcmFQcGdDUkZtODc3WF8zRVBNc2hjVUhjLVFXMTBjbjk2ZVRFaEs4MTRQRGtaN2FtcGVjRWtUVUdVd2tIYmZHTy0?oc=5), [IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86330775/Three-more-offending-tankers-hit-mines-in-Strait-of-Hormuz) reported that the IRGC Navy announced three separate oil tanker fire incidents after hitting mines in the Strait of Hormuz.

On 24 Nov 2026, [The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/mena/2026/11/24/live-iran-war-hormuz-tanker/), [Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249645/Three-oil-tankers-hit-mines-burn-in-Strait-of-Hormuz) reported that the IRGC Navy stated three oil tankers caught fire after striking naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2026/11/24/iran-war-live-iran-says-three-ships-catch-fire-after-hitting-hormuz-mines?traffic_source=rss) reported that Iran's Revolutionary Guards stated three oil tankers caught fire after hitting naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz.

On 24 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/middle-east/iran-news/article-915899) reported that the IRGC claimed the tankers were being escorted and protected by the US military, but support failed to prevent the incidents from occurring.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Egypt Independent](https://www.egyptindependent.com/iranian-attacks-in-the-strait-of-hormuz-are-at-the-highest-levels-since-the-conflict-began/) reported that maritime data shows reported attacks on shipping in and around the Strait of Hormuz are at the highest levels since the Iran war began.

On 23 Nov 2026, [The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/iran-and-us-trade-threats-tankers-burn-hormuz) reported that Iran and the US have intensified threats regarding returning to all-out war as oil tankers continue to burn in the Hormuz.

On 23 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/middle-east/iran-news/article-915773) reported that maritime data from Kpler shows Iranian attacks on ships in the Hormuz area are at their highest level since the start of the war while the US blockade stops oil exports.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249618/2-violating-supertankers-catch-fire-in-Strait-of-Hormuz-IRGC) reported that the Islamic Revolutionary Guards Corps stated two non-compliant supertankers attempting unauthorized Hormuz transit have caught fire after experiencing explosions.

On 21 Nov 2026, [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c95y1gr27xplo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that ocean campaigner Lewis Pugh completed the Hormuz swim challenge and warned of the environmental cost and lasting damage of war.

On 23 Nov 2026, [The Tide (Nigeria)](https://www.thetidenewsonline.com/2026/11/hormuz-oil-exports-could-decline-amid-inbound-tanker-shortage/) reported that Brent Crude prices slid to around $92 per barrel amid an inbound tanker shortage.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/svijet/dva-supertankera-udarila-u-mine-kod-hormuza-i-zapalila-se-iranci-tvrde-da-su-usli-u-zabranjenu-zonu/261122141) reported that two supertankers hit naval mines east of the Strait of Hormuz and caught fire, according to the Iranian navy.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/globus/1090163/video-dva-supertankera-planula-kod-hormuskog-moreuza-iran-tvrdi-da-su-udarili-u-mine) reported that two supertankers stopped after explosions near the Strait of Hormuz.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261122-iran-says-2-supertankers-struck-naval-mines-near-strait-of-hormuz/) reported that the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps stated two supertankers suffered explosions and were brought to a halt after striking naval mines near the Strait of Hormuz.

On 22 Nov 2026, [IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86328803/Army-exercising-sovereignty-over-Strait-of-Hormuz-Iran), a state-media outlet, reported that Iranian Army spokesperson Brigadier General Mohammad Akraminia stated that Iranian forces maintain control over the Strait of Hormuz.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/mid-east/bahrain-industrial-site-us-positions-targeted-by-fresh-iran-strikes) reported that Bahrain stated an Iranian attack struck a civilian industrial facility, causing a fire and injuring two people.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/middle-east-news/iran/2026-11-22/ty-article-magazine/the-athlete-swimming-through-a-war-zone-to-protest-iran-wars-impact-on-wildlife/000001a2-02a2-d9ff-a7b6-93aef6080000) reported that British endurance swimmer Lewis Pugh swam across the Strait of Hormuz to protest the impact of the Iran war on wildlife.

On 22 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/middle-east/20261122-bahrain-accuses-iran-of-striking-industrial-site-as-tankers-hit-in-hormuz) reported that Bahrain accused Iran of striking a civilian industrial site.

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2026/nov/26/net-migration-to-uk-falls-to-lowest-level-since-1997-excluding-pandemic), [The Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/world/uk/2026/11/26/uk-net-migration-falls-to-lowest-level-since-1997-excluding-pandemic/) reported that net migration to the UK fell to 77,000 in the year to June, the lowest level since 1997 excluding the pandemic.

On 26 Nov 2026, [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/uk-net-migration-falls-to-lowest-since-1997-indians-largest-foreign-group-entering-and-leaving-the-country/article71746576.ece) reported that 44,000 Indians arrived for work-related reasons, 77,000 to study, and 5,000 for other reasons, while 28,000 Indians on work visas left.

stories.label: RAF Lakenheath drone activity

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/business/markets/asx-set-for-gains-global-stocks-rise-20261127-p61hqd.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that the Australian sharemarket was set for a positive start and global stocks advanced while Wall Street was closed for Thanksgiving.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261126-soaring-jet-fuel-prices-erode-global-airline-profits-amid-middle-east-conflict/) reported that global airline profits came under pressure from surging fuel costs and airspace restrictions since the war in the Middle East began.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/global-stocks-rebound-after-ai-sell-off-as-investors-assess-trumps-tariffs-oil-prices-and-inflation-risks-101795689444252.html) reported that global stocks recovered after the artificial intelligence sell-off as investors assessed new tariffs, rising oil prices, inflation risks, and potential trade retaliation.

On 26 Nov 2026, [OilPrice](https://oilprice.com/Energy/Energy-General/Oil-Prices-Rebound-as-Middle-East-Supply-Fears-Return.html) reported that January WTI crude oil futures recovered from a three-month low as renewed concern over Middle East supply brought buyers back into the market.
On 26 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/economy/2225021) reported that Brent oil prices gained 1.5% to reach $96.03 a barrel on London's ICE.

On 25 Nov 2026, [The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2642232/oil-slips-over-1-as-supply-glut-prospect-offsets-middle-east-disruption-fears) reported that Brent crude futures dropped 1.35 dollars, or 1.5 percent, to 90.05 dollars a barrel as supply glut prospects offset Middle East disruption fears.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/qatari-pm-warns-middle-east-cannot-afford-more-us-iran-tensions-3725917) reported that Qatari Prime Minister Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al Thani warned that the Middle East cannot afford another round of tensions between the United States and Iran.

On 24 Nov 2026, [The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2642028/oil-prices-near-three-month-lows-as-rising-supply-offsets-hormuz-threat), [OilPrice](https://oilprice.com/Latest-Energy-News/World-News/Oil-Prices-Hold-Near-Three-Month-Lows-Despite-Hormuz-Mine-Claims.html) reported that oil prices traded near three-month lows as rising supplies offset Hormuz threat claims.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/oil-prices-fall-as-rising-supplies-offset-middle-east-tensions/) reported that oil prices fell due to rising supplies and the reopening of a Libyan oil pipeline.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/oil-prices-slip-as-iran-war-middle-east-shipping-attacks-support-brent-crude-and-wti-despite-weekly-losses-101795431644052.html) reported that Brent crude and WTI oil prices slipped despite support from Middle East shipping attacks and Strait of Hormuz tensions.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1585610/trump-claims-iran-launched-highest-number-of-drone-and-missile-attacks-in-a-year/) reported that Donald Trump stated Iranian aggression surged following recent midterm results and that Iran launched the highest number of drone and missile attacks in a year.

On 22 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-915744), [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/trump-warns-iran-of-fresh-attacks-after-new-year-if-negotiations-fail-to-produce-a-deal-101795389992076.html) reported that Donald Trump warned Iran of fresh attacks after the new year if negotiations fail and threatened to sink vessels.

On 22 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/world/2223073), [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261122-trump-inclined-to-resume-strikes-on-iran-after-new-year-if-no-deal-reached/) reported that US President Donald Trump stated he is inclined to resume military strikes against Iran after the New Year if negotiations fail to produce an agreement.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2026/11/21/iran-war-live-iran-targets-us-military-in-bahrain-houthi-strikes-continue?traffic_source=rss) reported that Bahrain condemned Iran's strikes on US military assets in the country while Houthi strikes continue.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/how-war-has-shifted-irans-missile-ambitions-beyond-middle-east) reported that the conflict has battered Iran's military capabilities and shifted its leadership's missile ambitions beyond the Middle East.

On 21 Nov 2026, [IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86328605/Iran-will-take-all-necessary-measures-to-break-US-blockade-Deputy) reported that Iran's deputy foreign minister stated the country considers the US economic blockade an act of war and will take all necessary measures to break it.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/estados-unidos/trump-dice-que-iran-quiere-un-acuerdo-y-mas-noticias-de-oriente-medio_0_6NgQglcy32.html) reported that President Donald Trump stated Iran wants a real deal while responding with attacks in Kuwait and Bahrain, intensifying regional tension.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/explosion-irans-qeshm-island-linked-disposal-unexploded-munitions-tasnim-reports) reported that an explosion and smoke on Iran's Qeshm Island were linked to the disposal of unexploded munitions.

On 20 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/middle-east/iran-news/article-915601) reported that local sources indicated a blast heard over Qeshm Island was possibly caused by air defenses intercepting an enemy aircraft.
On 19 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/world/2221047) reported that Iranian strikes damaged 15 hangars, warehouses, and at least ten other facilities at a US air base in Kuwait.

stories.title: South Korea Scrambles Jets as Russian Warplanes Inch Toward Air Defense Zone
stories.label: Russian warplanes enter South Korean air defense zone

reports.text: On 24 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/24/aje-onl-nf_russian-jets-spark-air-raid-alert-in-south-korea-241126?traffic_source=rss) reported that South Korean residents were urged to seek shelter as Russian military jets approached airspace.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/ukraine-war-latest-evacuation-air-raid-russian-military-aircraft-approach-south-korean-island-trigger-alert/) reported that Russian military aircraft approached a South Korean island and triggered an air raid alert.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/24/south-korea-tells-island-residents-to-take-shelter-as-russian-warplanes-near-its-airspace) reported that South Korea issued a rare shelter warning for an inhabited island as Russian warplanes neared its airspace.

On 24 Nov 2026, [The Moscow Times](https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/11/24/south-korea-says-russian-military-planes-entered-its-air-defense-zone-a94358) reported that Russian aircraft left the defense zone after South Korean forces took military measures, including deploying fighter jets.

On 24 Nov 2026, [NZ Herald](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/world/south-korea-says-russian-jets-entered-air-defence-zone/WV7XJTSF6VGBVLY3JQOVCRGCNM/) reported that the Russian aircraft entered South Korea's defence zone but did not breach its airspace.
On 24 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/world/2223801), a Russian state outlet, reported that South Korea lodged a protest with the Russian military attache over aircraft overflights.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/24/why-s-korea-issued-air-raid-alert-after-russian-jets-flew-near-its-airspace?traffic_source=rss) reported that South Korean authorities issued air raid warnings after several Russian jets approached its airspace.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/evacuation-air-raid-russian-aircraft-approach-south-korean-island-trigger-air-raid-alert-2/) reported that the alert was the first time South Korea's military issued a preliminary air raid alert over a possible airspace intrusion by Russian warplanes.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Yonhap](https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20261124002252315) reported that several Russian warplanes briefly flew into South Korea's air defense identification zone, prompting a brief alert on an eastern island.

On 24 Nov 2026, [The Korea Herald](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10946997), [Yonhap](https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20261124002251315) reported that several Russian military aircraft entered South Korea's air defense identification zone over the East Sea and approached Ulleungdo Island.

On 24 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/24/south-korea-tells-island-residents-to-take-shelter-after-russian-military-aircraft-approach) reported that South Korea told island residents to take shelter after Russian military aircraft approached.
On 24 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/world/2223663) reported that South Korea's Joint Chiefs of Staff acknowledged that the Russian planes did not violate South Korean airspace.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiyAFBVV95cUxPVnMyeTNTLWNPT1JoWVRGdTZmb2hnVi1USk9WNldKUVNfVWkzRk5RSjI5UlVIYkprbnEtOFplWGdpd2JoWmtZeEVZQTF6TGJJU0tEZXhsYVVNaHl1OVlfOF9sc3lHUUdzNXBpeHNqUTF0ZXY2VTcxbHEwbHluRF9sR3N0WnR1T3R1cmRKa1FDSnpOeGJwVVIyN0NhYmF4QmlyZHZjT2JNXzB4ZlY1cTJRNVZtTTluY3lYbmd0TEtlXzA3WUZwTVk3Uw?oc=5) reported that South Korea briefly scrambled fighter jets and issued a warning after Russian aircraft flew off its coast.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/south-korea-says-russian-aircraft-entered-air-defence-zone-fighter-jets-scrambled-101795481448953.html) reported that South Korea stated Russian aircraft flew into the air defense identification zone over waters between the Korean Peninsula and Japan before withdrawing.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Yonhap](https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20261124001300315) reported that multiple Russian warplanes entered South Korea's air defense zone without notice according to the South Korean military.

On 24 Nov 2026, [TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/35dea481821c) reported that the air defense zone extends beyond sovereign airspace and is not defined under international law as territorial airspace.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirwFBVV95cUxPSS12cWZyNHNoNWpmOTNnVWhuWWQwSmY1SDU5SjR5YXdxOWJtakJSVGl1RlZlZ09tbDdEUWVXTVc4dHhmN3RnVzFVRDVQSnR5UnBoTjNMOXJqLWxPUWJpSGdTZDQ2VldRVGd2LWN5bEZuYmoxQVdPcnNxemZGQXNya2p3RkpBVlFhWDlvYzJSWmtuZXFXSWxLYkRxSGpRSTJINjlCRFNpR3BDU1lpTVpJ?oc=5) reported that South Korea stated a suspected North Korean aircraft breached an island's airspace.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/88771253) reported that a Defence Ministry representative in Moldova stated protecting people's lives is a priority when drones fly over airspace and decisions to shoot them down follow extensive analysis.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Defence Blog](https://defence-blog.com/taiwan-f-16-intercepts-russian-tu-95-strategic-bomber/) reported that a Taiwanese F-16 intercepted and photographed a Russian Tu-95 strategic bomber.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Defence Blog](https://defence-blog.com/japan-scrambles-jets-to-intercept-russian-tu-95-bombers/) reported that Japan scrambled jets after two Russian Tu-95 bombers flew between Taiwan and Japan's westernmost island before entering the Sea of Japan.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/87975090) reported that Moldovan Prime Minister Vasile Tofan warned that frequent Russian drone incursions into Moldova's airspace could lead to tragedy and urged the accelerated adoption of defense industry legislation.

On 17 Nov 2026, [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/china/politics/article/3374750/taiwan-tracks-2-russian-warplanes-eastern-coast-ahead-apec-summit) reported that Taiwan's military monitored two Russian warplanes flying near the island.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinAFBVV95cUxOU3NFVmZBSmlQWklpSEpQenktMkVsQ3BRbndZVno0MzZmRHdpdkpOMHlyTTI1X0g5Z2wteEdkQ0d3MG11ZjFwckFzQ0VVbGx4cnFuWXBTZzhDNWM3T2ctdEc4UThLT2FpMVhBcWtBejZ4Q1ExOF9BNXctLUNCLTZjODJkWTBRRVFtSm05V0NGTTlad0doejF1MGxVLUM?oc=5) reported that Tokyo lodged a protest after two suspected Russian aircraft violated Japanese airspace in southwestern Japan.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Daily Maverick](https://www.dailymaverick.co.za/article/2026-11-17-taiwan-japan-flag-incursions-by-russian-aircraft-as-putin-set-to-arrive-in-china/) reported that Taiwan stated it detected two Russian military aircraft flying off its east coast.

On 17 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/japan-scrambles-jets-to-counter-suspected-russian-aircraft/a-79964537?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf), [Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/rest-of-world/completely-unacceptable-japan-lodges-very-stern-protest-after-russian-aircraft-enter-its-airspace/articleshow/135907668.cms) reported that Japan lodged a very stern protest with Moscow after two suspected Russian aircraft violated Japanese airspace.

On 17 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/world/2219281) reported that Chief Cabinet Secretary Minoru Kihara stated Tokyo lodged a diplomatic protest with Moscow after two Russian aircraft violated Japan's airspace.

On 17 Nov 2026, [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/tokyo-lodges-protest-after-aircraft-believed-to-be-russian-violate-japan-airspace/article71710315.ece) reported that according to the Defence Ministry, the last confirmed violation of Japan's airspace by Russian aircraft was off Rebun Island, Hokkaido, in September 2024.

On 17 Nov 2026, [The Korea Herald](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10939841) reported that several Russian military aircraft entered South Korea's air defense identification zone over the East Sea without prior notice, prompting Seoul to deploy fighter jets.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/17/japan-scrambles-jets-after-suspected-russian-planes-enter-airspace-tokyo-says), [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/tokyo-protests-after-two-suspected-russian-aircraft-violate-japanese-airspace-101794900379072.html) reported that Japan scrambled fighter jets and lodged an extremely stern protest after suspected Russian military aircraft violated Japanese airspace.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90302) reported that Japan scrambled fighter jets after suspected Russian aircraft violated its airspace, prompting a diplomatic protest, while South Korea also deployed jets.

On 17 Nov 2026, [CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/east-asia/seoul-deploys-fighter-jets-russian-aircraft-enters-air-defence-zone-6557236) reported that Seoul deployed fighter jets after an unspecified number of Russian aircraft entered and later exited the Korea Air Defence Identification Zone over the Eastern Sea.

stories.title: PM Shehbaz praises Musadik Malik’s diplomatic performance at Delhi SCO Forum
