reports.text: On 25 Nov 2026, [The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2642245/pm-shehbaz-lauds-musadik-maliks-diplomacy-at-delhi-sco-forum), [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1586763/shehbaz-lauds-maliks-representation-at-sco-dialogue/), [Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/pm-shehbaz-praises-musadik-maliks-diplomatic-performance-at-delhi-sco-forum/) reported that Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif praised Federal Minister Musadik Masood Malik for his representation and diplomacy at an SCO cultural dialogue in Delhi.

On 24 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/world/2223759), a state-run outlet, reported that Pakistan's ambassador to Russia Faisal Niaz Tirmizi stated Pakistan hopes President Vladimir Putin will attend the 2027 SCO summit.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/pakistan-offers-evidence-based-talks-with-india-on-terrorism/), [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2046343/any-talks-with-india-on-terrorism-must-be-evidence-based-says-musadik-malik) reported that Pakistani Federal Climate Change Minister Musadik Malik stated in New Delhi that any bilateral talks on terrorism with India must be based on evidence.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1585180/climate-change-enemy-of-civilisations-pakistan-tells-sco-moot-in-india/) reported that Climate Change Minister Musadik Malik declared climate change an enemy of civilisations at the SCO moot in India.

On 21 Nov 2026, [The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2641524/malik-warns-of-climate-threat-to-civilisation-heritage-at-sco-forum-in-new-delhi) reported that Musadik Malik warned of climate threats at the SCO forum in New Delhi and met Tajik and Iranian officials.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/musadik-malik-calls-for-dialogue-to-resolve-issues-during-india-visit/), [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1584860/musadik-malik-urges-evidence-based-solutions-in-delhi/) reported that Pakistani Federal Minister for Climate Change Dr Musadik Malik called for resolving regional issues through evidence-based solutions rather than mutual accusations during his visit to India.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/no-cultural-diplomacy-in-india-as-pakistani-minister-malik-blocked-from-visiting-historic-sites/) reported that Pakistani Federal Minister for Climate Change Musadik Malik was blocked from visiting historic sites in New Delhi.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/pakistan-to-promote-shared-heritage-through-sco-civilisational-dialogue/) reported that Pakistan's participation in the SCO Civilizational Dialogue in New Delhi offers an opportunity to promote shared heritage.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1584347/musadik-malik-arrives-in-india-for-sco-dialogue/) reported that Federal Climate Change Minister Musadik Masood Malik arrived in New Delhi for the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation Civilisational Dialogue Forum.

On 20 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/india-pakistani-minister-visits-delhi-for-sco-forum-amid-frozen-ties/live-79999264?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf), [TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/776aabd4c635) reported that Pakistan Climate Change Minister Musadik Masood Malik arrived in New Delhi for the SCO Civilisational Dialogue Forum in the first high-level visit since 2023.

On 20 Nov 2026, [The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2641334/musadik-malik-arrives-in-new-delhi-to-lead-pakistan-delegation-at-sco-forum), [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2045878/musadik-malik-arrives-in-new-delhi-to-attend-sco-dialogue-forum), [Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/musadik-malik-arrives-in-india-to-lead-pakistans-delegation-at-sco-forum/) reported that Pakistan's Federal Minister for Climate Change Dr. Musadik Malik arrived in New Delhi to lead a delegation at the SCO forum.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1584154/musadik-to-lead-delelgation-for-sco-forum-in-india/) reported that Federal Minister for Climate Change Dr. Musadik Masood Malik will lead the Pakistan delegation to the first Shanghai Cooperation Organisation forum in India.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1583771/pakistani-delegation-led-by-musadik-malik-to-attend-sco-civilizations-dialogue-forum-in-india/) reported that Federal Minister for Climate Change Dr. Musadik Masood Malik will lead a Pakistani delegation to India for the SCO Civilizations Dialogue Forum.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2641093/musadik-malik-set-for-delhi-visit) reported that Musadik Malik's visit to Delhi will be the first by a Pakistani federal minister to India since May 2023.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/pakistan-confirms-first-federal-ministerial-visit-to-india-in-over-three-years-for-sco-moot/) reported that Federal Minister Dr. Musadik Malik will visit New Delhi for the SCO Civilisational Dialogue Forum in the first ministerial visit in over three years.

stories.title: Will Iraq’s return to Jurf al-Sakhar weaken Iran-backed Kataib Hezbollah
stories.label: Iraq security force and oil smuggling dismissals

reports.text: On 25 Nov 2026, [The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/mena/2026/11/25/iraqs-national-security-service-reports-two-more-oil-smuggling-operations/) reported that Iraq's National Security Service reported two additional oil smuggling operations.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Long War Journal](https://www.longwarjournal.org/archives/2026/11/iraqi-forces-enter-jurf-al-sakhar-militia-stronghold-as-pm-seeks-to-consolidate-power.php) reported that Iraqi security forces entered Jurf al Sakhar on November 20 following an investigation.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Tehran Times](https://www.tehrantimes.com/news/532383/Iraq-s-government-and-Kataib-Hezbollah-agree-on-middle-ground), a state-media outlet, reported that the Iraqi government and Kataib Hezbollah reached a middle ground and the government backed down from threats to deploy the army and forcibly remove Kataib Hezbollah members from a town near Baghdad.

On 21 Nov 2026, [The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/mena/2026/11/21/iraqi-governments-control-of-jurf-al-sakhar-marks-rare-success-but-key-issues-remain/) reported that the Iraqi government's control of Jurf Al Sakhar marks a rare success while key issues remain.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261121-iraq-reopens-key-road-linking-jurf-al-nasr-to-karbala/) reported that Iraq reopened a key road linking the Latifiya area, Jurf al-Nasr district, and Karbala.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/will-iraqs-return-jurf-al-sakhar-weaken-iran-backed-kataib-hezbollah) reported that the town of Jurf al-Sakhar and surrounding agricultural areas had been under the control of Iran-backed armed factions since 2014.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261120-iraq-opens-security-command-headquarters-in-jurf-al-nasr-as-troops-redeploy/) reported that Iraq's Federal Police announced the opening of a headquarters for security and army forces in the Jurf al-Nasr area of Babil province.

On 20 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261120-iraqi-forces-strike-compromise-with-powerful-pro-iran-militia) reported that three senior security officials stated Iraq reached a compromise with the Iran-backed militia Kataib Hezbollah.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/iraqi-forces-enter-iran-backed-kataeb-hezbollah-stronghold-3725803) reported that Iraqi government forces moved into Jurf al-Sakher, the main base of Kataeb Hezbollah.

On 20 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/middle-east/20261120-iraqi-security-forces-to-deploy-in-hezbollah-stronghold-under-compromise-deal), [The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/mena/2026/11/20/iraqi-security-forces-move-into-iran-backed-militia-stronghold-of-jurf-al-sakhar/) reported that Iraqi security forces deployed in the Kataib Hezbollah stronghold of Jurf al-Sakhar under a compromise deal.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/iraqi-security-forces-deploy-iran-backed-militia-stronghold-security-officials) reported that Iraqi security forces will deploy in Jurf al-Sakhar on Friday.

On 20 Nov 2026, [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/20/world/middleeast/iraq-militia-iran-kataib-hezbollah.html) reported that Iraqi army and police units were deployed into territory controlled by Kataib Hezbollah for the first time in over a decade.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/iraqi-forces-strike-compromise-powerful-pro-iran-militia-security-officials-say) reported that Iraq has reached a compromise with the Iran-backed militia Kataib Hezbollah according to security officials.

On 19 Nov 2026, [The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/iraqi-forces-enter-militia-stronghold-jurf-al-sakhr-friday) reported that Iraqi forces will begin deploying on Friday in the main stronghold of Kataeb Hezbollah as Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi steps up efforts to rein in the faction.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/iraqi-pm-delays-lebanon-visit-amid-jurf-al-sakhr-standoff) reported that Iraq's prime minister delayed a visit to Lebanon amid a standoff over Kataib Hezbollah vacating Jurf al-Sakhr.

On 18 Nov 2026, [NPR World](https://www.npr.org/2026/11/18/nx-s1-6043167/iraq-environmentalist-marshes-iran-backed-militia-kidnapped) reported that an Iraqi environmentalist was kidnapped and tortured by Iran-backed militias while working to save the marshes.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/gulf/2026/11/18/iraqi-pm-delays-lebanon-visit-amid-standoff-with-iran-backed-militia/) reported that Iraq's Prime Minister delayed a visit to Lebanon amid a standoff with an Iran-backed militia.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261118-iraqs-kataib-hezbollah-rejects-government-ultimatum-to-withdraw-from-jurf-al-sakhr/) reported that Iraq's Kata'ib Hezbollah stated it would not withdraw from its stronghold in Jurf al-Sakhr despite a government ultimatum.

On 18 Nov 2026, [RT](https://rt-english.com/news/648958-iraq-militia-oil-smuggling/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS) reported that Iraq ordered troops into a militia-controlled area over alleged oil smuggling.

On 16 Nov 2026, [The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/iraq-moves-reclaim-jurf-al-sakhr-militias-after-12-years) reported that Iraq deployed tanks and troops ahead of a planned operation to retake Jurf Al-Sakhr from Kataib Hezbollah.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261113-iraq-establishes-special-security-force-to-combat-oil-smuggling-protect-pipelines/) reported that Iraq established a specialized security force to combat oil smuggling and protect its pipeline network.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Arab News](https://www.arabnews.com/middle-east/iraq-pm-sacks-officials-over-oil-smuggling-in-pro-iran-group-bastion-3011926) reported that the Iraqi Prime Minister dismissed nine officials following an investigation into oil smuggling linked to Kataeb Hezbollah.

reports.text: On 25 Nov 2026, [RFE/RL](https://www.rferl.org/a/eu-russia-sanctions-kremlev-trump-jr-sport/33905834.html) reported that the European Union proposed sweeping new restrictions on Russian involvement in European sport under its latest sanctions package.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/exclusive-7-countries-back-eu-push-to-limit-russian-visas-for-tourists-sports/), [Baltic News Network](https://bnn-news.com/world/seven-eu-countries-call-for-urgent-visa-ban-on-russian-athletes-w2na3p5) reported that seven European Union countries called for visas to be denied to Russian and Belarusian athletes.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/23/8064256/) reported that European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen unveiled the EU's 22nd sanctions package against Russia, targeting 60 banks, over 70 shadow fleet ships, ex-combatants, and athletes.

On 21 Nov 2026, [RT](https://rt-english.com/russia/649177-eu-visa-ban-russian-athletes/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS), a state outlet, reported that Sweden announced a Schengen visa ban on Russian athletes and officials.

On 19 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/world/2222103), a state-run outlet, reported that Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk stated the EU will include a ban on visas for Russian athletes in its 22nd sanctions package.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/19/finland-s-entry-restrictions-keep-seven-russian-skaters-out-of-the-helsinki-grand-prix-putin-says-the-decision-undermines-trust) reported that Russia's Foreign Ministry summoned Finland's acting chargé d'affaires to lodge a strong protest over entry restrictions affecting seven Russian skaters at the Helsinki Grand Prix.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/17/8063302/) reported that Finnish authorities refused to allow Russian figure skaters to cross the border, causing them to miss the ISU figure skating competition in Helsinki.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/14/8062828/) reported that Estonia's Culture Ministry informed the International Ski and Snowboard Federation that Russian and Belarusian athletes are barred from entering the country.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/ukraine-war-estonia-bars-russian-belarusian-athletes/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Estonia joined Norway and Finland in restricting Russian and Belarusian athletes from competing on its territory over the war in Ukraine.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirwFBVV95cUxNZ244cUZXcWZEXzlmTHVyY3dqS3RBZndRZWw5dGZrRC1yN1c3QmdDNEhyLWpzbUZxajg1aHBhUUxWUXRfbUlIUWF5MGpxaUlXTDY2Qmp6d2oyRTVzcWFBcHVFZ0xKTkJ2a1JEVEQ1ZGpSOGFOTUNJNm43Q0czcGpNLVFCR2tVUlZFWnk0Nld3N2VvMnF1Y2NZaWd3T05LTUF3eGFrVnc1dlpiMHBTZ05N?oc=5) reported that Norway barred Russian and Belarusian athletes from competitions it hosts.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisAFBVV95cUxOd3JjM01WOVF5dmxMUGVlQ3MtbERUV29oWFdvYnNHUWlialpudTZZMnJyWFFkSHNMX2JGX01wMjVHN0xrc3VMaGV3Y2Z0VjFuS0pJeHltekw1b3ZOVzdfNWdISTFONjRDcHB0RDdPZ25iZ180OXg2WEJaaWtRSnA2cHpzV1pJSWpLNXYySzV1UzZTT3owQk9YVWtScDlGdjVSMGNTaTNHeUVEZUhNSUtTag?oc=5), [The Moscow Times](https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/11/12/finland-moves-to-bar-russian-athletes-from-entry-over-ukraine-war-a94246), [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/12/days-before-major-winter-tournaments-finland-narrows-a-visa-exception-for-russian-athletes-including-those-competing-as-neutrals) reported that Finland tightened visa rules and moved to bar Russian athletes from entry due to the Ukraine war.

reports.text: On 22 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/nafdac-destroys-%e2%82%a622-73bn-fake-substandard-products/) reported that NAFDAC conducted 22 destruction exercises in which unwholesome products worth approximately 22.73 billion naira were destroyed.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/nafdac-destroys-n22-73bn-fake-unsafe-products-records-52-arrests/) reported that NAFDAC destroyed fake and unsafe products worth N22.73 billion and recorded 52 arrests.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/926899-nafdac-destroys-n100bn-counterfeit-products-uncovers-illegal-drug-and-cosmetics-factories.html) reported that NAFDAC destroyed counterfeit drugs, banned alcoholic beverages, and other unsafe products worth N100 billion in Ogun State.

On 21 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/customs-hands-over-n22-3m-seized-illicit-drugs-to-nafdac-ndlea/) reported that the Northern Western Marine Command of the Nigeria Customs Service handed over seized illicit drugs worth over N22.3 million to NAFDAC and NDLEA.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/kebbi-customs-marine-command-hands-over-seized-illicit-drugs-to-ndlea-nafdac/) reported that the Nigeria Customs Service North Western Marine Command handed over seized cannabis sativa and pharmaceutical products to the NDLEA and NAFDAC.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/nafdac-destroys-fake-expired-drugs-drinks-worth-n100bn/) reported that NAFDAC destroyed fake, counterfeit, expired, banned, and substandard drugs and alcoholic drinks worth N100bn.

On 19 Nov 2026, [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/20/nafdac-and-the-menace-of-fake-drugs/) reported that the growing menace of fake, substandard, and adulterated drugs in Nigeria has become a national emergency.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/drug-smuggling-scare-at-apapa-port-as-nafdac-uncovers-suspected-tramadol-hidden-in-corn-starch/) reported that NAFDAC officers uncovered suspected Tramadol hidden in corn starch at Apapa Port.

On 16 Nov 2026, [RT](https://rt-english.com/africa/648912-us-basketball-player-arrested-nigeria-drug-bust/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS) reported that Nigerian anti-narcotics authorities arrested a US basketball player over nearly 34 kilograms of cannabis found at Lagos airport.

On 16 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/africa/greene-damonte-khiree-arrest-cannabis-nigeria-b3085704.html), [Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/us/us-basketball-player-arrested-in-nigeria-with-34kg-cannabis-in-airport-luggage/articleshow/135898109.cms), [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/us-basketball-player-greene-da-monte-khiree-arrested-in-nigeria-with-34kg-of-cannabis-101794853127626.html) reported that an American basketball player named Greene Da’monte Khiree was arrested in Nigeria with 34 kilograms of cannabis in airport luggage.

On 16 Nov 2026, [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cj93rggenq4xo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that an American basketball player was arrested at a Nigerian airport with 34 kilograms of cannabis.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/ndlea-arrests-american-basketballer-over-34kg-cannabis-consignment/), [Punch](https://punchng.com/ndlea-arrests-us-basketball-player-with-33-95kg-cannabis-in-lagos/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web), [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/ndlea-american-basketballer-arrested-with-32-parcels-of-loud-in-lagos/) reported that the NDLEA arrested an American basketball player in Lagos over a cannabis and Loud consignment.

On 15 Nov 2026, [The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/major-blow-to-drug-traffickers-as-ndlea-uncovers-25kg-meth-hidden-in-cereal-packs-arrests-us-basketball-player-with-34kg-loud/), [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/nigeria/1741477-ndlea-arrests-american-basketballer-illict-drugs-lagos-airport/) reported that the agency also uncovered methamphetamine hidden in cereal packs at the Lagos airport.

reports.text: On 23 Nov 2026, [La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/cataluna/aemet-pronostica-hoy-rachas-muy-fuertes-cierzo-tarragona-oleaje-tambien-afectara-cataluna_202611236b0365af50b7057c6d13d423.html) reported that AEMET forecasted very strong wind gusts in Tarragona and high waves affecting Catalonia.

On 22 Nov 2026, [La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/el-tiempo/nevadas-encima-1500-metros-descenso-temperaturas-rachas-fuertes-viento-aemet-avisa-ocurrira-este-domingo-22-noviembre-b50m_202611226b0284f050b7057c6d135ec6.html) reported that AEMET issued warnings for snow above 1,500 meters, temperature drops, and very strong wind gusts.

On 19 Nov 2026, [La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/sociedad/temperaturas-seguiran-bajando-manana-avisos-naranja-olas-lluvias-fuertes-galicia_202611196aff219ef6b335433bb5e087.html) reported that temperatures will continue to drop with orange wave warnings and heavy rainfall in Galicia, with Asturias, Cantabria, and the Basque Country taking the worst part.

stories.title: Russia and Ukraine Hold First Exchange of War Dead Since Rebooted Peace Talks
stories.label: Russia-Ukraine prisoner exchange negotiations

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/91306) reported that Ukraine received the bodies of 250 people whom Russia claims were Ukrainian servicemen.

On 26 Nov 2026, [TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/d90d6f1c0ad1), a state-media outlet, reported that the Kremlin stated European Union funding for Ukraine would make Kyiv less willing to engage in peace efforts.

On 26 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2225171), a Russian state outlet, reported that Kremlin spokesperson Dmitry Peskov stated Russia and Ukraine may hold a prisoner swap soon without specifying a date or number of people.

On 26 Nov 2026, [The Moscow Times](https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/11/26/russia-and-ukraine-hold-first-exchange-of-war-dead-since-rebooted-peace-talks-a812378) reported that Russia returned 250 bodies to Ukraine and received 22 fallen Russian soldiers in exchange.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/26/8064711/) reported that US Special Envoy Jared Kushner stated an upcoming prisoner exchange between Ukraine and Russia will allow thousands of people to return home.

On 25 Nov 2026, [RT](https://rt-english.com/news/649364-kushner-ukraine-proxy-war-russia/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS) reported that US presidential envoy Jared Kushner described the Ukraine conflict as a proxy war between Europe and Russia.
On 25 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/world/2224967) reported that according to Jared Kushner, it is important to focus on post-conflict security architecture.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/91182) reported that European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen stated a European team will take part in the next round of negotiations to end the war in Ukraine.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/25/8064649/), [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/91197) reported that presidential chief of staff Kyrylo Budanov stated a prisoner of war exchange involving up to 1,000 people could take place in late November or early December.
On 23 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/world/2223555), a Russian state outlet, reported that German Chancellor Friedrich Merz stated a new round of Ukraine talks could take place in Abu Dhabi soon.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/90507977) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy urged allies to convene four-party peace talks with Europe, the United States, and Russia.

On 20 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/new-ukraine-talks-including-europe-to-be-held-soon-merz/a-79997961?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that German Chancellor Friedrich Merz stated European leaders could take part in fresh Ukraine talks on neutral ground.
On 19 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90616) reported that the Kremlin stated a prisoner exchange with Ukraine is in its final stages of coordination.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/europe-expects-to-join-new-ukraine-peace-talks-soon-says-merz-101795114233588.html) reported that Friedrich Merz stated Europe expects to join new Ukraine peace talks soon.

On 14 Nov 2026, [RT](https://rt-english.com/russia/648830-europe-delegation-ukraine-talks/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS) reported that European leaders agreed on a delegation for potential Ukraine peace talks.
On 14 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90125) reported that President Volodymyr Zelensky announced that US envoys brokered an agreement with Moscow to exchange 1,200 to 1,300 POWs.

reports.text: On 24 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/24/malaysia-to-send-thousands-of-migrants-back-to-myanmar), [CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/malaysia-repatriate-rohingya-migrants-myanmar-6577096) reported that Malaysian Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim announced that Malaysia will send thousands of migrants back to Myanmar following the ICJ genocide ruling.

On 24 Nov 2026, [The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/24/asia-pacific/politics/malaysia-rohingya-turkey/) reported that Malaysia will continue looking for other countries, including OIC members, willing to take Rohingya refugees.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Arab News](https://www.arabnews.com/middle-east/turkiye-dismisses-malaysias-announcement-of-rohingya-resettlement-3013389) reported that Turkey dismissed a Malaysian announcement stating that it would take in 10,000 Rohingya refugees currently living in Malaysia.

On 20 Nov 2026, [The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/malaysia-scrubs-post-announcing-rohingya-repatriation-turkey) reported that Malaysia appeared to backtrack on a plan to resettle 10,000 Rohingya refugees in Turkey after a post announcing the repatriation was scrubbed.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1584414/malaysia-secures-turkey-deal-for-10000-rohingya/) reported that Malaysia secured an agreement with Turkey to establish a structured program to resettle 10,000 Rohingya refugees.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Pajhwok Afghan News](https://news.google.?oc=5) reported that Malaysia's government stated Turkey is prepared to accept 10,000 Rohingya refugees from the country, with the Malaysian cabinet approving a plan for their transfer and resettlement.

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/26/8064869/) reported that firefighters are battling a blaze at business premises in the Khmelnytskyi district following a Russian attack, with no casualties reported.

On 26 Nov 2026, [RT](https://rt-english.com/russia/649399-ukraine-drone-russia-oil-spill/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS), a Russian state outlet, reported that a Ukrainian drone strike caused fires and an oil spill at a Russian refinery, injuring four people.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/91308) reported that Ukraine struck the Slavyansk oil refinery in Russia's Krasnodar Territory early on November 26, causing significant damage to processing equipment and pipelines.

On 26 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2225443) reported that four civilians were injured after a fire broke out at a refinery in the Krasnodar Region following a drone attack and oil spill.

On 26 Nov 2026, [The Moscow Times](https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/11/26/ukrainian-drone-strike-sparks-fire-and-inflicts-serious-damage-at-krasnodar-a812387) reported that the refinery-operating company stated the attack took place during a maintenance stoppage in place since a previous drone strike in September.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/russias-oil-refinery-runs-plunge-to-lowest-in-over-two-decades-as-ukrainian-drone-strikes-continue-101795659945340.html) reported that according to Rystad Energy, Russia's oil refinery runs fell to 2.6-2.7 million barrels a day, roughly halving since October 30 due to Ukrainian drone strikes.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/91164) reported that Russia launched 112 drones overnight, damaging a Kyiv courthouse and residential buildings alongside morning energy site strikes.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187931-russian-strikes-damage-civilian-and-energy-infrastructure-in-zhytomyr-region.html) reported that Russian forces struck civilian and energy infrastructure in the Zhytomyr region, causing damage.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/24/8064329/), [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187935-russian-attack-damages-business-energy-facility-in-vinnytsia-injuring-four.html) reported that a Russian drone attack on Vinnytsia damaged a civilian business and an energy facility, injuring people.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/23/8064229/) reported that Ukraine's General Staff stated that defense forces struck a Russian Tor air system, Rubicon drone unit personnel in Berdiansk, and UAV ground control stations and depots.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187733-ukrainian-forces-strike-russian-rubicon-units-personnel-concentration-site-in-berdiansk.html) reported that on November 22 and overnight into November 23, Ukraine's Defense Forces struck a personnel concentration site of Russia's Rubicon unit in Berdiansk.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187713-russian-attacks-target-railways-and-energy-infrastructure-since-yesterday-six-killed-across-ukraine.html), [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/23/8064228/) reported that Russian attacks targeting railway and energy infrastructure killed six civilians across Ukraine.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-economy/4187671-lukoil-oil-refinery-in-russia-on-fire-following-drone-attack-media-reports.html) reported that a fire broke out at the Lukoil-Permnefteorgsintez oil refinery in Perm following a drone attack.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/23/8064267/) reported that Ukraine's General Staff confirmed strikes on the Lukoil refinery in Perm in conjunction with the Chernaya Iskra underground resistance movement.

stories.label: Hungary suspends rail services to Ukraine

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/91330) reported that Foreign Minister Anita Orbán announced that Hungary joined the International Coalition for the Return of Ukrainian Children, making all 27 European Union member states part of it.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/26/8064742/) reported that Hungarian Foreign Minister Anita Orbán announced that Hungary is joining the International Coalition for the Return of Ukrainian Children.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4188832-hungary-to-join-international-coalition-for-the-return-of-ukrainian-children.html) reported that Hungary's decision to join the coalition means all 27 European Union member states are now part of it.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/hungary-joins-coalition-for-return-of-abducted-ukrainian-children-following-magyar-visit-zelensky-says/) reported that Hungarian Prime Minister Viktor Orban joined the coalition for the return of abducted Ukrainian children following his visit, according to Volodymyr Zelenskyy.

On 26 Nov 2026, [The Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/world/2026/11/26/viktor-orban-may-be-gone-but-europes-ukraine-funding-headache-remains/) reported that an awkward squad of populist prime ministers want to opt out of joining a 45 billion euro EU loan for Ukraine.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/25/8064672/) reported that Hungarian Prime Minister Péter Magyar stated Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy gifted him a 1942 newspaper mentioning his great-grandfather during his visit to Zakarpattia.

On 25 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/peter-magyar-meets-volodymyr-zelenskyy-hungary-and-ukraine-make-a-fresh-start-after-the-icy-relations-of-the-viktor-orban-era/a-80054175?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf), [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/91166) reported that Hungarian Prime Minister Peter Magyar visited Ukraine to discuss minority rights, historical grievances, energy cooperation, and EU accession with President Volodymyr Zelenskyy.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/ukraine-and-hungary-agree-to-deepen-energy-cooperation-zelenskyy-says-3725972) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy announced an agreement covering gas and diesel supplies to Kyiv and Hungarian access to Ukrainian gas storage.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4188290-zelensky-magyar-meet-with-representatives-of-hungarian-community-in-zakarpattia.html) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky and Hungarian Prime Minister Peter Magyar met with representatives of the Hungarian community in the Zakarpattia region.

On 25 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/25/ukraine-war-briefing-zelenskyy-and-hungary-pm-hail-new-era-of-cooperation-after-orban) reported that Hungary's new Prime Minister, Péter Magyar, called for efforts to build trust with Kyiv.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/24/8064474/) reported that during his visit to Uzhhorod, Hungarian Prime Minister Péter Magyar announced a new social support fund for ethnic Hungarians living abroad.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/24/8064480/) reported that Magyar stated Hungary has provided refuge to tens of thousands of Ukrainians, including ethnic Hungarians, since Russia's full-scale invasion.

On 24 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/ukraine-zelenskyy-and-hungary-s-magyar-meet-amid-thaw-in-ties/a-80036546?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that Hungary's Prime Minister Peter Magyar arrived in Ukraine for meetings with President Volodymyr Zelenskyy and ethnic Hungarians to signal a thaw in ties.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/24/8064433/) reported that Hungarian Prime Minister Péter Magyar arrived in Zakarpattia for the first time since 2015 and plans to meet President Zelenskyy.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4188112-hungarian-prime-minister-arrives-in-zakarpattia.html) reported that Hungarian Prime Minister Péter Magyar arrived in Ukraine's Zakarpattia region to meet with representatives of the local Hungarian community.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4188130-zelensky-and-magyar-pay-tribute-to-fallen-ukrainian-defenders-in-uzhhorod.html), [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/24/8064457/) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy and Hungarian Prime Minister Péter Magyar paid tribute to fallen Ukrainian defenders in Uzhhorod.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4188149-zelensky-makes-first-statement-after-meeting-with-magyar-in-uzhhorod.html) reported that President Volodymyr Zelenskyy made a statement to the press after meeting with Péter Magyar in Uzhhorod.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikgFBVV95cUxQZThtOW40QTkzbTFaSHVtVjE0WlZVTEtvSjNPQmRPcW1fLTEzY19obHNDTU1Majh6anZyUFdWTjJIdUVUMTB2SGw4dThvc1k2WjU3TnZNNDk5dzVtTDZOb3lVNTBoYWJjOWtrVGhNbDhNbzBWRjAxZUREMXJGZl9icEplejQtUkROMTFkenNQV3lmdw?oc=5) reported that Hungarian opposition leader Peter Magyar stated he will visit Ukraine to mend relations.

stories.title: Colombian authorities rescue all hostages held at Cartagena supermarket
stories.label: Cartagena supermarket hostage incident

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/alcalde-cartagena-detalles-secuestro-exito-jailer-muneton-HB44101226) reported that Cartagena Mayor Dumek Turbay gave details about the mass kidnapping that lasted approximately 17 hours at the Éxito de La Castellana.

On 26 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/falso-que-2-rehenes-liberados-sean-secuestradores-de-supermercado-en-cartagena-policia-de-colombia-imagenes-se-viralizan-en-redes/) reported that Colombian police stated it is false that two liberated hostages were the kidnappers in the Cartagena supermarket incident.

On 26 Nov 2026, [El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/jailer-muneton-zapata-abatido-toma-rehenes-exito-cartagena-KB44101487) reported that the hostage-taking at the Éxito store in La Castellana ended with the death of a man during a police-led operation.

On 26 Nov 2026, [El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/daniel-acevedo-rehen-confundido-con-secuestrador-exito-cartagena-encara-presidente-que-dijo-HJ44099097) reported details following the rescue of over 67 people who remained kidnapped for more than 17 hours at the Éxito de La Castellana in Cartagena.

On 26 Nov 2026, [El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/mindefensa-toma-rehenes-exito-cartagena-muerte-presunto-secuestrador-rescate-EJ44097175) reported that the Ministry of Defense explained the armed forces had to act to control the threat and killed a suspected kidnapper during the hostage rescue at the Éxito store in Cartagena.

On 26 Nov 2026, [El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/exito-cartagena-rescate-rehenes-secuestradores-la-terraza-PJ44092638) reported that after more than 17 hours of tension, President Abelardo De la Espriella announced the conclusion of the supermarket hostage crisis in Cartagena.

On 25 Nov 2026, [El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/esposa-buscaba-marido-presunto-lider-secuestradores-exito-cartagena-OE44048547) reported that an investigation into a woman searching for her husband among the hostages during the Éxito de La Castellana takeover in Cartagena took an unexpected turn regarding an individual killed during the robbery attempt.

On 26 Nov 2026, [El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/de-rehen-a-sospechoso-historia-daniel-diaz-exito-cartagena-acusado-secuestrador-EI44087517) reported on the account of Daniel Díaz Acevedo, a man mistakenly confused with a kidnapper during the Éxito de Cartagena takeover.

On 25 Nov 2026, [El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/por-que-confundieron-carlos-tapia-con-secuestrador-exito-cartagena-KH44075690) reported that around 76 people were rescued after 17 hours by special forces at the Éxito de La Castellana in Cartagena.

On 25 Nov 2026, [NZ Herald](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/world/cartagena-supermarket-hostage-siege-ends-with-all-hostages-rescued/O6BOYD3CZBATPLWXZNSSBDPF54/) reported that Colombian police and soldiers entered a supermarket building shortly after midnight, killing one hostage-taker and rescuing 76 hostages.

On 25 Nov 2026, [El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/lista-nombres-personas-rescatadas-exito-cartagena-FD44039837) reported that special military and police commando units released the hostages after approximately 16 hours of detention at the Éxito supermarket in Cartagena and published their names.

On 25 Nov 2026, [El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/rehenes-cartagena-cuales-armas-tenian-secuestradores-JH44070494) reported that the Attorney General's Office revealed the weapons used by the suspects during the supermarket hostage situation.

On 25 Nov 2026, [El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/rehenes-rescate-cartagena-palabras-agradecimiento-alcalde-cartagena-operativo-HD44030531) reported that Cartagena mayor Dumek Turbay expressed gratitude following the rescue operation at the Éxito supermarket.

On 25 Nov 2026, [El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/cuantos-secuestradores-participaron-toma-rehenes-exito-cartagena-PF44051871) reported that military Gaulas commander Colonel Styk Amaral Reyes confirmed 46 people were rescued after 17 hours of detention.

On 25 Nov 2026, [El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/nacion/rescatan-los-rehenes-del-exito-en-cartagena-tras-18-horas-de-secuestro) reported that Abelardo De La Espriella confirmed the result of the joint police and security operation following an 18-hour hostage situation at an Éxito supermarket in Cartagena.

On 25 Nov 2026, [El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/rehenes-exito-cartagena-secuestro-testigos-noticias-colombia-AD44030716) reported that a freed hostage stated the kidnappers were drinking alcohol and listening to music.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/mundo/15-horas-tension-termino-toma-rehenes-supermercado-colombia-delincuente-abatido_0_jxV41lwHpN.html), [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/mundo/noticia/2026/11/25/refens-sao-resgatados-apos-17-horas-de-sequestro-em-supermercado-na-colombia.ghtml) reported that the hostage-taking incident at a supermarket in Cartagena ended after more than 15 hours with the rescue of all hostages and one hostage-taker killed.

On 25 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/25/hostages-freed-colombia-security-forces-storm-cartagena-supermarket), [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261125-colombian-authorities-rescue-all-hostages-held-at-cartagena-supermarket), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/25/colombian-forces-rescue-all-hostages-after-supermarket-siege?traffic_source=rss) reported that Colombian security forces rescued all hostages held during a day-long siege at a supermarket in Cartagena.

On 25 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/columbia-hostage-cartagena-supermarket-exito-b3091232.html), [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/ckp80mjr9emyo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss), [The Rio Times](https://www.riotimesonline.com/colombia-rescues-hostages-cartagena-exito-store/) reported that one hostage-taker was killed in the police operation.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/international/article/2026/11/25/en-colombie-le-president-et-l-armee-a-carthagenes-pour-une-prise-d-otages-en-cours-dans-un-supermarche_6814815_3211.html) reported that Colombian President Abelardo de la Espriella traveled to Cartagena for an ongoing supermarket hostage situation and stated the incident pertained to common criminality, ruling out armed group involvement.

On 24 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/suben-a-9-los-rehenes-liberados-tras-mas-de-8-horas-de-toma-de-supermercado-en-colombia-33296095), [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/delincuentes-mantienen-veintena-de-rehenes-en-colombia-secuestro-dura-ya-mas-de-12-horas/) reported that nine to ten hostages were freed after armed individuals took over a supermarket in Colombia.

On 25 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/mundo/noticia/2026/11/25/presidente-da-colombia-chega-a-cartagena-para-liderar-operacao-de-resgate-de-refens-em-mercado.ghtml), [Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/international/colombie-dix-personnes-liberees-apres-une-prise-d-otages-dans-un-supermarche-de-carthagene-20261125) reported that Colombian President Abelardo de la Espriella traveled to Cartagena to coordinate the security response.

On 25 Nov 2026, [TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/9b8e59ae3188) reported that police confirmed 10 captives, including five elderly women, were released by nightfall after gunmen took dozens hostage in Cartagena.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/rest-of-world/watch-armed-men-take-30-hostage-at-colombia-supermarket-after-failed-attempt-to-rob-cash-van-10-rescued/articleshow/136147326.cms) reported that armed assailants took at least 20 hostages in a supermarket following a botched armored cash van heist in Cartagena.

On 25 Nov 2026, [El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/rehen-cuenta-experiencia-liberado-secuestro-exito-cartagena-tanta-pelicula-que-uno-ve-toca-tomarlo-calma-NC44020159) reported accounts from a freed hostage regarding the takeover at the Éxito store in Cartagena.

On 24 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/americas/20261124-hostages-supermarket-colombia-cartagena-flights) reported that armed robbers took roughly two dozen people hostage at a supermarket in Cartagena.

On 24 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/cartagena-colombia-hostage-situation-exito-b3090950.html) reported that five older women have been released so far following a failed cash truck heist.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/25-people-held-hostage-at-colombia-supermarket-cartagena-airport-briefly-suspends-landings-101795542302366.html) reported that the Rafael Nunez airport in Cartagena briefly stopped incoming flights as armed forces used one of its runways.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixAFBVV95cUxNUklaemoxV1Blc3lnelpxZHVwbmdXYUZBVHg2M1dBUzhwcU1PNVp2STNsbWlQMU5POEpHNmFabWtzNjMyTGRwR3dVRURmbDJITXdKZHJsbGdQVkQwZ1d1dmM3cVc3RGZsUGxGbDVmeDVRQVJMZ0c2b3ZNcTdyQ08ycHlSMlNnT3dYMUJzWXZ1VXh0LWJBdkFpeDF5TjRyMk40Y0FHZDdaSWoxQjFIUGNEYlJQWEZKZl9BQ04tTnl1WXl1cElH?oc=5) reported that hostages were held in a Cartagena, Colombia supermarket after a failed armored car hijacking.

On 24 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/24/cartagena-colombia-hostages-supermarket) reported that armed men took 25 hostages at a supermarket in Cartagena, with police seizing the store and snipers deployed on nearby buildings.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Sky News World](https://news.sky.com/story/armed-men-take-at-least-25-hostages-in-supermarket-in-colombia-tourist-hotspot-13616139) reported that officials stated a group of armed men are holding at least 25 people hostage in a supermarket in Colombia.

On 24 Nov 2026, [El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/cinco-pistas-investigacion-secuestro-30-rehenes-exito-cartagena-GA44004714) reported that an attempted robbery targeting an armored cash transport vehicle was behind the security alert at an Éxito store in Cartagena.

On 24 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/eeuu-y-canada/embajada-de-estados-unidos-en-colombia-emite-alerta-de-seguridad-por-el-secuestro-masivo-de-personas-en-el-exito-de-cartagena-3603915) reported that the United States Embassy in Colombia issued a security alert urging citizens to avoid the area.

On 24 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/hombres-armados-se-toman-un-supermercado-de-la-ciudad-colombiana-de-cartagena-33289618) reported that President Abelardo de la Espriella stated five older adult hostages out of 30 held inside a supermarket in Cartagena have been released.

On 24 Nov 2026, [El País](https://elpais.com/america-colombia/2026-11-24/un-grupo-de-hombres-armados-toma-varios-rehenes-en-un-supermercado-en-cartagena.html) reported that a group of armed men took about 30 customers and employees of Éxito stores hostage with hands tied in front of a window, and five women were released.

On 24 Nov 2026, [El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/nacion/policia-de-cartagena-despliega-operativo-por-toma-de-rehenes-en-local), [El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/hombres-armados-ingresaron-almacen-exito-cartagena-rehenes-GJ43977230) reported that armed men entered an Éxito store in Cartagena, prompting a police response and hostage rescue operation.

On 24 Nov 2026, [El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/reabren-aeropuerto-cartagena-tras-suspension-aterrizajes-JG43986539) reported that the Rafael Núñez Airport in Cartagena reopened after landings were suspended due to the supermarket hostage situation.

On 24 Nov 2026, [El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/rehenes-exito-cartagena-hablan-testigos-familiares-MA44000084) reported that family members expressed anguish as armed men held thirty people inside the La Castellana Éxito store in Cartagena.

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [Al Wihda (Chad)](https://www.alwihdainfo.com/conseil-des-ministres-cap-sur-la-lfr-2026-et-le-developpement-du-senegal-oriental/) reported that Senegal's Council of Ministers met under the presidency of Bassirou Diomaye Diakhar Faye to frame the execution of the 2026 amending finance bill and welcomed a TAS decision on the Africa Cup of Nations.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwgFBVV95cUxNSXB4M0Z3YmVRY00wSW9jUGpyU0hzT2h0a0tFel9wcXFIZFVpYWphTTI5Qm1nSDYxOW5ueVU2OHdLUGx2OFlDOWV2YTg5Wjl4Z0I5VmtWWFZkS0lDdU9IUWZnTjlicHMwMkpURXZaVC1RYzJrRFg5TjJrM3VTdFJ6S29FcFhwSTNpOEluWWJTZlZsdi01amwyZWNja0ptZkJnMGRiWnFJNkE3T3FwOHZyWEhfRVpKTTkyd0pmdU4wM0hFZw?oc=5), [RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/fr/afrique/20261126-s%C3%A9n%C3%A9gal-la-majorit%C3%A9-parlementaire-adopte-une-r%C3%A9solution-contre-le-passage-par-d%C3%A9cret-du-budget-rectificatif-2026), [Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/26/senegal-parliament-denounces-president-over-budget-decree/) reported that Senegal's parliament adopted a resolution criticizing President Bassirou Diomaye Faye's decision to implement the 2026 budget bill by decree.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Le Soleil (Senegal)](https://lesoleil.sn/actualites/politique/lfr-2026-senegal-oriental-diaspora-bassirou-diomaye-faye-fixe-ses-priorites-et-presse-le-gouvernement/) reported that President Bassirou Diomaye Faye gave new orientations to the government regarding the execution of the 2026 amending finance bill during a council of ministers.

On 24 Nov 2026, [RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/fr/afrique/20261124-s%C3%A9n%C3%A9gal-les-boulangers-en-gr%C3%A8ve-pour-r%C3%A9clamer-une-hausse-du-prix-du-pain) reported that bakers in Senegal went on strike to demand higher bread prices.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Aujourd'hui au Faso](https://aujourd8.net/greve-des-boulangers-au-senegal-rejet-du-budget-2027-questions-migratoires-diomaye-faye-a-lepreuve-du-pouvoir-solitaire/) reported that Senegal faced a three-day bakers' strike over flour and electricity prices alongside the rejection of the 2027 budget.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Rio Times](https://www.riotimesonline.com/pastef-drops-president-faye-membership/), [Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/18/senegals-ruling-party-pastef-expels-countrys-president-and-31-others/) reported that PASTEF, Senegal's ruling party, struck President Bassirou Diomaye Faye and 31 others from its list.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/18/senegals-ruling-party-pastef-expels-countrys-president-and-31-others/) reported that the move marks a new stage in the rift between President Faye and Pastef leader Ousmane Sonko.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Burkina 24](https://burkina24.com/2026/11/18/senegal-bassirou-diomaye-faye-et-31-autres-personnalites-radies-des-rangs-du-pastef/) reported that Senegalese President Bassirou Diomaye Faye and 31 other figures were expelled from the ranks of the PASTEF party.

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/iraqi-kurds-protest-against-pm-zaidis-moves-assert-control) reported that thousands of Kurds protested in their semi-autonomous region against the prime minister's bid to take over oil fields.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/26/how-an-oil-feud-is-deepening-rift-between-baghdad-and-iraqs-kurdish-region?traffic_source=rss) reported that Prime Minister al-Zaidi's move to take control of border crossings and oilfields has drawn a sharp response from Erbil.

On 26 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/protests-in-iraqi-kurdistan-at-plans-for-government-in-baghdad-to-take-over-oil-border-crossings/a-80065994?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that thousands gathered in the capital of northern Iraq's Kurdish region to protest federal government plans to take over oil and border crossings.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitAFBVV95cUxQVHNOckdCekZXZ2M0ZVFPbWhiUEpOOVJsRFZmYTZ5M0dLclVrWF9wLUN0cEZTbmFNZGlYUGtsWHA0RUlhX2R5UFNESDQtVDJOZ1VGa0FhQ3luZVk3Y1B6ZFM2M3dtN2ZKNG1QdkZWOEM5emtlNjVyU3E2dDk3Wmg4WVpLbU1qZU43cG9lbk5OaXlKcWx6VjQ1SHkxODZvT1VBS3YyajRjVFlPSERWTDUwcHJTMi0?oc=5) reported that thousands protested in Irbil as Baghdad moved to seize Kurdish oil and border control.

On 24 Nov 2026, [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/24/world/middleeast/iraq-prime-minister-kurdistan-control.html) reported that Iraq's Prime Minister moved to assert control over Kurdish border crossings and oil resources.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/iraqs-top-court-says-baghdad-can-deploy-troops-secure-borders-kurdistan-region) reported that Iraq's highest court ruled that Baghdad can deploy federal forces along all international borders in the Kurdistan region.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/iraqi-court-upholds-zaidis-moves-kurdish-region) reported that an Iraqi court ruling backed Baghdad's authority to deploy federal troops along the Kurdistan Region's borders.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/25/iraqs-top-court-rules-government-can-take-over-kurdish-borders-oil-fields?traffic_source=rss) reported that Iraq's top court ruled that the government can take over Kurdish borders and oil fields.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/24/iraq-orders-takeover-of-oilfields-in-areas-under-kurdish-control?traffic_source=rss) reported that PM Ali al-Zaidi also ordered his government to seize all crossings in the Kurdish region after an oil smuggling inquiry.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/iraqi-kurds-close-ranks-baghdad-moves-seize-oil-border-control) reported that the KDP and the PUK set aside their rivalries to oppose the federal move.

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [MercoPress](https://en.mercopress.com/2026/11/26/colombia-drops-its-bid-to-join-the-brics-bank-in-a-new-shift-towards-the-united-states?utm_source=feed&utm_medium=rss&utm_content=main&utm_campaign=rss) reported that the government of Colombian President Abelardo de la Espriella abandoned Colombia's process of joining the New Development Bank.

On 26 Nov 2026, [El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/colombia-desiste-ingreso-brics-nuevo-banco-de-desarrollo-JI44088607) reported that the intention for Colombia to enter the New Development Bank lasted 18 months and was not voted on in Congress.

On 23 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/eeuu-y-canada/congresista-estadounidense-maria-elvira-salazar-envio-carta-a-elon-musk-y-pidio-eliminar-cuenta-de-gustavo-petro-de-x-viola-claramente-las-normas-3603268) reported that US congresswoman Maria Elvira Salazar sent a letter to Elon Musk asking to eliminate Gustavo Petro's X account, stating it clearly violates the rules.

On 23 Nov 2026, [El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/gobierno-niega-recorte-esquema-seguridad-petro-familia-FP43913116) reported that Abelardo de la Espriella's government denied allegations made by former president Gustavo Petro regarding a reduction in security details for him and his family.

On 22 Nov 2026, [El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/nacion/mintic-pide-bloquear-cuenta-de-petro-en-x-por-presunta-incitacion-la-violencia), [El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/mintic-pidio-a-x-antiguo-twitter-suspender-cuenta-petro-incitacion-violencia-AO43905207) reported that the Colombian MinTIC asked X to suspend the account of former president Petro for alleged incitement to violence.

On 22 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/el-gobierno-de-colombia-pide-a-x-suspender-la-cuenta-de-petro-por-incitar-a-la-violencia-33266855), [El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/mundo/gobierno-colombiano-pide-x-suspender-cuenta-petro-esa-red-social_1795391948) reported that the government's request was criticized by congressmen from Petro's party.

On 23 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/gobierno-colombiano-pide-suspender-cuenta-de-petro-en-x-oposicion-denuncia-intento-de-censura/) reported that the opposition denounced the move as an attempt at censorship.

On 20 Nov 2026, [El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/politica/de-la-espriella-pide-estados-unidos-investigar-al-gobierno-petro), [El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/gobierno-abelardo-de-la-espriella-gustavo-petro-justicia-estados-unidos-ON43828431) reported that Abelardo de la Espriella called the Gustavo Petro government a criminal enterprise and asked United States justice authorities to act against it.

reports.text: On 25 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mexico/violencia-contra-las-mujeres-tambien-se-manifiesta-en-los-centros-de-trabajo-regina-de-la-vega-castillo-33314806) reported that lawyer Regina de la Vega Castillo stated violence against women also manifests in workplaces through wage inequality, pregnancy discrimination, and lack of growth opportunities.

On 25 Nov 2026, [El País](https://elpais.com/sociedad/2026-11-25/manifestaciones-25-n-contra-la-violencia-de-genero-en-directo.html) reported that Ana Redondo defended standing with women suffering the private terrorism of gender violence.

On 25 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/video/podcast/violencia-familiar-mato-a-5-mujeres-cada-hora-en-2025-onu-tu-dia-con-el-universal/) reported that the UN stated family violence killed five women every hour in 2025, with over 47,000 women killed by relatives globally.

On 25 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mexico/jornada-de-activismo-contra-la-violencia-de-genero-incluira-apertura-de-centros-de-justicia-para-las-mujeres-33304528) reported that Women's Secretary Laura Itzel Castillo Juárez announced the opening of Justice Centers for Women across several states.

On 25 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/nacion/nueve-de-cada-10-mujeres-que-sufren-violencia-fisica-o-sexual-en-mexico-no-denuncian-alerta-la-onu-pide-justicia-para-victimas/) reported that the UN stated nine out of ten women suffering physical or sexual violence in Mexico do not report it.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/violencia-domestica-mata-quase-cinco-mulheres-por-hora-no-mundo-aponta-onu.shtml) reported that over 47,000 women and girls were killed by partners or family members globally in 2025, equating to nearly five victims per hour according to the UN.

On 24 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/la-violencia-familiar-cobro-la-vida-de-cinco-mujeres-cada-hora-en-2025-segun-la-onu-33287678) reported that United Nations data highlighted the persistence of gender-based violence in the private sphere and failures to prevent and sanction it worldwide.

reports.text: On 25 Nov 2026, [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2047017/petrol-diesel-price-for-nov-26-2026) reported that the diesel price dipped below Rs350 after four months while the petrol rate went down by Rs4.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/pakistan-petrol-price-dips-to-rs319-after-nearly-rs60-cut-in-just-one-month/) reported that Pakistan's government slashed fuel prices, bringing petrol down to Rs319 after a cut of nearly Rs60 in one month.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/business-economy/energy/1742686-dangote-refinery-suspends-n150-diesel-price-cut-announces-fresh-review/) reported that Dangote Refinery withdrew its proposed diesel price cut to N1,570 per litre.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/business-economy/energy/1742683-petrol-prices-drop-by-n85-litre-dangote-refinery-marketers-announce-rates/) reported that petrol prices fell by N25 to N85 per litre at Nigerian stations in a week as Dangote cut its gantry price.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/govt-cuts-jet-fuel-kerosene-diesel-prices/), [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1584865/government-slashes-jet-fuel-kerosene-prices-today/) reported that the federal government reduced the prices of jet fuel, kerosene oil, and light diesel oil.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2045695/govt-snaps-petrol-price-reduction-spree-as-rate-raised-by-re1-per-litre-diesel-remains-unchanged), [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1584155/petrol-price-up-by-rs-1-per-litre-diesel-rate-unchanged/) reported that the Pakistan government increased the petrol price by Re1 to Rs323 per litre while keeping the diesel rate unchanged at Rs355 per litre.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1583646/petrol-and-diesel-dip-by-rs-3-per-litre/) reported that the government reduced the prices of petrol and diesel by Rs3 per litre, marking the twelfth consecutive decrease in the price of petrol.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2641040/petrol-and-high-speed-diesel-drop-by-rs3-per-litre) reported that the price of petrol dropped to Rs322 and high-speed diesel to Rs355 per litre.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/petrol-price-in-pakistan-drops-to-rs325-per-litre-after-rs53-cut-in-november/) reported that petrol prices in Pakistan dropped by nearly Rs53 per litre in just over two weeks after another reduction.

On 16 Nov 2026, [The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2640653/govt-cuts-petrol-high-speed-diesel-price-by-rs2), [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2044962/govt-reduces-petrol-diesel-prices-by-rs2-per-litre) reported that the government cut the price of petrol and high-speed diesel by Rs2.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/petrol-levy-relief-as-govt-cuts-publics-share-to-rs63-64-per-litre/) reported that the Pakistan government reduced the public's petrol levy burden by Rs1.65 to Rs63.64 per litre.

On 13 Nov 2026, [The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2640162/petrol-drops-by-rs2-diesel-remains-unchanged-till-nov-16), [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2044318/petrol-price-cut-by-by-rs2-high-speed-diesel-price-remains-unchanged) reported that the price of petrol was reduced by Rs2 while high-speed diesel remained unchanged.

stories.title: Australia passes online safety law, putting Big Tech at risk of multibillion-dollar fines
stories.label: Australia digital duty of care laws

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2026/nov/26/coalition-to-team-up-with-labor-to-pass-20-gas-reservation-scheme-for-australias-largest-exporters) reported that the Coalition voted in the Senate to pass a 20% gas reservation scheme for Australia's largest exporters, denying a Greens bid for a 25% tax on exports.

On 26 Nov 2026, [The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/26/asia-pacific/australia-lng-exporters-curb/) reported that Australia is the world's second-largest LNG supplier and exports far more gas than it consumes domestically.

On 26 Nov 2026, [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/sci-tech/technology/australias-digital-duty-of-care-law-why-big-tech-is-under-pressure/article71745512.ece) reported that Australia's Digital Duty of Care law places a legal obligation on online services to protect users from serious harm while drawing criticism from the conservative opposition and the United States.

On 26 Nov 2026, [NZ Herald](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/world/australia-parliament-backs-law-imposing-massive-new-fines-for-big-tech/ES6RECZQPVAVHLOVE3WIBSBFCY/) reported that the Australian Parliament backed a law imposing fines reaching up to 5% of global turnover or A$109m, whichever is greater.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiowFBVV95cUxQb0VmbVBBdkFRU29MMjl2RmM1bDgtcFI1ZlpKN2lJV2JocVppeS1zbzJPSWhvVjVSNnExam1KMHhDSTgtdVpSR2RMV0dhOFEyRTJzQnI0eW1lNGxkWDUxZ2V1a2JNX0pkcWFtT1VCVWtKNE5IY3plZHRabVJySThIekJkVmFJNGlRVUFjNS1INHR4WHk4WVM0aEFUbklvMEpyVm1R?oc=5), [Daily Maverick](https://www.dailymaverick.co.za/article/2026-11-25-australia-passes-law-forcing-internet-platforms-to-take-down-harmful-content/) reported that Australia passed an online safety law requiring internet companies to remove harmful content or face fines of up to 5% of global revenue.

On 24 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/live/2026/nov/25/treasurer-jim-chalmers-myefo-inflation-figures-coalition-one-nation-ntwnfb) reported that the Coalition would look to repeal the digital duty of care legislation.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipAFBVV95cUxQOXozaER4SUdERlZsSGNJYTgzQm5GR1lrZFM5S2tsUWJTV2I1TVo3Yi1RMDJiQ3E3Q0s1T1JGQ0JDdURHTTdJNEJEZENucEVuSHdWT3kwYmpfNmw3OGVkMFVma0RXUkdzTFpyOGhCY3NsNnZJa0tlOGhETU5nS1NJOHF6aTdaVjdEUl9mOVZmRDVVbDB4X3l4YTlkelh5NlBsX2pGSQ?oc=5) reported that Australia is set to pass a digital duty of care law with fines reaching up to 5 percent of tech giants' global revenue.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiuAFBVV95cUxORG5QdGdxRm1nOGVuczhoUXJVbnYwakY5NUxEVEVSbzhaRUtYdGx0X25LeGhQbVE0X05XeHI3OUNkZTJDWjA5aTRHN0FSSGRQZllJUjJ1Qm1wWkI4REhSbFhDUnZXRmc3UjBpWng0aExBX1JWSGJlNlNZNUwteFFEY0daYnA5LUJEa1JlakpkcUNBUDlyRTRuSnFpZ3dzU05lMV8xNHQ4YnpUODMxbHFBWXpRLW9jZk9v?oc=5), [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/technology/australia-set-to-adopt-internet-safety-law-fining-tech-giants-billions-3725921) reported that Australia is set to adopt internet safety legislation under a deal between the Labor Party and the Greens, exposing tech giants like Google, TikTok, and Meta to multibillion-dollar fines.

On 24 Nov 2026, [ABC Australia](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-24/federal-politics-labor-makes-deal-greens-on-digital-duty-of-care/107420982) reported that Australian users will be able to sue social media companies under revised digital duty of care laws after Labor secured a deal to strengthen proposed online safety regulations.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/politics/federal/tech-giants-to-face-billion-dollar-fines-for-breaching-labor-s-digital-duty-of-care-laws-20261124-p61gsi.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that penalties for allowing harmful content on social media platforms will face fines exponentially greater than the original maximum penalties set at $109.2 million.

On 23 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/ukraine-updates-kyiv-claims-strike-that-sank-russian-ship-off-libya/live-80015859?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said the attack was carried out with Ukrainian-made naval drones.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90949) reported that the strike on the frigate Merkury destroyed one of Russia's most advanced and expensive warships, which was equipped with sophisticated radar systems.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/video/2026/11/23/ukraine-releases-footage-of-strikes-on-two-russian-vessels-off-libya) reported that Ukraine released footage showing strikes against two Russian vessels off the Libyan port of Benghazi.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187865-zelensky-ukraine-to-continue-naval-strikes-after-hitting-two-russian-vessels-off-libya.html) reported that Volodymyr Zelensky stated Ukraine is responding appropriately to Russian attacks and that its naval operations will continue.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/ucrania-afunda-navio-de-guerra-russo-de-r-1-bi-na-libia-veja-video.shtml) reported that Ukraine launched an attack with seven maritime drones against a Russian warship in the port of Benghazi.

On 23 Nov 2026, [The Africa Report](https://www.theafricareport.com/437247/ukraine-strikes-at-russias-african-supply-lines/) reported that the sinking of a Russian warship in Libya exposes vulnerabilities in Moscow's military logistics network in Africa.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1585662/un-urges-probe-after-drone-attacks-hit-russian-and-maltese-ships-off-libya/) reported that the United Nations demanded an immediate, independent investigation following drone attacks on two ships off Libya.

On 23 Nov 2026, [TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/9e924d295365), a state-media outlet, reported that Tripoli called for an investigation into whether Libyan territory or facilities were used in the operations.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Defence Blog](https://defence-blog.com/russian-convoy-idles-off-tunisia-after-sea-drones-hit-benghazi/) reported that three Russian cargo ships escorted by a frigate have been crawling along the coast of Tunisia.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Defence Blog](https://defence-blog.com/russian-corvette-reportedly-destroyed-in-blast-at-libyan-port/), [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90861), [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187511-russian-warship-destroyed-in-blast-at-libyan-port-media.html) reported that a Russian Navy guided-missile corvette, identified as the Merkury, caught fire and was destroyed following an explosion at the Libyan port of Benghazi.

On 22 Nov 2026, [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cr894gjz0j0yo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that Libya's eastern rival government stated it is working with Russia to investigate a suspected drone attack explosion on a Russian ship at a Libya port.

On 22 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/africa/20261122-russian-warship-hit-by-suspected-ukrainian-drone-at-libya-s-benghazi-naval-base) reported that a Russian navy corvette docked at the Benghazi naval base in eastern Libya was hit by a suspected Ukrainian sea drone.

On 22 Nov 2026, [The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/libya-reports-second-attack-ships-including-russian-vessel) reported that authorities in east Libya said a second ship was hit in a drone attack off Benghazi, hours after a Russian vessel was targeted at the city's port.

On 23 Nov 2026, [ABC Australia](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-23/zelensky-says-ukraine-struck-russian-ship-near-libya/107418718) reported that the Ukrainian president claims responsibility for a series of drone strikes which sunk one Russian vessel and severely damaged another.
