reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261126-moscow-drone-incursions-poland-to-create-no-fly-zone-at-ukraine-border) reported that Poland will soon create a no-fly zone near the Ukrainian border following several airspace incursions.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/25/8064636/) reported that Polish Deputy Defence Minister Cezary Tomczyk stated that NATO does not support shooting down Russian drones over Ukraine because it would create numerous complications.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/25/8064605/), [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/91179), [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/25/bloomberg-poland-proposes-that-nato-consider-shooting-down-russian-missiles-over-ukraine-headed-toward-alliance-territory) reported that Poland urged NATO allies to consider intercepting Russian missiles over Ukraine if they are heading toward alliance territory.

On 25 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/poland-says-will-create-no-fly-zone-at-ukraine-border-after-repeated-airspace-violations), [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/25/8064627/) reported that Poland announced plans to create a no-fly zone near its border with Ukraine around the turn of the year following airspace incursions.

On 24 Nov 2026, [UK Defence Journal](https://ukdefencejournal.org.uk/nato-sends-awacs-forward-after-russian-incursion-into-poland/) reported that NATO forward deployed an AWACS aircraft following Russian missile and drone incursions into Polish airspace.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/24/8064413/) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated that restrictions on the use of SpaceX's Starshield terminals for military personnel continue to be recorded.

On 23 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/world/2223625), a Russian state outlet, reported that NATO announced the deployment of AWACS early warning aircraft to Poland following ambassador discussions on airspace violations.

On 24 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/poland-russia-airspace-ukraine-drone-b3090416.html) reported that Poland will deploy an early-warning aircraft after an object entered its airspace and that the drone was not shot down due to concerns regarding risks to civilians.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Daily Maverick](https://www.dailymaverick.co.za/article/2026-11-23-nato-to-send-early-warning-system-aircraft-to-poland-after-missiles-incident/), [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/91000) reported that NATO will deploy an AWACS early-warning system aircraft to Poland following a missile incident.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Dnevnik (Bulgaria)](https://www.dnevnik.bg/burzi-novini/2026/11/23/4983508_nato_izprashta_samolet_za_ranno_preduprejdenie_v/?ref=rss) reported that NATO is sending an early warning aircraft to Poland following a missile incident, according to a Polish deputy defense minister.

On 23 Nov 2026, [24 Chasa](https://www.24chasa.bg/mezhdunarodni/article/23983014) reported that NATO will deploy an AWACS military aircraft to Poland as part of its response to the incident involving three missiles.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/polish-authorities-find-russian-missile-remains-at-three-sites-following-airspace-incursion/) reported that the Lublin District Prosecutor's Office announced that debris from Kh-101 cruise missiles was discovered at three sites in eastern Poland following an airspace incursion.
On 22 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90841) reported that NATO Secretary-General Mark Rutte pledged in Warsaw that the alliance will defend every inch of Polish territory.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90830) reported that Polish Defense Minister Władysław Kosiniak-Kamysz announced Poland will receive strong support from NATO allies to strengthen border security.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/swedish-gripen-pilot-unable-to-shoot-down-suspected-russian-missile-over-poland-due-to-poor-weather-commander-says/) reported that a Swedish Gripen pilot participating in a NATO air defense deployment was unable to shoot down a suspected Russian missile over Poland due to poor weather.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/nato-pledges-to-defend-poland-after-russian-missile-incursion/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that NATO chief Mark Rutte pledged to defend Poland after two Russian missiles hit its southeast during a meeting of the alliance's council in Brussels.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/21/russian-missiles-hit-poland-what-happened-and-could-nato-respond?traffic_source=rss) reported that Warsaw accused Moscow of intentional provocation after Russian missiles hit Poland, while the bar for triggering NATO's collective defense clause remains high.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/21/8063930/) reported that the pilot of a Swedish Gripen fighter jet patrolling Polish airspace during airspace violations on Friday 20 November was authorized to shoot down a Russian missile but unable to identify it.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90803) reported that a Swedish JAS 39 Gripen pilot received NATO authorization to shoot down a suspected Russian Kh-101 cruise missile during Friday’s airspace violation over southern Poland, but held fire due to weather.
On 21 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90785) reported that European Union, British, and NATO leaders condemned Russia's overnight violation of Polish airspace.

On 20 Nov 2026, [The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2641478/russian-missiles-land-in-poland-amid-nato-drills), [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/russia-central-asia/article/3375302/russian-missiles-land-poland-europe-holds-military-drills-nearby) reported that two Russian missiles and a suspected drone landed in Poland during European military drills, prompting the Polish prime minister to call it an intentional provocation.

On 20 Nov 2026, [NZ Herald](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/world/russia-fires-cruise-missile-into-poland-during-british-troop-drills/3IBFJX7GAZGOLJUZRDPA2ND3PY/) reported that Russia fired a cruise missile into Poland during British troop drills 100 kilometers from the exercise.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimAFBVV95cUxPb2dKNkEyLW5VNkNqNmI3U2lRMGcwUzZxUEUzb2FqTmVPYmFSZVhWYXM3Z0VfN3JfVi1FbkZydE5UWkRmNlhSZTFOa1pBLUpMaG5lRzZKbmJRYjdkcHZRYXlwWVlSQ3hoSUxwSzdtZDRld1FCSzVUUThhR1dicE5XbjNiSnc5VThLSGdpUkhrM2xueDRmR19DYg?oc=5), [Politico](https://www.politico.eu/article/russian-missile-incursion-into-poland-seems-intentional-tusk-says/?utm_source=RSS_Feed&utm_medium=RSS&utm_campaign=RSS_Syndication) reported that the Polish prime minister stated a Russian missile's crash in Poland was likely an intentional provocation.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/20/8063854/) reported that Ukrainian Prime Minister Serhii Koretskyi was at Rzeszów-Jasionka Airport when Russian missiles and a drone violated Polish airspace.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiswFBVV95cUxQVGl6dU85bExfQlhuODY0Rkh6a3M2UVhRTlV1QmRsclI5ZHpRbWo5M3JIbUdydkRzOFNrZkZ6RDBIMHJVNGhqeklnRl9UVVAzRFpFUUk0OTVDVnU3RVh2VjdWZ2ktMUhMNmZZMUZkVDE5RFAtTjJ4UEZjUDlKZWd4YlhSaFBoYXdnYVI1ajFaRkdnTkpyMExkU0U4YjBHMTNSblZkRWt6aUVtTGJ5UWU1RVdrNA?oc=5), [Military.com](https://www.military.com/european-troops-from-11-countries-hold-a-drill-in-poland-for-a-potential-postwar-ukraine-mission) reported that European troops from 11 countries began a two-week military exercise in Poland on November 9 to test the coalition's ability to deploy in Ukraine once the war ends.

On 20 Nov 2026, [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cqx2x9dklxnro?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss), [Times of Malta](https://timesofmalta.com/article/warsaw-says-russian-missiles-hit-poland-intentional-provocation.1137425), [Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/world/europe/poland-says-russian-missile-that-crashed-in-its-territory-was-a-provocation-20261121-p61g3a.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk described the incident in which objects hit Poland as an intentional provocation from Moscow.
On 20 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90744) reported that Donald Trump stated on Fox News that Russian drones and missiles had previously entered Poland by mistake.

On 20 Nov 2026, [The Cipher Brief](https://www.thecipherbrief.com/washington-should-allow-ukraine-to-hit-russia-s-ballistic-missile-launchers) reported that a traveler to Ukraine visited soldiers and leaders in Kyiv, Dnipro, Pavlohrad, and Kharkiv, arguing that Washington should allow Ukraine to hit Russia's ballistic missile launchers.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Jowhar](https://jowhar.com/russian-missile-attacks-hit-major-bridges-across-kyiv/) reported that Russian ballistic missiles struck three bridges spanning the Dnipro River in Kyiv, killing six people.

On 20 Nov 2026, [ABC Australia](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-20/ukraine-russia-crimea-strikes-bridge-kyiv-power-outage-poland/107411538), [Times of Malta](https://timesofmalta.com/article/russia-pummels-ukraine-putin-vowed-painful-attack.1137390) reported that Russia pummelled Ukraine with dozens of missiles and hundreds of drones overnight, killing eight people, hours after President Vladimir Putin vowed a painful response.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90708) reported that President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated Ukraine destroyed one of three Russian ballistic missile launchers and downed 79 cruise missiles.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/89346957) reported that Russia proposed that European representatives travel to Moscow to clarify their position on peace talks concerning Ukraine.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/20/8063766/) reported that the Ukrainian Prime Minister stated energy sites, businesses, and houses in nine oblasts and a wastewater facility in Kyiv were damaged, with the Kyiv death toll rising to six and 28 injured across Ukraine.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4186726-death-toll-from-russian-attack-on-kyiv-rises-to-six-15-injured.html) reported that the death toll from the overnight attack on Kyiv rose to six, with 15 injured.

On 20 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/ukraine-updates-kyiv-targeted-by-missile-strikes-bridges-hit/live-79999822?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that at least three deaths were reported in Kyiv following missile strikes.

On 20 Nov 2026, [The Moscow Times](https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/11/20/3-killed-in-bridge-strikes-on-kyiv-mayor-says-a94324) reported that eight people were killed across Ukraine in the strikes.

On 20 Nov 2026, [The Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/world/europe/2026/11/20/putin-invites-european-leaders-to-moscow-for-peace-talks-as-russia-pounds-kyiv/) reported that Vladimir Putin invited European leaders to Moscow for peace talks.

On 20 Nov 2026, [ABC Australia](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-20/ukraine-crimean-bridge-destruction-significance-explained/107408488) reported that an expert stated Ukraine's destruction of the Crimean Bridge marked a huge blow to Vladimir Putin's credibility.

On 20 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20261120-live-deadly-russian-attacks-damage-two-bridges-in-kyiv-mayor-says), [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/20/8063728/), [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4186643-kyivs-podilskyi-and-darnytskyi-bridges-damaged-in-russian-ballistic-attack-mayor.html), [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/20/russian-missile-and-drone-attack-on-kyiv-kills-three-and-damages-three-dnipro-bridges-mayor-says) reported that Russian attacks damaged bridges in Kyiv.

On 20 Nov 2026, [RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/ukraine/2026/1120/1599948-ukraine-russia/) reported that a Russian ballistic missile attack hit three bridges on Kyiv's Dnipro River and killed three people, according to the city's mayor.

reports.text: On 25 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2026/nov/25/thomas-markle-transfer-charges-california) reported that a US judge ordered the transfer of Thomas Markle to face formal charges of possessing child pornography in California.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Sky News World](https://news.sky.com/story/thomas-markle-formally-charged-in-us-over-possessing-child-sexual-abuse-material-13616074) reported that Thomas Markle has been formally charged on two counts of possessing child sexual abuse material in Los Angeles.

On 24 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/crime/thomas-markle-charged-child-sex-abuse-material-b3091071.html) reported that Markle was arrested earlier this month after FBI agents seized material from two storage units.

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/rusia-rechaza-tregua-energetica-y-maritima-exigida-por-lider-europea-considera-un-ultimatum-el-llamado-de-von-der-leyen/) reported that Russia rejected an energy and maritime truce demanded by European Commission leader Ursula von der Leyen, considering her call an ultimatum.

On 26 Nov 2026, [La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/internacional/putin-rechaza-tregua-energetica-maritima-ucrania-exigida-von-der-leyen_202611266b0808fa5cb1082f89b5994a.html) reported that Russian negotiators refused to discuss an energy and maritime truce demanded by Ursula von der Leyen during negotiations mediated by the United States in Abu Dhabi.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/90370719) reported that German Defence Minister Boris Pistorius stated that declining an invitation from Vladimir Putin for Europeans to visit Moscow would send the wrong signal.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4186596-zelensky-meets-with-witkoff-kushner-and-european-national-security-advisers.html) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky met with U.S. presidential special envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner, along with European national security advisers.

On 19 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/europa/los-aliados-de-ucrania-se-reunen-en-berlin-francia-propone-reabrir-la-union-de-kiev-a-la-otan-y-alemania-pide-la-paz-en-europa-3602434) El Tiempo reported that following the Coalition of the Willing summit in Berlin, French President Emmanuel Macron opened the debate on NATO accession for Kyiv while Friedrich Merz rejected a Yalta 2.0 peace.

On 19 Nov 2026, [La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/internacional/merz-rechaza-paz-negociada-trump-putin-ucrania-europa_202611196aff481121e74551e81f9358.html) La Razón reported that Friedrich Merz rejected any peace negotiated by Donald Trump, Vladimir Putin, and Xi Jinping without Ukraine and Europe.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4186503-zelensky-outlines-key-topics-for-coalition-of-the-willing-meeting-in-berlin.html) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky outlined covering budget needs as a key topic for the meeting.

On 19 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/wadephul-coalition-of-the-willing-talks-in-berlin-send-strong-signal-to-moscow/a-79990664?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that German Foreign Minister Wadephul stated the talks send a strong signal to Moscow.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Jowhar](https://jowhar.com/zelensky-lands-in-berlin-for-key-summit-with-ukraines-allied-partners/) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky arrived in Berlin for a summit of allied nations.
On 19 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/19/8063612/) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy arrived in Berlin for Coalition of the Willing talks.

On 19 Nov 2026, [RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/world/2026/1119/1599769-coalition-of-willing-berlin-meeting/) reported that Taoiseach Micheál Martin joined other European leaders for a meeting of the Coalition of the Willing in Berlin.

On 19 Nov 2026, [The Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/politics/2026/11/19/taoiseach-in-berlin-for-ukraine-talks-as-triple-lock-row-rumbles-on/) reported that Micheál Martin joined Coalition of the Willing leaders in Berlin while Fianna Fáil rebels proposed Defence Bill amendments at home.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/19/zelenskyy-says-he-expects-debrief-from-us-envoys-on-trumps-talks-with-xi-and-putin) reported that US envoys told Kyiv they would give a debrief on Donald Trump's talks in China during meetings in Berlin.

On 19 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/ukraine-s-allies-gather-in-berlin-for-coalition-of-the-willing-summit/live-79986520?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that Ukraine's European backers are convening in Berlin for a 'Coalition of the Willing' summit with US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner attending.

On 19 Nov 2026, [The Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/world/europe/2026/11/19/european-allies-say-more-support-crucial-for-ukraine-to-withstand-long-winter/) reported that a Coalition of the Willing meeting in Berlin pledged continued aid to Ukraine as Trump and Putin sat down in Shenzhen.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMingFBVV95cUxNWHBhRURfZmJHUzhfMW53YjcxYUNlVE1rbFZtTmV2S2Jfcm5hYXFweEJaQlZHbmE0U2Q5Y2IzM29LUExzUUx0UlIyVTNMamhzT3NPS25rbmp3bzZuZDhId1B4YzZXYWZXRkU0clRpUm9scVV5ZXRvMnBSTUlTZlVtTDJlSnFlREg3YTZpM0xVOXl2cV9xaWZpcnF2M01zdw?oc=5), [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20261119-european-leaders-to-meet-in-berlin-to-support-for-ukraine-after-trump-putin-xi-talks) reported that Ukraine's European allies met in Berlin to rally support for Kyiv following the trilateral talks in China.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/19/eu-plans-a-new-45bn-loan-to-ukraine-how-much-will-it-cost-and-will-it-be-repaid) reported that the European Commission proposed a new 45 billion euro support loan to Ukraine.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/18/8063472/) reported that French officials outlined post-war security guarantees and reviewed an 11-nation military deployment ahead of the Berlin summit.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4186174-witkoff-kushner-to-attend-coalition-of-the-willing-summit-in-berlin.html), [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90536) reported that US President Donald Trump's special envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner will attend the Coalition of the Willing summit in Berlin.

On 18 Nov 2026, [La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/internacional/witkoff-kushner-participaran-cumbre-berlin-reunion-trump-putin_202611186afe094da6f8072789ee1638.html) reported that White House emissaries will inform Ukrainian and European allies about conversations in China.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/18/8063511/) reported that Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated Kyiv will coordinate next steps in negotiations with Russia alongside European leaders and receive briefings from US delegates.

On 18 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/world/2220767), a Russian state-media outlet, reported that Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner will meet with Ukrainian and European delegates in Berlin on November 19 to discuss multilateral talks.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/18/8063498/) reported that Donald Trump's special envoys are scheduled to discuss post-war security guarantees, economic rebuilding, and multilateral negotiations with Ukrainian and European officials in Berlin.

On 18 Nov 2026, [RT](https://rt-english.com/news/649038-european-commission-new-loan-kiev/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS), a Russian state media outlet, reported that the European Commission formally presented a plan to borrow 45 billion euros guaranteed by the bloc's budget to fund Kyiv.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/18/8063467/), [The Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/world/europe/2026/11/18/von-der-leyen-confident-all-eu-members-will-back-45bn-loan-for-ukraine/) reported that European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen expressed confidence that Hungary, Slovakia, Bulgaria, and Czechia will join the new Ukraine loan.
On 18 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/18/8063467/) reported that the European Commission hopes to secure unanimous support at the 26-27 November summit.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/world/europe/2026/11/18/von-der-leyen-confident-all-eu-members-will-back-45bn-loan-for-ukraine/) reported that Slovakia, Czechia, Hungary, and Bulgaria stated they do not intend to take part in the bloc's latest round of funding for Kyiv.

On 18 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20261118-eu-proposes-new-%E2%82%AC45-billion-ukraine-loan-to-be-repaid-by-russia), [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/18/von-der-leyen-proposes-45bn-loan-to-ukraine-backed-by-joint-debt) reported that European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen proposed a €45 billion loan to Ukraine for 2027.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2026/nov/18/europe-ukraine-russia-eu-germany-serbia-latest-news-updates) reported that EU leaders will vote on the measure in two weeks and that the commission president stated Ukraine has a €70 billion funding gap for next year.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/18/8063426/) reported that the €45 billion loan is split between €25 billion for military aid and €20 billion in reform-linked funds.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4185725-axios-witkoff-kushner-to-meet-ukrainian-eu-officials-to-discuss-peace-plan.html) reported that U.S. President Donald Trump's special envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff plan to meet with Ukrainian and European officials to discuss a peace plan.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/zelensky-announces-berlin-talks-with-us-european-allies-to-shape-next-phase-of-russia-negotiations/) reported that a Ukrainian official stated the meeting in Berlin could take place on November 19.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/17/8063195/), [TASS](https://tass.com/world/2219295) reported that US Special Presidential Envoy Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner plan to meet with Ukrainian and European officials in Berlin on November 19 to discuss security guarantees and economic recovery plans.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/eu-disburses-1-7-billion-euros-for-ukraines-military-needs/), [teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/european-commission-disburses-e1-71-billion-to-ukraine-for-military-equipment/) reported that the European Commission disbursed 1.71 billion euros to Ukraine for military needs including drones, ammunition, and air defenses.

stories.title: Gunmen attack NDC rally in Edo, injure one as Obi charges Nigerians to defend votes
stories.label: Nigeria Democratic Congress leadership resignation

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/youre-a-political-errand-boy-imo-apc-rejects-wike-says-state-not-for-sale/), [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/imo-apc-accuses-wike-of-plotting-to-manipulate-2027-elections/) reported that the Imo State chapter of the All Progressives Congress accused FCT Minister Nyesom Wike of attempting to interfere in the state's politics and manipulate upcoming elections.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/imo-apc-dismisses-wikes-claims-insists-unity/) reported that the All Progressives Congress in Imo State accused Federal Capital Territory Minister Nyesom Wike of attempting to interfere in the party.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/ndc-using-rig-and-die-slogan-to-mobilise-for-mass-rigging-keyamo/) reported that Minister of Aviation and Aerospace Development Festus Keyamo accused the Nigeria Democratic Congress of using a rig and die slogan to mobilize for mass rigging.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/adc-condemns-attacks-on-ndc-members-in-edo-delta-seeks-investigation/) reported that the African Democratic Congress Presidential Campaign Council condemned attacks on the leadership and members of the Nigeria Democratic Congress.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/i-have-no-time-for-anybody-okpebholo-denies-involvement-in-ndc-edo-attack/) reported that Edo State Governor Monday Okpebholo denied involvement in the NDC Edo attack during an APC presidential campaign rally in Ehor.

On 26 Nov 2026, [AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611260277.html) reported that gunmen opened fire at a rally for Peter Obi in Edo following a previous attack on an NDC event that killed six people.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/headlines/928139-gunmen-open-fire-at-peter-obis-rally-in-edo.html) reported that gunmen opened fire at a rally for Peter Obi in Edo.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/26/nigeria-opposition-accuses-ruling-apc-of-attacks-on-presidential-candidate-peter-obi/) reported that Nigeria's opposition accused the ruling All Progressives Congress of orchestrating attacks on presidential candidates during campaign rallies across the country.

On 25 Nov 2026, [The Authority (Nigeria)](https://authorityngr.com/2026/11/25/attack-on-opposition-ndc-cannot-be-intimidated-out-of-2027-elections-national-chairman/) reported that the Nigeria Democratic Congress National Chairman declared the party cannot be intimidated out of the 2027 elections and notified the UN, EU, and US of coordinated attacks on members.

On 26 Nov 2026, [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/26/atiku-wants-tinubus-reply-over-igbohos-claim-president-asked-him-to-sustain-operations/) reported that ADC presidential candidate Atiku Abubakar asked President Bola Tinubu to reply over claims that the President asked Yoruba activist Sunday Igboho to sustain operations.

On 25 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/obi-urges-nigerians-to-defend-votes-in-2027-election/) reported that Nigeria Democratic Congress presidential candidate Peter Obi urged Nigerians to vote for him in the 2027 presidential election.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/ndc-chieftain-dismisses-apcs-structure-insists-peter-obi-has-pathway-to-victory/) reported that the Nigeria Democratic Congress insisted its presidential candidate Peter Obi has a viable pathway to victory in the general elections.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/2027-election-why-attack-ndc-if-obi-has-no-path-to-victory-akpata-asks/) reported that former Nigerian Bar Association president Akpata questioned why the APC is preventing the Nigeria Democratic Congress from campaigning if Peter Obi has no path to victory.

On 25 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/2027-morka-questions-obi-ndc-over-rig-and-die-slogan/) reported that All Progressives Congress National Publicity Secretary Felix Morka questioned the meaning and legal basis of the Nigeria Democratic Congress slogan.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/south-east-governors-working-for-my-re-election-tinubu/), [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/2027-all-south-east-governors-backing-my-re-election-tinubu/) reported that President Bola Tinubu claimed all South-East governors are backing his re-election bid.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1743033-kwankwaso-reacts-claim-sending-kano-governor-abba-yusuf-negotiate-apc-return-tinubu/) reported that Rabiu Kwankwaso's movement denied claims that he sent Kano State Governor Abba Yusuf to negotiate a return to the APC with President Bola Tinubu.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/kwankwaso-denies-sending-yusuf-to-negotiate-apc-return/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Kwankwaso denied sending Governor Abba Yusuf to President Tinubu to negotiate an APC return.

On 24 Nov 2026, [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/24/yusuf-kwankwaso-made-me-swear-by-the-quran-to-return-to-apc-he-took-my-wife/) reported that Kano State Governor Abba Yusuf stated Rabiu Kwankwaso made him swear by the Quran to return to the APC and took his wife.

On 23 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/kano-ndc-apc-clash-over-alleged-2027-election-rigging/) reported that the Nigeria Democratic Congress accused the Kano State Government of plotting to manipulate the 2027 governorship election.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/927363-why-kwankwaso-didnt-join-apc-with-me-kano-governor.html) reported that Kano State Governor Abba Yusuf stated Rabiu Kwankwaso's public utterances scuttled his plan to lead followers into the APC.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/kwankwaso-asked-me-to-swear-on-quran-over-apc-return-deal-kano-gov/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Kano Governor Abba Yusuf said Kwankwaso asked him to swear on the Qur'an over a deal to join the APC if he won at the Supreme Court.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/kano-apc-to-ndc-resolve-your-candidates-eligibility-issues-stop-playing-victim/) reported that the All Progressives Congress in Kano State challenged the New Nigeria Democratic Congress to resolve candidate eligibility issues.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/why-accord-is-supporting-tinubus-re-election-national-publicity-secretary/) reported that Accord national publicity secretary Ambassador Joseph Omorogbe spoke about his party supporting President Tinubu's re-election.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/nwest/925748-ndc-local-government-chairman-others-join-apc-in-kano.html) reported that local government executives of the Nigeria Democratic Congress in Bichi Local Government Area of Kano State defected to the All Progressives Congress.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/ndc-loses-bauchi-gov-candidate-kano-executives-to-apc/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Nigeria Democratic Congress Bauchi State governorship candidate Ibrahim Kashim and Kano executives defected to the All Progressives Congress.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/ndc-vice-chairman-five-ward-chairmen-kwankwasiyya-leaders-defect-to-apc-in-kano/), [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1741689-ndc-suffers-major-blow-kano-vice-chairman-ward-leaders-join-apc/) reported that the political structure of the Nigeria Democratic Congress in Bichi Local Government Area of Kano State suffered a setback following the defection of the vice-chairman and ward chairmen to the APC.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/police-arrest-8-over-apc-ndc-clash-in-kano/) reported that the Kano State Police Command arrested eight suspects following a clash between supporters of the APC and the NDC.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/925709-2027-bauchi-ndc-governorship-candidate-defects-to-apc.html) reported that Ibrahim Kashim is listed by the Independent National Electoral Commission as the NDC flagbearer in Bauchi State.

On 16 Nov 2026, [The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/bauchi-ndc-governorship-candidate-dumps-party-for-apc/), [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1741676-breaking-drama-governorship-candidate-resigns-apc-ndc/), [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/kashim-dumps-ndc-for-apc-ahead-of-bauchi-2027/) reported that Ibrahim Kashim, the Nigeria Democratic Congress governorship candidate in Bauchi State, defected to the ruling All Progressives Congress.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/2027-setback-for-ndc-as-another-chieftain-dumps-party/) reported that the crisis rocking the Nigeria Democratic Congress deepened following the resignation of another chieftain.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/ndc-deputy-national-publicity-secretary-dumps-party/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the Deputy National Publicity Secretary of the Nigeria Democratic Congress, Abdulmumin Abdulsalami, resigned citing injustice and exclusion.

stories.title: Tinubu approves N100m, three-bedroom flats for families of NAF 931 crash victims
stories.label: Nigeria housing loan scheme

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [The Authority (Nigeria)](https://authorityngr.com/2026/11/26/tinubu-approves-n100m-three-bedroom-flats-for-families-of-naf-931-crash-victims/) reported that President Bola Ahmed Tinubu approved 100 million naira and three-bedroom flats for immediate families of military personnel and civilian victims of the NAF 931 crash.

On 26 Nov 2026, [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/26/tinubu-announces-financial-compensation-house-for-each-family-of-igbokoda-air-mishap-victims/) reported that President Bola Ahmed Tinubu announced financial compensation and a house for each family of the 25 victims of the Nigerian Air Force crash.

On 26 Nov 2026, [The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/tinubu-approves-three-bedroom-flats-%e2%82%a6100m-for-families-of-atr-42-crash-victims/), [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/igbokoda-air-crash-tinubu-allocates-houses-to-victims-families/), [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/nigeria/1743486-breaking-tinubu-announces-n100m-houses-ondo-aircraft-victims-video-trends/), [Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/928242-fg-gifts-houses-%e2%82%a6100-million-to-naf-crash-victims-families.html) reported that President Bola Tinubu approved three-bedroom flats and a N100 million donation for the families of victims of the ATR-42 / NAF aircraft crash.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/over-26000-units-525100-jobs-created-by-tinubus-housing-projects-apc-pcc/) reported that the All Progressives Congress Presidential Campaign Council showcased the achievements of the present administration regarding housing projects delivering over 26,000 units and 525,100 jobs.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/tinubus-housing-projects-created-525100-jobs-apc-pcc/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web), [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1743450-tinubu-government-lists-26000-housing-units-nigeria-targets-affordable-homeownership/), [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/tinubu-housing-projects-deliver-over-26000-units-525100-jobs-apc-pcc-says/) reported that the All Progressives Congress Presidential Campaign Council stated that President Bola Tinubu's housing projects delivered over 26,000 units and created 525,100 jobs.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/business-economy/economy/1742409-n100m-housing-loan-9-categories-nigerians-eligible-apply/) reported that the federal government listed nine categories of Nigerians eligible for its N100 million housing loan, including workers, entrepreneurs, and self-employed individuals.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/mreif-mortgage-what-you-need-for-the-%e2%82%a6100m-fg-backed-housing-loan/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that applicants for the MREIF mortgage of up to ₦100m must be between 21 and 60 years old, have a good credit score, and pay 20 percent equity.

On 19 Nov 2026, [The Chronicle (Ghana)](https://thechronicle.com.gh/tinubu-announces-housing-loan-scheme-for-nigerians-spreads-repayment-over-20-years/) reported that Nigerian President Bola Ahmed Tinubu introduced an affordable housing scheme with a fixed interest rate of 9.75 per cent and 20-year repayment terms.

On 18 Nov 2026, [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/18/tinubus-education-reset-n372-62bn-student-loans-technical-skills-and-wider-school-access/) reported on the implementation of student loans, technical skills development, and educational access initiatives in Nigeria.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/how-to-apply-for-fgs-n100m-housing-loans/) reported that Nigerians can apply for mortgage loans of up to 100 million naira under the Federal Government's housing finance programme.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/tinubu-offers-nigerians-n100m-housing-loans/) reported that Nigerian President Bola Ahmed Tinubu announced eligible Nigerians can obtain housing loans of up to ₦100m at a fixed interest rate of 9.75 per cent.

stories.title: Fountain of Life Church challenges bench warrant against Pastor Jimmy Odukoya
stories.label: Fountain of Life Church leadership dispute

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/nigeria/1743515-fountain-life-church-faults-bench-warrant-jimmy-odukoya-cites-due-process-breach/), [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/fountain-of-life-church-faults-bench-warrant-against-jimmy-odukoya/), [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/fountain-of-life-church-challenges-bench-warrant-against-pastor-jimmy-odukoya/) reported that the Fountain of Life Church challenged a bench warrant issued against its Senior Pastor, Jimmy Odukoya, citing a breach of due process.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/fountain-of-life-church-faults-arrest-warrant-against-jimmy-odukoya/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the Fountain of Life Church faulted the issuance of a bench warrant against its Senior Pastor, Jimmy Odukoya, claiming he was not served with the restraining order.

On 26 Nov 2026, [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/26/breaking-court-issues-bench-warrant-against-odukoya-for-disobeying-order-transfers-case/), [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/jimmy-odukoyas-arrest-ordered-by-court-amid-fountain-of-life-crisis/), [The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/leadership-crisis-jimmy-odukoya-faces-arrest-as-court-issues-bench-warrant/) reported that a Lagos State High Court issued a bench warrant against Pastor Jimmy Odukoya for failing to attend a hearing.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/just-in-lagos-court-orders-jimmy-odukoyas-arrest/) reported that Jimmy Odukoya stated he had not seen or been legally served with the warrant.

On 24 Nov 2026, [AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611240340.html) reported that pastor Jimmy Odukoya faces jail risks over alleged disobedience of a court order and was directed by the court to appear on November 26.

On 24 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/court-orders-jimmy-odukoya-to-appear-thursday-over-church-dispute/) reported that the Lagos State High Court directed Senior Pastor Jimmy Odukoya to appear before it on Thursday, November 26, over a church dispute.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/fountain-of-life-trustees-file-contempt-proceedings-against-jimmy-odukoya/) reported that the Incorporated Trustees of The Fountain of Life Church instituted contempt proceedings against Pastor Jimmy Odukoya over alleged disobedience of a Lagos court order.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/nigeria/1742936-breaking-court-summons-jimmy-odukoya-fountain-life-church-saga-reason/) reported that the Lagos State High Court issued a fresh major order to Pastor Jimmy Odukoya amid the deepened church crisis.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/fountain-okonkwo-preaches-unity-jimmy-insists-court-order-not-served/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Bishop Mike Okonkwo urged members not to take sides while Jimmy Odukoya stated he has not been served the interim court order.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/leadership-crisis-odukoya-says-fountain-of-life-church-remains-strong-unshakable/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Jimmy Odukoya stated the Fountain of Life Church remains strong and unshakable as the leadership crisis moves to the Lagos High Court.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/leadership-crisis-fountain-of-life-members-express-hope-for-resolution/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Fountain of Life Church members voiced hope for a resolution of the leadership crisis as Pastor Jimmy Odukoya received a rousing welcome at Sunday service.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/ive-not-been-served-jimmy-odukoya-speaks-on-court-injunction-amid-church-crisis/), [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/fountain-of-life-crisis-i-have-not-been-served-court-injunction-legally-jimmy-odukoya/) reported that Pastor Jimmy Odukoya stated he has not been formally served with a court injunction restraining him from acting as senior pastor.

On 22 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/dont-take-sides-bishop-okonkwo-warns-fountain-of-life-members/) reported that Bishop Mike Okonkwo made a surprise appearance at The Fountain of Life Church in Ilupeju, Lagos.

On 22 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/cheers-jubilation-as-jimmy-odukoya-arrives-church-amid-leadership-crisis/) reported that members of the church in Ilupeju, Lagos, gave Pastor Jimmy Odukoya a rousing welcome as he arrived for the Sunday service.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/dont-take-sides-bishop-okonkwo-tells-fountain-of-life-church-members/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Bishop Mike Okonkwo urged church members not to take sides in the leadership crisis.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/photos-heavy-police-presence-at-fountain-of-life-church-amid-leadership-crisis/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported a heavy police presence at the Fountain of Life Church in Ilupeju, Lagos, amid the leadership dispute.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/fountain-of-life-crisis-deepens-as-jimmy-sues-sister-others/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Fountain of Life senior pastor Jimmy Odukoya took his sister Tolu and seven trustees to a Federal High Court in Lagos.

On 21 Nov 2026, [The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/jimmy-odukoya-sues-sister-fountain-of-life-trustees-over-church-dispute/), [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/fountain-of-life-church-odukoya-drags-sister-others-to-court-over-removal-as-senior-pastor/) reported that Jimmy Odukoya instituted a court action against his sister and Fountain of Life Church trustees over his removal as senior pastor.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/nigeria/1742636-breaking-jimmy-odukoya-drags-sister-pastors-court-1-demand/) reported that Pastor Jimmy Odukoya dragged his sister and pastors to court making one demand.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/jimmy-odukoya-sues-sister-pastors-asks-court-to-declare-removal-illegal/) reported that Jimmy Odukoya approached the Federal High Court in Lagos to challenge his removal from office and ask the court to declare his removal illegal.

On 20 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/fountain-of-life-church-denies-being-sealed-announces-sunday-service/), [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/fountain-of-life-denies-closure-amid-leadership-crisis/), [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/fountain-of-life-debunks-closure-rumours-asks-worshippers-to-attend-sunday-service/) reported that The Fountain of Life Church dismissed reports that its premises had been sealed and invited members to attend Sunday service.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/fountain-of-life-church-dismisses-closure-claims-announces-sunday-service/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that The Fountain of Life Church stated it is not sealed and invited worshippers to a Sunday service.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/fountain-of-life-church-sealed-by-police-as-leadership-crisis-deepens/) reported that police officers sealed The Fountain of Life Church in Ilupeju, Lagos, as the leadership crisis deepened.

On 20 Nov 2026, [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/20/fountain-of-life-succession-crisis-court-restrains-jimmy-odukoya-as-leadership-dispute-deepens/) reported that the Lagos State High Court restrained Jimmy Odukoya from parading himself as the Senior Pastor and Spiritual Head of the Fountain of Life Church.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/court-restrains-jimmy-odukoya-from-parading-as-fountain-of-life-pastor/), [Punch](https://punchng.com/court-restrains-jimmy-odukoya-from-acting-as-fountain-of-life-pastor/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web), [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/court-restrains-jimmy-odukoya-from-parading-self-as-fountain-of-life-senior-pastor/) reported that a Lagos State High Court restrained Jimmy Odukoya from parading himself as the senior pastor and spiritual head of the Fountain of Life Church.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/fountain-of-life-church-postpones-thanksgiving-service/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the Fountain of Life Church postponed its 2026 Thanksgiving service amid a leadership dispute without providing a new date.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/how-my-sister-asked-me-to-step-aside-for-her-to-become-board-chairman-jimmy-odukoya/), [The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/fountain-of-life-crisis-jimmy-accuses-sisters-of-leaking-fathers-succession-video/) reported that Pastor Jimmy Odukoya alleged his sister Tolu Odukoya-Ijogun asked him to step aside as board chairman.

On 19 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/my-late-father-appeared-to-me-urged-me-to-stand-firm-jimmy-odukoya/) reported that Pastor Jimmy Odukoya stated his late father appeared to him in a dream and urged him to stand firm.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/keeping-my-fathers-succession-video-was-a-mistake-jimmy-odukoya/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web), [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/i-disobeyed-fathers-order-to-delete-succession-video-jimmy-odukoya/) reported that Pastor Jimmy Odukoya admitted that keeping his late father's succession video was a mistake and that he disobeyed his father's order.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/my-late-father-appeared-in-dream-warned-me-not-to-succumb-jimmy-odukoya/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Jimmy Odukoya stated his late father appeared in a dream and warned him not to succumb to trustees.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/fountain-of-life-crisis-jimmy-odukoya-alleges-conspiracy/) reported that Pastor Jimmy Odukoya broke his silence regarding the leadership crisis at The Fountain of Life Church and alleged a conspiracy.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/nigeria/1741982-pastor-rotimi-okpaise-facts-fountain-lifes-interim-leader/) reported that Pastor Rotimi Okpaise was appointed as interim leader of the Fountain of Life Church following the alleged removal of Jimmy Odukoya.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/meet-kunle-areogun-taiwo-odukoyas-preferred-successor/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web), [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/fountain-of-life-who-is-kunle-areogun-late-pastor-odukoyas-preferred-successor/) reported that Pastor Kunle Areogun has emerged at the center of The Fountain of Life Church leadership crisis as the late Pastor Taiwo Odukoya's preferred successor.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/jimmy-odukoya-inside-the-fountain-of-life-leadership-crisis/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that two groups within The Fountain of Life Church are making competing claims over the leadership of the Lagos-based ministry following an announcement.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/fountain-of-life-crisis-board-accuses-jimmy-odukoya-of-hijacking-churchs-social-media-accounts/) reported that the Board of Trustees of the Fountain of Life Church accused Pastor Jimmy Odukoya of hijacking the church's social media accounts.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/fountain-of-life-church-appoints-rotimi-okpaise-as-interim-leader/), [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/nigeria/1741904-alleged-jimmy-odukoya-removal-fountain-life-trustees-interim-leader/) reported that the Board of Trustees of The Fountain of Life Church appointed Pastor Rotimi Okpaise as interim leader.

On 17 Nov 2026, [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/17/fountain-of-life-church-in-fresh-dispute-over-jimmy-odukoyas-removal/) reported that a statement was posted on the Fountain of Life Church's platform hours after the announcement regarding Pastor Jimmy Odukoya's removal as Senior Pastor.

On 17 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/jimmy-odukoya-removed-as-senior-pastor-of-fountain-of-life-church/), [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/just-in-fountain-of-life-church-removes-jimmy-odukoya-as-senior-pastor/), [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/nigeria/1741750-breaking-fountain-life-church-removes-jimmy-odukoya-senior-pastor/), [The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/fountain-of-life-church-removes-jimmy-odukoya-as-senior-pastor/), [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/17/fountain-of-life-removes-jimmy-odukoya-as-senior-pastor/), [Punch](https://punchng.com/breaking-fountain-of-life-church-removes-jimmy-odukoya-as-senior-pastor/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the Board of Trustees of the Fountain of Life Church in Lagos removed Pastor Jimmy Odukoya as its senior pastor, citing the late founder Taiwo Odukoya's recorded instructions and succession arrangements.

On 17 Nov 2026, [BBC](https://www.bbc.com/pidgin/articles/cmqlq5xn3yl5o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss), [Punch](https://punchng.com/jimmy-odukoyas-removal-invalid-says-fountain-of-life-church/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web), [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/fountain-of-life-church-rejects-jimmy-odukoyas-removal/) reported that the Fountain of Life Church rejected reports alleging that Pastor Jimmy Odukoya had been removed as its senior pastor, describing the decision as invalid.

stories.title: NDC Alleges Plot to Silence Obi, Opposition Members, Vows to Resist Intimidation
stories.label: APC Kano stakeholders support group

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1743503-2027-presidency-seyi-makindes-camp-speaks-alleged-plan-step-atiku/), [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/2027-election-makinde-may-succumb-to-atiku-i-wish-hes-with-us-bwala/) reported that Seyi Makinde's campaign labeled claims that he will step down from the 2027 presidential race for Atiku Abubakar as fake news.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/928199-kano-apc-kicks-as-group-petitions-against-2023-governorship-election-petition-judgement.html) reported that the Kano APC council described a petition authored by Suleiman Malali regarding the 2023 governorship election petition judgment as legally flawed.

On 26 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/2027-your-sacrifices-wont-be-in-vain-obi-to-families-of-slain-ndc-members/) reported that former presidential candidate Peter Obi condemned the killings of Nigerian Democratic Congress members.

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/2027-voters-register-shrinks-to-100m-after-inec-removes-1-6m-records/) reported that the Independent National Electoral Commission removed more than 1.6 million invalid, duplicate, and deceased persons records from the supplementary voters register, bringing the total to 100 million.

On 25 Nov 2026, [AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611250546.html), [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/atiku-at-80-tinubu-advocates-politics-without-bitterness-celebrates-arthur-eze-at-78/) reported that President Bola Ahmed Tinubu congratulated Prince Arthur Eze on his 78th birthday.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/inecs-verified-voters-register-exceeds-100-million-says-amupitan/) reported that INEC Chairman Prof. Joash O. Amupitan stated that the commission's verified voters' register exceeds 100 million.

On 24 Nov 2026, [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/24/2027-actionaid-challenges-inec-over-voter-register-errors-result-transparency/) reported that ActionAid Nigeria challenged the Independent National Electoral Commission to account for errors in the voters' register.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/927454-2027-politics-watch-atikus-withdrawal-denial-tinubus-lagos-turnout-push-seraps-suit-against-inec.html) reported that Atiku Abubakar rejected claims that he had quit the presidential race and Bola Tinubu urged greater voter mobilisation.

On 22 Nov 2026, [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/22/rep-dasuki-inec-under-amupitan-has-worst-voter-data/) reported that House of Representatives Deputy Minority Leader Abdussamad Dasuki raised alarm over the poor state of the Independent National Electoral Commission's voter data.

On 22 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/inec-under-amupitan-has-worst-voter-data-compromised-register-could-jeopardise-2027-election-rep-dasuki/) reported that Deputy Minority Leader Dasuki stated that compromised voter registers could jeopardise the 2027 election.

On 22 Nov 2026, [The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/serap-drags-inec-data-protection-commission-to-court-over-alleged-ai-fraud-in-voters-register/) reported that SERAP filed a lawsuit against the National Data Protection Commission and INEC over alleged artificial intelligence fraud in the voters' register.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/serap-sues-ndpc-inec-over-ai-manipulation-of-voters-register/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that SERAP sued NDPC and INEC at the Federal High Court in Abuja seeking an independent probe into AI-generated photos and possible data breaches in the voters' register.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/2027-voter-register-row-sparks-electoral-manipulation-fears/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web), [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/serap-sues-ndpc-inec-over-alleged-ai-manipulation-of-voters-register/) reported that AI-generated photos in INEC's preliminary voter register sparked concerns, leading SERAP to file a lawsuit against the National Data Protection Commission and INEC.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/inec-backs-code-for-independent-tabulation-of-2027-election-results/) reported that the Independent National Electoral Commission endorsed a voluntary Code of Conduct for independent tabulation and publication of election results.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/926632-atiku-asks-inec-to-open-ai-system-for-independent-audit-ahead-of-2027-elections.html) reported that ADC presidential candidate Atiku Abubakar asked INEC to open its AI system for an independent audit ahead of the 2027 elections.

On 20 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/inec-must-open-ai-system-to-independent-audit-atiku/) reported that ADC presidential candidate Atiku Abubakar demanded an independent audit of INEC's artificial intelligence system.

On 19 Nov 2026, [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/19/2027-independent-results-tabulation-cant-replace-statutory-collation-inec-declares/) reported that INEC declared independent results tabulation cannot replace statutory collation.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/2027-atiku-demands-scrutiny-of-inecs-ai-system-for-processing-election-results/), [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/19/atiku-demands-independent-audit-of-inecs-ai-system-ahead-of-2027-elections/), [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1742321-2027-elections-atiku-challenges-inec-reveal-ai-technology-source-code/) reported that former Vice President Atiku Abubakar demanded that INEC submit its proposed artificial intelligence system for processing election results to independent scrutiny.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Authority (Nigeria)](https://authorityngr.com/2026/11/18/n11-2tr-opaque-pipeline-security-bill-exceeds-military-budget-ndc/) reported that the Nigeria Democratic Congress National Campaign Council accused President Bola Tinubu's administration of prioritising opaque spending on a pipeline security bill.

On 18 Nov 2026, [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/18/ndc-raises-the-alarm-over-voter-register-demands-nationwide-audit-by-inec/) reported that the Nigeria Democratic Congress National Campaign Council raised concerns over the integrity of the Independent National Electoral Commission and demanded a nationwide audit.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/2027-ndc-alleges-voter-register-inflation-demands-probe-of-n11-2trn-nnpcl-funds/) reported that the Nigeria Democratic Congress raised concerns over the credibility of the 2027 general elections and the handling of public funds.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/925913-2027-inec-proposes-code-to-regulate-independent-result-tabulation.html), [AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611170671.html) reported that the Independent National Electoral Commission proposed a code of conduct to regulate independent election result tabulation ahead of the 2027 general elections.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/2027-makinde-campaign-faults-tinubu-over-federal-recruitment-freeze/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web), [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/makinde-campaign-slams-tinubu-over-recruitment-embargo/) reported that Seyi Makinde's Allied Peoples Movement Presidential Campaign Organisation criticised President Bola Tinubu over a federal recruitment freeze.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/925987-makinde-campaign-group-criticises-tinubu-over-federal-governments-recruitment-freeze.html) reported that Mr Makinde's campaign organisation stated that the employment restriction would worsen Nigeria's high unemployment rate.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/ndc-alleges-n11-2trn-pipeline-security-bill-exceeds-military-budget/), [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/17/ndc-tinubus-n11-2trn-pipeline-security-bill-exceeds-twice-defence-budget/) reported that the Nigeria Democratic Congress accused President Bola Tinubu's administration of presiding over an opaque N11.2 trillion pipeline security bill and demanded a forensic audit.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/924782-makindes-campaign-group-demands-probe-of-tinubus-n11-2trn-crude-oil-backed-loans.html) reported that Makinde's campaign group demanded that the federal government disclose lenders, amounts borrowed, interest rates, management fees, and repayment terms for Tinubu's N11.2trn crude oil-backed loans.

On 13 Nov 2026, [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/13/account-for-n11-2-trillion-crude-oil-advance-sale-mdpco-challenges-tinubu/) reported that the Makinde-Daura Presidential Campaign Organisation challenged President Bola Tinubu's administration to account for the N11.2 trillion crude oil advance sale.

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/police-arrest-six-suspects-recover-n11-7m-stolen-goods-in-borno/) reported that the Borno State Police Command arrested six suspects and recovered stolen goods valued at over N11.7 million in shop-breaking incidents across Maiduguri.

On 26 Nov 2026, [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/26/ibom-lng-partners-afreximbank-to-support-1-5bn-lng-project-in-akwa-ibom/) reported that Ibom LNG & Logistics Base Limited signed a Financial Advisory Agreement with Afreximbank to support mobilising a $1.5 billion LNG project in Akwa Ibom.

On 25 Nov 2026, [The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/police-arrest-six-in-akwa-ibom-raid-recover-gun-ammunition-human-skull/) reported that police arrested six suspects and recovered a firearm, ammunition, and a human skull during a raid at Abiakpo Village.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/police-arrest-six-recover-human-skull-in-akwa-ibom/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Akwa Ibom police arrested six suspects and recovered a human skull, a firearm, and ammunition from an alleged gang hideout in Obot Akara.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/927640-akwa-ibom-csos-raise-alarm-over-budget-secrecy-exclusion-of-women-others.html) reported that civil society groups stated the absence of detailed reports makes it impossible to establish whether approved funds for women, girls, and persons with disabilities were properly allocated.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/ssouth-west/927771-adeleke-inaugurates-26-subcommittees-for-tinubus-re-election-campaign-in-osun.html) reported that cross-party political leaders in Osun State inaugurated 26 subcommittees to coordinate electioneering and mobilize support for President Bola Tinubu's re-election campaign.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/osun-tinubu-campaign-council-sets-1-5-million-vote-target/) reported that the Osun State Presidential Campaign Council for President Bola Tinubu set a target of 1.5 million votes and inaugurated 26 subcommittees.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/south-south-regional/927541-eno-admits-akwa-ibom-federal-lawmaker-not-doing-well-pleads-with-voters-to-re-elect-him.html) reported that Akwa Ibom Governor Umo Eno admitted a federal lawmaker was not doing well and pleaded with voters to re-elect him.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/akwa-ibom-gov-inaugurates-new-lg-secretariat/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Governor Umo Eno inaugurated the new Ika Local Government Secretariat in Akwa Ibom and stated the 2027 budget will fund 10km of roads in each of 31 LGAs.

On 23 Nov 2026, [The Authority (Nigeria)](https://authorityngr.com/2026/11/23/akwa-ibom-united-for-tinubus-re-election-akpabio-declares-targets-two-million-votes/) reported that Senate President Godswill Akpabio declared that Akwa Ibom State is united behind President Bola Tinubu's re-election and targets two million votes.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/south-south-regional/927307-police-in-akwa-ibom-honour-gov-eno-akpabio-254-officers.html) reported that the Akwa Ibom police command honored Governor Eno, Senate President Akpabio, and 254 officers at an award and dinner night in Uyo.

On 22 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/2027-akwa-ibom-opposition-to-vote-tinubu-akpabio/) reported that Senate President Godswill Akpabio revealed that the APC and other opposition political parties in Akwa Ibom formed a coalition to vote for President Tinubu.

On 20 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/akpabio-abbas-matawalle-pledge-20-million-votes-for-tinubu/) reported that Senate President Godswill Akpabio, Speaker Tajudeen Abbas, and Minister of State for Defence Bello Matawalle pledged 20 million votes for President Tinubu in 2027.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/fct-traders-artisans-pledge-tinubu-200000-votes/) reported that traders and artisans in the Federal Capital Territory pledged 200,000 votes.

On 19 Nov 2026, [The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/moniepoint-moves-to-enrol-24000-akwa-ibom-residents-for-fgs-%e2%82%a650000-grant/) reported that Moniepoint Microfinance Bank partnered with the Akwa Ibom State Ministry of Humanitarian Affairs to facilitate access to the Federal Government's ₦50,000 grant for 24,000 residents.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/south-south-regional/926280-in-akwa-ibom-residents-say-major-agricultural-project-worsens-road-condition.html) reported that Akwa Ibom residents stated drainage works associated with Governor Umo Eno's agricultural project worsened flooding, destroyed a community road, and cut off families.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/more-news/926070-first-ladys-food-relief-reaches-vulnerable-akwa-ibom-residents.html) reported that the First Lady's Food Outreach Scheme launched in March 2024 has provided direct nutritional relief to persons with disabilities, widows, and other vulnerable groups in Akwa Ibom.

On 18 Nov 2026, [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/18/first-lady-extends-food-outreach-to-2500-vulnerable-people-in-akwa-ibom/), [The Authority (Nigeria)](https://authorityngr.com/2026/11/18/rhi-extends-food-support-to-2500-vulnerable-households-in-akwa-ibom/) reported that the Renewed Hope Initiative led by First Lady Oluremi Tinubu extended its food outreach program to 2,500 vulnerable people, widows, and persons with disabilities in Akwa Ibom State.

On 16 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/2500-akwa-ibom-widows-pwds-benefit-from-first-ladys-food-intervention/) reported that at least 2,500 widows, persons with disabilities, and vulnerable persons in Akwa Ibom State received food assistance under the Renewed Hope initiative.

On 16 Nov 2026, [The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/apc-begins-31-lga-campaign-tour-in-akwa-ibom-targets-mkpat-enin-first/) reported that the APC began its 31-LGA campaign tour in Akwa Ibom, targeting Mkpat Enin first.

On 13 Nov 2026, [The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/akwa-ibom-targets-solar-powered-water-projects-in-369-wards-approves-n1-2trn-2027-budget/) reported that Akwa Ibom State targeted solar-powered water projects in 369 wards and approved its 2027 budget.

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mercado/2026/11/governo-descarta-nova-ligacao-de-lula-a-trump-sobre-tarifas-e-aguarda-setor-privado.shtml) reported that the Brazilian government is consulting with the private sector regarding proposed U.S. tariffs against Brazilian items.

On 26 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/brasil-excluye-a-milei-de-la-lista-de-invitados-a-la-posesion-de-lula-33326343), [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/javier-milei-queda-fuera-de-la-lista-de-invitados-a-la-posesion-de-lula-evalua-invitar-a-un-opositor-argentino/) reported that Brazilian authorities excluded Argentine President Javier Milei from the list of invited guests to Lula's presidential inauguration.

On 26 Nov 2026, [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/politica/brasil-analiza-invitar-a-otras-autoridades-argentinas-en-lugar-de-milei-a-la-asuncion-de-lula-nid26112026/) reported that Celso Amorim, special advisor to the Brazilian presidency for international affairs, stated that Brazil is analyzing inviting other Argentine authorities instead of Javier Milei to Lula's inauguration to send a message.

On 26 Nov 2026, [MercoPress](https://en.mercopress.com/2026/11/26/brazil-withdraws-its-ambassador-to-argentina-and-will-not-invite-milei-to-lula-s-inauguration?utm_source=feed&utm_medium=rss&utm_content=main&utm_campaign=rss) reported that the Brazilian government decided to permanently withdraw its ambassador in Buenos Aires, Julio Bitelli, and exclude Javier Milei from Lula's presidential inauguration.

On 25 Nov 2026, [O Dia](https://odia.ig.com.br/mundo-e-ciencia/2026/11/7325850-brasil-decide-que-embaixador-nao-deve-voltar-a-argentina-de-milei.html) reported that the Brazilian government decided that its ambassador will not return to Argentina after the Argentine foreign minister questioned the Brazilian election without evidence.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/governo-lula-decide-nao-enviar-embaixador-de-volta-a-argentina-apos-novo-ataque-de-milei.shtml) reported that the Lula administration decided not to send its ambassador back to Argentina after new attacks by Milei.

On 24 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/24/governo-lula-decide-manter-representacao-na-argentina-sem-embaixador-e-descarta-convite-a-milei-para-a-posse.ghtml) reported that ambassador Julio Bitelli will not assume the post again and that an invitation to Milei for the presidential inauguration was discarded.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/governo-lula-nao-deve-chamar-milei-para-posse.shtml) reported that the Brazilian government does not intend to invite Javier Milei for the presidential inauguration scheduled for a specific date.

stories.title: Egypt road traffic accident condolences

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [Sada El Balad](https://www.elbalad.news/7196010) reported that Prime Minister Mostafa Madbouly reviewed a report from the unified government complaints system regarding inquiries and reports received concerning the Warraq Ring Road accident.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Sada El Balad](https://www.elbalad.news/7196146) reported that Professional Footballers Association head Magdy Abdel Gany announced a financial donation for the families of victims and injured of the Warraq accident.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Sada El Balad](https://www.elbalad.news/7195960) reported that the Egyptian cabinet announced receiving contributions totaling hundreds of millions of pounds to support the families of victims of the Ring Road and Warraq accidents.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Al-Masry Al-Youm](https://www.almasryalyoum.com/news/details/4421118) reported that Awqaf Minister Osama Al-Azhari directed mosques across Egypt to hold absent funeral prayers for the victims of the Ring Road accident.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Sada El Balad](https://www.elbalad.news/7195522) reported that the African Football Confederation approved Zamalek's request for a minute of silence for the victims of the Ring Road accident.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Al-Masry Al-Youm](https://www.almasryalyoum.com/news/details/4420530) reported that Islam Azzam, head of the Financial Regulatory Authority, instructed the Egyptian Motor Insurance Pool to quickly disburse compensation to the families of victims and the injured from the Ring Road fire in Warraq.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Sada El Balad](https://www.elbalad.news/7195279) reported that the government complaints system announced it is receiving inquiries from families of victims and the injured via the hotline 16528.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Al-Masry Al-Youm](https://www.almasryalyoum.com/news/details/4420752) reported that the Secretary General of the Gulf Cooperation Council expressed condolences to Egypt over the Ring Road fire victims.
On 26 Nov 2026, [Sada El Balad](https://www.elbalad.news/7195699) reported that actress Asmaa Galal mourned the victims of the Warraq fire.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Sada El Balad](https://www.elbalad.news/7195712) reported that Saudi King Salman bin Abdulaziz Al Saud and Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman bin Abdulaziz Al Saud sent cables of condolence to Egyptian President Abdel Fattah al-Sisi over the victims of the Warraq accident.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Al-Masry Al-Youm](https://www.almasryalyoum.com/news/details/4421114) reported that the management of the Arab Excellence and Creativity Forum postponed its fifth-edition ceremony, which was scheduled for today, to mourn the souls of the victims of the Warraq Ring Road accident.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Sada El Balad](https://www.elbalad.news/7195524) reported that television programme presenters wore black to express grief over the Ring Road accident in the Warraq area and sent messages of solidarity to the victims' families.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Al-Masry Al-Youm](https://www.almasryalyoum.com/news/details/4420755) reported that the North Giza Prosecution identified the body of the heavy transport fuel tanker driver who died in the Warraq fire accident and ordered blood tests to check for drug use.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Asharq News](https://asharq.com/reports/204418/%D8%A8%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B5%D9%88%D8%B1-%D9%88%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%81%D9%8A%D8%AF%D9%8A%D9%88-%D9%85%D8%B4%D8%A7%D9%87%D8%AF-%D9%85%D9%86-%D8%AD%D8%B1%D9%8A%D9%82-%D8%AF%D8%A7%D8%A6%D8%B1%D9%8A-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%88%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%82-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D9%85%D8%B5%D8%B1/) reported on footage and scenes from the massive fuel truck fire on the Giza Ring Road in Egypt after a tanker collided with a concrete barrier, killing 31 people and injuring 26.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Asharq News](https://asharq.com/reports/204414/%D8%AD%D8%B1%D9%8A%D9%82-%D8%AF%D8%A7%D8%A6%D8%B1%D9%8A-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%88%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%82-%D8%AA%D8%B6%D8%A7%D9%85%D9%86-%D8%B9%D8%B1%D8%A8%D9%8A-%D9%85%D8%B9-%D9%85%D8%B5%D8%B1-%D9%88%D8%AA%D8%B9%D8%A7%D8%B2-%D9%84%D8%A3%D8%B3%D8%B1-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B6%D8%AD%D8%A7%D9%8A%D8%A7/) reported that Arab countries expressed solidarity with Egypt following the petroleum tanker truck accident on the Warraq Ring Road in Giza, which resulted in 31 deaths and 21 injuries.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Sada El Balad](https://www.elbalad.news/7195064) reported that eyewitness Yusuf Ahmed gave an account of the initial moments of the fuel truck overturning and catching fire on the Warraq Ring Road.
On 26 Nov 2026, [Sada El Balad](https://www.elbalad.news/7195276) reported that singer Sherine Abdel Wahab expressed grief and sympathy for the victims of the Warraq accident.
On 26 Nov 2026, [Sada El Balad](https://www.elbalad.news/7195021) reported that actress Yasmine Sabri offered condolences to the families of the victims of the Warraq Ring Road fire.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/191025/%D9%82%D9%88%D9%89-%D9%88%D9%81%D8%B5%D8%A7%D8%A6%D9%84-%D9%81%D9%84%D8%B3%D8%B7%D9%8A%D9%86%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%AA%D8%AA%D8%B6%D8%A7%D9%85%D9%86-%D9%85%D8%B9-%D9%85%D8%B5%D8%B1-%D9%88%D8%AA%D8%B9%D8%B2%D9%8A-%D8%A8%D8%B6%D8%AD%D8%A7%D9%8A%D8%A7-%D8%AD%D8%B1%D9%8A%D9%82-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AC%D9%8A%D8%B2%D8%A9) reported that Palestinian factions and Hamas expressed solidarity with Egypt and offered condolences over the victims of the Ring Road fire in Giza's Warraq district.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Asharq News](https://asharq.com/reports/204423/%D9%85%D8%B5%D8%B1-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%86%D9%8A%D8%A7%D8%A8%D8%A9-%D8%AA%D8%B9%D9%84%D9%86-%D8%B6%D8%A8%D8%B7-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%AA%D9%87%D9%85-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%AA%D8%B3%D8%A8%D8%A8-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%AD%D8%A7%D8%AF%D8%AB-%D8%AF%D8%A7%D8%A6%D8%B1%D9%8A-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%88%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%82/) reported that the Egyptian Public Prosecution announced the arrest of the suspect accused of causing the petroleum tanker collision and fire in Giza's Waraq district.
On 25 Nov 2026, [Al-Masry Al-Youm](https://www.almasryalyoum.com/news/details/4420740) reported that Turki Al Sheikh offered condolences to Egyptians over the fatal accident victims.
On 26 Nov 2026, [Al-Masry Al-Youm](https://www.almasryalyoum.com/news/details/4420750) reported that the Libyan government expressed condolences to Egypt over the Cairo Ring Road fire victims.

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/nwokos-supporter-injured-during-apc-primary-dies/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Senator Ned Nwoko announced that a supporter injured during the APC Delta North senatorial primary has died.

On 26 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/tinubu-to-terrorists-bandits-now-is-your-chance-to-lay-down-arms/) reported that President Bola Tinubu renewed his call on terrorists and bandits to lay down their arms and renounce violence.

On 25 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/tinubu-to-terrorists-bandits-this-is-your-window-to-surrender-now-lay-down-your-arms/) reported that President Bola Tinubu challenged terrorists and bandits to surrender their weapons and abandon violence during an APC rally in Borno State.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/17-die-25-injured-in-zamfara-road-crash-frsc/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the Federal Road Safety Corps confirmed 17 people died in a road crash at Kisami village along the Gummi-Daki Takwas-Anka Road.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/zamfara-govt-suspends-campaign-after-road-crash/) reported that the Zamfara government suspended campaign activities in Maru Local Government Area following the accident.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/headlines/927635-makinde-accuses-apc-of-importing-supporters-for-tinubus-rally-orders-fumigation.html) reported that Mr Makinde alleged during a live radio programme that the APC mobilised supporters from neighbouring states to attend Saturday's rally.
