On 17 Nov 2026, [Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/nnorth-east/925953-terrorists-disrupt-apc-campaign-in-borno.html), [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1741914-just-terrorists-disrupt-apc-campaign-borno-details-emerge/) reported that suspected terrorists launched mortar bombs and IED attacks targeting the campaign team of Mohammed Mungono in Borno State.

On 17 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/kebbi-apc-rally-tinubu-approves-dry-inland-port-for-kebbi-seeks-support-for-apc-in-2027/), [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/tinubu-approves-kebbi-inland-dry-port-promises-completion-of-landmark-projects-improved-security/), [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/17/at-apc-presidential-rally-in-birnin-kebbi-tinubu-approves-inland-dry-port-for-kebbi/) reported that President Bola Tinubu approved the operationalisation of the Tsamiya Inland Dry Port in Kebbi State.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/two-die-gombe-apc-chairman-campaign-dg-injured-in-crash/) reported that Gombe State Chairman of the All Progressives Congress Mohammed Dantata Ndus and the director-general of the party's 2027 governorship campaign were injured in a vehicle crash while two people died.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/photos-apc-supporters-throng-kebbi-stadium-for-tinubus-rally/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that President Bola Tinubu's presidential rally in Kebbi State attracted a massive crowd of APC supporters and party loyalists.

On 17 Nov 2026, [The Authority (Nigeria)](https://authorityngr.com/2026/11/17/kebbi-state-ready-to-receive-tinubu-for-presidential-campaign-launch-info-commissioner/) reported that the Kebbi State Government, the All Progressives Congress, and state residents declared readiness to receive President Bola Ahmed Tinubu for the presidential campaign launch.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/stay-away-from-tomorrows-apc-campaign-rally-itsekiri-youths-warn-oborevwori/) reported that Itsekiri youths warned political leaders and state governor Sheriff Oborevwori to stay away from the upcoming APC campaign rally.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/aibom-gov-seeks-80000-lg-votes-for-tinubu-apc/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Akwa Ibom State Governor Umo Eno tasked voters in Mkpat Enin local government area to deliver 80,000 votes for President Tinubu and APC candidates in the 2027 polls.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/apc-flags-off-2027-campaign-in-abia-kalu-targets-75-for-tinubu/), [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/abia-apc-kicks-off-presidential-campaign-promises-massive-votes-for-tinubu/) reported that the Abia State chapter of the All Progressives Congress formally kicked off its 2027 presidential campaign rally with assurances to secure massive votes for President Bola Ahmed Tinubu.

stories.title: Severe weather alerts in Argentina

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mexico/primera-tormenta-invernal-de-la-temporada-cual-es-el-pronostico-del-clima-en-los-estados-33325391) reported that the first winter storm will bring intense rain, cold, and snow to several Mexican states over the weekend.

On 26 Nov 2026, [El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/santa-cruz/lluvias-inundan-barrios-crucenos-hay-alerta-crecida-rios_1795688614) reported that heavy rains flooded neighborhoods and prompted alerts over rising river levels in Santa Cruz.

On 25 Nov 2026, [El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/santa-cruz/lanzan-alerta-roja-crecida-extraordinaria-tres-rios-santa-cruz_1795643646) reported that a red alert was issued for extraordinary rises in three rivers in Santa Cruz due to heavy rains.

On 25 Nov 2026, [El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/santa-cruz/sepa-rios-reportan-crecidas-extraordinarias-santa-cruz_1795644342) reported that the municipality of La Guardia is working on an emergency declaration due to the storms.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/loterias-y-quinielas/quiniela-cordoba-resultado-sorteo-nocturna-hoy-miercoles-25-noviembre_0_qFhmeUWt7K.html) reported winning lottery numbers for the Córdoba, Province, and National night draws held on Wednesday, November 25.

On 25 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/nacion/proteccion-civil-alerta-por-la-primera-tormenta-invernal-a-partir-del-26-de-noviembre-pronostican-lluvias-intensas-y-posible-caida-de-nieve/) reported that civil protection authorities issued alerts for the first winter storm starting November 26, forecasting intense rain and possible snowfall.

On 24 Nov 2026, [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/sociedad/hay-alertas-naranja-y-amarilla-por-tormentas-y-vientos-para-este-martes-24-de-noviembre-las-nid24112026/) reported that Argentina's National Meteorological Service warned of adverse conditions in different regions with a forecast high of 30 degrees in Buenos Aires.

On 23 Nov 2026, [El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/pais/fenomeno-nino-defensa-civil-reporta-158-alertas-naranjas-crecidas-rios_1795467984) reported that Civil Defense Vice Minister Roberto Rivero stated 158 orange alerts were issued for rising river levels and sudden water level ascents.

On 22 Nov 2026, [El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/pais/rigen-alertas-naranja-amarilla-crecida-posibles-desbordes-rios-pais_1795348903) reported that yellow priority alerts for rising river levels and potential overflows were issued for multiple departments.

On 19 Nov 2026, [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/sociedad/hay-alerta-amarilla-por-tormentas-lluvias-y-viento-zonda-para-este-jueves-19-de-noviembre-las-nid19112026/) reported that Argentina's National Meteorological Service issued yellow weather alerts for storms, rainfall, and Zonda wind across affected provinces.

On 18 Nov 2026, [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/sociedad/super-nino-en-argentina-el-fenomeno-se-intensifica-y-rigen-alertas-meteorologicas-en-varias-nid18112026/) reported that Argentina's National Meteorological Service maintained orange and yellow level weather warnings for storms across ten provinces.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/sociedad/ciclon-argentina-provincias-alerta-meteorologica-lluvias-intensas-temporal-fin-semana_0_Ug8mUgmGq4.html) reported that nine provinces in Argentina face yellow and orange alerts for storms, abundant precipitation, hail, and strong winds.

stories.title: Nafiu Bala to begin presidential campaign next week, considers Atiku for DG
stories.label: Nigerian opposition political alliance talks

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/oyo-guber-makinde-picked-me-as-successor-out-of-love-for-oyo-adekanmbi-apm-candidate/) reported that Allied Peoples' Movement governorship candidate in Oyo State Bimbo Adekanmbi stated that Governor Seyi Makinde backed his emergence as a successor.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/nafiu-bala-to-begin-presidential-campaign-news-week-eyes-atiku-for-dg/), [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/2027-nafiu-bala-to-kick-off-campaign-wants-atiku-as-dg/) reported that former Deputy National Chairman of the African Democratic Congress Nafiu Bala announced he will begin his presidential campaign next week and expressed interest in having Atiku as director-general.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/nafiu-bala-to-begin-presidential-campaign-next-week-considers-atiku-for-dg/) reported that former African Democratic Congress deputy national chairman Nafiu Bala announced plans to begin his presidential campaign and consider Atiku Abubakar for director-general.

On 26 Nov 2026, [AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611260246.html) reported that a video from an APM event in Nigeria was falsely shared as a rally for ADC presidential aspirant Atiku Abubakar.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/2027-atiku-appoints-bashir-adamu-as-jigawa-adc-campaign-coordinator/) reported that African Democratic Congress presidential candidate Atiku Abubakar appointed Bashir Adamu Kazaure as the Jigawa campaign coordinator.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/928004-adc-postpones-jigawa-presidential-campaign-rally.html) reported that the ADC postponed its Jigawa presidential campaign rally to allow time to prepare for presidential candidate Atiku.

On 25 Nov 2026, [AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611250548.html) reported that Nigerian President Tinubu congratulated African Democratic Congress Presidential Candidate Atiku Abubakar on his 80th birthday.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/oyo-2027-i-wont-step-down-for-anyone-adc-guber-candidate-vows/) reported that African Democratic Congress governorship candidate in Oyo State Adegboyega Adegoke dismissed rumours that he plans to withdraw from the race.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/2027-how-we-plan-to-present-a-common-front-adc-apm-ndc-sdp/) reported that major opposition parties pledged to present a common front to wrest power from the APC ahead of the 2027 general elections.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/adc-crisis-gombe-mocks-atiku-as-feud-deepens/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that ADC faction chairman Nafiu Bala Gombe urged Atiku to register in his ward and promised to consider him for 2027 campaign council chairman.

On 22 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/atiku-to-launch-adc-presidential-campaign-in-jigawa-nov-27/) reported that African Democratic Congress presidential candidate Atiku Abubakar is expected in Jigawa State for a campaign launch on November 27.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/court-declares-aiguobarueghian-as-ndc-candidate-for-ovia-federal-constituency/) reported that the Federal High Court in Benin City declared Charity Iguodala Aiguobarueghian as the Nigeria Democratic Congress House of Representatives candidate for Ovia Federal Constituency.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/926855-court-orders-removal-of-tukur-ribadu-as-adc-governorship-candidate.html) reported that a court ordered the removal of Tukur Ribadu as the ADC governorship candidate for Adamawa State and restrained him from parading himself as the candidate.

On 20 Nov 2026, [The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/court-sacks-ribadu-declares-suleiman-adamawa-adc-governorship-candidate/) reported that the Federal High Court in Abuja removed Tukur Ribadu and declared Suleiman the African Democratic Congress governorship candidate for Adamawa State.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1742472-breaking-drama-court-sacks-adc-governorship-candidate/), [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/2027-court-sacks-adc-governorship-candidate-in-adamawa/) reported that a Federal High Court in Abuja ordered the removal of Tukur Ribadu as the ADC Adamawa governorship candidate.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/adc-ndc-pdp-others-halt-campaigns-sign-common-agreement-nov-30/) reported that member parties of the Coalition for Democracy, including the African Democratic Congress, the Nigeria Democratic Congress, and a faction of the Peoples Democratic Party, agreed to halt campaigns and sign a common agreement on November 30.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/group-asks-inec-to-list-abidikugu-as-oyo-adc-reps-candidate/) reported that an African Democratic Congress support group urged INEC to implement a judgment regarding the Oyo ADC Reps candidate.

On 20 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/adc-crisis-deepens-as-bot-orders-atiku-others-to-halt-campaigns/) reported that the African Democratic Congress Board of Trustees aligned with Nafiu Bala Gombe demanded that Atiku and others halt campaigns.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1742326-court-sacks-atiku-inec-announces-final-decision-adc-crisis/) reported that INEC has disclosed when it will take a final decision on the leadership crisis rocking the ADC.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/adc-crisis-bot-faction-asks-inec-to-delist-mark-candidates/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the Nafiu Gombe-led ADC Board of Trustees faction urged INEC to enforce a Federal High Court judgment and delist uploaded candidates.

On 19 Nov 2026, [The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/tinubus-interview-with-us-strategist-london-sparks-debate-over-access-to-nigerian-media/) reported that President Bola Tinubu's decision to grant an exclusive interview to American political strategist Diana London has triggered public debate over access to Nigerian media.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/fresh-scandal-rocks-tinubus-us-lobbying-team-as-interviewers-2018-theft-conviction-emerges/) reported that questions have emerged regarding the professional background of individuals involved in President Bola Tinubu's American lobbying campaign following revelations about an interviewer's past.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/diana-london-tinubu-should-grant-interviews-to-nigerian-journalists-osinbajos-ex-aide/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web), [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/tinubu-should-grant-interviews-to-nigerian-journalists-akande-says/) reported that Laolu Akande, a former spokesman for ex-Vice-President Yemi Osinbajo, urged President Bola Tinubu to grant interviews to Nigerian journalists.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/2027-tinubu-atiku-obi-contest-a-family-civil-war-lamido/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Sule Lamido stated that the 2027 presidential contest between Tinubu, Atiku, and Obi is a family civil war because the three share similar political backgrounds.

On 19 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/2027-ndume-accuses-politicians-of-using-poor-youths-for-political-violence/) reported that Senator Ali Ndume accused politicians of exploiting poor youths to perpetrate political violence ahead of the 2027 elections.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/2027-why-atiku-is-still-adc-candidate-despite-court-order-inec/) reported that the Independent National Electoral Commission explained why former Vice-President Atiku Abubakar remains listed on its website as the ADC candidate.

On 19 Nov 2026, [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/19/adc-pcc-seeks-postponement-of-inec-november-28-mock-accreditation-exercise/) reported that the ADC-PCC sought the postponement of the INEC November 28 mock accreditation exercise, accused the commission of bias, and raised concerns over short notice.

On 19 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/2027-ndume-warns-political-violence-could-threaten-nigerias-elections/) reported that Senator Ali Ndume warned that rising political violence and intolerance could threaten Nigeria's 2027 general elections.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/rising-political-violence-could-threaten-2027-elections-ndume/) reported that Senator Ndume proposed the establishment of special courts to handle electoral violence cases.

On 19 Nov 2026, [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/19/atiku-to-tinubu-tell-nigerians-if-recorded-interview-was-part-of-4-5m-lobbying-deal/) reported that former Vice President Atiku Abubakar demanded to know whether President Bola Tinubu's recorded interview was part of a $4.5 million lobbying deal.

On 19 Nov 2026, [The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/diana-london-denies-4-5m-payment-for-tinubu-interview-as-atiku-demands-full-disclosure/) reported that American political strategist Diana London denied receiving $4.5 million from the Nigerian government.

On 19 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/2027-tinubu-atiku-obi-in-us-lobbying-controversies/) reported that a widening row over American lobbying activities embroiled President Bola Tinubu, Atiku Abubakar, and Peter Obi.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/us-strategist-denies-4-5m-payment-for-tinubu-interview/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that American political strategist Diana London denied receiving 4.5 million dollars from the Nigerian government or anyone else in the country.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/us-strategist-restricts-x-comments-after-tinubu-interview-backlash/), [Punch](https://punchng.com/american-strategist-restricts-x-comment-after-backlash-over-tinubu-interview/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that American political strategist Diana London restricted access to comments on her X account and deleted posts praising the Nigeria-US security partnership following backlash over her interview with President Bola Tinubu.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/american-strategist-deletes-posts-on-tinubu-nigeria-us-security-ties/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web), [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/american-strategist-deletes-posts-on-tinubu-nigeria-us-security-partnership/) reported that American political strategist Diana London deleted her social media posts regarding her engagement with the Nigerian government and security ties.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/nigeria-is-uss-greatest-ally-in-africa-american-strategist-says-as-tinubu-grants-interview-to-london/) reported that American political strategist Diana London described Nigeria as the United States' greatest ally in Africa.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/photos-tinubu-grants-interview-to-american-political-strategist-diana-london/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that President Bola Tinubu granted an exclusive interview to American political strategist Diana London.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/adc-pcc-asks-inec-to-postpone-mock-accreditation-faults-irev-plan/), [Punch](https://punchng.com/adc-faults-inec-over-short-notice-for-mock-accreditation-exercise/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web), [The Authority (Nigeria)](https://authorityngr.com/2026/11/18/adc-pcc-demands-postponement-of-inecs-november-28-mock-accreditation-exercise-alleges-bias/) reported that the African Democratic Congress Presidential Campaign Council asked the Independent National Electoral Commission to postpone its mock accreditation exercise, citing short notice and alleging bias.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1742114-2027-election-inec-takes-decision-retaining-atiku-final-list-adc-crisis/) reported that INEC provisionally retained Atiku Abubakar on the final presidential candidate list amid the ADC leadership crisis.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/adc-campaign-accuses-inec-of-bias-demands-postponement-of-mock-election-test/) reported that the ADC campaign accused INEC of bias and demanded the postponement of a mock election test.

stories.title: Netanyahu tells aides ‘miracle’ needed to prevent Eisenkot from forming government
stories.label: Ahmed Tibi appointed as deputy speaker of Israel’s Knesset

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261126-netanyahu-tells-aides-miracle-needed-to-prevent-eisenkot-from-forming-government/), [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/politics-and-diplomacy/article-916196) reported that Israeli caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu told aides that a miracle is needed to prevent Yashar party leader Gadi Eisenkot from forming a government, while Likud officials expect Eisenkot to form a government without Netanyahu's party.

On 26 Nov 2026, [IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86332990/Israel-seeks-to-drag-US-into-another-war-with-chemical-weapons) reported that Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi condemned Israeli allegations that Iran is pursuing chemical weapons as an attempt to drag the US into another war.
On 25 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/politics-and-diplomacy/article-916082) reported that Likud and Yashar teams resumed unity government negotiations.

On 25 Nov 2026, [TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/d654b69da553) reported that Israel's opposition stated that Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Defence Minister Israel Katz had a lust for power that drove them out of their minds.

On 25 Nov 2026, [RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/middle-east/2026/1125/1600662-iran-israel/) reported that Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi stated that Israel was trying to drag the United States into another war after an Iranian minister alleged Tehran's involvement.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Arab News](https://www.arabnews.com/middle-east/iran-says-israel-trying-to-deceive-us-into-war-with-chemical-weapons-claim-3014026) reported that Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi accused Israel of attempting to mislead the United States into a conflict by falsely claiming that Iran is developing chemical weapons.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/podcasts/2026-11-24/ty-article-podcast/amos-harel-on-the-israeli-pms-politically-motivated-push-for-war/000001a2-0e5f-d089-a1fe-2f7f2e3b0000) reported that Amos Harel stated there is no urgent need to strike Iran now regarding Netanyahu's push for war.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261124-kushner-israeli-policies-risk-turning-country-into-international-pariah-netanyahu-obstructs-gaza-reconstruction/) reported that US presidential adviser Jared Kushner warned that Israel's current policies risk turning the country into an international pariah and stated that Netanyahu obstructs Gaza reconstruction.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/knessets-tibi-files-complaint-against-israeli-comedian-over-assault-3725919), [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261124-ahmad-tibi-complains-against-israeli-comedian-over-alleged-assault-in-knesset/) reported that Israeli Knesset Deputy Speaker Ahmad Tibi filed an official complaint against right-wing Israeli comedian Guy Hochman for an alleged assault inside the parliament building.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-security/2026-11-23/ty-article/.premium/netanyahu-points-to-irans-chemical-weapons-to-push-for-war-and-stay-in-power/000001a2-09eb-d0d9-a9f6-bdfbca320000) reported that Prime Minister Netanyahu cited Iran's chemical weapons program to press for renewed strikes.
On 23 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/article-915848) reported that Israeli comedian Guy Hochman claimed he was assaulted by Joint List's Ahmad Tibi at the Knesset.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-politics/2026-11-22/ty-article/.premium/eisenkot-bloc-sets-in-motion-plan-to-undo-netanyahus-judicial-coup/000001a2-024f-d9ff-a7b6-93ef846e0000) reported that the Eisenkot bloc set in motion a plan to deliberate bills repealing laws that politicize the Judicial Selection Committee, weaken the attorney general's authority, and reform the media.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/business/economy-finance/2026-11-21/ty-article/.premium/israeli-banks-fear-sanctions-are-closing-in-netanyahu-looks-away/000001a1-f967-d381-ade5-fbe7269d0000) reported that Israeli banks fear sanctions targeting settlement construction could spread to the wider economy.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261120-netanyahu-using-iran-threat-to-obstruct-eisenkot-government-bid-israeli-analysts-say/) reported that Israeli analysts stated Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is seeking to use the Iranian threat to push for another war to obstruct Gadi Eisenkot’s government bid.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-politics/2026-11-19/ty-article-magazine/.premium/the-great-undo-why-the-new-knesset-is-racing-to-dismantle-netanyahus-coup-laws/000001a1-f447-dad7-a9fd-f64fc6130000) reported that the new Knesset majority is moving to undo laws that weakened courts, the attorney general, and the media.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261118-israeli-knesset-approves-9-deputy-speakers-including-2-arab-lawmakers/) reported that the Israeli Knesset approved the appointment of nine deputy speakers, including two Arab lawmakers.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/18/jerusalem-daily-chaos-in-the-knesset-as-new-speaker-elected?traffic_source=rss) reported chaos in the Knesset as a new speaker was elected and the Israeli army beat a journalist near Jericho.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/israeli-opposition-elects-matan-kahana-new-knesset-speaker) reported that the Israeli opposition elected Matan Kahana as new Knesset speaker following a deadlocked general election.

On 18 Nov 2026, [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/middle-east/article/3374954/israels-parliament-moves-roll-back-netanyahus-divisive-legacy) reported that Israel's parliament met under a new speaker from the anti-Benjamin Netanyahu bloc as opponents began a legislative rollback of his legacy.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-politics/2026-11-18/ty-article/.premium/netanyahu-seeks-to-appoint-ex-knesset-speaker-as-minister-against-legal-advice/000001a1-edf1-d165-a7bd-fdffd6bf0000) reported that despite legal advice from the deputy attorney general regarding Supreme Court rulings on caretaker governments, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu plans to appoint the outgoing Knesset speaker as a minister.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/politics-and-diplomacy/article-915294) reported that the Israeli Knesset advanced bills repealing judicial overhaul laws while supported by a parliamentary majority that includes Arab parties.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/18/israeli-parliament-elects-eisenkot-ally-as-new-knesset-speaker/), [Egypt Independent](https://www.egyptindependent.com/israels-parliament-elects-new-knesset-speaker-weakening-netanyahus-grip-on-power/) reported that the Israeli Knesset elected a new speaker backed by Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's opponents.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-politics/2026-11-18/ty-article/.premium/with-new-speaker-elected-eisenkot-bloc-moves-to-repeal-judicial-overhaul-laws/000001a1-edc2-dd16-adbf-edc2b2990000) reported that the Arrangements Committee approved fast-tracking bills to reverse political control over judicial appointments.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisAFBVV95cUxPZ0FvY0VGYXV2RkxSOFMxOENQVF85Mkt5SjZUUXFQS0VuZGpBZjBRbmxnNkVMNWVuRXFOa3lpY09XaE9HNk00UjYtVXJURmtTZGpyaEhEajVoUjh6bGZYbFRzd2NTQUVNd2ExdGFBbkdyXzhnOFZoWjNuRGtuTWpLMmU0U0FrdE40aEtTRnZtZTY5WWRJbFV2UUZXMzI3ZTZSVzFKNDZhYkpYc2hmd3Y2Yg?oc=5) reported that the Israeli parliament elected a speaker backed by Netanyahu opponents.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/israeli-parliament-elects-new-knesset-speaker-backed-by-netanyahus-opponents/article71714379.ece) reported that the Israeli parliament elected Matan Kahana, an ally of Gadi Eisenkot, as the new Knesset Speaker.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/eisenkot-ally-matan-kahana-elected-israeli-parliament-speaker-in-setback-for-netanyahu-101794952478403.html) reported that Matan Kahana secured 66 votes in the 120-member Knesset.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/18/eisenkot-ally-elected-knesset-speaker-with-arab-blocs-backing?traffic_source=rss) reported that Israel's parliament elected Matan Kahana as the new speaker with support from Arab parties.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/elections/2026-11-17/ty-article/.premium/eisenkot-rejects-likud-request-to-bar-arab-parties-from-knesset-leadership-role/000001a1-ea29-d9ff-a7b5-fbafd0bb0000) reported that Gadi Eisenkot rejected demands to bar Arab lawmakers from Knesset leadership roles ahead of a vote to replace the current Likud speaker.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/who-matan-kahana-israels-new-knesset-speaker) reported that Matan Kahana's election gives the opposition control of the Knesset's legislative agenda.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-politics/2026-11-17/ty-article/.premium/who-is-matan-kahana-poised-to-be-israels-next-knesset-speaker/000001a1-e99c-d848-abeb-fb9c8f3e0000) reported that Gadi Eisenkot's ally Matan Kahana has expressed a pragmatic view about ending the war in Gaza while taking a hard line on West Bank settlements.

On 17 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/major-setbacks-for-netanyahu-ahead-of-vote-to-name-new-knesset-speaker) reported that Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's party repeatedly claimed Israel's October 27 election was stolen by Arab-led parties.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/israels-parliament-set-to-select-new-speaker-opposed-to-netanyahu-3725693) reported that Israel's parliament is set to select Matan Kahana as Knesset speaker as Likud resists.

On 17 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/middle-east/20261117-%F0%9F%94%B4-israeli-parliament-elects-eisenkot-ally-matan-kahana-as-speaker), [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/17/world/middleeast/israel-opposition-selects-parliamentary-speaker.html), [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/politics-and-diplomacy/article-915242) reported that Israel's parliament elected Matan Kahana as the new Knesset speaker by a vote of 66 to 52.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261117-israeli-knesset-opens-session-to-elect-new-speaker-amid-government-deadlock/) reported that Israel's parliament opened a session to elect a new speaker to succeed Likud's Amir Ohana amid uncertainty over forming the next government.

On 17 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/politics-and-diplomacy/article-915171) reported that Shas and United Torah Judaism announced they would back Ofir Katz against Kahana in the Knesset speaker vote.

On 17 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/politics-and-diplomacy/article-915157) reported that Ra'am leader Mansour Abbas warned against a minority government without haredi parties and stated openness to an Eisenkot unity government.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-politics/2026-11-17/ty-article/.premium/haredi-parties-back-likud-challenger-to-eisenkot-blocs-knesset-speaker-nominee/000001a1-e922-d381-ade5-ebe3cde10000) reported that UTJ backed a Likud challenger for Knesset Speaker over the Eisenkot bloc's nominee, marking a departure from not recommending Netanyahu.

On 17 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/politics-and-diplomacy/article-915135) reported that Yashar is seeking procedural rules to prevent a potential Likud filibuster during the Knesset speaker election.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-politics/2026-11-17/ty-article/.premium/knesset-set-to-elect-eisenkot-ally-matan-kahana-as-new-speaker/000001a1-e5dc-d381-ade5-effd223b0000) reported that Religious Zionism offered to back Matan Kahana as Knesset speaker if he pledged not to appoint deputies from parties that do not define Hamas as a terror group, a demand Kahana rejected.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261116-israeli-knesset-speaker-nominee-rejects-netanyahus-bid-to-block-arab-lawmakers-from-deputy-posts/) reported that Matan Kahana rejected an offer of support from caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to block Arab lawmakers from deputy posts.

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2642429/atc-postpones-verdict-in-aleema-khans-nov-2024-protest-case-for-eighth-time), [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2047187/rawalpindi-atc-defers-verdict-in-november-2024-protest-case-involving-aleema-khan-until-dec-16) reported that an Anti-Terrorism Court in Rawalpindi postponed the verdict in the November 2024 protest case involving Aleema Khan until December 16.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2047226/security-breach-case-ihc-seeks-replies-from-parties-on-imaan-hadis-appeals-against-their-conviction) reported that the Islamabad High Court issued notices and sought replies from parties on appeals filed by lawyers Imaan Zainab Hazir-Mazari and Hadi.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/pakistan-court-postpones-verdict-against-imran-khans-sister-aleema-for-sixth-time-101795689832476.html) reported that a Pakistan court deferred its verdict against Imran Khan's sister Aleema for the sixth time.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2046995/ps190m-corruption-case-imran-bushras-counsel-says-transaction-caused-no-loss-to-exchequer), [Pakistan Today](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqAFBVV95cUxQMDc1VlZ4cGhPaEl0NkdsWmZNR3YtbDNkbUNxT1h6UEJmQXgya0JUV2J2UEc2VllIMVh6YURkWmpxVVFKVG5GZlpVYVJvRnFtOWFSem1mQXlreTkyOFBGTkZPd3NNeW1OUzlsLVduTGpkV1k4SjFYcHFIVndJY2F6OVp5M3JoWkxnQU16cDBoY2dHT0dNTGRLZFBmM1BacDd0bEhyYkR2aEY?oc=5) reported that counsel for Imran Khan and Bushra Bibi argued in court that the 190 million pound transaction caused no loss to the national exchequer.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2046874/imran-asks-pti-to-reach-out-to-fazl-other-parties) reported that the Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf core committee was briefed on jailed founder Imran Khan's instructions to expand its political alliance and reach out to Fazlur Rehman and other parties.

On 24 Nov 2026, [The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2642048/imran-asks-pti-to-reach-out-to-fazlur-rehman-expand-opposition-alliance), [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2046742/imran-wants-pti-to-expand-political-alliance-extend-outreach-to-fazl-and-other-opposition-parties-core-committee-told) reported that incarcerated PTI founder Imran Khan instructed his party's core committee to expand its political alliance and reach out to Fazlur Rehman and other opposition parties.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1586208/imran-bushra-seek-live-coverage-of-190m-case-appeals/) reported that former prime minister Imran Khan and his wife Bushra Bibi sought live streaming of their 190 million pound case appeals in the Islamabad High Court.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2046751/pti-moves-ihc-for-live-broadcast-of-al-qadir-trust-case-hearing) reported that the Pakistan Tehreek-i-Insaf filed a petition in the Islamabad High Court seeking a live broadcast of the appeal proceedings in the £190 million reference case.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2046539/ptis-zafar-says-karachi-can-become-separate-province-imran-khan-favours-new-administrative-units) reported that PTI parliamentary leader in the Senate Barrister Ali Zafar stated that Karachi could become a separate province and that Imran Khan favors new administrative units.

On 23 Nov 2026, [The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2641909/imran-khan-may-be-engaged-on-new-provinces-if-needed-says-tariq-fazal) reported that Tariq Fazal stated Imran Khan may be engaged on new provinces if needed, while the PPP warned against imposing decisions through referendums.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/ihc-grants-barrister-gohar-more-time-to-submit-reply-in-imran-khans-x-account-case/) reported that the Islamabad High Court granted PTI Chairman Barrister Gohar Ali Khan additional time to submit a reply in a case.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/ex-pakistan-pm-imran-khan-needs-immediate-help-to-prevent-heart-damage-delay-could-lead-to-serious-consequences-101795402560694.html) reported that Pakistan's Imran Khan needs immediate help to prevent heart damage, warning in an open letter that he may not return alive.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1585157/ihc-schedules-appeals-in-190m-pounds-case-for-nov-25/) reported that the Islamabad High Court scheduled appeals filed by PTI founder Imran Khan and his wife Bushra Bibi in the 190 million pounds case for November 25.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1584955/pti-founder-bushra-bibi-undergo-medical-checkups/) reported that a special medical team examined PTI founder Imran Khan and Bushra Bibi at Adiala Jail.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/imran-khan-bushra-bibi-190-million-al-qadir-trust-case-fixed-for-hearing-on-nov-25/) reported that the Islamabad High Court scheduled appeals filed by Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf founder Imran Khan and Bushra Bibi in the £190 million Al-Qadir Trust case for hearing on Nov 25.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Pakistan Today](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixAFBVV95cUxQbV96NTNUd3dRQ0lPcG5mb1U0UjR5Q2Y2VFhrWVpYQ3JadjZhcFdVWUp4cmpJUFRYVEJUZHBYNlVzVG92ZFRTX3F4dVNEU0xkU3dLMVRzUWp1VTg5dDdONEZOcWFxREJ4cDZ5XzdpR1NYM1JFRjd4c3pIQWlQYmVnaWpxY3dtVmt6OFo0NEUyUzVMVF9yODNMajd5Q2xJOVJyYmI3MVlUbUNkNEl1bTJWODlqUnJZRlBxRWZocmhNdVBvVXM1?oc=5), [Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/pakistan/i-call-for-imran-khans-release-un-rights-chief-flags-ex-pakistan-pms-health-jail-conditions/articleshow/136013041.cms) reported that the UN human rights chief urged Pakistan to release Imran Khan and raised alarm over jail conditions.

On 19 Nov 2026, [The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2641245/un-rights-chief-calls-for-imran-khans-release-urges-political-de-escalation) reported that the UN rights chief called for Imran Khan's release and urged political de-escalation while Amnesty stated Imran faces solitary confinement and denial of medical care.

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/2027-inec-to-test-bvas-in-406-ondo-polling-units-on-november-28/) reported that the Independent National Electoral Commission in Ondo State will conduct a mock accreditation and result upload exercise in 406 polling units.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/2027-inec-plans-mock-election-in-638-rivers-polling-units/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that INEC plans to hold a mock accreditation and results upload exercise in 638 Rivers polling units on November 28 to test the BVAS device ahead of the 2027 elections.

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2047181/security-forces-kill-12-india-sponsored-terrorists-in-multiple-ibos-in-balochistan-ispr) reported that security forces killed 12 India-sponsored terrorists in four separate intelligence-based operations in Balochistan between November 20 and 23.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/pakistan-security-forces-kill-9-terrorists-in-separate-operations-in-bannu-and-lakki-marwat-101795597503171.html) reported that Pakistani security forces killed nine terrorists in separate operations in Bannu and Lakki Marwat.

On 23 Nov 2026, [The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2641813/two-policemen-among-five-injured-in-lakki-marwat-ied-blast), [Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/five-injured-in-ied-blast-targeting-police-van-in-lakki-marwat/) reported that an IED blast targeting a police van in Lakki Marwat injured five people, including two police personnel.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/blow-to-fitna-al-hindustan-as-pakistani-forces-gun-down-15-terrorists-in-balochistans-mastung/) reported that Pakistani security forces eliminated 15 Fitna al-Hindustan terrorists in two back-to-back operations in Balochistan’s Mastung district.

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/26/8064832/) reported that German Foreign Minister Johann Wadephul backed Ukraine's right to self-defence while warning against geographical expansion of the conflict.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/91456675) reported that German Chancellor Friedrich Merz accused Russia of escalating threats to European security and stated that Russia wants more than Ukraine.
On 26 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/world/2224977), a Russian state outlet, reported that Jared Kushner emphasized that Europe should choose a single representative for Ukraine talks.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivwFBVV95cUxQWUI5R19MZFluOFUyQWRCLTJnRVpNYnZfemhIT0g5bEZqblpJYXNxSVBFNk4xSjFYWGFIcldBUEZvM0xrWDlya3hrVzNRbWQxdFpXOEdXR2g0bmRDZ1FOS2t5TnlKNkE2WGhOVXp5MU9YZkRHM1hQSUhRT0hzMEx5MlU4a1dMS2lEMDZ2MVdrQ3dBeE5wZGhwTmFoLUJ2QjV0ZzEzMXJ3eVpsaGVKM2ZmYlJrNi02MWl3Q1I0UFN4VQ?oc=5) reported that German leader Merz stated that Russia wants more than just Ukraine and defended continued aid for Kyiv.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/91144) reported that France stated it will consider an invitation for talks in Moscow only if Russia guarantees Europe a full seat at the negotiating table.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4188617-zelensky-waiting-for-us-to-set-date-for-next-round-of-peace-talks.html) reported that President Volodymyr Zelensky stated he was waiting for the United States to set a date for the next quadripartite meeting of negotiating teams.

On 25 Nov 2026, [TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/f5e615345fc3) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated that Kyiv has done a lot to involve Europe in the peace process with the next round expected to include European representatives.

On 25 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2026/nov/25/ukraine-russia-energy-strikes-mark-rutte-donald-trump-friedrich-merz-germany-latest-news-updates), [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/25/8064567/), [Baltic News Network](https://bnn-news.com/world/merz-russia-wants-more-than-ukraine-k22w3g2) reported that German Chancellor Friedrich Merz warned that Russia wants more than just Ukraine and is escalating tensions massively across the Baltic region, Poland, the Black Sea, outer space, and within Germany.

On 24 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/world/2224285), a Russian state outlet, reported that former spokeswoman Yulia Mendel stated Vladimir Zelensky wants Ukrainians to volunteer to die at the frontline while his inner circle amasses wealth.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/24/8064380/) reported that Kremlin press secretary Dmitry Peskov dismissed the added value of European involvement in four-party talks to end the war in Ukraine.
On 23 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/world/2223135), a state-media outlet, reported that former spokeswoman Yulia Mendel stated that Vladimir Zelensky is rejecting every realistic peace agreement.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90813) reported that President Volodymyr Zelensky stated during a meeting with British Defense Secretary Wes Streeting that the next round of four-party peace talks must deliver concrete results.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4187172-next-round-of-peace-talks-depends-on-us-zelensky-says.html) reported that Zelensky said holding the next meeting in the Ukraine-Europe-Russia-US format depends on the American side.
On 19 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90635) reported that President Volodymyr Zelensky stated after the Berlin summit that Ukraine would hold separate talks with US envoys.

On 19 Nov 2026, [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/ckzd9nln5e6go?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that European allies of Ukraine stated they have a united negotiating position at a summit in Berlin.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/zelensky-arrives-in-berlin-for-talks-with-european-officials-trumps-envoys/) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky arrived in Berlin and outlined four priorities at the Coalition of the Willing meeting.

On 16 Nov 2026, [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/united-states-canada/article/3374650/ukraine-held-new-talks-us-european-officials-peace-prospects-zelensky-says) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said his nation held new online talks with US presidential envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner on peace prospects.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/16/8063102/) reported that representatives of the E5 countries, the European Commission, and the European Council will form a negotiating team for the next round of talks on ending Russia's war against Ukraine.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/kremlin-aide-denies-us-assertion-europeans-will-join-next-round-ukraine-peace), a regional outlet, reported that a senior Kremlin aide stated Russia has not yet agreed to European participation in the next round of Ukraine peace talks.

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/26/fora-da-bolha-lula-escanteia-haddad-trabuco-na-fazenda-e-uma-mulher-negra-no-supremo.ghtml) reported that President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva invited Bradesco banker Luiz Carlos Trabuco to assume the post of Minister of Finance.

On 26 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/26/luiz-carlos-trabuco-aceita-convite-de-lula-e-vai-comandar-a-fazenda-em-2027-conheca-a-trajetoria-do-banqueiro.ghtml) reported that Luiz Carlos Trabuco accepted Lula's invitation to lead the Ministry of Finance in 2027.

On 26 Nov 2026, [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/el-mundo/lula-analiza-nombrar-a-luiz-carlos-trabuco-como-ministro-de-economia-y-los-mercados-lo-reciben-con-nid26112026/) reported that President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva met with Bradesco banker Luiz Carlos Trabuco while assembling his cabinet for his fourth mandate following a week of financial turbulence.

On 26 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/26/trabuco-do-bradesco-e-sondado-por-lula-para-a-fazenda-quem-e-o-banqueiro-e-como-e-visto-pelo-mercado.ghtml) reported that President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva met with Bradesco board chairman Luiz Carlos Trabuco Cappi.

On 26 Nov 2026, [El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/politica/gobierno-avanza-en-ultimas-reuniones-con-partidos-por-ajuste-fiscal) reported that the government advanced in final meetings with political parties at the Ministry of Finance regarding a fiscal adjustment.

On 25 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/25/luiz-trabuco-do-bradesco-e-sondado-por-lula-para-assumir-o-ministerio-da-fazenda.ghtml) reported that President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva consulted Bradesco board chairman Luiz Roberto Trabuco regarding the possibility of him taking over the Ministry of Finance.

On 25 Nov 2026, [El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/politica/gobierno-busca-consensos-con-el-partido-de-la-u-sobre-ajuste-fiscal) reported that the Brazilian government sought consensus with the Partido de la U regarding fiscal adjustment.

On 24 Nov 2026, [O Dia](https://odia.ig.com.br/economia/2026/11/7325559-entenda-o-pacote-fiscal-que-preve-ajuste-de-ate-rs-56-bilhoes.html) reported that Congress approved and President Lula sanctioned a fiscal package adjusting spending rules and federal transfers.

On 24 Nov 2026, [O Dia](https://odia.ig.com.br/brasil/2026/11/7325313-camara-aprova-ajuste-fiscal-do-governo-lula-sem-alteracoes.html) reported that Brazil's Chamber approved the government's fiscal adjustment without alterations with 353 favorable votes.

On 24 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/24/pacote-fiscal-de-lula-quem-foram-os-deputados-do-pl-que-apoiaram-o-governo-e-os-aliados-que-nao-votaram.ghtml) reported that seven deputies from Jair Bolsonaro's PL party contributed to the government's victory in passing the fiscal package.

On 24 Nov 2026, [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/el-mundo/el-congreso-de-brasil-aprobo-el-ajuste-fiscal-de-lula-pero-persisten-las-dudas-de-los-mercados-nid24112026/) reported that although Brazil's Congress approved the fiscal adjustment, market investors consider the measures insufficient and demand reforms.

On 24 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/23/apos-criticar-projeto-e-fazer-as-pazes-com-ministro-lindbergh-se-abstem-de-votar-ajuste-fiscal-do-governo.ghtml) reported that deputies Lindbergh Farias and Natália Bonavides decided to abstain from voting on the government's fiscal package.

On 24 Nov 2026, [El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/mundo/congreso-brasil-aprueba-paquete-ajuste-fiscal-gobierno-lula-2027_1795487697) reported that the government had expressed urgency in approving the matter before the presentation of a budgetary planning report.

On 24 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/24/vitoria-do-governo-na-camara-e-puxada-por-votos-do-centrao-e-ajuda-de-motta-veja-como-cada-deputado-votou.ghtml) reported that the government achieved an expressive victory in the Chamber by approving the fiscal adjustment project without modification.

On 24 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/24/sancao-e-vigencia-em-2027-entenda-os-proximos-passos-do-pacote-fiscal-de-lula-aprovado-no-congresso.ghtml) reported that the Chamber of Deputies approved a project for fiscal adjustment of public accounts previously passed by the Senate, with sanction and validity set for 2027.

On 24 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/24/abstencoes-de-lindbergh-e-erika-hilton-chamam-a-atencao-na-votacao-do-pacote-fiscal-de-lula-que-conquista-7-votos-do-pl.ghtml) reported that the government achieved a victory with the conclusion of the fiscal package voting in the Chamber, featuring specific party abstentions and votes.

On 24 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/23/camara-aprova-texto-base-de-projeto-de-ajuste-fiscal-do-governo-lula-com-impacto-de-ate-r-56-bilhoes-em-2027.ghtml) reported that the Chamber of Deputies plenary approved the base text of the Lula government's fiscal adjustment project with an impact of up to 56 billion reals in 2027.

On 24 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/23/sancao-de-lula-e-vigencia-em-2027-entenda-os-proximos-passos-do-projeto-de-ajuste-fiscal-aprovado-na-camara.ghtml) reported that the fiscal adjustment project approved by the Chamber had already been approved by the Senate and awaits Lula's sanction to take effect in 2027.

On 24 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/23/ajuste-fiscal-de-lula-vai-de-supersalarios-a-incentivos-tributarios-entenda-o-plano-de-r-56-bi-aprovado-na-camara.ghtml) reported that the fiscal adjustment project presented by Jaques Wagner and written by Lula's economic team ranges from high salaries to tax incentives.

On 23 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/23/lider-do-pl-anuncia-que-partido-votara-contra-projeto-de-ajuste-fiscal-do-governo-nao-ajusta-nada.ghtml) reported that PL House leader Sostenes Cavalcante announced the party will vote against the Lula government's fiscal adjustment package.

On 23 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/23/camara-comeca-a-analisar-ajuste-fiscal-de-ate-r-56-bilhoes-em-meio-a-pressao-do-governo-por-votacao-rapida.ghtml) reported that the Chamber of Deputies plenary began analyzing the fiscal adjustment project presented by the government.

On 23 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/blogs/bela-megale/post/2026/11/o-placar-da-disputa-pelo-senado-entre-alcolumbre-e-marinho-que-circula-entre-ministros-do-stf.ghtml) reported that Supreme Federal Court ministers evaluate that Davi Alcolumbre is ahead of Rogério Marinho in the Senate leadership dispute.

On 23 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/23/lula-vai-escolher-tres-nomes-para-o-stj-enquanto-mantem-suspense-sobre-indicacao-a-vaga-aberta-no-stf.ghtml) reported that President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva will choose three names for the Superior Court of Justice while maintaining suspense over a Supreme Court vacancy.

On 23 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/23/lula-deve-se-reunir-com-alcolumbre-nos-proximos-dias-para-tratar-de-formacao-do-governo-e-vaga-no-stf.ghtml) reported that President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Senate President Davi Alcolumbre are scheduled to meet to discuss government formation and the Supreme Court vacancy.

On 23 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/23/camara-analisa-ajuste-fiscal-entenda-o-que-esta-em-jogo-para-o-governo-e-as-contas-publicas.ghtml) reported that the Chamber is scheduled to vote on the fiscal adjustment proposed by the government and approved by the Senate.

On 23 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/23/fim-da-escala-6x1-governo-publica-hoje-primeira-com-regras-da-nova-jornada-veja-o-que-falta-definir.ghtml) reported that the government of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva is to publish its first ordinance with rules for the new 6x1 work schedule.

On 22 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/22/moretti-e-durigan-ganham-confianca-de-lula-com-pacote-fiscal-entenda-por-que-isso-nao-garante-que-continuarao-no-governo.ghtml) reported that Dario Durigan and another official gained Lula's confidence with the fiscal package.

On 21 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/21/lula-critica-ala-da-esquerda-que-se-opos-ao-ajuste-fiscal-e-diz-que-faria-lima-nao-vai-ensina-lo-a-governar.ghtml) reported that President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva criticized leftist factions opposing his government's fiscal adjustment package.

On 21 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/21/em-busca-de-reeleicao-alcolumbre-e-motta-acenam-ao-planalto-por-ajuste-fiscal-e-a-oposicao-com-beneficio-a-bolsonaro.ghtml) reported that House President Hugo Motta and Senate President Davi Alcolumbre intensified gestures toward the Planalto and the opposition regarding fiscal adjustment.

On 21 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/21/proposta-de-ajuste-fiscal-do-planalto-vira-estopim-e-psol-racha-sobre-relacao-com-governo-lula.ghtml) reported that the PSOL entered an internal dispute over how to react to the government's fiscal adjustment package ahead of the Chamber vote.

On 20 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/blogs/bela-megale/post/2026/11/os-dois-votos-do-pl-que-rogerio-marinho-ja-considera-perdidos-na-disputa-pela-presidencia-do-senado.ghtml) reported that Rogério Marinho already discounted two votes from his own party in the dispute for the presidency of the Senate.

On 19 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/19/relator-na-camara-divulga-parecer-de-pacote-fiscal-e-nao-faz-alteracoes-no-texto-para-acelerar-aprovacao.ghtml) reported that Mauro Benevides Filho, the rapporteur of the fiscal adjustment project drafted by President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's government, released his opinion without making changes to the text in order to accelerate approval in the Chamber.

On 19 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/19/pacote-fiscal-senado-suaviza-corte-de-repasses-a-estados-e-texto-vai-a-camara.ghtml) reported that the Brazilian Senate concluded voting on the government's fiscal adjustment package with a gesture to states, softening cuts to transfers.

On 19 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/19/votacao-do-governo-em-projeto-de-ajuste-fiscal-expoe-disputa-entre-alcolumbre-e-marinho-pelo-comando-do-senado.ghtml) reported that the Senate vote on the government's fiscal adjustment package exposed a dispute between Davi Alcolumbre and Rogério Marinho for control of the Senate.

On 19 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/19/pacote-fiscal-passa-no-senado-entenda-os-proximos-passos-antes-de-medida-entrar-em-vigor.ghtml) reported that the Brazilian Senate concluded voting on the government's fiscal adjustment package, though the measures are not yet in force.

On 18 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/18/senado-aprova-projeto-que-estabelece-novas-regras-para-uso-de-postes-por-empresas-de-internet.ghtml) reported that the Senate approved a bill establishing new rules for the sharing of electricity poles by internet companies.

On 18 Nov 2026, [O Dia](https://odia.ig.com.br/brasil/2026/11/7323780-senado-rejeita-mudancas-no-texto-e-aprova-ajuste-fiscal-do-governo.html), [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/18/alcolumbre-ve-influencia-de-disputa-eleitoral-em-criticas-ao-ajuste-fiscal-e-diz-que-dialogo-prevaleceu-no-senado.ghtml) reported that the Brazilian Senate rejected changes to the text and approved the government's fiscal adjustment project, sending it to the Chamber of Deputies.

On 18 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/brasil/noticia/2026/11/18/pena-maior-para-quem-matar-dirigindo-sob-efeito-de-alcool-e-aprovada-no-senado-e-projeto-vai-a-camara.ghtml) reported that the Senate approved a bill increasing penalties for homicide and serious bodily injury caused by drunk drivers, sending the project to the Chamber.

On 18 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/18/chefe-da-articulacao-politica-diz-que-governo-acertou-com-motta-votacao-do-pacote-fiscal-na-camara-ate-terca-feira.ghtml) reported that Institutional Relations Minister José Guimarães stated he agreed with Chamber President Hugo Motta to vote on the fiscal package in the Chamber by Tuesday.

On 18 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/18/senado-mantem-teto-para-compensacao-previdenciaria-a-estados-e-municipios-no-pacote-fiscal.ghtml) reported that the Brazilian Senate maintained the provision in the fiscal adjustment project limiting social security compensation transfers to states and municipalities to 3 billion reals per year between 2027 and 2030.

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/ebonyi-ndc-candidate-says-apc-defector-was-never-his-running-mate/) reported that the Ebonyi State Nigeria Democratic Party denied that Uka Chris Ndubuisi was ever its deputy governorship candidate.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/2027-oyo-ndc-governorship-candidate-rules-out-stepping-down-for-other-parties/) reported that Nigeria Democratic Congress governorship candidate in Oyo State, Akim Yusuf, ruled out stepping down for other parties.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/ypp-sues-inec-apc-over-farouk-mustaphas-eligibility-as-bauchi-deputy-guber-candidate/) reported that the Young Progressives Party filed a legal battle against Farouk Mustapha, the running mate in the Bauchi State gubernatorial election.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/courts-rule-on-adc-guber-candidacy-in-ogun-oyo/) reported that the Supreme Court affirmed Dr Biodun Collins Ogundipe as the governorship candidate of the African Democratic Congress in Ogun for the 2027 general elections.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/promoted/928050-nec-appeals-ruling-ordering-adebutua-inclusion-in-2027-ogun-governorship-election.html) reported that INEC filed a notice of appeal asking the Court of Appeal to review the ruling ordering the commission to recognize Adebutu as the PDP candidate.

On 25 Nov 2026, [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/25/supreme-court-revelation-resign-now-or-be-impeached-adc-tells-tinubu/) reported that the African Democratic Congress called on President Bola Ahmed Tinubu to immediately resign from office or face impeachment.

On 25 Nov 2026, [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/25/ogun-2027-supreme-court-affirms-collins-ogundipe-as-adc-governorship-candidate/) reported that the Supreme Court affirmed Dr. Bisi Collins Ogundipe, also known as BCO, as the African Democratic Congress governorship candidate.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/wike-saved-pdp-from-soothsayers-naysayers-bauchi-pdp-guber-candidate/) reported that the gubernatorial candidate of the Nyesom Wike-backed faction stated Wike saved the PDP.

On 23 Nov 2026, [The Tide (Nigeria)](https://www.thetidenewsonline.com/2026/11/2027-pdp-dissociates-self-from-opposition-coalition-warns-against-name-use/) reported that the Peoples Democratic Party dissociated itself from an opposition coalition and warned against using its name.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/namadi-flags-off-apc-campaign-in-27-jigawa-lgas/) reported that Jigawa State Governor Malam Umar Namadi flagged off the All Progressives Congress campaign across the state's 27 local government areas.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/ogun-pdp-deputy-guber-candidate-installed-akinkanju-of-egbaland/) reported that Ogun State Peoples Democratic Party Deputy Governorship Candidate Hajia Yemi Sowunmi-Kolapo was installed as the Akinkanju of Egbaland.

On 22 Nov 2026, [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/22/2027-wike-led-pdp-rejects-opposition-coalition-snubs-november-30-summit/) reported that the Peoples Democratic Party rejected claims that it joined the opposition Coalition for Democracy.

On 21 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/2027-count-us-out-of-opposition-summit-says-pdp/) reported that the Peoples Democratic Party disassociated itself from the Summit of Opposition political parties under the Coalition for Democracy.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/2027-were-not-joining-your-opposition-coalition-pdp-tells-lukman/) reported that the PDP stated it is not joining the opposition coalition.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/wike-led-pdp-disowns-november-30-coalition-summit/) reported that the Wike-led PDP distanced itself from the November 30 coalition summit.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/926715-2027-sule-lamido-rejects-rainbow-coalition-says-pdp-will-win-jigawa-in-presidential-poll.html) reported that former Jigawa State Governor Sule Lamido stated President Bola Tinubu and APC governors have failed across Nigeria.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/jigawa-pdp-apc-clash-over-dancing-at-campaign-rallies/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Jigawa PDP chairman Babandi Gumel stated APC leaders' dancing at campaign rallies is insensitive to hardship, while the APC stated it reflects joy and public acceptance.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/926451-2027-sule-lamido-berates-vice-president-shettima-as-jigawa-pdp-begins-campaign.html) reported that Sule Lamido criticized Vice President Shettima as the Jigawa PDP began its campaign.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/2027-yayi-realised-his-looming-defeat-the-day-adebutu-returned-to-the-ballot-pdp-natl-sec/), [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/2027-yayi-jittery-over-adebutus-return-to-ballot-pdp-natl-sec/) reported that PDP National Secretary Samuel Anyanwu claimed that Ogun APC members joined the PDP and stated opponents are jittery over Adebutu's return.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/ogun-2027-pdp-presents-governorship-flag-to-adebutu/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that PDP National Secretary Samuel Anyanwu presented the party's governorship flag to Ladi Adebutu at Ake Palace.

On 18 Nov 2026, [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/18/abia-pdp-guber-candidate-anosike-promises-to-tackle-water-borne-diseases/) reported that the Peoples Democratic Party governorship candidate in Abia State, Dr. Kelechi Anosike, promised to build 552 solar-powered boreholes to tackle water-borne diseases.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/2027-ekiti-deputy-gov-mobilises-traditional-rulers-politicians-for-tinubus-re-election/) reported that Ekiti State Deputy Governor Monisade Afuye rallied traditional rulers across the state to support President Bola Ahmed Tinubu’s re-election.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/ekiti-deputy-gov-mobilises-monarchs-pdp-members-for-tinubus-re-election/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Ekiti State Deputy Governor Monisade Afuye intensified mobilization efforts seeking support from traditional rulers and PDP members for President Bola Tinubu’s re-election.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/2027-pdp-may-not-win-single-ward-ogun-apc/) reported that the Ogun State chapter of the All Progressives Congress dismissed claims by the Peoples Democratic Party that it would win every ward.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/ogun-2027-pdp-apc-clash-over-adebutus-chances/) reported that the Peoples Democratic Party and the All Progressives Congress in Ogun State exchanged words over the 2027 gubernatorial chances.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/ekiti-pdp-seeks-probe-of-attack-on-ex-dep-gov-candidate/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the Peoples Democratic Party in Ekiti State called on police and security agencies to investigate an alleged attack on its 2026 deputy governorship candidate.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/jigawa-needs-a-listening-leader-says-pdp-gov-candidate/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that PDP governorship candidate in Jigawa, Mustapha Sule Lamido, stated the state needs a listening leader rather than a furious one ahead of the 2027 elections.

On 15 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/adebutu-ogun-apc-guber-aspirant-hails-court-judgment/) reported that Ogun State All Progressives Congress governorship aspirant Abayomi Hunye congratulated the Peoples Democratic Party's governorship candidate following a court judgment.

On 15 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/gov-oyebanji-rallies-apc-candidates-promises-campaign-support-assures-members-of-political-inclusion/) reported that Ekiti State Governor Biodun Oyebanji reaffirmed his commitment to strengthening the APC and promised full logistical support for upcoming elections.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/2027-katsina-gov-promises-more-development-seeks-apc-victory/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Katsina State Governor Dikko Radda urged residents to support the APC in the 2027 elections and promised more development projects.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/adebutu-hunye-hails-court-judgment-says-its-victory-for-democracy/) reported that Hunye described a court judgment regarding Adebutu as a victory for democracy and justice for Ogun State.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/pdp-celebrates-as-adebutu-floors-inec/) reported that a court ordered the Independent National Electoral Commission to publish Oladipupo Adebutu as the Peoples Democratic Party governorship candidate.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/2027-katsina-pdp-gov-candidate-promises-free-medical-treatment-for-residents/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that PDP governorship candidate in Katsina, Yakubu Lado Danmarke, promised to introduce free healthcare services for residents if elected in 2027.

On 13 Nov 2026, [AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611130470.html) reported that following a boost to Ladi Adebutu's candidacy, the Peoples Democratic Party vowed to reclaim Ogun State in the 2027 gubernatorial election.

On 14 Nov 2026, [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/14/ogun-2027-court-orders-inec-to-publish-adebutu-as-pdp-candidate-says-commission-lacks-powers-to-disqualify-him/) reported that Justice Peter Lifu of the Federal High Court ordered INEC to publish Adebutu as the PDP candidate.

On 13 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/2027-im-voting-pdp-at-all-levels-sule-lamido-declares/) reported that former Jigawa State Governor Sule Lamido declared his commitment to the Peoples Democratic Party and stated he will vote for the party's candidate.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/ogun-guber-pdp-celebrates-court-judgment-reinstating-adebutu/), [The Authority (Nigeria)](https://authorityngr.com/2026/11/13/pdp-seeks-inec-compliance-as-court-reinstates-adebutu-as-ogun-governorship-candidate/), [Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/925024-2027-pdp-reacts-to-court-ruling-reinstating-adebutu-as-ogun-gov-candidate-urges-inec-to-comply.html) reported that the Peoples Democratic Party welcomed the Federal High Court judgment reinstating Adebutu as its Ogun governorship candidate and urged INEC to comply.

On 13 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/inec-chairman-amupitan-denies-operating-pro-tinubu-x-account/) reported that INEC Chairman Prof. Joash Amupitan denied operating an X account allegedly used to express support for Tinubu.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/inec-to-obey-court-on-atikus-adc-candidacy-amupitan/), [Punch](https://punchng.com/2027-inec-will-obey-court-ruling-on-atikus-candidacy-amupitan/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that INEC Chairman Prof. Joash Amupitan stated the commission will abide by the final court decision on Atiku Abubakar's presidential candidacy under the ADC.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1741071-will-atiku-participate-2027-election-inec-chairman-speaks-out/) reported that Amupitan explained what happens to Atiku's 2027 bid if he loses his court battle.

On 26 Nov 2026, [El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/santa-cruz/operativo-san-matias-deja-policia-herido-bala_1795701605) reported that an anti-narcotics police officer was shot in the neck during an operation in San Matías and evacuated to Brazil.

On 26 Nov 2026, [El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/santa-cruz/san-matias-confirman-policia-resulto-herido-bala-enfrentamiento-presuntos-narcotraficantes_1795707783) reported that a Brazilian man was arrested following an armed confrontation between police and suspected traffickers in San Matías.

On 26 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/estados/ataque-a-balazos-contra-una-familia-en-monterrey-deja-dos-muertos-entre-ellos-una-nina-hay-al-menos-cuatro-heridos/) reported that a shooting attack against a family in Monterrey left two dead, including a girl, and at least four injured.

On 25 Nov 2026, [El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/video-emboscada-armada-policia-cauca-deja-al-menos-dos-uniformados-muertos-cuatro-heridos-AG44063542) reported that an armed attack against authorities in Cauca left at least two officers dead and four others wounded.

On 24 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/estados/en-solo-48-horas-tres-mujeres-son-asesinadas-en-distintos-puntos-de-mazatlan-suman-12-victimas-en-lo-que-va-de-noviembre/) reported that three women were killed in separate points of Mazatlán within 48 hours, bringing the monthly total to 12 victims.

On 23 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/estados/jornada-violenta-en-culiacan-y-mazatlan-deja-tres-muertos-y-cuatro-heridos-mujer-resulta-victima-colateral-de-un-ataque-armado/) reported that a violent day in Culiacán and Mazatlán left three dead and four injured, including a woman struck by stray gunfire near the Culiacán Science Center.

On 22 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/estados/investigan-posible-falla-mecanica-tras-desplome-de-avioneta-cessna-en-culiacan-accidente-dejo-dos-muertos/) reported that Civil Aeronautics authorities are investigating possible mechanical failure as the cause of the Cessna plane crash near a training runway for new pilots.
