reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/estados/director-de-servicios-publicos-de-ahome-sinaloa-permanecera-en-el-cargo-su-hermano-fue-detenido-junto-a-el-chapo-isidro/) reported that Ahome public services director Iván Gálvez Meza will remain in his position despite his brother being detained alongside El Chapo Isidro.
On 26 Nov 2026, [InSight Crime](https://insightcrime.org/news/chapo-isidro-arrest-chapitos-mayiza-war/) reported that the capture of Fausto Isidro Meza Flores shook up the Sinaloa Cartel war.

On 26 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/estados/asignan-elementos-de-seguridad-a-alcaldesa-de-guasave-tras-captura-de-el-chapo-isidro-proteccion-fue-ordenada-por-gobernadora/) reported that Guasave Mayor Cecilia Ramírez Montoya announced security elements were assigned to her following the capture of Chapo Isidro.

On 26 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/nacion/operativo-contra-el-chapo-isidro-para-el-publico-de-eu-analizan-operativo-con-los-de-casa/) reported that specialists questioned whether the criminal leader's capture should be valued for its visual display rather than results in combating organized crime.

On 25 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mexico/exjefe-de-la-dea-pide-enviar-a-rocha-moya-y-al-chapo-isidro-a-estados-unidos-33314185) reported that former DEA chief Derek Maltz requested President Claudia Sheinbaum to transfer the licensed governor of Sinaloa and Chapo Isidro to the United States.

On 25 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/finanzas/empresarios-piden-rescate-economico-federal-para-sinaloa-ante-violencia-tras-la-captura-de-el-chapo-isidro-33308222) reported that Coparmex requested federal economic rescue and extra security for Sinaloa following violence after the capture of Chapo Isidro.

On 25 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/mexico/el-chapo-isidro-sera-extraditado-a-estados-unidos-la-respuesta-del-gobierno-de-mexico-al-pedido-de-donald-trump-3604123) reported that Mexico's Attorney General's Office confirmed that cartel leader Chapo Isidro will face a domestic judicial process in Mexico rather than immediate extradition.

On 25 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/nacion/ricardo-anaya-exige-extraditar-a-chapo-isidro-a-eu-advierte-conflicto-de-interes-con-gobiernos-de-morena/) reported that Mexican lawmaker Ricardo Anaya demanded the extradition of Chapo Isidro to the United States and warned of potential conflicts of interest.

On 25 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/nacion/al-caer-la-noche-calles-vacias-y-temor-en-guasave-tras-captura-de-el-chapo-isidro-violencia-cambia-rutina-de-sus-habitantes/) reported that nighttime activities and routines in Guasave have been disrupted following the capture of narcotics trafficker Chapo Isidro.

On 24 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mexico/chapo-isidro-permanecera-en-mexico-mientras-se-define-su-situacion-juridica-y-la-solicitud-de-extradicion-a-eu-33297994) reported that the FGR stated Fausto Isidro Meza Flores will not be expelled to the United States and his extradition process will be carried out.

On 24 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/nacion/senado-rinde-homenaje-a-militares-caidos-en-operativo-contra-el-chapo-isidro-guardan-un-minuto-de-silencio/) reported that the Senate held a moment of silence and paid tribute to military personnel who died in the operation against Chapo Isidro.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/americas/mexico-defies-us-extradition-bid-for-drug-lord-el-chapo-isidro) reported that a senior Mexican official stated Mexico will prosecute alleged drug lord Fausto Isidro Meza despite a U.S. extradition request.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Jowhar](https://jowhar.com/mexico-oo-maxkamadeyn-doonta-el-chapo-isidro-inkastoo-mareykanka-uu-codsaday-in-la-soo-dhiibo/) reported that Fausto Isidro Meza Flores, known as El Chapo Isidro, will be tried in Mexico despite a US extradition request.

On 24 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/nacion/despiden-a-militares-caidos-en-captura-de-el-chapo-isidro-veracruz-honra-su-servicio/) reported that Veracruz held a farewell ceremony for two military personnel killed in the operation in Guasave, Sinaloa, to capture Fausto Isidro Meza Flores.

On 24 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/americas/20261124-us-flew-surveillance-drone-over-mexico-to-help-capture-top-drug-lord) reported that Mexican officials stated the United States flew a surveillance drone over Mexican territory to help locate and capture a drug trafficker.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/mexico-took-down-a-top-drug-kingpin-can-it-dismantle-his-cartel-101795490045058.html) reported that U.S.-backed raids are delivering tactical victories against crime groups that remain deeply embedded in Mexican politics, society, and the local economy.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/24/mexico-to-try-el-chapo-isidro-despite-us-extradition-request?traffic_source=rss), [The Korea Herald](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10947449) reported that Mexico will try alleged drug lord Fausto Isidro Meza, known as 'El Chapo Isidro', at home despite a US extradition request.

On 23 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/tendencias/mire-la-bala-cruzar-con-un-destello-amarillo-reportero-de-meganoticias-relata-como-vivio-la-violencia-en-guasave-tras-la-detencion-de-chapo-isidro/) reported that Meganoticias reporter Jesús Adrián Ibarra recounted experiencing violence and gunfire spreading in Guasave following the arrest.

On 24 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/nacion/asi-ingresaron-fuerzas-especiales-al-escondite-de-el-chapo-isidro-en-guasave-lo-encontraron-sentado-en-un-sillon-y-sin-resistirse/) reported that the Secretary of Defense presented a video showing special forces entering the hideout of El Chapo Isidro in Guasave, where he was found sitting in a chair without resisting.

On 23 Nov 2026, [El País](https://elpais.com/mexico/2026-11-23/361-militares-operaron-el-ataque-al-bunker-del-chapo-isidro.html) reported that 361 military personnel operated the three-month planned attack using US drones to capture cartel leader El Chapo Isidro.

On 23 Nov 2026, [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c5rmgkv2lk73o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that eight suspects were arrested after firing on soldiers attempting to re-establish order following the arrest of El Chapo Isidro.

On 23 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mexico/fgr-descarta-extradicion-del-chapo-isidro-por-el-momento-sera-juzgado-en-mexico-dice-godoy-33278626) reported that the FGR dismissed the extradition of Chapo Isidro for the moment and stated he will be tried in Mexico.

On 23 Nov 2026, [El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/mundo/mexico-juzgara-chapo-isidro-pese-solicitud-extradicion-estados-unidos_1795477374) reported that Meza Flores was detained on November 20 during a federal operation in the municipality of Guasave in Sinaloa.

On 23 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mexico/garcia-harfuch-corrupcion-y-omision-de-autoridades-permitieron-operar-al-chapo-isidro-33275613) reported that SSPC head García Harfuch stated that corruption and official omission allowed El Chapo Isidro to operate, and announced reinforced security in Sinaloa.

On 23 Nov 2026, [teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/capture-of-drug-trafficker-chapo-isidro-leaves-20-dead-in-sinaloa/) reported that Operation Centella involved three months of intelligence sharing with the United States and was carried out by 371 Mexican personnel, leading to the capture of 'Chapo Isidro'.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Military.com](https://www.military.com/us-flew-drone-over-mexican-territory-to-help-capture-drug-lord-in-sinaloa) reported that the United States flew a drone over Mexican territory to help capture Fausto Isidro Meza Flores.

On 23 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/mexico/helicopteros-artillados-fuerzas-especiales-y-un-despliegue-de-361-militares-asi-fue-la-operacion-para-capturar-a-el-chapo-isidro-en-mexico-3603443) reported that the intervention ended with 16 alleged members of the criminal organization dead and four military personnel dead.

On 23 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/nacion/cronologia-del-operativo-centella-para-capturar-al-chapo-isidro-sedena-detalla-fase-a-fase-la-caida-del-capo-en-guasave/) reported that General Ricardo Trevilla stated the operation involved 361 elements and 14 aircraft.

On 23 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/nacion/la-caceria-de-el-chapo-isidro-en-guasave-se-preparo-con-eu-senala-nyt/) reported that the New York Times stated the operation to hunt 'El Chapo Isidro' in Guasave was prepared with the US, sharing intelligence and using reconnaissance drones for weeks.

On 23 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/mundo/noticia/2026/11/23/mexico-prende-oito-suspeitos-de-integrar-quadrilha-de-el-chapo-isidro-apos-onda-de-violencia.ghtml) reported that the Mexican Army captured eight suspected members of Fausto Isidro Meza's gang following violence in Sinaloa.

On 23 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/nacion/caen-ocho-presuntos-integrantes-del-grupo-de-el-chapo-isidro-en-sinaloa-militares-son-atacados-a-balazos/) reported that according to the Secretariat of National Defense, eight suspected members of the group of 'El Chapo Isidro' were arrested in Sinaloa after participating in roadblocks on November 20 and military elements were attacked with gunfire.

On 23 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/estados/suman-17-muertos-tras-captura-de-el-chapo-isidro-en-sinaloa-investigan-actuacion-de-fuerzas-federales/) reported that the death toll rose to 17 following the capture of Fausto Isidro Meza Flores in Sinaloa, with ten military elements treated for gunshot wounds.

On 23 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/tendencias/video-viral-capta-el-fuego-cruzado-en-el-cielo-nocturno-de-guasave-vecinos-registran-los-disparos-tras-el-operativo-contra-el-chapo-isidro/) reported that viral video captured crossfire in the night sky of Guasave as neighbors recorded gunfire following the operation against Fausto Isidro Meza Flores.

On 22 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/dea-expresa-condolencias-a-familiares-de-militares-muertos-en-captura-de-el-chapo-isidro-su-sacrificio-no-sera-olvidado/) reported that the DEA expressed condolences to the families and colleagues of four Mexican army elements killed during the operation in Guasave.

On 22 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/video/2026/nov/22/vehicles-burn-on-mexican-highway-after-capture-of-el-chapo-isidro-video) reported that footage showed burnt-out cars and trucks on roads in Sinaloa state following the capture of Fausto Isidro Meza Flores.

On 21 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/americas/20261121-mexico-captures-drug-cartel-boss-el-chapo-isidro-after-deadly-firefight) reported that Mexico's military forces captured Fausto Isidro Meza Flores following a deadly firefight.

On 21 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/mexican-special-forces-arrest-drug-kingpin-chapo-isidro/a-80010745?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that the alleged leader of the Beltran Leyva gang and one of the FBI's most wanted fugitives, known as Chapo Isidro, was captured by the Mexican military following an operation.

On 22 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/estados/tras-captura-del-chapo-isidro-localizan-4-hombres-asesinados-en-guasave-investigan-posible-vinculo-con-operativo/) reported that following the capture of Chapo Isidro, four dead men were located in Guasave and authorities are investigating a possible link to the operation.

On 22 Nov 2026, [La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/internacional/detienen-mexico-chapo-isidro-uno-diez-criminales-mas-buscados-fbi_202611226b02b6c6c0d5c85b96c464ba.html) reported that authorities confirmed eleven deaths and eight arrests in the operation.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/21/mexico-captures-fbis-most-wanted-cartel-boss-el-chapo-isidro-triggering-violence), [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/el-chapo-isidro-captured-fbi-sinaloa-trump-b3089155.html), [Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/international/article/2026/11/21/le-mexique-arrete-fausto-isidro-meza-alias-chapo-isidro-un-puissant-chef-de-cartel-recherche-par-le-fbi_6814013_3210.html) reported that the arrest of the cartel boss set off violent clashes in Sinaloa.

stories.label: APC campaign council political violence condemnation

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/26/kwara-apc-flags-off-electioneering-urges-members-to-vote-for-all-its-candidates/) reported that the All Progressives Congress flagged off its 2027 campaign in Kwara South district.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/2027-oyo-apc-targets-85-of-south-west-votes-for-tinubu/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Oyo APC leaders in Ogbomoso North urged South-West voters to deliver 85 per cent of votes for President Tinubu and governorship candidate Sharafadeen Alli in 2027.

On 26 Nov 2026, [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/26/2027-eno-persuades-citizens-to-vote-for-tinubu-himself-and-all-apc-candidates/) reported that Akwa Ibom State Governor Umo Eno urged citizens to vote for President Tinubu and all APC candidates at a rally in Eket Local Government.

On 25 Nov 2026, [The Authority (Nigeria)](https://authorityngr.com/2026/11/25/akpe-lokpobiri-mobilise-bayelsa-west-for-tinubus-2027-re-election/) reported that Bayelsa State Deputy Governor Peter Akpe and Minister of State for Petroleum Resources Heineken Lokpobiri mobilized Bayelsa West for President Tinubu’s 2027 re-election.

On 26 Nov 2026, [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/26/former-apc-state-chairmen-mobilise-nationwide-for-tinubus-re-election-in-2027/) reported that former state chairmen of the All Progressives Congress pledged to deploy their nationwide grassroots structures and political networks for President Tinubu's 2027 re-election.

On 25 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/tinubus-anti-violence-directive-put-into-action-in-kogi-says-apc-chieftain/), [Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/promoted/927970-tinubus-peace-directive-reflected-in-atikus-kogi-rally-says-apc-chieftain.html) reported that APC chieftain Alhaji Mohammed Usman denied party involvement in campaign violence and commended Kogi State Governor Ahmed Usman Ododo for ensuring an ADC rally proceeded without disruption.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/why-tinubu-apc-will-sweep-kebbi-votes-in-2027-governor-idris/) reported that Kebbi State Governor Dr Nasir Idris stated President Bola Tinubu and the APC will sweep Kebbi votes in 2027.

On 25 Nov 2026, [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/25/umahi-tinubu-has-integrated-igbo-into-national-development-deserves-re-election/) reported that Minister of Works David Umahi stated President Tinubu has integrated Igbo into national development and listed major federal road projects as evidence.

On 25 Nov 2026, [The Authority (Nigeria)](https://authorityngr.com/2026/11/25/barau-rallies-2000-kano-north-clerics-for-tinubus-re-election/) reported that Deputy President of the Senate Senator Barau I. Jibrin rallied support from Islamic clerics in Kano North for Tinubu's re-election.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/umahi-urges-ndigbo-in-lagos-to-support-tinubus-2027-re-election-bid/) reported that Minister of Works Senator David Umahi urged Ndigbo in Lagos to support President Bola Tinubu's 2027 re-election bid.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/2027-barau-urges-kano-clerics-to-back-tinubu/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Senate Deputy President Barau Jibrin urged over 2,000 Kano clerics to back Tinubu's 2027 re-election, citing federal projects.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/2027-akpabio-eno-rally-support-for-tinubu-apc-candidates/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Senate President Godswill Akpabio and Akwa Ibom State Governor Umo Eno urged residents of Ika and Etim Ekpo Local Government Area to support Tinubu and APC candidates.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/2027-bichi-constituents-pledge-300000-votes-for-tinubu-kano-gov/) reported that House of Representatives member Abubakar Kabir Abubakar Bichi urged Bichi constituents to support President Tinubu and the Kano governor.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/adebutus-return-to-ballot-could-boost-tinubus-votes-in-ogun-apc-chieftain/) reported that APC Presidential Campaign Council member Abdulkabir Akinlade stated Adebutu's return to the ballot could boost Tinubu's votes in Ogun State.

On 21 Nov 2026, [The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/2027-revolt-in-apc-as-northern-youths-threaten-to-withdraw-support-for-tinubu/) reported that the APC’s Northern Youths Forum threatened to withdraw support for President Bola Tinubu.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/northern-apc-youths-reject-tinubus-2027-re-election-bid-back-partys-other-candidates/) reported that the Anti-Tinubu APC Northern Youths Forum rejected President Bola Ahmed Tinubu’s second-term bid while backing other party candidates.

On 20 Nov 2026, [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/20/kano-apc-crisis-chieftain-seeks-tinubu-yaris-intervention/) reported that an APC chieftain in Kano State, Aminu Sh, warned that divisions could undermine the party's electoral chances and sought intervention.

On 20 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/2027-atikus-camp-demands-probe-into-circulating-apc-form-linked-to-potential-vote-buying/) reported that Paul Ibe, spokesman to ADC presidential candidate Atiku Abubakar, demanded an immediate investigation into a circulating 'APC form' linked to potential vote buying.

On 20 Nov 2026, [The Authority (Nigeria)](https://authorityngr.com/2026/11/20/tinubu-2027-yari-urges-igbo-to-turn-economic-strength-into-political-influence/) reported that APC Presidential Campaign Council Director-General Senator Abdul'aziz Yari urged the Igbo people to turn economic strength into political influence.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1742340-us-court-convict-popular-pastor-assassination-late-president/) reported that an ADC chieftain disclosed Atiku Abubakar's plan to speak on the controversial $16bn power funds and privatization under Olusegun Obasanjo.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1742347-atiku-allegedly-sold-shares-intel-dubai-property-2027-election/) reported that President Bola Tinubu's camp disclosed a list of properties and investments Atiku Abubakar allegedly sold to fund his 2027 presidential election campaign.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/kaduna-apc-flags-off-2027-campaign-inaugurates-council/) reported that the Kaduna State All Progressives Congress flagged off its presidential and gubernatorial campaign and inaugurated its campaign council.

On 19 Nov 2026, [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/19/plateau-apc-campaign-council-moves-to-unite-party-ahead-of-2027-polls/) reported that the Plateau State chapter of the All Progressives Congress intensified preparations for the 2027 general election.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/2027-apc-chieftain-urges-tinubu-yari-to-unite-kano-party/) reported that APC chieftain Aminu Shehu Sharada appealed to Tinubu and Yari to unite the party in Kano ahead of the 2027 general elections.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/atiku-cant-claim-25m-northern-votes-when-his-son-supports-tinubu-george/) reported that George questioned whether the African Democratic Congress could convince Nigerians it had a plan.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/2027-anambra-apc-inaugurates-350-member-campaign-council/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the Anambra APC inaugurated a 350-member campaign council led by Azuka Okwusa to mobilise support for Tinubu and party candidates ahead of the 2027 elections.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/2027-apc-inaugurates-anambra-campaign-council-for-tinubus-re-election/) reported that the Anambra State chapter of the All Progressives Congress inaugurated its campaign council for President Bola Ahmed Tinubu's reelection bid.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1741002-apc-support-group-targets-15-million-votes-tinubu-kano-2027/) reported that an APC support group inaugurated coordinators across Kano's 44 local government areas targeting votes for Tinubu and other candidates.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/ndc-campaign-council-fires-back-says-apc-spreading-agbero-politics-nationwide/) reported that the Nigeria Democratic Congress National Campaign Council accused the APC of exporting 'agbero' politics nationwide.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/december-15-for-hearing-in-kano-governors-divorce-suit/) reported that an Upper Area Court in Abuja fixed December 15 for a hearing in the divorce suit filed against Kano State Governor Abba Yusuf by his estranged wife.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/nigeria/1741994-breaking-court-takes-action-gov-yusuf-kwankwasos-daughter/) reported that the Upper Area Court in Abuja issued a statement regarding the divorce saga of Kano State Governor Abba Kabir Yusuf and his wife Zainab.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1741945-atiku-campaign-aide-reacts-kano-governor-divorce-controversy/) reported that an Atiku campaign aide criticised Kano Governor Abba Yusuf over his public divorce announcement and dismissed claims linking Kwankwaso to the marriage crisis.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/court-adjourns-kano-governors-divorce-case-to-december-15/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the Upper Area Court in Gudu District, Abuja, adjourned the divorce case involving Kano State Governor Abba Yusuf and his second wife till December 15.

On 17 Nov 2026, [BBC](https://www.bbc.com/pidgin/articles/c6zxvd27e9lvo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss), [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/kano-gov-confirms-divorce-from-kwankwasos-niece-hints-at-remarrying/) reported that Kano State Governor Abba Kabir Yusuf confirmed his divorce from Zainab Musa Kwankwaso and thanked citizens for advice regarding marriage.

On 17 Nov 2026, [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/17/governor-yusuf-divorces-wife-kwankwasos-daughter-declares-he-is-open-to-marriage/), [Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/nwest/925753-kano-governor-confirms-dissolution-of-20-year-marriage-with-kwankwasos-niece.html) reported that Kano State Governor Abba Yusuf confirmed the dissolution of his 20-year marriage to Zainab Kwankwaso.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/2027-ypp-presidential-candidate-condemns-attacks-on-obi-kwankwaso/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Young Progressives Party presidential candidate Peter Agada condemned attacks on the presidential campaign convoys of the Nigeria Democratic Congress.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/kano-govt-kwankwasiyya-movement-clash-over-attack-on-kwankwasos-convoy/) reported that the Kano government and the Kwankwasiyyah Movement were locked in a verbal war over an alleged attack on Rabiu Musa Kwankwaso's convoy.

On 17 Nov 2026, [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/17/on-presidential-directive-police-release-78-suspects-who-attacked-tinubus-convoy/) reported that the Federal Capital Territory Police Command confirmed a presidential directive to release 78 suspects who attacked Tinubu’s convoy.

On 16 Nov 2026, [The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/presidencys-denial-crumbles-as-police-confirm-attack-on-tinubus-convoy-arrest-78/) reported that the Federal Capital Territory Police Command commenced the release of 78 suspects arrested over an attack on President Bola Tinubu's motorcade.

On 17 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/tinubu-pardons-78-convoy-attack-suspects-police-arrest-8-over-kwankwaso-assault/) reported that President Bola Tinubu granted presidential clemency to 78 suspects arrested over an attack on his motorcade in Abuja while police arrested eight over an assault on Rabiu Musa Kwankwaso.

stories.title: Ukrainian attacks drive Russian oil refining to 20-year low – Bloomberg
stories.label: Air defense downs 80 of 117 Russian drones launched overnight

reports.text: On 25 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-economy/4188679-ukrainian-attacks-drive-russian-oil-refining-to-20year-low-bloomberg.html) reported that Russia's oil refining volumes fell to a 20-year low following Ukrainian strikes against Russian refineries.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/26/8064739/) reported that Russian oil refining volumes fell to 2.6-2.7 million barrels per day following Ukrainian attacks on refineries.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/91262), [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/26/8064751/) reported that Ukrainian drones struck critical energy and industrial infrastructure in Russian regions overnight, setting a fire at the Subkhankulovo line production dispatch station in Bashkortostan with no injuries reported.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/25/8064533/) reported that Ukrainian air defences intercepted 88 Russian drones overnight, with strikes recorded at 18 locations and falling debris at 13 others.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4188315-air-defenses-down-88-of-112-russian-drones-targeting-ukraine-overnight.html) reported that Russian forces attacked Ukraine with 112 attack drones overnight on November 24-25.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/ukrainian-drones-reportedly-strike-russian-oil-refineries-in-massive-attack/) reported that monitoring channels stated Ukrainian forces struck two Russian oil refineries and set them ablaze in a massive overnight attack.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/24/355-ukrainian-drones-flew-toward-moscow-overnight-prompting-flight-restrictions-at-two-airports) reported that Moscow Mayor Sergei Sobyanin stated 355 Ukrainian drones flew toward the capital overnight on November 24 and air defense forces shot down most of them.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/russia-says-it-shot-down-699-ukrainian-drones-overnight-including-355-targeting-moscow-region-101795505024950.html) reported that Russia stated its air defences intercepted 699 Ukrainian drones overnight, including 355 targeting the Moscow region.
On 24 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/emergencies/2223681) reported that Russian air defenses shot down 10 Ukrainian drones headed for Moscow according to the mayor.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/23/ukrainian-drones-strike-two-russian-oil-refineries-and-pumping-station-in-overnight-attacks) reported that Ukrainian forces struck oil infrastructure facilities in Almetyevsk and Novoshakhtinsk overnight.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Hasht-e Subh](https://8am.media/eng/russia-says-it-shot-down-192-ukrainian-drones-in-overnight-attacks/) reported that Russia's Defence Ministry announced air defence systems shot down 192 Ukrainian drones during overnight attacks.
On 21 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/defense/2222867), a Russian state-media report, stated that Russian air defenses intercepted 464 Ukrainian UAVs over the past day.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Pajhwok Afghan News](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiAFBVV95cUxQYlNPelhjZnJORzRJbU5hclNnbDFfeTdBNDVhVnQxMTJodlRRazFIdlFlOFRJb0JGZFFlMHZWRmtaNTg4VExVaHBmU2JISGdnQ09EVW1DamJ1WF9zRDNCdUlYbTN5SGR3blFhVHpfZ3VqcF9lOGJVbW0yZVVyNFhUMDFUb1loc0lx?oc=5), [Hasht-e Subh](https://8am.media/eng/russia-shoots-down-275-ukrainian-drones/) reported that Russia's Defence Ministry announced the interception and destruction of 275 Ukrainian drones overnight.
On 21 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/defense/2222839), a Russian state outlet, reported that air defenses destroyed 275 Ukrainian UAVs over 12 regions overnight.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90751) reported that the Council of the EU approved another €1 billion in military assistance for Ukraine covering joint purchases of drones and air defense equipment.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/20/8063768/), [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4186737-ukraines-air-defenses-down-82-missiles-380-russian-drones-overnight.html) reported that Ukrainian air defenses intercepted or downed numerous missiles and drones launched by Russian forces overnight.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/19/8063559/) reported that Russia launched Oniks anti-ship missiles and 98 attack drones overnight, and Ukrainian forces destroyed 69 drones.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4186118-zelensky-discusses-support-for-ukraines-combat-aviation-with-portuguese-foreign-minister.html) reported that President Volodymyr Zelensky met with Portuguese Foreign Minister Paulo Rangel to discuss support for Ukraine's combat aviation.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90475) reported that Canada announced a new military package for Ukraine worth hundreds of millions of Canadian dollars, including funding for the Czech ammunition initiative and air defense.

On 18 Nov 2026, [UK Defence Journal](https://ukdefencejournal.org.uk/uk-to-send-ukraine-more-than-a-thousand-air-defence-missiles/) reported that Britain will send Ukraine more than 1,000 short-range air defense missiles from Thales Belfast and over a dozen radars in a £240m winter package.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/18/8063455/) reported that Portuguese Foreign Minister Paulo Rangel stated Portugal cannot supply F-16 fighter jets to Ukraine due to domestic airspace and maritime defence needs.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/uk-to-supply-ukraine-with-more-than-1000-short-range-air-defense-missiles-3725721), a local outlet, reported that Defense Secretary Wes Streeting announced a £240 million package of missiles, launchers, and radars for Ukraine.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/18/8063360/) reported that President Volodymyr Zelenskyy called on Western partners to accelerate air defence deliveries and highlighted ongoing Russian attacks with jet-powered weapons.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/18/8063378/), [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185864-air-defence-neutralises-126-russian-drones-used-to-attack-ukraine-overnight.html) reported that Ukrainian air defense forces destroyed or jammed 126 out of 141 drones launched overnight by Russia, with strikes recorded at seven locations.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4185832-canada-to-allocate-120m-in-military-aid-to-ukraine.html), [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/18/8063366/) reported that the Canadian government announced a new military assistance package for Ukraine including ammunition, specialised air defence sensors, and winter military equipment.

On 17 Nov 2026, [National Defence (Canada)](https://www.canada.ca/en/department-national-defence/news/2026/11/minister-mcguinty-announces-new-military-aid-to-ukraine-at-ukraine-defense-contact-group-meeting.html) reported that Canadian National Defence Minister David McGuinty announced new military aid to Ukraine at the 37th Ukraine Defense Contact Group meeting.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/17/8063307/) reported that the UK anticipates a number of announcements on weapons for Ukraine at the Ukraine Defence Contact Group meeting.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/17/8063323/) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy requested 40 more F-16 fighter jets and proposed an air defence missile exchange at the Ukraine Defence Contact Group meeting.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/17/8063305/), [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185706-over-1000-air-defense-missiles-uk-announces-gbp-240m-military-aid-package-for-ukraine.html) reported that the UK government announced a £240 million military aid package providing over 1,000 short-range air defense missiles for Ukraine.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/17/8063265/) reported that starting the evening of 16 November, Russia launched over 300 UAVs and missiles against Ukraine, with air defences downing 205 drones.

On 17 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2219745) reported that the Russian Defense Ministry claimed its air defenses set a single-day record by shooting down nine Flamingo cruise missiles, a guided air bomb, and 2,256 drones.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185432-fire-breaks-out-at-a-petrochemical-complex-after-attack-in-russias-bashkortostan-media.html) reported that an attack targeted the Gazprom Neftekhim Salavat petrochemical complex in the Republic of Bashkortostan, causing a fire.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/fire-reported-at-major-russian-petrochemical-complex-in-bashkortostan-amid-drone-attack/), [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90314) reported that Ukrainian drones targeted the Gazprom Neftekhim Salavat petrochemical complex in Bashkortostan, causing a fire.
On 17 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90314) reported that Moscow claimed a record 1,441 drones had been downed.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/16/8063109/) reported that Ukraine's Defence Ministry stated private businesses have helped expand air defence capabilities since spring 2026 through groups operating under military command.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-defense/4185180-eu-allocates-eur-171b-to-ukraine-for-drones-ammunition-air-defense-systems.html), [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90277) reported that the European Commission allocated 1.71 billion euros to Ukraine under the Ukraine Support Loan program to purchase drones, ammunition, and air defense systems.
On 14 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/14/8062856/) reported that Ukrainian Defence Minister Yevhenii Khmara spoke to UK Defence Secretary Wes Streeting.

On 14 Nov 2026, [RT](https://rt-english.com/news/648834-ukraine-aid-hurts-us-military/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS) reported that a Pentagon report stated Ukraine aid has forced US troops in Europe to divert funds.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/15/8062918/) reported that Ukrainian air defense shot down or jammed 106 out of 132 Russian drones overnight, with hits recorded at 20 locations.

On 14 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/defense/2218213), a state-media outlet, reported that Russian air defense forces intercepted and destroyed 39 Ukrainian unmanned aerial vehicles over several regions during the day.

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/bih/sda-najavila-apelaciju-ustavnom-sudu-bi-h-zbog-izmjena-zakona-o-rtrs-u/) reported that the SDA announced it will submit an appeal to the Constitutional Court of Bosnia and Herzegovina regarding amendments to the RTRS law.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/sda-ide-na-ustavni-sud-zbog-zakona-o-rtrs-u-poziva-tuzilastvo-bih/261126285) reported that the Party of Democratic Action announced it will submit an appeal to the Constitutional Court of Bosnia and Herzegovina to review the constitutionality of amendments to the RTRS law and urged the Prosecutor's Office of Bosnia and Herzegovina to react.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/biznis/ekonomija/ustavni-sud-bih-odbio-apelaciju-firme-miroslava-miskovica-koja-od-rs-a-trazi-142-miliona-km/261126159) reported that the Constitutional Court of Bosnia and Herzegovina rejected an appeal by Miroslav Mišković's Delta Real Estate firm seeking 14.2 million convertible marks from Republika Srpska and Banja Luka.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/obrazlozenje-odluke-o-simbolima-armije-rbih-mogu-ih-ukinuti-samo-institucije-bih-nsrs-nema-to-pravo/261123250) reported that the Constitutional Court of Bosnia and Herzegovina stated that only state-level institutions can repeal the symbols of the Army of the Republic of Bosnia and Herzegovina, and the National Assembly of Republika Srpska lacks the right to do so.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/bih/Valerija-Galic-nije-saglasna-sa-odlukom-Ustavnog-suda-o-vetu-Zeljke-Cvijanovic/993877) reported that Constitutional Court Vice President Valerija Galic disagreed with the court's decision regarding Zeljka Cvijanovic's veto.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/biznis/ekonomija/bingo-ostaje-vlasnik-hotela-zenit-ustavni-sud-bih-odbio-apelacije-hnk-i-neuma/261123179) reported that the Constitutional Court of Bosnia and Herzegovina rejected the appeals of Herzegovina-Neretva Canton and Neum regarding Hotel Zenit.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/ustavni-sud-bih-detaljno-objasnio-zasto-je-srusio-veto-zeljke-cvijanovic-valerija-galic-dala-izjavu-o-neslaganju/261123253) reported that the Constitutional Court of Bosnia and Herzegovina explained its decision to overturn Zeljka Cvijanovic's veto regarding the Commission to Preserve National Monuments.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/bih/ademovic-ustavni-sud-bi-h-je-jedini-bedem-pred-secesionistickom-politikom-iz-rs/) reported that legal expert Ademović stated the Constitutional Court of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the only bulwark against secessionist policy from Republika Srpska.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/bih/1090081/sanja-vulic-udarila-na-ustavni-sud-bih-odavno-je-vrijeme-da-stranim-sudijama-kazemo-goodbye) reported that SNSD Caucus Head Sanja Vulić criticized the Constitutional Court of Bosnia and Herzegovina and stated that it is time to say goodbye to foreign judges.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/bih/kovacevic-o-odluci-ustavnog-suda-bi-h-ovo-je-napad-na-prava-srba/) reported that SNSD delegate Kovačević commented on a Constitutional Court decision concerning Bosnia and Herzegovina.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/nedim-ademovic-u-rs-u-su-odluke-ustavnog-suda-bih-samo-izgovor-za-blokadu-drzavnog-sistema/261121066) reported that constitutional law expert Nedim Ademovic considers that decisions of the Constitutional Court of Bosnia and Herzegovina are used only as an excuse for blockades of the state system in Republika Srpska.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/opozicija-u-rs-u-nazvala-odluku-ustavnog-suda-bih-provokacijom-traze-odlazak-stranih-sudija/261121004) reported that political leaders Draško Stanivuković and Ognjen Bodiroga described the Constitutional Court's decision as unacceptable.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/bih/becirovic-entitetski-zakoni-ne-mogu-osporavati-upotrebu-obiljezja-armije-r-bi-h/) reported that BiH Presidency member Denis Bećirović stated that entity laws cannot challenge the use of the Army of the Republic of Bosnia and Herzegovina insignia.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/bih/historijski-presedan-ustavni-sud-bi-h-prvi-put-preispitao-veto-u-predsjednistvu/) reported that the Constitutional Court of Bosnia and Herzegovina reviewed a veto in the Presidency for the first time and annulled Cvijanović's veto.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/bih/Minic-Nema-formiranja-vlasti-na-nivou-BiH-dok-se-rusi-Srpska/993552) reported that Republika Srpska President Savo Minic stated there will be no talks on forming government levels in Bosnia and Herzegovina until issues regarding state property and the OHR are resolved.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/bih/sda-zadovoljna-odlukom-ustavnog-suda-pod-ljiljanima-je-branjena-nasa-drzava/) reported that the SDA expressed satisfaction with the Constitutional Court's decision.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/hoce-li-komisija-za-ocuvanje-nacionalnih-spomenika-postati-prvi-test-za-buduce-odnose-u-predsjednistvu-bih/261120290) reported that the Constitutional Court of Bosnia and Herzegovina left the appointment of four members of the Commission to Preserve National Monuments in force.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/bih/stanivukovic-tvrdi-da-odluka-o-zastavi-armije-r-bi-h-ponovo-otvara-ratne-rane/), [Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/bih/1089646/odluka-ustavnog-suda-bih-izazvala-reakciju-stanivukovica-ponovo-otvaraju-rane) reported that Stanivuković stated that the decision of the Constitutional Court of BiH regarding the Army of RBiH flag reopens war wounds and is unacceptable.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/snsd-krece-s-ucjenama-najavljena-potpuna-blokada-vijeca-ministara-zbog-odluke-ustavnog-suda-o-zastavama-armije-bih/261120261) reported that SNSD President Milorad Dodik stated no member of the BiH Council of Ministers from that party will make any decision until the Constitutional Court's decision is withdrawn.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/bih/1089634/sda-pozdravila-odluku-ustavnog-suda-ljiljani-i-simboli-armije-rbih-predstavljaju-dio-historijskog-i-drzavnog-naslijedja-bih), [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/sda-odluka-ustavnog-suda-bih-potvrdila-da-ljiljani-i-simboli-armije-rbih-ne-mogu-biti-zabranjeni/261120312) reported that SDA welcomed the Constitutional Court's decision, stating that the lilies and symbols of the Army of the Republic of Bosnia and Herzegovina represent part of the historical and state heritage of BiH.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/bih/1089638/dodik-se-oglasio-i-na-drustvenim-mrezama-nakon-odluke-ustavnog-suda-danas-je-umrla-bosna-i-hercegovina) reported that Dodik posted on social media that Bosnia and Herzegovina died today.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/ustavni-sud-srusio-veto-cvijanovic-komisija-za-zastitu-nacionalnih-spomenika-imenovana-u-skladu-sa-zakonom/261120219) reported that the Constitutional Court of BiH set aside Željka Cvijanović's statement on the vital interest of Republika Srpska and the National Assembly decision confirming it.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/bih/zestoka-reakcija-iz-rs-nikada-ovdje-nece-postaviti-zastavu-armije-r-bi-h/) reported a fierce reaction from Republika Srpska regarding the Constitutional Court decision.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/dodik-da-dode-100-ustavnih-sudova-nece-postaviti-nijednu-zastavu-armije-rbih-u-rs-neka-probaju/261120242) reported that SNSD President Milorad Dodik reacted to the Constitutional Court of BiH ruling by stating that no flag of the Army of the Republic of Bosnia and Herzegovina would be placed in Republika Srpska.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/odluka-ustavnog-suda-bih-zabrana-simbola-armije-rbih-je-neustavna/261120215), [Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/bih/1089543/ustavni-sud-bih-ukinuo-zabranu-simbola-armije-rbih-u-rs-oboren-veto-zeljke-cvijanovic) reported that the Constitutional Court of Bosnia and Herzegovina ruled that the provision of the Republika Srpska Criminal Code punishing the display of Army of the Republic of Bosnia and Herzegovina symbols is unconstitutional.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/vijece-ministara-ukinulo-odluku-o-kupovini-zgrade-za-smjestaj-drzavnih-institucija-u-istocnom-sarajevu/261120277), [Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/bih/vijece-ministara-bi-h-ponistilo-odluku-o-kupovini-zgrade-u-istocnom-sarajevu/) reported that the Council of Ministers of Bosnia and Herzegovina annulled the decision to purchase a building in East Sarajevo for state institutions.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/covic-najavio-da-ce-nova-vlada-fbih-biti-formirana-do-kraja-februara/261118278), [Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/bih/covic-najavio-kada-bi-bi-h-mogla-dobiti-novo-vijece-ministara-i-vladu-f-bi-h/) reported that HDZ BiH President Dragan Čović stated that talks on forming the government are intensive and expressed expectations for the legislative authority to be established by the end of February.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/bih/Covic-otkrio-s-kim-je-razgovarao-o-formiranju-vlasti-i-najavio-rokove/993122) reported that HDZ BiH President Dragan Čović stated talks had been held with SDA, SDP, and SNSD on government formation.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/bih/covic-do-kraja-novembra-najavio-teske-razgovore-o-formiranju-vlasti-u-bi-h/) reported that HDZ BiH leader Dragan Čović announced difficult talks on government formation by the end of November.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/covic-najavio-smjenu-generacija-u-hdz-u-tako-smo-poceli-s-clanicom-predsjednistva-bih/261113122) reported that Dragan Čović announced a generational shift in the HDZ after a session of the HDZ Presidency in Mostar.

stories.title: Gunmen On Rampage As Obi Visits Edo, Attack Ex-NBA President Akpata’s Office, NDC Supporters
stories.label: Delta State political campaign attack

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/shot-edo-ndc-supporter-narrates-ordeal/) reported that an NDC supporter, Aimionkhale Michael, narrated how suspected political thugs shot him at close range in Edo State.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/thugs-attack-peter-obis-convoy-in-benin-we-dont-support-violence-apc/) reported that the APC stated it does not support violence following an attack on an NDC convoy and campaign office in Benin where Peter Obi was expected to speak.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/one-injured-as-gunmen-attack-obi-supporters-in-benin/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that one person was shot in the thigh when gunmen attacked Peter Obi supporters near Benin airport in Edo State.

On 25 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/edo-ndc-rally-shooting-police-launch-manhunt-for-attackers/) reported that police launched a manhunt after a gunman attack during a Nigeria Democratic Congress rally in Benin left a victim injured.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/five-bullets-ndc-supporter-recounts-attack-on-omo-ageges-campaign-team-in-delta/) reported that an NDC supporter recounted being shot five times during an attack on Ovie Omo-Agege's campaign team in Delta.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/2027-we-dont-want-them-to-rig-us-out-peter-obi-tells-edo-voters/) reported that Nigeria Democratic Congress presidential candidate Peter Obi urged voters in Edo to remain at their polling places to prevent vote rigging.

On 25 Nov 2026, [The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/gunmen-strike-ndc-again-attack-peter-obis-supporters-at-benin-airport-days-after-delta-killings/), [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/breaking-gunmen-attack-peter-obis-convoy-in-edo/) reported that gunmen attacked the presidential campaign convoy and supporters of Peter Obi, the Nigeria Democratic Congress candidate, in Benin City.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/south-south-regional/928011-peter-obi-kwankwaso-visit-family-of-slain-ndc-supporter-in-delta.html) reported that Peter Obi and Rabiu Kwankwaso visited the family of a supporter killed during earlier campaign violence in Delta State.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/police-confirm-attack-on-ndc-supporters-in-edo-one-injured/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Edo State police confirmed the attack on NDC supporters on Airport Road in Benin City, resulting in one injury.

On 24 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/attack-on-omo-ageges-campaign-team-dangerous-for-democracy-ochei/) reported that Nigeria Democratic Congress Delta North senatorial candidate Victor Ochei strongly condemned the reported attack on Omo-Agege's campaign team.

On 24 Nov 2026, [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/24/regina-omo-agege-condemns-attack-on-brothers-campaign-team-says-politics-must-never-become-a-death-sentence/) reported that Regina Omo-Agege urged President Tinubu to ensure the protection of Ovie Omo-Agege and other Nigerians and called on the IGP and DSS to conduct a transparent investigation.

stories.title: General Staff: Russia has lost 1,645,899 troops in Ukraine since Feb. 24, 2022
stories.label: Ukraine frontline combat engagements

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4188741-167-clashes-reported-along-front-line-in-past-24-hours-with-pokrovsk-sector-remaining-hottest-spot.html) reported that 167 combat engagements were recorded along the front line over the past 24 hours, with the Pokrovsk sector remaining the hottest spot.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/26/8064755/), [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4188814-russias-november-losses-in-ukraine-already-top-55000-setting-new-wartime-record-general-staff.html) reported that Ukraine's General Staff stated Russian forces suffered 55,629 personnel losses in the first 25 days of November, marking the highest monthly figure of the war.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/general-staff-russia-has-lost-1-645-899-troops-in-ukraine-since-feb-24-2022/) reported that the General Staff stated Russian forces suffered 2,319 casualties over the past day, bringing total reported losses since Feb. 24, 2022, to 1,645,899.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/general-staff-russia-has-lost-1-643-580-troops-in-ukraine-since-feb-24-2022/) reported that the General Staff stated Russia has lost 1,643,580 troops in Ukraine since February 24, 2022, including 2,091 casualties suffered over the past day.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/russia-breaks-yearly-troop-losses-record-in-ukraine-at-432-519-casualties-general-staff-says/) reported that the General Staff stated Russia broke its yearly troop losses record in Ukraine with 432,519 casualties.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187920-war-update-161-combat-clashes-reported-on-front-line-over-past-day.html) reported that 161 combat engagements between Ukrainian Defense Forces and Russian troops were recorded along the front line on November 23.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4187894-lithuania-provides-ukraine-with-over-usd-1b-in-military-aid-since-2022-general-staff.html) reported that Lithuania has provided Ukraine with over $1 billion in military assistance since 2022.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187530-war-update-149-clashes-on-front-lines-over-past-day-heaviest-fighting-on-kostiantynivka-pokrovsk-axes.html) reported that Ukraine's Defense Forces engaged in 149 combat clashes with Russian troops along the front line on November 22, with the heaviest fighting on the Kostiantynivka and Pokrovsk axes.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187253-war-update-116-clashes-on-front-line-russian-forces-pressing-hardest-in-pokrovsk-kostiantynivka-sectors.html) reported that 116 combat engagements took place along the front line, with Russian forces launching nearly 25 assaults in the Pokrovsk and Kostiantynivka sectors.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/general-staff-russia-has-lost-1-633-130-troops-in-ukraine-since-feb-24-2022/) reported that total Russian troop losses reached 1,633,130, including 2,150 casualties over the past day.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4186670-war-update-278-clashes-on-front-line-over-past-day-pokrovsk-sector-hottest.html) reported that 278 combat engagements were recorded along the front line on November 19, with the highest number in the Pokrovsk sector.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4186183-war-update-205-clashes-on-front-line-80-russian-troops-neutralized-on-pokrovsk-axis.html) reported that 205 combat engagements were recorded along the frontline on November 18, with 80 Russian troops neutralized on the Pokrovsk axis.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185400-war-update-135-combat-engagements-on-front-line-over-past-day.html) reported that 135 combat engagements were recorded along the frontline between Ukraine's Defense Forces and Russian invading forces on November 16.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185350-war-update-133-combat-engagements-on-front-line.html) reported that 133 combat engagements were recorded along the front line, with Russian forces attacking Ukrainian positions 13 times in the Pokrovsk sector.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185037-war-update-141-clashes-on-front-lines-over-past-day-kostiantynivka-axis-hottest.html) reported that 141 combat engagements were recorded on the front line, with the Kostiantynivka axis being the most active.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/15/8062929/) reported that Ukraine's General Staff recorded 171 combat clashes on November 14, with the Pokrovsk front experiencing the highest number of attacks.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4184540-war-update-243-clashes-on-front-line-fiercest-fighting-in-pokrovsk-sector.html), [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/14/8062835/) reported that Ukraine's General Staff recorded hundreds of combat clashes along the front line over the past day, with the heaviest fighting in the Pokrovsk sector.

stories.title: Serbia National Assembly consultations

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/region/poznato-ime-kandidata-studentske-liste-za-predsjednika-srbije/), [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/misteriozne-poruke-na-mrezama-otkrile-novog-moguceg-kandidata-za-predsednika/sy9yrzq) reported that social media messages indicated potential candidates for the Student List in the upcoming presidential elections in Serbia.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/ex-yu/Mediji-Radomir-Saicic-kandidat-Studentske-liste-za-predsjednika-Srbije/994424) reported that National Assembly President Aleksandar Cupic scheduled presidential elections for December 27 and media indicated Radomir Sajcic is the Student List candidate.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/biznis/privreda/program-studentske-liste-za-turizam-nova-pravila-za-vaucere-stan-na-dan-i-subvencije/5e790bx) reported that the Student List program for tourism proposes new rules for vouchers, apartment rental taxes, and the suspension of state funds for hotels on Zlatibor and Kopaonik, focusing instead on eastern Serbia and the Danube.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/vucic-sam-sedi-u-poslanickim-klupama-opozicije-otkrio-razlog/byvw2em) reported that Serbian Progressive Party parliamentary group head Aleksandar Vučić remained sitting alone in opposition benches after a recess in the National Assembly.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/skupstina-srbije-uzivo-danas-se-raspravlja-samo-jedna-tacka-dnevnog-reda/h73jbdp) reported that the National Assembly continued its constitutive session with a discussion on parliamentary delegations while students observed from the gallery.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/regija/studenti-usli-na-sjednicu-narodne-skupstine-srbije-i-dobili-gromoglasan-aplauz-vucic-ih-ogorceno-posmatrao/261124091) reported that representatives of the Student Movement entered the hall of the National Assembly of Serbia during its session.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/stanovi-aleksandra-cupica-vucic-spominje-milione-evo-sta-kaze-novi-predsednik/mxy5sqb) reported that Serbian President Aleksandar Vučić criticized the statement of National Assembly President Aleksandar Čupić regarding property ownership.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/cupic-najavio-konsultacije-oko-formiranja-skupstinskih-odbora/s6ggxg7) reported that National Assembly President Aleksandar Čupić announced consultations regarding the formation of parliamentary committees ahead of the continuation of the constitutive session.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/u-utorak-nastavak-konstitutivne-sednice-skupstine-srbije/m21fnxe) reported that the constitutive session of the National Assembly will continue on Tuesday, November 24.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/rastislav-dinic-i-zoran-lutovac-komentarisali-odluku-studentske-liste-o-skupstini/qrz2vqg) reported that the fact that the Student List did not give any parliamentary vice-president position to either the SNS or minority parties has been a topic of discussion for days.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/aleksandar-cupic-za-pevnicom-u-crkvi-u-raski-povodom-slave-arandjelovdan/qp0bsvm) reported that National Assembly President Aleksandar Čupić attended a liturgy in Raška and sang church songs with believers.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/aleksandar-cupic-sastao-sa-sefom-delegacije-eu-u-srbiji-foto/64zqtng) reported that the EU Delegation's charge d'affaires in Serbia, Julian Vassallo, met with newly elected National Assembly President Aleksandar Čupić.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/kosta-cestitao-cupicu-imenovanje-za-predsednika-skupstine/txwtk3m) reported that European Council President António Costa congratulated Aleksandar Čupić on his appointment as president of the National Assembly of Serbia.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/pogledajte-sta-je-aleksandar-cupic-radio-dan-nakon-izbora-za-predsednika-skupstine/4x82b6x) reported that newly elected National Assembly President Aleksandar Čupić removed graffiti with students the morning after his election.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/nesvakidasnja-scena-ispred-skupstine-srbije-cupic-zapevao-sa-poslanicima/ryqtxrj) reported that the new president of the National Assembly of Serbia, Aleksandar Čupić, sang outside the parliament building with gathered citizens and deputies.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/studenti-odgovorili-na-dodikovu-cestitku-novom-predsjedniku-skupstine-srbije-sreca-pa-ne-zaboravljamo/261120039) reported that students from Serbia responded to Milorad Dodik's congratulatory message to the new president of the National Assembly of Serbia.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/region/1089376/izglasano-sest-potpredsjednika-narodne-skupstine-republike-srbije) reported that six vice presidents of the National Assembly of Serbia were elected, with all functions going to deputies of the Student List "Students win".

On 19 Nov 2026, [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/obratili-se-predstavnici-studentske-liste-nakon-sednice-skupstine-medju-njima-i-cupic/86s66k5) reported that Student List representatives held a press conference after the constituent assembly session, where Čupić stated he would be the president of all deputies.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/ex-yu/Cupic-objavio-imena-kandidata-za-potpredsjednike-Skupstine-Srbije/993285) reported that Aleksandar Čupić, president of the National Assembly of Serbia, read the names of candidates for six vice presidents during the continued constituent session.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/stevandic-prvi-cestitao-novom-predsjedniku-skupstine-srbije-pozvao-ga-da-dode-u-nsrs/261119159) reported that Republika Srpska National Assembly President Nenad Stevandic congratulated Aleksandar Čupić on his election as president of the National Assembly of Serbia and invited him to visit.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/region/1089228/ko-je-aleksandar-cupic-profesor-koji-je-ugostio-studente-u-plasteniku-a-danas-vodi-skupstinu-srbije) reported that Aleksandar Čupić is a faculty assistant professor who was proposed by student representatives.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/zvanicnici-crne-gore-cestitali-cupicu-izbor-za-predsednika-skupstine-srbije/x5h5s39) reported that officials of Montenegro congratulated Aleksandar Čupić on his election as president of the National Assembly of Serbia.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/ex-yu/Aleksandar-Cupic-novi-predsjednik-Narodne-skupstine-Republike-Srbije/993241) reported that Aleksandar Čupić was elected as the new president of the National Assembly of the Republic of Serbia.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/region/1089177/treci-dan-konstitutivne-sjednice-skupstine-srbije-zastupnici-biraju-predsjednika-parlamenta) reported that the National Assembly session continued for its third day to choose a parliament president.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/region/zavrsen-i-drugi-dan-zasjedanja-skupstine-srbije-vucic-moze-pricati-jos-10-dana/) reported that the second day of the National Assembly session concluded without electing a parliamentary president and will continue on Thursday.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/regija/potpuni-haos-na-kraju-dana-u-skupstini-srbije-vucic-pobjesnio-uslikaj-ih-sve-zapisi-ih-sve/261118290) reported that the session ended in uproar with Aleksandar Vučić demanding individuals be recorded and photographed.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/vucica-provocirao-novinar-pitanjem-o-bratu-andreju-dobio-zestok-odgovor-video/85h9d7t), [Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/region/tenzije-u-holu-skupstine-srbije-vucic-izgubio-nerve-nesreco-sram-te-bilo/) reported that tensions occurred in the lobby of the National Assembly involving Aleksandar Vučić and a journalist.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/regija/vucic-rekao-da-ga-poslanik-studentske-liste-seksualno-uznemirava-ja-nisam-od-tih-imate-tu-kolega-drugih-koliko-hocete/261118157), [Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/region/1088957/video-vucic-tvrdi-da-ga-poslanik-studentske-liste-seksualno-uznemirava-nemam-nista-protiv-tih-ljudi-ali-nisam-od-njih) reported that Aleksandar Vučić told Studentska lista deputy Zlatko Kokanović during a session of the National Assembly not to send him kisses, alleging sexual harassment.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/aleksandar-cupic-o-sednici-skupstine-svojoj-imovini-i-vucicu/9tdz2vx) reported that Aleksandar Čupić, a candidate for president of the National Assembly from the Student List, announced plans to submit a property report following a parliamentary session where Aleksandar Vučić spoke for five hours.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/kamberi-sda-ce-glasati-za-aleksandra-cupica-za-predsednika-skupstine-srbije/0lg50wn) reported that MP Shaip Kamberi stated the SDA will vote for Aleksandar Čupić as president of the National Assembly of Serbia.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/oglasili-se-studenti-o-govoru-jugoslava-gasica-u-skupstini-srbije/wj1j0ls) reported that students from the Faculty of Media and Communications reacted on social media to criticism directed at Student List MP Jugoslav Gašić.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/ex-yu/Skupstina-Srbije-nastavila-sjednicu-Minut-cutanja-za-pilota-Vucic-ponovo-govori/993001), [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/skupstina-srbije-uzivo-bakic-sef-poslanicke-grupe-studentske-liste-bira-se-predsednik/dv39qz9) reported that the National Assembly of Serbia held a minute of silence for Serbian Air Force pilot Goran Bulajić during its constitutive session.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/sara-valentik-studentska-lista-ocekujem-efikasniju-skupstinu-nakon-izbora-predsednika/4r7ggv4) reported that Student List youngest MP Sara Valentik stated she expects a more efficient National Assembly of Serbia following the election of a new parliament president.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/ex-yu/Ko-je-Jovo-Bakic-novi-sef-poslanicke-grupe-Studentske-liste/992989) reported that Jovo Bakić, a 56-year-old sociology professor at the Faculty of Philosophy in Belgrade, became the head of the Student List parliamentary group in the new National Assembly of Serbia.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/nastavak-konstitutivne-sednice-novog-saziva-skupstine-srbije/dv39qz9) reported that members of the 15th parliamentary session of the National Assembly of Serbia continued their constitutive session with discussions on candidates for assembly president.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/jovo-bakic-otkrio-ko-je-kandidat-studentske-liste-za-potpredsednika-skupstine-srbije/lhpd4cq) reported that Jovo Bakić, head of the Student List parliamentary group, held a press conference to reveal the candidate for vice president of the National Assembly.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/lija-srdanovic-nakon-sednice-sutra-dobijamo-predsednika-skupstine/wd4r421) reported that Ilija Srdanović, the first on the Student List - Students Win list, stated after the National Assembly session that they will get a parliamentary president the next day and criticized Aleksandar Vučić.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/ana-brnabic-o-studentskoj-listi-posle-konstitutivne-sednice-skupstine-srbije-video/zf5qshz) reported that member of parliament Ana Brnabić spoke out after the constitutive session of the National Assembly of Serbia regarding the Student List candidate for the presidency of the assembly.
