reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/ogun-police-rescue-stolen-baby-sold-for-n1-5m-arrest-three/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Ogun police rescued a stolen baby sold for N1.5m and arrested three female suspects at Ifo market.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/alleged-sexual-assault-katsina-govt-sets-up-panel-to-probe-emir-of-daura/), [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/katsina-sets-up-committee-to-probe-daura-emir-over-sexual-misconduct-allegations/), [Punch](https://punchng.com/katsina-sets-up-panel-to-probe-daura-emir-over-sexual-assault-allegation/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the Katsina State government constituted a nine-member committee to investigate sexual assault allegations involving the Emir of Daura.

On 25 Nov 2026, [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/25/katsina-suspends-emir-of-daura-over-sexual-harassment-allegation/) reported that the Katsina State government suspended the Emir of Daura over sexual harassment allegations involving a foreign tourist, while Governor Radda set up a committee to probe the claims.

On 25 Nov 2026, [The Rio Times](https://www.riotimesonline.com/daura-emir-suspended-tourist-assault-claim-nigeria/) reported that Katsina State suspended the Emir of Daura's engagements and opened a committee probe after a tourist's allegation, which the palace disputes.

On 24 Nov 2026, [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cmglrz462nn6o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that the Emir of Daura, a 92-year-old monarch, was suspended after sexual assault claims.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/katsina-suspends-emir-of-dauras-engagements-over-assault-allegation-launches-investigation/) reported that the Katsina State Government constituted an investigative committee to probe allegations involving Alhaji Umar Faruk Umar.
On 24 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/katsina-suspends-daura-emir-over-sexual-assault-allegations-by-polish-tourist/) reported that the allegations were made by a Polish tourist.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/927384-daura-emirate-examines-tourists-assault-video-police-deny-knowledge-of-incident.html) reported that the Daura emirate is examining whether the footage accompanying a tourist's sexual assault allegation is genuine or manipulated.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/instagram-removes-polish-tourists-video-accusing-daura-emir-of-sexual-assault/) reported that Instagram removed a video posted by a Polish tourist accusing the Emir of Daura of sexual assault.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/police-arrest-11-suspected-yahoo-boys-in-ogun-recover-charms/) reported that the Police Special Fraud Unit under FCID Alagbon arrested 11 suspected internet fraudsters during an intelligence-led operation in Ogun and recovered charms.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/927767-police-arrest-11-in-ogun-yahoo-academy-raid-official.html) reported that police stated investigations are ongoing to establish the identity of suspected human remains found in the Ogun raid or whether they connect to any reported murder case.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/police-bust-ogun-yahoo-academy-uncover-human-remains/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web), [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/ogun-police-bust-yahoo-academy-recover-human-remains/) reported that the Police Special Fraud Unit arrested 11 suspected internet fraudsters at an alleged Yahoo academy in Abeokuta and recovered human remains.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/morning-recap-157-nigerians-face-us-deportation-police-bust-ogun-yahoo-academy-other-top-stories/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that 157 Nigerians now face US deportation after 24 more were added, and Ogun police arrested 11 suspects at a cybercrime academy.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/amnesty-international-condemns-death-threats-against-tourist-over-daura-emir-video/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Amnesty International condemned death threats against a tourist who alleged sexual assault by the Emir of Daura and urged police to investigate impartially.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1742869-just-katsina-governor-told-suspend-emir-daura-sexual-misconduct-allegations/), [Punch](https://punchng.com/ex-kaduna-gov-demands-daura-emirs-suspension-over-sexual-assault-allegation/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that former Kaduna governor Abubakar Dangiwa Umar called on Katsina State Governor Dikko Radda to suspend the Emir of Daura over allegations involving a female tourist.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/nigeria/1742942-instagram-removes-foreign-tourists-video-accusing-daura-emir-sexual-assault/) reported that Instagram removed a video uploaded by a foreign tourist accusing the Emir of Daura of sexual assault at a palace in Katsina state.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/instagram-removes-video-of-alleged-sexual-assault-by-emir-of-daura/) reported that Instagram removed a viral video of a tourist accusing the Emir of Daura of sexual assault.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/nwest/927381-dangiwa-umar-gumi-demand-suspension-of-emir-of-daura-over-alleged-sexual-misconduct.html) reported that former Military Governor Abubakar Dangiwa Umar called on Katsina State Governor Dikko Radda to suspend the Emir of Daura.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/daura-emirate-probes-viral-video-as-tourist-insists-on-assault-claim/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the Daura Emirate Council commenced a review of a viral video involving assault claims against the Emir of Daura.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/daura-emir-faces-sexual-assault-allegation-amnesty-seeks-probe/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Amnesty International Nigeria called for a probe after a female tourist accused the Emir of Daura of sexual assault while a palace source denied it.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/morning-recap-opposition-challenges-tinubu-daura-emir-faces-sexual-assault-allegation-other-top-stories/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that opposition parties challenged Tinubu's endorsement of APC candidates.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/gumi-calls-for-removal-of-emirs-guilty-of-immoral-conduct/) reported that Islamic cleric Sheikh Ahmad Gumi called for the immediate removal of any Emir found guilty of immoral conduct.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/any-emir-guilty-of-immorality-should-be-dethroned-gumi/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Sheikh Ahmad Gumi stated any emir guilty of immorality should be dethroned amidst a tourist harassment allegation against the Emir of Daura.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/nwest/927263-tourist-alleges-sexual-assault-against-daura-emir-amnesty-demands-probe.html) reported that Amnesty International demanded an investigation after a foreign tourist accused the Emir of Daura of sexual assault during a palace visit.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/nigeria/1742749-sheikh-gumi-calls-immediate-removal-emir-sexual-harassment-allegation/) reported that Sheikh Ahmad Gumi called for the immediate removal of any Emir found guilty of misconduct following the sexual harassment allegation.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/amnesty-international-demands-probe-of-emir-of-daura-over-sexual-assault-allegations/) reported that Amnesty International Nigeria called on authorities to immediately investigate allegations of sexual assault against the Emir of Daura.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/emir-of-daura-trends-on-x-after-tourists-inappropriate-touching-allegation/) reported that a female tourist who uses the online identifier 'beduina' alleged inappropriate touching by the Emir of Daura after completing a 30-day trip across Nigeria.

On 22 Nov 2026, [The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/sexual-assault-allegation-rocks-daura-emirate-as-tourist-accuses-emir-of-groping/) reported that a tourist posting under the Instagram handle @beduinqa accused the Emir of Daura of groping in a video following a tour of Nigeria.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/full-list-fg-announces-19-international-job-vacancies/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the Federal Government announced 19 international job vacancies for Nigerians at the African Space Agency and OIC.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/petrol-imports-jump-47-despite-local-refining/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Nigeria's petrol imports rose 47% to 15 million litres per day in October according to NMDPRA data.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/fg-suspends-lagos-ibadan-bridge-work-after-20-hour-gridlock/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the Nigerian Federal Government suspended construction on the pedestrian bridge at Aseese along the Lagos-Ibadan Expressway following a severe gridlock.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/926362-2027-politics-watch-from-apcs-benue-ticket-setback-to-tinubus-state-police-bill.html) reported that a court invalidated the APC's substitution of Gabriel Suswam in Benue North-East, while President Bola Tinubu received a constitutional amendment bill on state police.

On 19 Nov 2026, [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/19/at-last-senate-sends-state-police-bill-to-president-demands-operational-guidelines/) reported that the Senate sent the State Police Bill to the President and demanded operational guidelines while lawmakers warned against abuse.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/state-police-on-verge-of-reality-operational-guidelines-bill-submitted-to-justice-ministry/) reported that an operational guidelines bill for state police was submitted to the Justice Ministry.
On 19 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/state-police-senate-demands-safeguards-against-abuse/) reported that the Senate demanded safeguards against the abuse of state police.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/state-police-why-constitutional-amendment-is-just-the-first-step-omole/) reported that a constitutional amendment allowing states to establish their own police services is considered the first step in decentralising policing in Nigeria.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/state-police-senate-clears-final-hurdle-sends-constitutional-amendment/), [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/state-police-bill-forwarded-by-senate-to-tinubu-for-assent/) reported that the Senate cleared the final hurdle and directed the Clerk to transmit the constitutional amendment bill seeking to establish state police for presidential assent.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/tinubu-seeks-decriminalisation-of-attempted-suicide-proposes-support-for-victims/), [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/tinubu-seeks-reps-approval-to-decriminalise-attempted-suicide/) reported that President Bola Tinubu transmitted the National Mental Health (Amendment) Bill, 2026, to the House of Representatives seeking to decriminalise attempted suicide.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/tinubu-receives-state-police-bill-to-consult-agf-before-assent/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that President Bola Tinubu will consult the Attorney-General before giving assent to the state police bill.

On 18 Nov 2026, [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/18/senate-sends-state-police-bill-to-tinubu-demands-operational-guidelines/) reported that Senator Akpabio stated the new policing structure could tackle 70% of insecurity.

stories.title: Pentagon Has Yet to Sign Off on 48 Patriot Missiles for Ukraine, Zelensky Says
stories.label: Ukraine aims 1,300 drones at Russia in one of war's largest attacks

reports.text: On 25 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4188662-zelensky-no-word-yet-from-us-on-accelerating-air-defense-missile-deliveries.html), [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/no-good-news-from-us-on-accelerating-air-defense-missile-deliveries-zelensky-says/) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky stated there is no word or good news yet from the United States regarding the acceleration of air defense missile deliveries.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/91220) reported that the Pentagon stated it is working with European partners and Ukraine to expand Patriot production while neither confirming nor denying reports of delayed interceptor deliveries.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/91079113) reported that US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth has yet to approve the transfer of around 60 interceptor missiles for Patriot air defense systems to Ukraine.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/91107) reported that President Volodymyr Zelensky stated an agreement to deliver 48 Patriot interceptors remains unsigned on US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth's desk.
On 25 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/world/2224311) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky stated the Pentagon is holding up the delivery of 48 Patriot missiles.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4188232-zelensky-says-comprehensive-solution-to-counter-russian-glide-bombs-will-be-found.html) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky stated a comprehensive solution to counter guided aerial bombs will be found.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/24/8064335/) reported that deliveries of PAC-2 and PAC-3 interceptor missiles allocated to Ukraine are awaiting Pentagon approval, according to the Financial Times.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4187966-hegseth-yet-to-approve-transfer-of-patriot-missiles-already-allocated-to-ukraine-ft.html) reported that US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth has yet to authorize the transfer of around 60 Patriot interceptor missiles.
On 24 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/world/2223699), a Russian state-media outlet, reported that the Pentagon delayed PAC-2 and PAC-3 Patriot missile deliveries to Ukraine.

On 24 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/hegseth-pentagon-patriot-missiles-ukraine-b3090496.html) reported that US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth delayed shipments of Patriot missiles to Ukraine, holding up interceptors paid for by European allies.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/91035) reported that the Pentagon is delaying the transfer of around 60 Patriot interceptor missiles already purchased by Ukraine's Western allies.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/23/8064201/) reported that Ukrainian Defence Minister Yevhenii Khmara stated Russia launched over 4,000 jet-powered drones and 153 ballistic missiles in October.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/ukraine-war-latest-us-delays-on-patriot-missiles-difficult-to-understand-as-russia-fires-165-missiles-in-single-week-zelensky-says/) reported that President Volodymyr Zelensky stated Russia fired 165 missiles in a single week and criticized US delays on Patriot missiles.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Politico](https://www.politico.eu/article/14-missing-after-russian-strike-zelenskyy-presses-us-patriot-missiles/?utm_source=RSS_Feed&utm_medium=RSS&utm_campaign=RSS_Syndication) reported that following an attack near Kyiv, President Volodymyr Zelenskyy urged Washington to authorize air defense missiles financed by allies.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/22/zelenskyy-urges-us-to-release-patriot-missiles?traffic_source=rss) reported that a Russian drone attack killed at least two people near Kyiv while Russian shelling killed one person in Zaporizhzhia.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/zelensky-says-us-delays-on-patriot-missiles-are-difficult-to-understand-as-russia-fires-165-missiles-in-a-week/) reported that President Volodymyr Zelensky urged Washington to authorize the transfer of Patriot missiles.
On 22 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90844) reported that Russian forces launched approximately 2,700 strike drones, nearly 1,460 guided aerial bombs, and 165 missiles.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/22/8064012/) reported that Ukraine's air defence shot down or jammed 161 out of 186 Russian drones overnight, with hits recorded at 18 locations.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/21/8063914/) reported that Russia launched three ballistic missiles and 148 drones against Ukraine overnight, with strikes recorded at 19 locations.
On 20 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90720) reported that President Volodymyr Zelensky urged the Pentagon to release expected PAC-2 and PAC-3 Patriot missile deliveries.

On 20 Nov 2026, [CBC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTFBVVzZGZEdDYjRKSW93bXh0dGlWbFM2Yld3dDJxSXZ2M21lY1kySXVYZGxaTVVQSEFrNXdaZG43bm5iV2ZLM1JBcFBEUDhDWHg5bHM2UktJbjVzYzNHVFFMWEd1eFZ3TlU1Q0xkSUJDSl8?oc=5) reported that Russia fired hundreds of missiles and drones at Ukraine and allegedly into Poland.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90693) reported that the Ukrainian Air Force stated Russia attacked Kyiv and nine Ukrainian regions with 84 cruise missiles, 404 drones, and additional ballistic and Zircon missiles overnight into Friday.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/russia-fired-more-than-110-missiles-in-one-of-wars-largest-attacks-zelensky-says-3725804), [Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/europe/compensating-with-terror-russia-hits-ukraine-with-400-drones-110-missiles-in-one-of-wars-largest-attacks/articleshow/136025133.cms) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated Russia fired more than 110 missiles and over 400 drones in one of the largest attacks of the war, killing at least eight people.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Defense News](https://www.defensenews.com/global/europe/2026/11/19/ukraine-plans-to-double-drone-supplies-triple-deep-strikes/) reported that Ukraine is moving forward with its long-range strike campaign with European partner support despite Washington's request to prioritize front-line defense.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/18/8063389/) reported that at the 37th Ramstein meeting in Brussels, Ukraine's partners outlined new air defence funding, drone procurement, and ammunition deliveries, with Belgium pledging ten F-16s and two Mirage jets by year-end.

On 18 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261118-us-hits-out-at-ukraine-s-deep-strikes-against-russia-in-rift-with-eu-over-war-tactics) reported that top US defense official Elbridge Colby criticized Ukraine's deep strikes against Russia.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90419) reported that Ukraine announced plans to more than triple its deep-strike capabilities in 2027 and that Britain and Germany defended Kyiv's actions.
On 17 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/world/2219895) reported that Moscow stated that arming the Kiev regime only prolongs the conflict in Ukraine.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185731-ramstein-zelensky-proposes-swapping-partners-patriot-and-irist-missile-stockpiles-for-future-deliveries.html), [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90407) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky proposed swapping partner countries' Patriot and IRIS-T missile stockpiles for future deliveries and requested 40 more F-16 jets at Ramstein.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/europe/ukraine-aims-1300-drones-at-russia-in-one-of-wars-largest-attacks) reported that Russia's Defense Ministry stated it intercepted 1,336 Ukrainian drones in one of the war's largest aerial attacks.

On 17 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2219401), a Russian state outlet, reported that the Moscow Mayor stated approximately 800 UAVs headed toward the Moscow region during an overnight attack.

On 26 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/2026-budget-atiku-makinde-tackle-tinubu-over-n10-78trn-oil-revenue-shortfall-n31-4trn-fiscal-deficit/) reported that opposition presidential candidates Atiku Abubakar and Seyi Makinde raised concerns over the 2026 budget regarding an oil revenue shortfall and fiscal deficit.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/928006-ndc-alleges-assassination-attempt-on-kwankwasiyya-social-media-influencer.html) reported that the Kano State Presidential and Gubernatorial Campaign Council of the Nigeria Democratic Congress alleged an assassination attempt on a Kwankwasiyya social media influencer.

On 25 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/tinubu-must-explain-n10trn-gap-in-oil-revenue-atiku/) reported that African Democratic Congress presidential candidate Atiku Abubakar stated President Bola Tinubu must explain a 10.78 trillion naira oil revenue shortfall.

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/da-li-je-postignut-dogovor-sutra-nastavak-sjednice-skupstine-kantona-sarajevo/261126179) reported that Democratic Front deputy Albin Zuhrić stated a agreement was reached at a meeting of parties represented in the Sarajevo Canton Assembly, with the session continuing tomorrow.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/djurdjevic-stamenkovski-vucic-ne-bi-izgubio-izbore-da-je-formirao-pokret-za-narod-i/vhnlyty) reported that technical Minister for Labour Milica Djurdjevic Stamenkovski stated Aleksandar VuciC should discover who in his ranks opposed a past move.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/vucic-za-informer-stigla-je-vest-na-koju-smo-upozoravali-dve-godine-dobili-smo/6yyfkvf) reported that Aleksandar Vučić gave an interview from the National Assembly after taking the function of head of the parliamentary group.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/bih/zastupnici-skupstine-kantona-10-polozili-zakletvu-slijedi-izbor-rukovodstva/) reported that deputies of the Canton 10 Assembly took their oaths of office ahead of leadership elections.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/ovo-su-savjetnici-becirovica-cvijanovic-i-filipovic-u-predsjednistvu-bih/261118104) reported that the official website of the Presidency of Bosnia and Herzegovina published the names of cabinet chiefs and advisers for Denis Bećirović, Željka Cvijanović, and Željko Komšić.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/nenad-stevandic-ce-i-u-naredne-cetiri-godine-biti-predsjednik-narodne-skupstine-rs-a/261116117), [Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/bih/Nenad-Stevandic-novi-stari-predsjednik-Narodne-skupstine-Republike-Srpske/992589) reported that Nenad Stevandić was re-elected as president of the National Assembly of Republica Srpska for another four-year term.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/bakassi-deep-seaport-will-redefine-nigerias-maritime-economy-tinubu/) reported that President Bola Ahmed Tinubu described the groundbreaking of the Bakassi Deep Seaport as a defining milestone in Nigeria's economic diversification.

On 13 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/tinubu-flags-off-3-5bn-bakassi-deep-seaport-targets-44bn-annual-maritime-revenue/) reported that President Bola Tinubu flagged off the construction of the $3.5 billion Bakassi Deep Seaport.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/cross-river-tinubu-flags-off-3-5bn-bakassi-deep-seaport-targets-regional-trade-expansion/), [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/13/tinubu-fags-off-bakassi-deep-seaport-says-project-will-redefine-nigerias-maritime-economy/), [Punch](https://punchng.com/tinubu-flags-off-bakassi-seaport-in-cross-river/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that President Bola Ahmed Tinubu performed the groundbreaking ceremony for the Bakassi Deep Seaport in Cross River State to expand maritime trade and create jobs.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/tinubu-flags-off-3-5bn-bakassi-deep-seaport-construction/) reported that Tinubu stated he came to break ground and break centuries-old jinx rather than to cut a ribbon and dance.

stories.title: Israel government coalition talks

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/191063/%D9%84%D9%8A%D8%A8%D8%B1%D9%85%D8%A7%D9%86-%D9%8A%D8%AD%D8%B0%D8%B1-%D9%85%D9%86-%D9%85%D9%86%D8%A7%D9%88%D8%B1%D8%A9-%D8%AA%D9%86%D8%A7%D9%88%D8%A8-%D9%8A%D8%B7%D8%B1%D8%AD%D9%87%D8%A7-%D9%86%D8%AA%D9%86%D9%8A%D8%A7%D9%87%D9%88-%D9%84%D8%B9%D8%B1%D9%82%D9%84%D8%A9-%D8%AD%D9%83%D9%88%D9%85%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AA%D8%BA%D9%8A%D9%8A%D8%B1) reported that Yisrael Beytenu party leader Avigdor Liberman warned against a rotation maneuver proposed by Benjamin Netanyahu to obstruct the change government.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Al-Watan (Syria)](https://alwatan.sy/%d9%86%d8%aa%d9%86%d9%8a%d8%a7%d9%87%d9%88-%d9%8a%d8%b3%d8%aa%d9%86%d8%ac%d8%af-%d8%a8%d8%a7%d9%84%d9%85%d8%b9%d8%ac%d8%b2%d8%a9-%d9%88%d8%a2%d9%8a%d8%b2%d9%86%d9%83%d9%88%d8%aa-%d9%8a%d9%86/) reported that pessimism is growing within the Likud party regarding Benjamin Netanyahu's chances of retaining power while Gadi Eisenkot advances negotiations.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Sada El Balad](https://www.elbalad.news/7193649) reported that the party of designated Israeli Prime Minister Gadi Eisenkot announced it agreed to sign a coalition agreement with an opposition right-wing party.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/203870/%D8%A5%D8%B3%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%A6%D9%8A%D9%84-%D8%A2%D9%8A%D8%B2%D9%86%D9%83%D9%88%D8%AA-%D9%8A%D8%AA%D8%B9%D9%87%D8%AF-%D8%A8-%D8%AD%D9%83%D9%88%D9%85%D8%A9-%D8%B7%D9%88%D8%A7%D8%B1%D8%A6-%D8%A5%D8%B0%D8%A7-%D8%AA%D8%B9%D8%B0%D8%B1-%D8%AA%D8%B4%D9%83%D9%8A%D9%84-%D8%A7%D8%A6%D8%AA%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%81/) reported that Israeli Yisrael Beytenu party leader and designated government formation leader Gadi Eisenkot stated he would move to form a national emergency government if efforts to build a broad coalition fail.

reports.text: On 24 Nov 2026, [Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/conjoncture/l-assemblee-nationale-adopte-en-premiere-lecture-le-projet-de-loi-logement-20261124) reported that the National Assembly adopted the housing bill in the first reading.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Le Figaro](https://immobilier.lefigaro.fr/article/edouard-philippe-veut-geler-l-interdiction-des-passoires-thermiques-pendant-5-ans-20261119) reported that Horizons presidential candidate Edouard Philippe promised a normative moratorium on housing and to freeze the rental ban on energy-inefficient properties for five years.

stories.title: Flydubai to resume Israel flights from December 3, two months after foiled attack
stories.label: Israel approves Flydubai flight resumption

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/article-916279) reported that Flydubai will operate up to 42 weekly flights between Dubai and Tel Aviv.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/travel/news/2026-11-26/ty-article/.premium/flydubai-to-resume-israel-flights-in-december-two-months-after-foiled-attack/000001a2-17c8-d9b5-aba3-97cf6bb40000) reported that Flydubai will resume flights to Israel on December 3, operating six daily flights instead of 10 following a September 30 incident.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/israel-approves-flydubais-return-tel-aviv-pending-security-clearance) reported that Israeli Transportation Minister Miri Regev approved the resumption of Flydubai flights between Dubai and Tel Aviv pending security approvals.

On 24 Nov 2026, [The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/israel-approves-flydubais-return-tel-aviv-pending-clearance) reported that Israel approved Flydubai's return to Tel Aviv pending clearance, following a suspension since an alleged September 30 incident.

On 24 Nov 2026, [The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/travel/2026/11/24/flydubai-given-approval-to-resume-flights-to-tel-aviv-by-israeli-authorities/), [Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/middle-east/flydubais-tel-aviv-flights-to-resume-within-weeks-2-months-after-co-pilots-hijack-bid/articleshow/136121718.cms) reported that Israeli transportation minister Miri Regev approved Flydubai's return to resume flights to Tel Aviv within weeks.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/24/israeli-minister-approves-return-of-flydubai-flights?traffic_source=rss) reported that an Israeli minister approved the return of Flydubai flights pending final security approval.

On 23 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/article-915864) reported that Miri Regev approved Flydubai's return to Israel, with flights expected to resume within two weeks following consultations.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/travel/news/2026-11-23/ty-article/.premium/flydubai-to-resume-israel-flights-pending-security-approval-after-hijack-attempt/000001a2-0992-df88-afb7-09d3a6a40000) reported that Israel's transportation minister gave the green light for Flydubai to resume flights pending security approval after meeting Emirati officials.

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/26/8064824/) reported that the World Bank provided Ukraine with US$450 million to support businesses and reconstruction, disbursed based on performance milestones.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-economy/4188958-ukraine-receives-450-mln-from-world-bank-with-japanese-government-support.html) reported that Ukraine received the funds backed by guarantees from the Japanese government under the RISE program to support businesses and other recovery programs.
On 26 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/91312) reported that US$225 million of the funding is allocated for small and medium-sized business development.

stories.title: HSE executive tenure termination

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [The Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/politics/oireachtas/2026/11/26/anne-oconnor-never-stood-a-chance-social-democrats-padraig-rice-rounds-on-health-minister/) reported that Dáil questions were dominated by the HSE sacking crisis as the Tánaiste defended the Minister for Health.

On 26 Nov 2026, [The Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/politics/2026/11/26/simon-harris-fails-to-express-confidence-in-hse-board-and-says-it-must-answer-questions/) reported that Simon Harris failed to express confidence in the HSE board following the sacking of Anne O'Connor, while the Tánaiste defended the Health Minister.

On 26 Nov 2026, [RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/politics/2026/1126/1600709-politics-hse-ireland/) reported that both the Taoiseach and Tánaiste called for explanations regarding the dismissal of Anne O'Connor as CEO.
On 26 Nov 2026, [RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/ireland/2026/1126/1600729-politics-ireland/) reported that RTÉ executives are set to appear before the Public Accounts Committee.

On 26 Nov 2026, [RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/primetime/2026/1126/1600685-clarity-anne-o-connor/) reported on what is known about how Anne O'Connor went from being the best candidate for a difficult public service job to being fired in less than eight months.

On 25 Nov 2026, [RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/2026/1125/1600677-behind-the-story-axing-of-hse-ceo-triggers-political-turmoil-and-a-cold-case-breakthrough/) reported that the sacking of former HSE CEO Anne O'Connor continued to cause political turmoil with the opposition pressing the board.

On 25 Nov 2026, [The Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/politics/2026/11/25/sacking-of-hse-boss-anne-oconnor-dominates-proceedings-in-leinster-house/) reported that the sacking of HSE boss Anne O'Connor dominated proceedings in Leinster House.

On 25 Nov 2026, [RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/politics/2026/1125/1600552-politics-health-hse/) reported that Minister for Health Jennifer Carroll MacNeill did not inform Taoiseach Micheál Martin or Tánaiste Simon Harris of the HSE's intention to sack CEO Anne O'Connor.

On 25 Nov 2026, [The Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/politics/2026/11/25/government-circles-the-wagons-around-an-unlikely-story-about-anne-oconnors-sacking/) reported that most people find it extraordinary that the HSE board would fire a chief executive without the Minister for Health's knowledge and approval.

On 24 Nov 2026, [The Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/politics/2026/11/24/jennifer-carroll-macneill-was-told-of-decision-to-sack-hse-chief-on-thursday/) reported that Carroll MacNeill was informally told of the decision to sack the HSE chief on Thursday.

On 24 Nov 2026, [RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/2026/1124/1600391-hse-removal-dail/) reported that Taoiseach Micheál Martin is expected to address the sudden removal of HSE Chief Executive Anne O'Connor in the Dáil.

On 23 Nov 2026, [The Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/health/2026/11/23/who-are-the-members-of-the-hse-board-behind-anne-oconnors-removal/) reported that the HSE board includes 11 members such as a former GAA president and a consultant general surgeon.
On 23 Nov 2026, [RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/2026/1123/1600281-anne-oconnor-hse/) reported that HSE Chief Executive Anne O'Connor is leaving her role with immediate effect.

stories.title: Sara Duterte trial witness subpoenas

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1010906/rodrigo-duterte-camp-discloses-63-item-evidence-batch-ahead-of-icc-trial/story/) reported that Rodrigo Duterte's defense submitted 63 items of evidence ahead of the ICC trial.

On 26 Nov 2026, [GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1010899/sara-duterte-can-best-answer-allegations-says-house-prosecutor/story/) reported that House lead impeachment prosecutor Representative Gerville Luistro stated she was left wanting more after the defense panel submitted only two names of witnesses.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Rappler (Philippines)](https://www.rappler.com/philippines/former-cale88-co-owner-boc-official-testify-sara-duterte-impeachment-trial/) reported that Dr. Lourdes Tingson-Lebosada is expected to testify in the Sara Duterte impeachment trial regarding Cale88's organizational structure.

On 26 Nov 2026, [GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1010897/mother-of-drug-war-victims-set-to-observe-duterte-s-icc-proceedings-in-the-hague/story/) reported that the mother of two drug war victims will observe former President Rodrigo Duterte's trial proceedings at the International Criminal Court in The Hague.

On 26 Nov 2026, [GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1010903/icc-trial-chamber-iii-sets-conduct-for-duterte-trial-proceedings/story/) reported that ICC Trial Chamber III set the conduct of proceedings for the trial of former President Rodrigo Duterte.

On 26 Nov 2026, [GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1010854/defense-lawyer-brings-up-duterte-s-cognitive-impairment-anew-ahead-of-icc-trial/story/) reported that Rodrigo Duterte's defense lawyer stated he has a cognitive impairment affecting his understanding of crimes against humanity charges before the ICC.

On 25 Nov 2026, [GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1010809/rodrigo-duterte-camp-link-to-alleged-crimes-against-humanity-untenable/story/) reported that Rodrigo Duterte's defense team questioned the Office of the Prosecutor's evidence linking him to alleged crimes against humanity in a 77-page pre-trial brief.

On 25 Nov 2026, [GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1010792/justice-leonen-concurs-with-dismissal-but-says-sc-should-have-ruled-on-duterte-arrest/story/) reported that Senior Associate Justice Marvic Leonen concurred with the Supreme Court's dismissal of habeas corpus petitions while stating the court should have ruled on the arrest.

On 25 Nov 2026, [GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1010704/kitty-duterte-to-appeal-sc-dismissal-of-petitions-challenging-father-s-arrest-lawyer/story/) reported that the camp of Veronica “Kitty” Duterte will appeal the Supreme Court decision dismissing the habeas corpus petitions challenging her father's arrest.

On 24 Nov 2026, [GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1010638/icc-prosecution-to-present-100-witnesses-protective-measures-may-be-implemented/story/) reported that the International Criminal Court spokesperson stated the prosecution team is expected to present over 100 witnesses during the trial.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Rappler (Philippines)](https://www.rappler.com/philippines/expectations-opening-rodrigo-duterte-international-criminal-court-trial/) reported that more than 500 victims of extrajudicial killings in the drug war are authorized to participate in the trial through their legal representatives.

On 24 Nov 2026, [GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1010631/sara-duterte-the-best-defense-witness-in-impeachment-trial-says-prosecutor-luistro/story/) reported that House Lead Impeachment Prosecutor Gerville Luistro stated that Vice President Sara Duterte is the best witness the defense panel can present.

On 24 Nov 2026, [GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1010604/sc-junks-petitions-challenging-ex-president-duterte-s-arrest/story/), [Rappler (Philippines)](https://www.rappler.com/philippines/supreme-court-dismisses-petition-rodrigo-duterte-icc-arrest/) reported that the Philippine Supreme Court dismissed habeas corpus petitions challenging the arrest of former President Rodrigo Duterte.

On 23 Nov 2026, [GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1010558/icc-sets-procedure-for-external-submissions-in-rodrigo-duterte-drug-war-probe/story/) reported that the International Criminal Court Pre-Trial Chamber I is setting a standard procedure to process submissions from external entities in the Rodrigo Duterte drug war probe.

On 23 Nov 2026, [GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1010560/rodrigo-duterte-camp-opposes-sweeping-closed-sessions-for-icc-prosecution-witnesses/story/) reported that former President Rodrigo Duterte's defense team opposed the ICC prosecution's request for sweeping closed sessions for prosecution witnesses.

On 23 Nov 2026, [GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1010495/pnp-considering-to-visit-sara-duterte-over-alleged-threats/story/) reported that the Philippine National Police stated on Monday that it is willing to visit Vice President Sara Duterte to gather details regarding reported threats against her.

On 23 Nov 2026, [GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1010457/pnp-preparing-for-the-worst-ahead-of-sara-duterte-impeachment-trial-verdict-jonvic-remulla/story/) reported that Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla urged the Philippine National Police to remain impartial and prepare for possible scenarios ahead of the verdict.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Rappler (Philippines)](https://www.rappler.com/philippines/rodrigo-duterte-icc-trial-hearing-schedule-key-dates/) reported that the ICC set November 30 as the start of Rodrigo Duterte's trial, with hearings resuming on January 11.

On 22 Nov 2026, [GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1010417/prosecution-ready-should-vp-sara-mans-carpio-testify-in-impeachment-court-joel-chua/story/) reported that House lead prosecutor Joel Chua stated the prosecution is ready should Vice President Sara Duterte and her husband Manases Carpio testify before the impeachment court.

On 22 Nov 2026, [GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1010362/prosecution-asks-icc-chamber-to-reject-rodrigo-duterte-defense-request-on-evidence/story/) reported that prosecutors asked the International Criminal Court Trial Chamber III to dismiss a request of former president Rodrigo Duterte's defense team regarding evidence.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Rappler (Philippines)](https://www.rappler.com/philippines/agnes-callamard-us-sanctions-vs-icc-jeopardize-rodrigo-duterte-case/) reported that Agnes Callamard stated that US sanctions against the ICC could jeopardize the Rodrigo Duterte case.

On 22 Nov 2026, [GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1010404/sara-duterte-spox-given-until-nov-23-to-respond-to-senate-show-cause-order/story/) reported that Vice President Sara Duterte's spokesperson Paolo Panelo was given until Monday, November 23, to respond to a show-cause order issued by the Senate impeachment court.

On 21 Nov 2026, [GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1010302/adiong-on-questions-to-vp-sara-s-tree-planting-link-with-cale88-don-t-be-onion-skinned/story/) reported that House prosecution spokesperson Zia Adiong responded to criticism from the Office of the Vice President regarding questions on tree planting.

On 21 Nov 2026, [GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1010288/ovp-tree-planting-campaign-not-associated-with-cale88-boi-compliance/story/) reported that the Office of the Vice President denied that its tree planting campaign is related to Cale88 Foods Corporation's compliance with the Board of Investments.

On 20 Nov 2026, [GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1010253/sara-duterte-impeachment-trial-day-45-cale88-seen-as-small-time-despite-millions-in-money-flows/story/) reported that the 45th day of Vice President Sara Duterte's impeachment trial began with the Senate impeachment court ordering OVP spokesperson Paolo Panelo to explain money flows related to Cale88.

On 20 Nov 2026, [GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1010254/rodrigo-duterte-camp-asks-icc-to-reject-ex-davao-cop-s-prior-recorded-testimony/story/) reported that former President Rodrigo Duterte's defense team asked the International Criminal Court to reject an ex-Davao City police officer's prior recorded testimony.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Rappler (Philippines)](https://www.rappler.com/philippines/defense-witness-cannot-explain-discrepancy-cale88-sales-cash-inflows/) reported that DTI Undersecretary Ceferino Rodolfo's testimony on Cale88 raises suspicions about the banana chips exporter's inward remittances from China.

On 20 Nov 2026, [GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1010235/sara-duterte-trial-dates-on-nov-26-and-27-reset-over-defense-witnesses-unavailability/story/) reported that trial dates on November 26 and 27 were reset over the unavailability of defense witnesses.

On 20 Nov 2026, [GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1010193/cale88-reduced-employees-due-to-non-operation-change-of-management-dti-witness/story/) reported that a Department of Trade and Industry defense witness stated Cale88 reduced its number of employees from 2024 to 2025 due to non-operation and a change in management.

On 20 Nov 2026, [GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1010214/sara-duterte-s-tree-planting-connection-to-calle88-questioned-in-impeachment-trial/story/) reported that the House prosecution panel raised questions regarding the alleged possible connection of Vice President Sara Duterte's tree planting activities with Cale88 during her impeachment trial.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Rappler (Philippines)](https://www.rappler.com/philippines/impeachment-court-orders-sara-duterte-spokesman-paolo-panel-explain-comments-judges/) reported that Sara Duterte's spokesperson Paolo Panelo was told to explain after being accused of bias by senators, and defense lawyer Michael Poa stated a contempt citation would not affect the defense's strategy.

On 20 Nov 2026, [GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1010175/paolo-panelo-issued-show-cause-order-by-senate-impeachment-court/story/) reported that the Philippine Senate impeachment court issued a show cause order against Vice President Sara Duterte's spokesperson, lawyer Paolo Panelo, over comments regarding the trial.

On 19 Nov 2026, [GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1010147/sara-duterte-impeachment-trial-day-45-what-to-expect/story/) reported that Vice President Sara Duterte's impeachment trial continues with her defense team expected to present its last three witnesses for the week.

On 19 Nov 2026, [GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1010114/sara-duterte-s-financial-transactions-need-further-investigation-says-witness/story/) reported that a witness stated Vice President Sara Duterte's financial transactions need further investigation based on Anti-Money Laundering Council data.

On 19 Nov 2026, [GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1010151/victim-s-lawyers-back-closed-testimony-stronger-protection-for-duterte-icc-trial-witnesses/story/) reported that lawyers for victims backed closed testimony and stronger protection for witnesses in former President Rodrigo Duterte's International Criminal Court case.

On 19 Nov 2026, [GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1010120/sara-duterte-defense-presents-salns-of-marcos-leni-robredo/story/) reported that Vice President Sara Duterte's defense counsel presented the statements of assets, liabilities, and net worth of President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

On 19 Nov 2026, [GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1010122/sara-duterte-s-defense-fails-to-challenge-evidence-in-impeachment-trial/story/) reported that the House prosecution stated the defense team has yet to debunk evidence at the conclusion of the 44th day of the impeachment trial.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Rappler (Philippines)](https://www.rappler.com/philippines/escudero-calls-out-fire-transition-effect-sara-duterte-trial-livestream/) reported that Senator-judge Alan Peter Cayetano led the opening prayer during which a transition fire effect briefly appeared on the livestream.

On 19 Nov 2026, [GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1010032/gov-t-exec-tapped-to-appear-in-sara-duterte-trial-seeks-reschedule-of-testimony/story/) reported that one of the four expected witnesses in Vice President Sara Duterte's trial requested that the impeachment court allow her to appear on another date.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Rappler (Philippines)](https://www.rappler.com/newsbreak/inside-track/can-sara-duterte-defense-explain-remittances-cale88/) reported that the defense in Vice President Sara Duterte's trial is turning to government agencies to address money laundering allegations.

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [The Korea Herald](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10950541) reported that police raided the home of the deceased first-ever perfect scorer on South Korea's law school entrance exam as part of an escalating investigation.

On 25 Nov 2026, [ABC Australia](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-26/asia-exams-and-ai-smart-glasses-cheating/107419882) reported that wearable devices have emerged as aids to cheaters across Asia in exams that determine people's life trajectories.

On 23 Nov 2026, [The Diplomat](https://thediplomat.com/2026/11/south-korea-cannot-police-its-way-out-of-ai-cheating/) reported that the top scorer on the tax exam confessed to AI cheating and 111 more alleged cases surfaced at the college entrance exam.

On 22 Nov 2026, [The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2641688/south-korean-education-minister-offers-to-resign-amid-ai-assisted-cheating-controversy) reported that South Korean Education Minister Kyo-jin offered to resign and took responsibility for last-minute anti-cheating measures that caused confusion.

On 22 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/22/south-korea-education-minister-resigns-after-ai-cheating-scandal-engulfs-university-exams), [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/south-korea-education-minister-choi-kyo-jin-resigns-amid-ai-cheating-scandal-101795322293412.html), [The Korea Herald](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10945089), [Punch](https://punchng.com/south-korea-education-minister-resigns-over-ai-cheating-scandal/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web), [Yonhap](https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20261122001051315), [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/asia/east-asia/article/3375362/south-koreas-education-minister-quits-amid-backlash-over-anti-cheating-exam-checks) reported that South Korean Education Minister Choi Kyo-jin resigned following an AI-assisted cheating scandal and last-minute exam rule changes.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Korea Herald](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10940994) reported that recent AI-assisted exam cheating scandals in South Korea reveal a growing willingness to bend the rules, with psychologists stating technology is making dishonesty easier.

On 17 Nov 2026, [GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/world/1009880/south-korea-tightens-exam-security-after-ai-cheating-scandal/story/) reported that South Korea will deploy thousands of extra personnel to prevent cheating on college entrance exam sites this week.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Yonhap](https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20261117006200315) reported that an education ministry official reaffirmed that the government ruled out postponing the college entrance exam.

On 17 Nov 2026, [The Korea Herald](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10940048), [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/week-asia/lifestyle-culture/article/3374703/south-korea-checks-glasses-and-collars-hidden-ai-university-exam) reported that South Korean education officials and Prime Minister Han Seong-sook took measures to prevent artificial intelligence-assisted cheating ahead of the nationwide college entrance exam.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Yonhap](https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20261117003600315) reported that the leader of the ruling Democratic Party stated the party will push for a 10-year exam ban for AI-assisted cheating.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Yonhap](https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20261117003200315), a local outlet, reported that Prime Minister Han Seong-sook vowed again to root out AI cheating in this week's college entrance exam.
On 17 Nov 2026, [Yonhap](https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20261117003100315) reported that the top scorer of this year's certified tax accountant exam apologized for cheating before police questioning.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/glasses-worn-by-exam-candidates-come-under-scanner-in-south-korea-after-ai-cheating-scandal-101794803535654.html), [CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/east-asia/south-korea-national-exam-ai-cheating-scandal-6554101) reported that South Korea's Education Minister announced the ministry will inspect all glasses worn by candidates in the college entrance exam following an AI cheating scandal.

On 19 Nov 2026, [La Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/2026/11/19/politica/004n2pol?partner=rss) reported that the Chamber of Deputies approved the creation of the General Law on Animal Welfare, Care, and Protection.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Siempre!](https://www.siempre.mx/2026/11/congreso-aprueba-historica-ley-de-bienestar-animal/) reported that Congress approved an animal protection law to regulate animal welfare and homogenize concepts of welfare, mistreatment, and cruelty nationwide.

On 19 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/tendencias/ley-de-bienestar-animal-que-sanciones-y-medidas-de-proteccion-implica-esta-iniciativa/) reported that the animal welfare regulation represents an important tool in advancing fauna protection.

On 18 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/metropoli/ley-de-rentas-justas-iniactiva-privada-propone-diferenciar-aumentos-en-arrendamientos-buscan-proteger-a-las-familias-aseguran/) reported that business organizations suggested rents higher than 15,000 pesos be adjusted with each change of tenant or every three years.

On 18 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/metropoli/terminan-mesas-de-dialogo-sobre-ley-de-rentas-justas-en-congreso-de-cdmx-objetivo-es-evitar-aumentos-desproporcionados-insiste-diputado/) reported that dialogue tables on the Fair Rent Law concluded in the CDMX Congress.

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/26/nato-deploys-awacs-airborne-radar-to-monitor-polish-airspace) reported that NATO authorized deploying an AWACS reconnaissance aircraft to Poland after prosecutors stated three Russian cruise missiles fell on its territory.
On 26 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/91319) reported that Czech President Petr Pavel urged NATO to be ready to shoot down Russian drones and missiles violating allied airspace.

On 24 Nov 2026, [RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/2026/1124/1600432-poland-russia-ukraine/) reported that Poland stated a Russian reconnaissance drone briefly entered its airspace during an overnight attack on Ukraine.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/90854607) reported that NATO is considering a stronger military presence in Europe and deployed an early warning radar plane following Russian missile and drone breaches of Polish airspace.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/finland-summons-russian-ambassador-over-unacceptable-actions-in-europe-3725931) reported that Finland's Foreign Ministry summoned Russia's ambassador for talks, calling Moscow's dangerous and irresponsible actions in Europe unacceptable.

On 24 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2026/nov/24/russia-ukraine-poland-drone-patriots-latest-news-updates), [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/24/8064344/) reported that Poland's Defence Ministry believes Russia deliberately sent a drone across the Ukrainian border into Polish airspace.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/24/8064315/), [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187891-russian-drone-enters-polish-airspace-during-attack-on-ukraine.html) reported that a Russian drone entered Polish airspace during an attack on Ukraine and the Polish military refrained from shooting it down due to risks.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/russian-unmanned-aerial-vehicle-violates-polish-airspace-days-after-missile-incursion/) reported that Poland's Government Security Center issued an air-attack alert in parts of the Lublin region after a Russian unmanned aerial vehicle violated airspace.
On 24 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90985) reported that Poland's military authorized the destruction of the drone but withheld firing due to safety risks.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/23/finland-summons-russian-ambassador-as-it-condemns-russias-dangerous-and-reckless-actions-i) reported that Finland summoned the Russian ambassador after a Russian helicopter was suspected of violating Finnish airspace.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/23/8064207/) reported that Poland will summon Russian ambassador Georgy Mikhno following a 20 November airspace violation.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/23/8064278/) reported that NATO's allied aircraft will complement ground-based systems following Russian missiles violating Polish airspace.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/90373428) reported that U.S. President Donald Trump stated in an interview with Fox News that Vladimir Putin launched several missiles toward Poland by mistake.

On 23 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/nato-parliamentary-assembly-convenes-amid-russian-airspace-violations/live-80016415?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy and German Foreign Minister Wadephul are set to address the NATO Parliamentary Assembly in Berlin amid discussions on Russian airspace violations.
On 23 Nov 2026, [Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/90376380) reported that NATO convened an emergency meeting after two Russian missiles and a drone entered Polish airspace.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/23/all-three-flying-objects-that-fell-in-poland-turned-out-to-be-russian-x-101-cruise-missiles) reported that debris recovered in all three Polish towns where objects fell during the overnight attack on Ukraine turned out to be Russian X-101 cruise missiles.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/22/8064097/) reported that missile debris recovered at three sites in Poland has been identified as belonging to Russian Kh-101 cruise missiles.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/poland-identifies-russian-cruise-missiles-behind-strikes-near-ukraine-border-nato-to-hold-discussions-101795373162372.html) reported that Poland Prime Minister Donald Tusk stated missile impacts near the Nowa Dęba military training ground were unlikely to be coincidental.

On 22 Nov 2026, [teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/polish-prosecutors-office-points-that-three-russian-missiles-hit-poland-on-friday/), a state-run outlet, reported that the Prosecutor's Office in Lubin investigating the incident indicated three Russian systems impacted Polish soil.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipwFBVV95cUxNM1VMUS1oUkxlYzRWaDg5WjNPbGJoV2t1LTlRNkVMWnF6a3Q3aUljXzlCal9hWmdhWnlkYzdKNjdFVGdwVk1WUFFucGdfbUlnY3RtUjBsdFBxVTdmTGNjcnJ1a0VDNnk5eFh5NDdWaGNWcjNWcFI2WkoxZnFUbkI5UHZ6YTdYZUVMa19Ldk5YTERtX3ZialpvbjI4eFVoQ0Eyd2l0NGxoVQ?oc=5) reported that prosecutors stated three Russian missiles flew into Poland on Friday.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/moldova-finland-report-russian-airspace-violations-day-after-suspected-russian-missiles-flew-into-poland/) reported that Moldova and Finland reported separate instances of airspace violations by Russia.
On 22 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90845) reported that wreckage from a Russian Kh-101 cruise missile that crashed in Poland was manufactured in Russia in late 2026.

On 21 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/russian-helicopter-suspected-of-violating-finnish-airspace/a-80010133?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that Finland's Defense Ministry thinks a suspected Russian helicopter airspace incursion is linked to an earlier drone strike on a Russian cargo ship.
On 22 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90848) reported that a jet-powered unmanned aerial vehicle violated Moldova's airspace twice during a Russian aerial attack on Ukraine.
On 21 Nov 2026, [Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/89816890) reported that a new jet-powered drone violated the airspace of the Republic of Moldova amidst Russian attacks on Ukraine.

On 20 Nov 2026, [HuffPost World](https://www.huffpost.com/entry/poland-condemns-russian-provocation-after-three-airspace-violations_n_6b004317e4b0976dc4a2f08e) reported that Poland condemned three airspace violations by Russia as a provocation.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4186925-trump-claims-putin-sent-drones-and-little-missiles-into-poland-by-mistake.html), [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/20/trump-says-putin-launched-a-couple-of-small-missiles-into-poland-by-accident-a-couple-of-little-missiles) reported that US President Donald Trump claimed Russian drones and missiles entered Polish territory by mistake.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/20/poland-condemns-russian-provocation-after-airspace-violations?traffic_source=rss) reported that Poland condemned a Russian provocation after airspace violations during European troop exercises.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/89556156) reported that Moldova's permanent representative to the OSCE strongly condemned violations of national airspace amid Russian attacks on Ukraine.

On 20 Nov 2026, [El País](https://english.elpais.com/international/2026-11-20/ukraine-war-spills-over-into-eastern-poland.html) reported that residents of eastern Polish border regions live with SMS alerts about Russian attacks and the sound of fighter jets as the Ukraine war spills over.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4186768-ukraine-cooperating-with-poland-in-probe-into-airspace-violation-fm-sybiha.html) reported that Ukraine is working closely with Poland to assist in investigating the airspace violation during Russia's massive attack.

On 20 Nov 2026, [The Moscow Times](https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/11/20/poland-condemns-russian-provocation-after-3-airspace-violations-a94331) reported that Poland condemned a Russian provocation after three airspace violations.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/20/unidentified-object-falls-in-eastern-poland-amid-major-russian-attack-on-ukraine), [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/20/8063740/), [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90676), [TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/9f4712724be0), [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/poland-reports-airspace-violation-during-russian-attack-on-ukraine-investigates-debris-crash/), [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4186756-poland-investigating-crash-of-unidentified-object-near-border-during-russian-attack-on-ukraine.html) reported that Poland is investigating a possible airspace violation or falling unidentified object during a Russian attack on Ukraine.
On 20 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90692) reported that Poland evacuated its Rzeszow Airport control tower for the first time during the attack.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/89347044) reported that Germany reaffirmed its defense commitments to Moldova and prioritized airspace protection following repeated Russian drone incursions.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/89297987) reported that an unidentified drone entered Moldovan airspace from Ukraine, traveling for nine minutes from the Vinnytsia region.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/88193791) reported that fragments of a Gerbera-2 drone were discovered near the village of Cuhureștii de Sus following a November 17 incursion.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185880-debris-of-russian-gerbera2-drone-found-in-moldova.html) reported that drone debris was also found near the village of Naslavcea in Moldova's Ocnița district.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Hungary Today](https://hungarytoday.hu/hungarian-conservatives-condemn-russian-drone-attack-on-ukraines-transcarpathia/) reported that several Russian drones struck Ukraine’s Transcarpathian region, targeting areas around Mukachevo.
On 18 Nov 2026, [Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/88197893) reported that Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha condemned the incursion of Russian drones into Moldovan airspace.

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/politica/escandalo-ueno-bank-milei-reunio-paraguay-sucesor-santiago-pena-ofrecio-asistencia-economica-financiera_0_mlCfzuQmoz.html) reported that Javier Milei traveled to Asuncion, met with Pedro Alliana, and offered economic and financial assistance following the Ueno Bank scandal.

On 26 Nov 2026, [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/politica/tras-el-escandalo-de-ueno-bank-javier-milei-se-reune-con-pedro-alliana-nuevo-presidente-de-paraguay-nid26112026/) reported that Javier Milei met with new Paraguay president Pedro Alliana following the Ueno Bank scandal.

On 25 Nov 2026, [El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/internacional/imputarian-expresidente-pena-por-lavado-de-activos-y-soborno) reported that prosecutors plan to indict former president Peña for asset laundering and bribery in an expanded filing for the Ueno Bank case.

On 24 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/paraguay-prepara-ley-de-emergencia-por-crisis-de-ueno-bank-garantizara-indemnizaciones-a-miles-de-trabajadores/) reported that Paraguay prepared an emergency law for the Ueno Bank crisis to guarantee compensation for workers.

On 24 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/latinoamerica/fiscalia-de-paraguay-acusa-al-expresidente-santiago-pena-y-a-dos-familiares-por-lavado-de-activos-y-cohecho-por-el-escandalo-de-ueno-bank-3603960) reported that Paraguay's prosecutor's office accused former president Santiago Peña and two relatives of asset laundering and bribery.

On 24 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/fiscalia-paraguaya-acusa-a-santiago-pena-por-lavado-de-activos-y-cohecho-por-el-caso-ueno-bank-33294119) reported that the Paraguayan Prosecutor's Office accused former president Santiago Peña of money laundering and bribery in the Ueno Bank case.

On 24 Nov 2026, [El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/mundo/fiscalia-paraguaya-acusa-expresidente-pena-lavado-activos-cohecho-ueno-bank_1795556481) reported that the new charges against the former president constitute an expansion of the initial accusation of breach of trust and negligent administration.

On 23 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/detienen-a-hermano-del-expresidente-santiago-pena-por-el-caso-ueno-bank-en-paraguay-33282464) reported that Paraguay's Prosecutor's Office ordered the arrest of former president Santiago Peña's brother, Francisco Peña, and his wife over alleged money laundering.

On 24 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/latinoamerica/detienen-al-hermano-y-a-la-cunada-del-expresidente-de-paraguay-santiago-pena-en-medio-del-caso-ueno-bank-son-investigados-por-lavado-de-activos-3603618) reported that Francisco Peña and Rocío Caballero were captured following a fiscal order investigating a simulated purchase of 1,184 hectares.

On 23 Nov 2026, [El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/mundo/detienen-hermano-cunada-expresidente-paraguayo-pena-investigados-caso-ueno_1795476703) reported that judicial authorities detained the brother and sister-in-law of former Paraguayan president Peña in connection with the Ueno case involving a real estate acquisition.

On 23 Nov 2026, [El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/internacional/detenido-hermano-del-expresidente-de-paraguay-por-escandalo-de-ueno-bank) reported that agents intercepted Francisco Peña Palacios as he left his home regarding the Ueno Bank scandal.

On 23 Nov 2026, [teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/paraguay-detention-pena-brother-ueno/) reported that Paraguay's Prosecutor's Office ordered the preventive detention of Francisco Peña, brother of former president Santiago Peña, over links to the Ueno Bank scandal.

On 23 Nov 2026, [La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/internacional/fiscalia-paraguay-ordena-detener-hermano-expresidente-santiago-pena-escandalo-ueno-bank_202611236b04a39cff6fec2921993996.html) reported that Francisco Peña and his wife are under suspicion for alleged money laundering and self-interested administration in a real estate operation linked to the bank.

On 20 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/fiscalia-abre-investigacion-penal-contra-el-exfiscal-general-de-paraguay-por-el-caso-ueno-bank-33238340) reported that Paraguay's Attorney General's Office opened a criminal investigation against former Attorney General Emiliano Rolón.

On 21 Nov 2026, [El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/mundo/fiscalia-abre-investigacion-penal-exfiscal-general-paraguay-ueno-bank_1795221891) reported that the Paraguayan Attorney General's Office opened a criminal investigation against the former attorney general regarding Ueno Bank, alongside the resignation and preventative detention of former Central Bank head Carlos Carvallo and three board directors.

On 19 Nov 2026, [MercoPress](https://en.mercopress.com/2026/11/19/ueno-bank-collapse-claims-paraguay-s-attorney-general-and-the-head-of-itaipu?utm_source=feed&utm_medium=rss&utm_content=main&utm_campaign=rss) reported that Paraguay's Attorney General Emiliano Rolón resigned and the Paraguayan director of the binational Itaipú dam departed following the Ueno Bank collapse.

On 18 Nov 2026, [teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/paraguay-attorney-general-rolon-resigns/), a state-media outlet, reported that Paraguay’s Attorney General Emiliano Rolon Fernandez resigned to stop an impeachment trial in the Chamber of Deputies.

On 17 Nov 2026, [teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/paraguay-pena-moved-to-military-prison/), a state-media outlet, reported that a criminal guarantees judge ordered the immediate transfer of former president Santiago Peña to the Viñas Cué military prison in Asuncion.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/16/paraguay-ex-president-moved-to-military-jail-amid-special-treatment-reports?traffic_source=rss) reported that former Paraguayan president Santiago Peña was accused of corruption following the collapse of Ueno Bank earlier in the month.

On 17 Nov 2026, [El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/mundo/santiago-pena-trasladado-carcel-militar-evitar-privilegios_1794875745) reported that Santiago Peña was transferred to a military jail to avoid privileges following an immediate transfer order by penal guarantee judge Osmar Legal.

On 16 Nov 2026, [The Rio Times](https://www.riotimesonline.com/paraguay-ex-president-pena-moved-vinas-cue-military-prison/) reported that former Paraguayan president Santiago Peña entered a military prison following a judge's transfer order in the Ueno Bank case.

On 16 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/santiago-pena-ingresa-a-una-carcel-militar-en-paraguay-esposado-y-con-chaleco-antibalas-33164061) reported that former Paraguayan president Santiago Peña was placed in preventive detention at a military prison.

On 16 Nov 2026, [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/el-mundo/el-escandalo-por-los-privilegios-de-santiago-pena-en-prision-fuerza-su-traslado-a-otra-carcel-nid16112026/) reported that the scandal over Santiago Peña's privileges in prison forced his transfer to another military jail in Paraguay.

On 16 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/juez-en-paraguay-ordena-trasladar-al-expresidente-santiago-pena-a-carcel-militar-sera-recluido-en-la-prision-de-vinas-cue/) reported critics denounced alleged privileges granted to the former leader, including a gymnasium.

On 16 Nov 2026, [El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/mundo/entrega-jefe-juridico-banco-central-paraguay-investigado-caida-ueno-bank_1794790896) reported that Aldo Rodríguez, head of the legal department of the Central Bank of Paraguay, surrendered to a police station in Asunción after an arrest warrant was issued over an altered report in the Ueno Bank case.

On 15 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/latinoamerica/asi-vive-la-principal-plaza-de-mercado-de-asuncion-la-crisis-financiera-por-la-caida-de-ueno-bank-en-paraguay-3600940) reported that sellers at Mercado 4 in Asunción stated sales have plummeted due to the Ueno Bank financial crisis.

On 14 Nov 2026, [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/el-mundo/la-caida-del-ueno-bank-en-paraguay-revela-el-avance-de-los-tecnomagnates-en-america-latina-nid14112026/) reported that the crisis of Paraguay's digital bank exposed links between technology entrepreneurs, governments, and far-right financing networks.

On 14 Nov 2026, [El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/mundo/fiscalia-paraguaya-acusa-asociacion-criminal-pena-cupula-bcp-caso-ueno-bank_1794677588) reported that Paraguayan prosecutor Christian Benítez stated a new charge of criminal association has been added against former president Santiago Peña and the Central Bank leadership in the Ueno bank case.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/how-a-bank-collapse-in-paraguay-brought-down-the-countrys-president-explained/article71677767.ece) reported that millions of customers abruptly lost access to savings and pension accounts after regulators seized a bank in Paraguay.

On 14 Nov 2026, [teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/paraguay-pena-criminal-association-ueno/), a state-media outlet, reported that Paraguay's Public Prosecutor's Office added a charge of criminal association as perpetrator against former president Santiago Peña.

On 13 Nov 2026, [El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/internacional/fiscalia-acusa-expresidente-paraguayo-pena-de-liderar-una-asociacion-criminal) reported that the prosecutor's office accused former Paraguayan president Peña of leading a criminal association, which carries a sentence of up to 15 years in prison.

On 13 Nov 2026, [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/politica/milei-se-comunico-con-pedro-alliana-el-sucesor-de-santiago-pena-en-paraguay-nid13112026/) reported that Javier Milei communicated with Pedro Alliana, the successor of Santiago Peña, and expressed readiness to collaborate.

On 13 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/latinoamerica/crisis-en-paraguay-fiscalia-pide-ampliar-la-imputacion-contra-el-expresidente-santiago-pena-y-lo-acusa-de-liderar-una-asociacion-criminal-3600892), [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/el-mundo/la-fiscalia-de-paraguay-complica-la-situacion-de-pena-con-una-nueva-imputacion-por-asociacion-nid13112026/), [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/fiscalia-acusa-a-expresidente-paraguayo-de-liderar-asociacion-criminal-santiago-pena-protegio-desde-el-poder-a-ueno-bank-senala/) reported that the Paraguayan prosecutor's office expanded charges against former president Santiago Peña, accusing him of leading a criminal association and protecting Ueno Bank from power.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Siempre!](https://www.siempre.mx/2026/11/santiago-pena-palacios-presidente-de-paraguay-sigue-la-pauta-destituido-y-en-la-carcel/) reported that regulators seized Ueno Bank, which managed about 850 million dollars in public funds.

On 13 Nov 2026, [The Rio Times](https://www.riotimesonline.com/paraguay-adds-prosecutors-ueno-bank-pena-investigations/) reported that Paraguay's attorney general Emiliano Rolón added two prosecutors to the Ueno Bank and Santiago Peña investigations.

On 12 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/fiscalia-de-paraguay-allana-la-residencia-presidencial-por-escandalo-de-ueno-bank-33098347) reported that the Paraguayan justice system is carrying out two parallel investigations, one focused on Ueno Bank executives, 10 of whom are detained.

On 12 Nov 2026, [El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/internacional/paraguay-detienen-al-superintendente-de-bancos-por-caso-ueno-bank) reported that Paraguay's Superintendent of Banks was detained in connection with the Ueno Bank case following reports by prosecutors regarding operations without guarantees.

On 12 Nov 2026, [MercoPress](https://en.mercopress.com/2026/11/12/paraguay-s-banking-superintendent-arrested-in-the-ueno-bank-investigation?utm_source=feed&utm_medium=rss&utm_content=main&utm_campaign=rss), [Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/mundo/caso-ueno-bank-detuvieron-superintendente-bancos-paraguay_0_haEsfgaxKm.html) reported that Paraguay's Superintendent of Banks, Holger Insfrán, was arrested as part of the investigation into Ueno Bank.

On 11 Nov 2026, [El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/economia/ahorristas-bolivianos-ueno-bank-pueden-perder-12-dinero-tipo-cambio_1794364395) reported that Sergio León, director of the Bolivian-Paraguayan Chamber of Commerce, stated that Bolivian depositors in Ueno Bank can lose between up to 12% of their money due to the exchange rate.

On 11 Nov 2026, [El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/mundo/seguridad-social-paraguay-denuncia-ueno-bank-516-millones-dolares_1794351537) reported that Paraguay's social security denounced Ueno Bank for more than 516 million dollars, with President Pedro Alliana confirming the return of funds to public sector contributors.
