reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/bbc/suerte-le-termino-migrante-fue-detenido-ice-ee-uu-dias-despues-ganar-loteria_1795714392) reported that a Salvadoran man who won a lottery was detained by ICE agents in the United States.

On 26 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/eeuu-y-canada/gano-un-millon-de-dolares-en-la-loteria-de-estados-unidos-y-fue-detenido-por-el-ice-parece-que-se-le-acabo-la-suerte-3604488) reported that an individual who won a million dollars in a United States lottery was detained by ICE to be deported.

On 20 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/eeuu-y-canada/periodista-colombiana-estefany-rodriguez-quien-estuvo-16-dias-detenida-por-ice-en-estados-unidos-recibio-premio-internacional-del-cpj-en-nueva-york-3602665) reported that Colombian journalist Estefany Rodríguez received an international CPJ award in New York after being detained for 16 days by ICE.

On 20 Nov 2026, [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/estados-unidos/washington/kirsten-davies-llega-a-la-direccion-nacional-de-ciberseguridad-tras-una-serie-de-fallas-en-eeuu-nid20112026/) reported that Kirsten Davies will replace Sean Cairncross as national cybersecurity director following failures affecting services in the United States.

On 20 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/eeuu-y-canada/jefe-de-ciberseguridad-de-la-casa-blanca-dejara-su-cargo-en-medio-de-fallas-tecnologicas-que-afectaron-a-empresas-y-agencias-de-estados-unidos-3602610) reported that Kirsten Davies will assume the national cybersecurity directorship following her appointment by Secretary of State Marco Rubio.

On 19 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/casa-blanca-despide-al-jefe-de-ciberseguridad-tras-una-serie-de-fallos-tecnologicos-33221131) reported that Secretary of State Marco Rubio announced the appointment of Kirsten Davies.

On 20 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/reportan-despido-del-jefe-de-ciberseguridad-de-la-casa-blanca-tras-serie-de-fallas-tecnologicas-kirsten-davies-asume-sus-funciones/) reported that the removal of Sean Cairncross follows disruptions affecting air traffic, automated teller machines, emails, and alert services.

On 19 Nov 2026, [El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/avion-hercules-c130-colombia-estados-unidos-fuerza-aerea-donacion-fac-1019-BH43770166) reported that U.S. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth delivered a C-130 Hercules aircraft to Colombia, restoring its fleet to six such planes.

On 18 Nov 2026, [El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/captura-trillizos-colombianos-ee-uu-ice-advierte-tener-solicitud-pendiente-no-da-estatus-legal-FD43738904) reported that U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement issued a warning after detaining 19-year-old Colombian triplets, stating that a pending application grants no legal status.

On 18 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/eeuu-y-canada/esta-es-la-enfermedad-que-padece-la-mama-de-los-trillizos-colombianos-detenidos-por-ice-en-ee-uu-fue-sometida-a-una-cirugia-y-esta-en-recuperacion-3602082) reported that family testimony indicated the 19-year-old individuals arrived in the United States to provide financial support for their recovering mother.

On 18 Nov 2026, [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/el-mundo/que-hay-detras-de-la-inquietante-ola-de-fallas-tecnologicas-en-estados-unidos-nid18112026/) reported that a succession of technology disruptions in airlines, banks, and intelligence networks exposed digital vulnerabilities in the United States.

On 18 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/eeuu-y-canada/marco-rubio-hablo-sobre-las-fallas-tecnologicas-en-estados-unidos-y-descarto-interferencia-extranjera-no-estamos-bajo-un-ataque-cibernetico-3601898) reported that U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio stated that technology outages affecting Microsoft, Chase, airlines, and the NSA were unrelated and not caused by a foreign cyberattack.

On 18 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/eeuu-y-canada/la-caida-de-la-red-secreta-de-la-nsa-se-suma-a-una-ola-de-fallas-tecnologicas-en-estados-unidos-coincidencia-o-amenaza-cibernetica-3601808) reported that disruptions in bank and technology platform services coincided with cyberattacks affecting approximately 200 websites.

On 16 Nov 2026, [The Washington Times](https://www.washingtontimes.com/news/2026/nov/16/united-airlines-hit-sudden-system-outage/) reported that United Airlines suffered a widespread system outage that left planes unable to take off.
On 16 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/emergencies/2219263) reported that a major outage hit United Airlines affecting a system related to flight departures.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/svet/drama-na-americkim-aerodromima-pao-sistem-united-airlinesa/npgmhe1) reported that United Airlines confirmed a system failure occurred on Monday afternoon.

On 16 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/finanzas/jpmorgan-chase-atribuye-los-fallos-a-un-error-de-software-y-descarta-un-ciberataque-33166828) reported that JPMorgan Chase attributed banking service outages affecting thousands of customers to a software error and ruled out a cyberattack.

On 16 Nov 2026, [La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/economia/united-airlines-reporta-interrupcion-generalizada-sus-sistemas_202611176afb8b9903bbf30bb04e2f1a.html) reported that United Airlines experienced a widespread system disruption in the United States attributed to instability in communications and radar systems.

On 17 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/united-airlines-restablece-sistema-tras-falla-tecnologica-interrupcion-provoco-retrasos-en-vuelos/) reported that on November 13 the FAA ordered flights to remain on the ground because a new router failed and saturated the system.

On 16 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/16/united-airlines-system-outage) reported that United Airlines acknowledged a technology issue that delayed flight departures.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/united-airlines-hit-by-widespread-system-outage-days-after-faa-ground-stop-disrupted-us-air-travel-101794867751137.html) reported that the carrier clarified the issue was not affecting flights already in the air or services operated by United Express.

On 16 Nov 2026, [NZ Herald](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/world/united-airlines-reports-widespread-outage-just-days-after-nationwide-ground-stop/CHU2RQYJERCJNHQAEB4INTZEGY/) reported that old network equipment was overloaded, disrupting 17 of 22 major control centres.

On 16 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/united-airlines-resolves-tech-outage-that-delayed-flights/a-79964387?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that United Airlines said a system outage that delayed departures has been resolved.

On 17 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/economy/2219271), a Russian state-owned outlet, reported that there was no indication that the United Airlines electronic system outage was a cybersecurity-related issue.

On 17 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/business-and-innovation/article-915107) reported that there was no indication that United's outage was connected to the Federal Aviation Administration shutdown.

On 16 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/mundo/noticia/2026/11/16/united-airlines-relata-falha-generalizada-dias-depois-da-suspensao-de-voos-nos-eua.ghtml) reported that United Airlines reported a widespread system outage days after nationwide flight cancellations due to technical problems.

On 16 Nov 2026, [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/estados-unidos/estados-unidos-recupera-la-normalidad-aerea-tras-miles-de-cancelaciones-y-una-falla-en-el-sistema-de-nid16112026/) reported that more than 18,000 flights were canceled and 28,000 suffered delays over three days due to an FAA router issue before normal operations resumed.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/mundo/estados-unidos-united-airlines-reporta-falla-generalizada-sistemas_0_H77eHnDPQG.html) reported that United Airlines reported a generalized failure in its systems days after the national flight suspension.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/estados-unidos/sitios-de-bancos-en-eeuu-presentan-fallos-pero-no-hay-ciberataque-segun-jpmorgan-chase_0_gtsuRx0yIe.html) reported that JPMorgan Chase stated there was no ciberattack despite users reporting banking app failures.

On 16 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/cartera/bancos-de-eu-reportan-fallas-en-sus-plataformas-digitales-usuarios-denuncian-problemas-de-acceso/) reported that Zelle also registered interruptions in its transfer services alongside bank platform issues.

On 16 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/eeuu-y-canada/se-desploman-las-acciones-de-grandes-bancos-en-wall-street-tras-fallas-en-sus-plataformas-digitales-en-estados-unidos-3601471) reported that shares of JPMorgan Chase, Bank of America, Wells Fargo, and Capital One registered losses on Wall Street following digital platform failures.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/chase-bank-of-america-us-bank-and-wells-fargo-among-banks-down-today-users-report-mobile-banking-outages-101794855031957.html), [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/eeuu-y-canada/caida-de-bancos-en-estados-unidos-chase-bank-of-america-y-wells-fargo-presentan-fallas-en-sus-servicios-digitales-3601448), [Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/estados-unidos/usuarios-denuncian-problemas-de-acceso-a-chase-bank-of-america-y-wells-fargo_0_giCFGzhtEk.html) reported that users of Chase, Bank of America, Wells Fargo, and US Bank experienced digital service outages and difficulties accessing online accounts.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/aeroportos-dos-eua-comecam-a-voltar-a-normalidade-apos-caos-aereo-mas-ainda-ha-atrasos.shtml) reported that the US aviation sector began returning to normality following three days of cancellations and delays caused by a system outage.

On 15 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/mundo/noticia/2026/11/15/voos-nos-eua-devem-ser-normalizados-ate-o-fim-de-domingo-promete-faa-passageiros-ainda-devem-enfrentar-transtornos.ghtml) reported that the FAA administrator promised US flights would be normalized by Sunday evening.

On 14 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/mundo/noticia/2026/11/14/caos-nos-eua-mais-de-12-mil-voos-foram-cancelados-entre-sexta-feira-e-sabado.ghtml) reported that official FlightAware data showed more than 12,000 flights were cancelled between Friday and Saturday in the United States.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/troca-de-cabos-causou-suspensao-que-cancelou-mais-de-16-mil-voos-nos-eua.shtml) reported that a cable swap caused a suspension that cancelled more than 16,000 flights in the United States.

On 14 Nov 2026, [O Dia](https://odia.ig.com.br/brasil/2026/11/7322457-anac-sete-voos-previstos-para-os-eua-foram-cancelados-e-14-atrasaram.html) reported that the head of the US Federal Aviation Administration forecasted between 4,000 and 5,000 flight cancellations on Saturday.

reports.text: On 23 Nov 2026, [La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/economia/gobierno-firma-dias-elecciones-otro-acuerdo-cataluna-que-politiza-mas-gestion-aeropuertos-aena_202611236afc4eb6a6f8072789ec34b6.html) reported that the government signed an agreement with Catalonia to give the Generalitat a role in the design of airport policies and investments.

On 20 Nov 2026, [El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/operaciones-militares-conjuntas-estados-unidos-permiso-congreso-colombia-EN43827407) reported that Colombian Foreign Minister Omar Bula stated that the Congress of the Republic is the sole entity authorized to approve joint military operations with other countries on Colombian soil.

On 20 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/secretario-de-defensa-de-eu-firma-acuerdo-sobre-ciberdefensa-con-el-gobierno-de-honduras-plantea-operaciones-militares-conjuntas/) reported that US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth signed a cyberdefense agreement with the government of Honduras and proposed joint military operations.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/19/on-the-same-page-hegseth-hails-us-ties-with-colombias-de-la-espriella?traffic_source=rss) reported that US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth praised security cooperation with Colombia as the country joins the Americas Counter Cartel Coalition.

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/latinoamerica/que-es-la-recesion-tecnica-en-la-que-entro-la-economia-de-argentina-expertos-explican-la-contraccion-que-complica-frente-de-gobierno-de-javier-milei-3604492) reported that Argentina's GDP registered two negative quarters, entering a technical recession.

On 25 Nov 2026, [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/sociedad/la-ciudad-sanciono-a-los-policias-responsables-de-remover-el-deck-en-caballito-y-reconoce-errores-en-nid25112026/) reported that Buenos Aires City sanctioned the police officers and officials responsible for removing a wooden deck in Caballito, removing them from their posts.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Buenos Aires Times](https://www.batimes.com.ar/news/argentina/key-milei-ally-bullrich-says-re-election-at-risk-unless-argentinas-economy-improves.phtml), [The Rio Times](https://www.riotimesonline.com/argentina-bullrich-surgical-economic-changes-milei/) reported that Senate bloc leader Patricia Bullrich warned that Argentina's re-election is at risk unless the economy improves.

On 25 Nov 2026, [La Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/2026/11/25/economia/019n2eco?partner=rss) reported that Argentina entered a technical recession after its monthly economic activity estimator fell 1.2 percent year-on-year in September.

On 25 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/latinoamerica/por-que-argentina-entro-en-recesion-tecnica-las-claves-de-la-contraccion-economica-que-complica-el-plan-de-javier-milei-para-reelegirse-3604234) reported that Argentina's economy contracted 1.8 percent in the third quarter.

On 25 Nov 2026, [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/politica/las-reacciones-del-arco-politico-al-enfrentamiento-entre-la-policia-y-vecinos-de-caballito-tras-el-nid25112026/) reported that political figures from Peronism, the left, and the Civic Coalition criticized security forces via social media following clashes between police and neighbors in Caballito over the removal of a merchant's deck.

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/sudanese-army-says-air-defenses-downed-fh-95-drone-in-south-kordofan-3726006) reported that the Sudanese army stated its air defenses shot down an enemy FH-95 drone west of Kadugli in South Kordofan state.

On 25 Nov 2026, [The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/mena/2026/11/25/sudan-war-grinds-on-with-rsf-seeking-to-stretch-safs-resources-thin/) reported that the Sudan conflict continues as the RSF seeks to stretch the SAF's resources thin.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiuAFBVV95cUxQUFl6aC1QT2ozUEthZ0V6aGJXcnRHek1YYWt4OXZCU2otdGxqanpDTHdtY090MUNYVEV6NFlXdHowV0tDSUpWWlpaaE1EWWFCRlgxNDMtRWRKUW1WemlJZ2ozWExFR2p2ZzhZeWRuQllURFdHekpZNkpKVWh5bnpwSVN2U3piTTFnYms1OEpjVVdGeHpZaTMzU2E4VC1XaXJQZ3QxMmJrYnFuamRUNUl0WGtPSk85ZV82?oc=5) reported that drone strikes killed 19 civilians in southeastern Sudan, according to a rights group.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261125-rsf-defector-says-israelis-training-hemedtis-forces-in-darfur/) reported that a former commander who defected from Sudan's Rapid Support Forces revealed that Israeli experts are currently training Hemedti's forces in Darfur.

On 24 Nov 2026, [The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/sudan-rsf-commander-defects-says-israelis-training-militia) reported that a senior Sudanese RSF commander defected to the army and alleged that Israeli experts are training militia officers in Darfur.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/new-group-defects-from-rsf-and-joins-sudanese-army-in-khartoum-3725942), a Turkish state outlet, reported that a group that defected from the Rapid Support Forces arrived at Khartoum airport and joined the Sudanese army due to atrocities against civilians.

On 24 Nov 2026, [TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/82011abbd620), a Turkish state outlet, reported that Major General Ammar Mohammed Zein Rabih cited massacres, killings, and looting of civilians in Khartoum, Darfur, and Gezira as reasons for breaking away from the RSF to join the Sudanese army.

On 23 Nov 2026, [AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611230154.html) reported from Geneva that the UN stated armed drones have become a defining feature of the conflict in Sudan, expanding impacts beyond active frontlines.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/sudanese-aid-group-accuses-rsf-of-looting-shops-and-livestock-in-west-kordofan-3725887) reported that a Sudanese aid group accused the Rapid Support Forces of looting shops and livestock during a two-day attack on the village of Abu Qalb.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/22/civilians-killed-in-rsf-drone-strikes-in-sudan?traffic_source=rss) reported that several civilians were killed and buildings damaged in drone strikes by Sudan’s Rapid Support Forces.

On 20 Nov 2026, [AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611200102.html) reported that Amnesty International called for an investigation into possible war crimes after documenting nine Rapid Support Forces drone strikes on civilians in North Kordofan.

On 20 Nov 2026, [AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611200101.html) reported that Sudanese women's rights group The No to Oppression against Women Initiative condemned the continuation of the war and drone strikes.

On 17 Nov 2026, [CGTN](https://newsaf.cgtn.com/news/2026-11-17/Drones-account-for-nearly-three-quarters-of-Sudan-war-deaths-this-year-1S9peiQ9zy0/p.html?UTM_Source=cgtn&UTM_Medium=rss&UTM_Campaign=World) reported that the UN human rights office verified over 2,230 civilian deaths in Sudan's war between January and October 2026, with drone strikes accounting for nearly three-quarters.

On 18 Nov 2026, [RT](https://rt-english.com/africa/648986-drone-strikes-cause-nearly-three-quarters-verified-sudan-civilian-deaths/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS), a Russian state outlet, reported that the UN stated drone strikes caused nearly three-quarters of verified civilian deaths in Sudan, killing over 1,630 civilians between January and October.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivAFBVV95cUxNUzVVZlh0cUIxWFBYU2NGYnZWdHZmc1RLY3oyNm51NTlQQjJEMFlVclNsN2tWM0FjMmRycVdsMXQ2WW4xeUJZYVR1V3lac2ZBTmJ4RWcxYXVxaFlGV1dNbXM3OG5FOXhheVdiM0dzUVktZnJZZkQxNUU4ZWZuM0lWV2JyZXVKUXZtcDl2RHVaTVRtRGN1ZFdPckdPQ0dZSFI1SDVfVGlPbWhYa0o0alNCNFdsSDgtUkhxakRWZw?oc=5) reported that the UN stated drones account for nearly three-quarters of Sudan war deaths this year.

On 17 Nov 2026, [The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/drones-behind-nearly-75-civilian-deaths-year-sudan) reported that the war between the Sudanese Armed Forces and the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces erupted in April 2023 and is estimated to have killed more than 200,000.

On 17 Nov 2026, [AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611170440.html), [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261117-over-2230-civilians-killed-in-sudan-in-10-months-most-by-drone-strikes-un-rights-office/) reported that a UN Human Rights Office report stated over 2,230 civilians were killed in Sudan between January and October 2026, with over 1,630 killed in drone strikes.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/16/sudanese-army-air-attack-kills-13-in-western-sudan-rights-group?traffic_source=rss) reported that a Sudanese army air attack killed 13 people in West Kordofan according to the Emergency Lawyers rights group.

On 16 Nov 2026, [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/sudan-army-strike-kills-15-including-children-says-rights-group-survivor/article71707212.ece) reported that a rights monitor stated a double-tap strike on November 15 in the village of Abu Qalb killed 15 people and burned homes.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimwFBVV95cUxObWZuRk5ZOHl1UjItOGw2MXZmMWt4ekZJYWtVXzgzaHpFUlVzbmdMQ01LdDZ1S1VvUTdCSmpLRzNjT1NVRnA3c3FSNTZMZG1xaDlpQWQ1M05DLUZCZExaeUJ0ZFJ2M2NSMElJUGFHMHlOMHJ3bDF1d09PS0RiZGFVMmNKM2dLRDVCSVFrMkNVWm03bnQ3TlpGSlV1QQ?oc=5) reported that a rights group stated an army airstrike killed at least 13 people in West Kordofan.
On 16 Nov 2026, [The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/rsf-commander-defects-army-makes-ground-kordofan) reported that RSF commander Al-Rasoul defected as the army made ground in Kordofan.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261116-sudanese-army-says-it-seized-5-areas-from-rsf-in-west-kordofan/) reported that the Sudanese army said it seized five areas in West Kordofan, including Al-Saatat, and advanced toward the strategic town of Abu Zabad.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/sudanese-army-seizes-3-areas-in-west-kordofan-military-sources-say-3725583), [The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/sudanese-army-offensive-west-kordofan-captures-al-khuwai) reported that the Sudanese army seized areas in West Kordofan, capturing locations including Al-Khuwai as part of an offensive towards Darfur.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Sada El Balad](https://www.elbalad.news/7188394) reported that Jens Laerke, spokesperson for the UN Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs, stated that humanitarian convoy trips and distribution in the Gaza Strip face numerous procedures.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190549/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A8%D8%B7%D8%A9-%D9%8A%D8%AD%D8%B0%D8%B1-%D9%85%D9%86-%D9%83%D8%A7%D8%B1%D8%AB%D8%A9-%D8%A5%D9%86%D8%B3%D8%A7%D9%86%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%BA%D8%B2%D8%A9-%D9%88%D9%8A%D8%AF%D8%B9%D9%88-%D9%84%D9%81%D8%AA%D8%AD-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%B9%D8%A7%D8%A8%D8%B1) reported that the Gaza Strip Union of Municipalities, the Engineers Syndicate, and the Ministry of Public Works and Housing called for opening crossings, breaking the siege, and allowing humanitarian aid.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/203178/4-%D8%AF%D9%88%D9%84-%D8%AA%D8%AF%D8%B9%D9%88-%D8%A5%D8%B3%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%A6%D9%8A%D9%84-%D9%84%D9%84%D8%B3%D9%85%D8%A7%D8%AD-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%81%D9%88%D8%B1%D9%8A-%D8%A8%D8%AF%D8%AE%D9%88%D9%84-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%B3%D8%A7%D8%B9%D8%AF%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%A5%D9%84%D9%89-%D8%BA%D8%B2%D8%A9/) reported that Canada, Britain, Italy, and Australia called on Israel to immediately and without hindrance allow humanitarian aid into Gaza.

stories.label: MQM-P call for smaller provinces in Pakistan

reports.text: On 25 Nov 2026, [Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/mqm-p-plans-rally-on-shahrah-e-faisal-public-gathering-at-bagh-e-jinnah-on-nov-29/) reported that Muttahida Qaumi Movement-Pakistan decided to organise a rally along Shahrah-e-Faisal and a public gathering at Bagh-e-Jinnah.

On 23 Nov 2026, [The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2641897/ppp-asks-mqm-p-to-reconsider-karachi-rally-dates-at-first-meeting-amid-tensions-over-new-provinces), [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2046542/mqm-p-to-deliberate-on-ppps-request-to-postpone-nov-29-karachi-rally-says-farooq-sattar) reported that the Pakistan Peoples Party asked MQM-P to reconsider the date of its Karachi rally during a meeting addressing tensions over new provinces.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1585276/mustafa-kamal-says-december-key-to-new-provinces-movement/) reported that Federal Minister Mustafa Kamal declared December a crucial month for advancing the demand for new provinces in Pakistan.

On 20 Nov 2026, [The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2641457/pti-backs-referendum-on-new-provinces) reported that PTI backed a referendum on new provinces while awaiting an amendment draft.

On 20 Nov 2026, [The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2641368/pti-backs-referendum-to-determine-public-opinion-on-creation-of-new-provinces) reported that PTI Chief Whip Aamir Dogar stated that decisions on new provinces must reflect the public will and follow constitutional procedures.

On 20 Nov 2026, [The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2641377/mustafa-kamal-links-mqm-ps-demand-for-new-provinces-to-failure-of-local-governments) reported that Mustafa Kamal linked MQM-P's demand for new provinces to the failure of local governments.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1584344/atta-tarar-supports-public-vote-on-new-provinces/) reported that Federal Information Minister Atta Tarar stated new provinces should emerge if supported by a public vote and that people should decide their future.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2045670/mqm-ps-khalid-maqbool-urges-courts-to-take-notice-of-bilawals-bloodshed-remark) reported that MQM-P chief Dr Khalid Maqbool Siddiqui urged courts to take notice of Bilawal Bhutto-Zardari's bloodshed remark.

On 19 Nov 2026, [The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2641183/mqm-renews-demand-for-new-provinces-says-administrative-units-cannot-be-treated-as-personal-estates) reported that MQM-P postponed its November 29 rally for new provinces while reiterating demands for administrative division and criticizing the PPP.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/mqm-p-accuses-bilawal-of-threatening-pakistan-seeks-action-over-bloodshed-remarks/), [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1583816/mqm-p-demands-action-over-bilawals-bloodshed-remarks-amid-debate-on-new-provinces/) reported that MQM-P leader Khalid Maqbool Siddiqui accused PPP Chairman Bilawal Bhutto-Zardari of threatening Pakistan and demanded action over bloodshed remarks.

stories.title: Moldova Closes Airspace After Russian Geran-2 Drone Enters Country Twice
stories.label: Moldova airspace closure following drone incursion

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/91636196) reported that Moldova's energy minister stated the new Vulcanesti–Chisinau power line prevented a nationwide blackout following Russian attacks on Ukraine's energy infrastructure.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/91186) reported that the British Royal Air Force is moving aircraft into hangars and hardened shelters overnight amid fears of Russian drone attacks.
On 21 Nov 2026, [Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/89862223) reported that a jet-propelled drone repeatedly crossed the state border amid Russian attacks on Ukraine.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4186943-moldova-reports-second-drone-incursion-into-its-airspace-in-one-day.html) reported that an unauthorized drone flight into Moldova's airspace was recorded twice on November 20.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/89369445) reported that the Moldovan Ministry stated an unauthorized drone crossed Moldovan airspace for nine minutes overnight after entering from Ukraine's Vinnytsia region and exiting toward Chernivtsi.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/88294566) reported that the General Police Inspection identified a drone that crashed in a forest strip near the village of Baxani in Soroca district as a Gerbera-2 model.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/88188175) reported that an aircraft detected near Cuhurestii de Sus in northern Floresti district was identified as a Gerbera-2 model that exploded upon impact.
On 17 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90394) reported that a Russian drone was spotted over the Moldovan capital of Chisinau.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/17/8063339/), [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185796-seven-drones-enter-moldovan-airspace.html) reported that seven drones entered Moldovan airspace on November 17, with some crashing near settlements.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/17/moldova-closes-airspace-after-shahed-type-drone-detected-heading-towards-chisinau), [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/7-drones-cross-into-moldovan-airspace-during-latest-russian-attack-against-ukraine-1-spotted-over-chisinau/) reported that Moldovan authorities and President Maia Sandu stated that several Russian drones violated Moldovan airspace.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/87515748) reported that three flights from Yerevan, Istanbul, and Sharm El-Sheikh were unable to land in Chisinau due to the airspace closure.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/17/8063332/) reported that Moldova closed six border crossing points with Ukraine in Ocnița, Otaci, Unguri, Briceni, Grimăncăuți, and Clocușna.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/21/ballistic-missile-attack-on-zelenskyys-hometown-kills-two-people) reported that a ballistic missile strike targeted civilian infrastructure in Zelenskyy's hometown and killed two people.

stories.title: Alta banka insured deposits payout in Serbia

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/hronika/oglasio-se-mup-o-hapsenju-brata-vlasnika-alta-banke/zl9yp1z) reported that the Ministry of Internal Affairs arrested Dubravko Macura for allegedly taking money from the treasury vault and giving it to the Alta bank owner.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/ex-yu/Nova-hapsenja-u-slucaju-Alta-banke-MUP-otkrio-kako-je-navodno-izvlacen-novac/994442) reported that three more people were arrested in connection with abuses at Alta bank.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/biznis/vesti/isplata-depozita-alta-banke-postanska-stedionica-isplatila-185-miliona-evra/ew3067m) reported that Banka Postanska stedionica paid out about 185 million euros, which is more than half of the total insured funds of Alta banka in bankruptcy.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/biznis/postanska-stedionica-prodala-deo-drzavnih-obveznica-i-povecala-dinarsku-likvidnost/5pqkgbh) reported that Banka Poštanska štedionica confirmed the acceptance of its bid to sell part of the government bonds of the Republic of Serbia at an early repurchase auction.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/biznis/vesti/dva-fonda-intesa-invest-izlozena-u-alta-banci-direktor-otkrio-sta-su-ga-prvo-pitali/14wn1n1) reported that Intesa Invest funds had a cumulative exposure of less than 1 percent toward Alta banka according to executive director Srdjan Maletic.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/biznis/vesti/isplata-depozita-alta-banke-slobodno-jos-14200-termina/5p87ptf) reported that over 25,000 depositors of bankrupt Alta banka scheduled an appointment through the Banka Poštanska štedionica portal to collect insured deposits.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/biznis/vesti/banka-postanska-stedionica-raspoloziva-gotovina-na-9872-odsto-bankomata/jb7rzys) reported that Banka Poštanska štedionica announced available cash was confirmed on 98.72 percent of ATMs.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/biznis/postanska-stedionica-isplatila-vise-od-sedam-odsto-osiguranih-depozita-klijentima/6rqnc0h) reported that Banka Poštanska štedionica continued the payout of insured deposits to Alta banka clients using funds provided by the Deposit Insurance Agency.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/biznis/vesti/rusi-cekaju-isplatu-novca-iz-alta-banke-kupili-smo-stanove-a-novac-stoji-na-racunu/5gz25z4) reported that the beginning of insured deposit payouts to bankrupt Alta banka clients brought relief to many savers while creating uncertainty for those with funds on accounts tied to apartments.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/biznis/vesti/postanska-stedionica-isplatila-sve-zakazane-klijente-alta-banke-prvog-dana-nastavak-i/6q0l3ml) reported that Banka Poštanska štedionica announced it paid out all scheduled clients of Alta banka on the first day of insured deposit payouts despite a system failure.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/biznis/banka-postanska-stedionica-produzen-rad-zbog-isplate-depozita-alta-banke-termin/4mt6466) reported that Banka Poštanska štedionica extended working hours for branches handling insured deposit payouts to Alta banka clients, with 16,450 clients having scheduled appointments.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/biznis/finansije/pocela-isplata-osiguranih-depozita-klijentima-alta-banke-u-srbiji/261113085) reported that Banka Poštanska štedionica began paying out insured deposits to clients of Alta banka in Serbia after its operating license was revoked.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/region/pocela-isplata-osiguranih-depozita-u-alta-banci-prijavilo-se-14-419-klijenata/) reported that 14,419 clients applied for payouts up to 50,000 euros per depositor.

stories.title: Russia Accused Of Plotting To Kill Same Ukrainian American Rapper Twice In 2 Months
stories.label: Reported Russian false flag operation near Poland

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/91334) reported that the Security Service of Ukraine and the National Police detained a 23-year-old man from the Vinnytsia region on suspicion of killing a Kharkiv army major.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4188906-russia-may-stage-new-provocations-against-poland-during-christmas-holidays-general-kraszewski.html) reported that General Kraszewski stated Russia may step up provocations against Poland ahead of Christmas and New Year holidays.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/sbu-detains-russias-gru-agent-accused-of-plotting-to-kill-ukrainian-special-forces-commander/) reported that the SBU detained a Russian military intelligence agent accused of planting an explosive device in a car parked near a target.

On 23 Nov 2026, [HuffPost World](https://www.huffpost.com/entry/russia-rapper-plot-alleged_n_6b042c7fe4b0da866ee1465f) reported that Denmark expelled a Russian official after thwarting an alleged plot to assassinate a Ukrainian American citizen on Danish soil.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/23/poland-says-russia-tried-to-assassinate-ukrainian-rapper-twice?traffic_source=rss) reported that Poland confirmed Russia tried to assassinate a Ukrainian rapper twice after Copenhagen revealed an alleged plot.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/poland-says-russia-allegedly-tried-to-kill-ukrainian-american-rapper-before-denmark-plot-101795377771052.html) reported that Denmark expelled a Russian official after authorities uncovered an alleged Russian intelligence plot to kill Ukrainian-American rapper Albert Vasiliev.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiyAFBVV95cUxOS0J3SExfSVZDcXRXb2wtcElESFhiam1fWTR4MUh0VGIzQU9iQjRkamVnWXZMaFI2cVRyNmFxYU40dmJBdWFOZTRuZVlPcFAzXzVhanZPckVpVXdQRlE0YkE3bkhfZk1ld2o5SDhYcmg0bUMwTklpdV9Qc3Q2Sjloajd0NzdzX0JhYjZvY0NmM2hMRnhLUmd4VzZxLUlsTWZoMmRFNVVwTU5uZ1lSVlp6MlpleTVJd2FqT1Q2d1NyaHYxU0lNSG1aWg?oc=5), [The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/denmark-pushes-eu-tighten-travel-curbs-russians-after-foiled-plot) reported that Denmark urged EU members to take action and tighten travel curbs on Russians after stating it foiled an alleged Russian intelligence plan to assassinate a US-Ukrainian rapper.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90505) reported that Russian intelligence allegedly planned a sabotage operation in Poland in late October or early November that would have caused heavy casualties and be blamed on Ukraine.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/poland-russia-false-flag-ukraine-ww2-nazi-plot-b3087440.html) reported that security sources claimed Moscow planned a mass-casualty attack near the border to frame Ukraine.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/18/8063521/) reported that Poland's defence minister stated the security services acted against a suspected Russian false-flag scheme and proposed extending armed force deployment.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/18/russia-planned-false-flag-operation-with-mass-casualties-on-polish-territory-rzeczpospolita-reports), [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/the-goal-was-to-halt-aid-to-ukraine-russia-planned-high-casualty-false-flag-attack-near-kaliningrad-border-rzeczpospolita-reports/) reported that according to senior sources cited by Rzeczpospolita, Russian intelligence services planned a false-flag sabotage operation with high casualties on Polish territory intended to halt aid to Ukraine.

stories.title: China’s Persian Gulf oil imports hit highest level since start of Iran war
stories.label: IEA warning on Middle East energy security

reports.text: On 25 Nov 2026, [The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/uk/2026/11/25/uk-households-to-suffer-energy-bill-shock-caused-by-middle-east-crisis/), [Arab News](https://www.arabnews.com/world/british-household-energy-bills-to-jump-26-percent-on-iran-war-shock-3014004) reported that British household energy bills are expected to increase by 26 percent in January due to the Middle East conflict.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/china-india-set-for-record-russian-oil-imports-in-2026-but-middle-east-supply-recovery-may-curb-demand-in-2027-101795511420735.html) reported that traders and analysts expect shipments of Russian oil to China and India to wane in 2027 as Middle Eastern supplies recover.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Tehran Times](https://www.tehrantimes.com/news/532350/Iran-s-naval-dominance-extends-500km-beyond-Persian-Gulf-IRGC) reported that IRGC Commander stated Iran's naval dominance extends at least 500 kilometers beyond the Persian Gulf and the Strait of Hormuz.

On 20 Nov 2026, [OilPrice](https://oilprice.com/Latest-Energy-News/World-News/Chinas-Oil-Imports-from-Persian-Gulf-Jump-to-Wartime-High.html) reported that China's crude oil imports from the Persian Gulf surged by 42.4% in October from September to the highest level since the Iran war began.

On 20 Nov 2026, [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/economy/china-economy/article/3375213/chinas-persian-gulf-oil-imports-hit-high-start-iran-war-producers-cut-prices) reported that China's crude oil imports from the Persian Gulf surged to their highest monthly volume in October as producers offered competitive rates amid the Iran war.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Tehran Times](https://www.tehrantimes.com/news/532322/West-Asia-crisis-biggest-energy-security-threat-Persian-Gulf) reported that the IEA warned the West Asia crisis is the biggest energy security threat ever.

On 19 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/economy/2221985), a Russian state-owned outlet, reported that the global market has lost 2.8 billion barrels of oil due to the Middle East conflict according to the IEA.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/business/energy/strait-of-hormuz-crisis-largest-threat-to-energy-security-ever-iea) reported that the IEA stated the Middle East crisis centered around the Strait of Hormuz following the US-Iran war created the largest threat to energy security ever.

On 19 Nov 2026, [The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/business/energy/2026/11/19/iea-says-40bn-spent-on-pipelines-will-not-end-gulfs-hormuz-dependence/) reported that the IEA stated spending $40 billion on pipelines will not end the Gulf's Strait of Hormuz dependence.

On 19 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/middle-east/20261119-middle-east-crisis-energy-security-iea) reported that the International Energy Agency warned that the Middle East crisis triggered by US and Israeli strikes on Iran poses the largest threat to energy security in history.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/203400/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A8%D9%86%D8%AA%D8%A7%D8%AC%D9%88%D9%86-%D9%8A%D8%A8%D8%AD%D8%AB-%D9%85%D8%B9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%AA%D8%AD%D8%A7%D8%AF-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D9%88%D8%B1%D9%88%D8%A8%D9%8A-%D8%AE%D8%B7%D8%B7-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%86%D8%B3%D8%AD%D8%A7%D8%A8-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D9%85%D9%8A%D8%B1%D9%83%D9%8A/) reported that European Union defense ministers discussed U.S. troop withdrawal and repositioning plans in Europe with a U.S. Department of War official.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Al-Watan (Syria)](https://alwatan.sy/%d8%a7%d9%84%d8%a7%d8%aa%d8%ad%d8%a7%d8%af-%d8%a7%d9%84%d8%a3%d9%88%d8%b1%d9%88%d8%a8%d9%8a-%d8%a7%d8%b3%d8%aa%d9%82%d8%b1%d8%a7%d8%b1-%d8%b3%d9%88%d8%b1%d9%8a%d8%a7-%d9%85%d9%87%d9%85-%d9%84%d8%a3/) reported that European Union Mediterranean commissioner Dubravka Šuica emphasized the importance of Syria's stability for regional security.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Al-Watan (Syria)](https://alwatan.sy/%d9%83%d8%a7%d9%84%d8%a7%d8%b3-%d8%a7%d9%84%d8%a7%d8%aa%d8%ad%d8%a7%d8%af-%d8%a7%d9%84%d8%a3%d9%88%d8%b1%d9%88%d8%a8%d9%8a-%d9%8a%d9%88%d8%a7%d9%81%d9%82-%d8%b9%d9%84%d9%89-%d8%a7%d9%84%d9%85%d8%b6/) reported that EU foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas announced that foreign ministers of the 27 EU member states agreed to move forward with a partnership agreement with Syria.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Al-Watan (Syria)](https://alwatan.sy/%d9%82%d8%a7%d8%af%d9%8a%d8%b4-%d9%88%d8%a7%d9%84%d9%85%d8%b5%d8%b7%d9%81%d9%89-%d9%8a%d8%a8%d8%ad%d8%ab%d8%a7%d9%86-%d9%85%d8%b9-%d9%85%d8%b3%d8%a4%d9%88%d9%84-%d8%a3%d9%85%d9%85%d9%8a-%d9%88%d8%a7/) reported that Syrian Deputy Foreign Minister Qutaiba Qadish discussed international cooperation and refugee returns with a UN official and the Spanish ambassador.

stories.title: Nduka Obaigbena: Arise News owner breaks silence after police declare him wanted

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/nigeria/1743480-full-list-igp-suspends-wanted-declaration-arise-news-owner-8-others/) reported that IGP Tunji Disu announced the suspension of the wanted declaration of nine powerful Nigerians, including the owner of Arise News TV.

On 26 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/obaigbena-denies-being-declared-wanted-by-police-alleges-smear-campaign/) reported that media mogul Nduka Obaigbena denied reports that he has been declared wanted by the Nigeria Police Force following a petition allegedly filed by First Bank.

On 26 Nov 2026, [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/politica/el-gobierno-defiende-el-rumbo-economico-pese-a-los-numeros-oficiales-los-salarios-estan-por-arriba-nid26112026/) reported that Chief of Cabinet Diego Santilli stated the government has the numbers to suspend the PASO primaries.

On 22 Nov 2026, [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/politica/se-profundiza-la-interna-macrista-en-la-capital-de-andreis-desafia-a-jorge-macri-y-ritondo-respalda-nid22112026/) reported that the internal rift among macri supporters in the Capital deepened as De Andreis challenges Jorge Macri while Ritondo backs the head of government.

On 21 Nov 2026, [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/politica/el-gobierno-admite-que-tiene-los-votos-justos-para-aprobar-la-suspension-de-las-paso-en-el-senado-nid21112026/) reported that the Argentine government admitted it has 38 assured votes out of the 37 needed to approve the suspension of the PASO primaries in the Senate.

On 19 Nov 2026, [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/politica/la-libertad-avanza-presiona-para-suspender-las-paso-en-la-capital-y-tensiona-el-vinculo-con-jorge-nid19112026/) reported that La Libertad Avanza is pushing to suspend the PASO primaries in the Capital, creating tension with Jorge Macri's government.

stories.title: Chefe da PF explica saída de delegados do caso Master

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/blogs/malu-gaspar/post/2026/11/relatorio-da-pf-sobre-nunes-marques-e-vorcaro-inclui-desimpedimento-a-favor-do-master.ghtml) reported that the Federal Police report sent to the president regarding Daniel Vorcaro's relation with Supreme Federal Court Minister Kassio Nunes Marques included a disimpediment in favor of Master.

On 25 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/25/defesa-de-vorcaro-contesta-relatoria-de-nunes-marques-e-pede-que-acao-sobre-caso-master-seja-encaminhada-a-gilmar.ghtml) reported that former banker Daniel Vorcaro's defense contested the distribution of the Master case to Minister Nunes Marques and asked for it to be sent to Gilmar Mendes.

On 25 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/25/ministros-do-stf-pressionam-por-nova-distribuicao-de-pedido-de-vorcaro-sobre-relatoria-do-master-entregue-a-nunes-marques.ghtml) reported that Supreme Federal Court ministers are pressing for a new distribution of a request presented by former banker Daniel Vorcaro's defense team.

On 24 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/blogs/malu-gaspar/post/2026/11/master-relatorio-sobre-moraes-rejeitado-pela-pf-detalhava-mensagens-de-vorcaro-e-contrato.ghtml) reported that a Federal Police report detailed messages involving Daniel Vorcaro and a contract regarding Supreme Federal Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes.

On 23 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/23/pgr-analisa-relatorios-de-ministros-em-meio-a-tensao-entre-alas-do-stf-e-pressao-sobre-procuradores.ghtml) reported that the Prosecutor General's Office is set to begin analyzing Federal Police reports regarding citations of Supreme Federal Court ministers.

On 22 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/blogs/lauro-jardim/post/2026/11/delegados-afastados-querem-falar-da-polemica-dos-relatorios-sobre-ministros-do-stf.ghtml) reported that removed Federal Police delegates Daniel Cola and Wedson Cajé intend to speak about the controversy surrounding reports on Supreme Federal Court ministers.

On 21 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/blogs/malu-gaspar/post/2026/11/diretor-da-pf-pos-mendonca-entre-ministros-com-indicios-de-crime-mesmo-sem-achar-contato-dele-com-vorcaro.ghtml) reported that Federal Police Director-General Andrei Rodrigues ordered reports produced on all ten Supreme Federal Court ministers and divided them into two groups.

On 20 Nov 2026, [O Dia](https://odia.ig.com.br/brasil/2026/11/7324407-relatorio-da-pf-tem-dialogos-de-vorcaro-sobre-mendonca.html) reported that a Federal Police report contained dialogues involving Vorcaro regarding Mendonça and were forwarded to the Prosecutor General's Office.

On 20 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/20/inclusao-de-mendonca-em-relatorio-sobre-master-integra-estrategia-da-pf-de-questionar-volta-de-ministro-a-relatoria-avaliam-investigadores.ghtml) reported that allies of Minister André Mendonça in the Supreme Federal Court view his inclusion in the Federal Police report regarding the Master case as an attempt to wear him down.

On 20 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/post/2026/11/caso-master-galipolo-relata-a-pf-suspeitas-de-vazamentos-no-bc-e-ata-fora-do-padrao-feita-por-servidor.ghtml) reported that Central Bank President Gabriel Galípolo related suspicions of leaks at the BC and an unusual meeting minutes document prepared by a civil servant to the Federal Police.

On 20 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/blogs/malu-gaspar/post/2026/11/relatorios-sobre-ministros-do-stf-rejeitados-por-andrei-nao-foram-enviados-a-fachin.ghtml) reported that Federal Police reports regarding ministers Alexandre de Moraes, Kassio Nunes Marques, and Dias Toffoli, which were rejected by Director-General Andrei Rodrigues, were not sent to Fachin.

On 20 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/20/caso-master-fachin-abre-sigilo-de-relatorio-da-pf-sobre-mencoes-a-mendonca-a-pedido-do-ministro.ghtml) reported that Supreme Federal Court President Edson Fachin made public a Federal Police report regarding mentions of Minister André Mendonça in the Master case at the minister's request.

On 20 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/20/fachin-deu-nova-orientacao-a-pf-para-avaliar-relevancia-de-citacoes-a-ministros-do-stf-no-caso-master-diz-documento.ghtml) reported that STF President Edson Fachin gave new guidance to the Federal Police to evaluate the relevance of information regarding Supreme Federal Court ministers in the Master case.

On 20 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/20/relatorio-da-pf-sobre-mendonca-reune-mensagens-de-terceiros-sobre-terno-jantar-e-reuniao-com-vorcaro-e-nao-aponta-beneficio-a-ministro.ghtml) reported that a Federal Police report on Minister André Mendonça gathered third-party messages about clothing, a dinner, and a meeting with Vorcaro, without pointing to any benefit for the minister.

On 19 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/19/caso-master-fachin-determina-que-concierge-de-vorcaro-apresenta-despesas-de-banqueiro.ghtml) reported that Supreme Federal Court President Edson Fachin accepted a request from the Federal Police and ordered a concierge company contracted by former banker D. Vorcaro to present the banker's expenses.

On 19 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/19/investigacao-novas-diligencias-ou-arquivamento-o-que-a-pgr-pode-fazer-com-os-relatorios-da-pf-sobre-ministros-do-stf.ghtml) reported that the Prosecutor-General's Office will have to individually analyze reports produced by the Federal Police concerning the Master case.

On 18 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/18/andrei-stf-fachin-relatorios-da-pf-sobre-mencoes-a-ministros-do-stf-no-caso-master.ghtml) reported that Federal Police Director-General Andrei Rodrigues delivered investigation reports mentioning Supreme Federal Court ministers in the Master case to STF President Edson Fachin, who then forwarded them to the PGR.

On 18 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/18/pf-investiga-vazamento-de-informacoes-sobre-relatorio-com-mencoes-a-ministros-do-stf-no-caso-master.ghtml) reported that Federal Police Director-General Andrei Rodrigues stated in a Senate hearing that an investigation is underway into information leaks concerning a report mentioning Supreme Federal Court ministers in the Master case.

reports.text: On 25 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/26/8064707/) reported that the number of injured in Russian attacks on Zaporizhzhia rose to 11, including two children, with energy infrastructure also damaged.

On 26 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/26/8064717/) reported that two people are in serious condition among seven total injured in a Russian ballistic missile attack on Kyiv.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/25/ecuador-and-us-review-joint-military-operations-official-says?traffic_source=rss) reported that joint military efforts between Ecuador and the US have been paused while the US investigates a lethal operation carried out by Ecuador.

On 25 Nov 2026, [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/24/world/americas/ecuador-us-military-operations-trump.html) reported that the Trump administration has halted military operations while it investigates an operation by Ecuadorean forces that killed an accused gang leader.
On 24 Nov 2026, [Hasht-e Subh](https://8am.media/eng/russian-attack-in-ukraine-leaves-two-dead-and-40-injured/) reported that a Russian attack on Zaporizhzhia killed two people and injured 40 others.

On 24 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/emergencies/2223753) reported that municipal head Ruslan Khomenko stated that Ukrainian drone and artillery attacks in the Kherson Region left two civilians dead and seven injured, with 464 artillery and mortar strikes and 440 drone attacks recorded on Alyoshki.

On 22 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2223101), a state-media outlet, reported that Kremlin spokesperson Dmitry Peskov stated Vladimir Putin and Donald Trump did not discuss the appointment of a Russian ambassador to the U.S. and that the conversation was more conceptual.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-society/4187214-zelensky-names-settlements-where-ukraine-proposes-to-conduct-humanitarian-missions.html) reported that President Volodymyr Zelensky named settlements in the Kherson and Zaporizhzhia regions where Ukraine proposes conducting humanitarian missions.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/21/8063949/) reported that President Volodymyr Zelenskyy named 15 settlements in Russian-occupied Kherson and Zaporizhzhia oblasts where Ukraine proposes humanitarian evacuations similar to the Oleshky operation.

On 19 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/humanitarian-mission-for-kostiantynivka-is-it-a-trap/a-79996772?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that Russian President Vladimir Putin proposed an evacuation of the Ukrainian city of Kostiantynivka.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/19/8063649/) reported that Kremlin spokesperson Dmitry Peskov stated that Donald Trump and Vladimir Putin did not discuss a proposed five-day ceasefire in Kostiantynivka.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4186206-russian-assault-troops-in-kherson-regions-island-zone-readily-surrender-press-officer.html) reported that Russian servicemen sent to storm the islands in the Dnipro River delta near Kherson readily surrender to Ukrainian forces.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185902-ukrainian-military-ready-to-conduct-further-civilian-evacuations-from-occupied-kherson-region-press-officer.html) reported that Ukrainian military personnel are prepared to carry out further civilian evacuations from temporarily occupied areas of the Kherson region.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/ukraine-russia-negotiating-another-oleshky-style-humanitarian-mission-lubinets-says/) reported that Ukrainian human rights ombudsman Dmytro Lubinets stated that Ukraine and Russia are negotiating another humanitarian mission.

On 13 Nov 2026, [The Moscow Times](https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/11/13/kremlin-says-ready-for-civilian-evacuation-from-ukraines-kostiantynivka-a94257) reported that the Kremlin stated it is ready for civilian evacuation from Ukraine's Kostiantynivka.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/13/8062720/) reported that Ukraine's Human Rights Commissioner Dmytro Lubinets stated that Kostiantynivka was not raised in talks on humanitarian missions.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/13/8062686/) reported that Human Rights Commissioner Dmytro Lubinets shared updates on 105 animals evacuated from occupied Oleshky.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/12/putin-proposes-joint-humanitarian-operation-with-ukraine-in-kostiantynivka-modeled-on-earlier-evacuation-mission-in-oleshky) reported that Russian President Vladimir Putin proposed organizing a humanitarian operation in Kostiantynivka, modeled on an earlier evacuation mission in Oleshky.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-society/4184013-humanitarian-mission-needed-in-occupied-hola-prystan-community-similar-to-oleshky-operation-local-official.html) reported that local officials stated a similar humanitarian mission is urgently needed in the occupied Hola Prystan community.

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [Dnevnik (Bulgaria)](https://www.dnevnik.bg/bulgaria/2026/11/26/4984960_sudut_vuv_varna_vurna_kmeta_blagomir_kocev_na_posta_do/?ref=rss) reported that the Administrative Court in Varna halted the preliminary execution of the decision to prematurely terminate the powers of mayor Blagomir Kotsev.

On 25 Nov 2026, [24 Chasa](https://www.24chasa.bg/bulgaria/article/23997676), [Dnevnik (Bulgaria)](https://www.dnevnik.bg/bulgaria/2026/11/25/4984635_s_kostjumi_a_ne_s_dunki_nad_1000_varnenci_protestiraha/?ref=rss) reported that hundreds of residents gathered outside the Varna municipal building in support of removed mayor Blagomir Kotsev after the Municipal Election Commission decided to terminate his term early.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Dnevnik (Bulgaria)](https://www.dnevnik.bg/bulgaria/2026/11/25/4984588_varnenski_praseta_dolu_rucete_ot_kmeta_protest_v/?ref=rss) reported that citizens and politicians gathered in Sofia to support Blagomir Kotsev and blocked traffic on Georgi Rakovski Street.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Dnevnik (Bulgaria)](https://www.dnevnik.bg/bulgaria/2026/11/25/4984049_zashto_beshe_otstranen_ot_dlujnost_kmetut_na_varna/?ref=rss) reported that Varna Mayor Blagomir Kotsev was removed from office due to more than a month of unjustified absence from work.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Dnevnik (Bulgaria)](https://www.dnevnik.bg/bulgaria/2026/11/24/4983722_koi_e_daniel_slavov_-_dunkata_chovekut_svurzvan_s/?ref=rss) reported that Blagomir Kotsev identified Daniel Slavov as the main driver behind the premature termination of his mayoral mandate.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Dnevnik (Bulgaria)](https://www.dnevnik.bg/bulgaria/2026/11/24/4983891_obnovi_evropa_osudi_otstraniavaneto_na_kocev_i_sezira/?ref=rss) reported that the Renew Europe group condemned the removal of Blagomir Kotsev from the mayoral post in Varna and referred the case to the European Commission.

On 24 Nov 2026, [24 Chasa](https://www.24chasa.bg/bulgaria/article/23987155) reported that the Renew Europe group in the European Parliament strongly condemned the decision of the Varna Municipal Election Commission to prematurely terminate Blagomir Kotsev's mandate.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Dnevnik (Bulgaria)](https://www.dnevnik.bg/bulgaria/2026/11/24/4983632_dps_se_razgranichi_ot_otstraniavaneto_na_blagomir_kocev/?ref=rss) reported that the DPS press center stated the party has nothing to do with the removal of Varna mayor Blagomir Kotsev.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Dnevnik (Bulgaria)](https://www.dnevnik.bg/bulgaria/2026/11/24/4983659_organizirat_se_protesti_sled_otstraniavaneto_na/?ref=rss) reported that protests are being organized in Varna and other cities following the removal of mayor Blagomir Kotsev.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Dnevnik (Bulgaria)](https://www.dnevnik.bg/bulgaria/2026/11/24/4983762_zad_otstraniavaneto_na_kocev_stoiat_mestni_mafioti/?ref=rss) reported that Asen Vassilev claimed local mafia figures are behind the removal of Blagomir Kotsev.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Dnevnik (Bulgaria)](https://www.dnevnik.bg/bulgaria/2026/11/24/4983764_vuzrajdane_haresa_otstraniavaneto_na_kocev_triabvalo/?ref=rss) reported that Vazrazhdane approved of Kotsev's removal and suggested the mayors of Sofia and Blagoevgrad should also be removed.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Dnevnik (Bulgaria)](https://www.dnevnik.bg/bulgaria/2026/11/24/4983571_vuv_varna_beshe_izvurshen_prevrat_blagomir_kocev/?ref=rss), [24 Chasa](https://www.24chasa.bg/bulgaria/article/23984035) reported that ousted Varna mayor Blagomir Kotsev claimed a coup occurred and blamed businessman Daniel Slavov for his removal, adding that he will appeal the decision.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Dnevnik (Bulgaria)](https://www.dnevnik.bg/bulgaria/2026/11/24/4983551_kakvo_sledva_sled_reshenieto_za_otstraniavaneto_na/?ref=rss) reported that the decision of the Varna Municipal Election Commission regarding the early termination of Blagomir Kotsev's mandate can be appealed by the mayor or others.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Dnevnik (Bulgaria)](https://www.dnevnik.bg/bulgaria/2026/11/23/4983501_obshtinskata_izbiratelna_komisiia_vuv_varna_otstrani/?ref=rss) reported that the Varna Municipal Election Commission terminated the powers of mayor Blagomir Kotsev and cancelled his election certificate.
On 23 Nov 2026, [24 Chasa](https://www.24chasa.bg/bulgaria/article/23982664) reported that the commission concluded Kotsev was absent from work without legal grounds for more than a month in 2025.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Dnevnik (Bulgaria)](https://www.dnevnik.bg/bulgaria/2026/11/23/4983530_borisov_poiska_ostavkite_na_horata_na_gerb_v/?ref=rss) reported that GERB chairman Boyko Borisov demanded the resignation of GERB representatives in the Varna Municipal Election Commission and distanced himself from their vote.

stories.title: Why Australia’s security pact with Solomon Islands is such a big blow to China

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/china/diplomacy/article/3375923/will-solomon-islands-australia-treaty-prompt-china-rethink-its-pacific-strategy) reported that the Solomon Islands' decision to replace its 2022 security pact with China with a new Australian treaty may push Beijing to rethink its Pacific strategy.

On 26 Nov 2026, [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/week-asia/politics/article/3375849/can-australias-pacific-diplomacy-solomon-deal-match-chinas-enduring-influence) reported that Australia's new bilateral treaty with the Solomon Islands is seen as a significant victory for Canberra's strategy of banking on development aid and economic sweeteners.

On 25 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/australia-solomon-islands-sign-sweeping-pact-seen-as-countering-china/a-80043646?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/25/solomon-islands-signs-security-deal-with-australia?traffic_source=rss), [Military.com](https://www.military.com/video/australia-and-the-solomon-islands-sign-bilateral-security-pact-in-canberra) reported that Australia and the Solomon Islands signed a sweeping bilateral security pact in Canberra making Australia the primary security partner and requiring the archipelago to consult Canberra before making new security or infrastructure deals.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/national/australia-records-big-foreign-policy-win-in-deal-with-solomon-islands-20261125-p61haz.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that Australia signed a treaty with the Solomon Islands as the Pacific nation scrapped its security pact with China.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilwFBVV95cUxOSG1oWFgtQ2pTYWVManFSTHhtZmk2UFl6VllsZFBkTWpHWUF0WGZ6LTNZaTZqTXJpeEhBWHVUallaaXhORWxVbmlaRUk0NkhPdEJXQ3puZHA4RFNIS01rdUVNS2MzdlcyalFTU0NNN2dUSFBuMy1rUmVDdWVFWlhTdGNpYVU2ZUc0bzRiZ0FWR3NiSG5hMEhF?oc=5), [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/25/australia-solomon-islands-treaty-blow-to-china-pacific-influence), [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/24/world/asia/solomon-islands-security-treaty-australia-china.html) reported that Australia and the Solomon Islands signed a new security treaty designating Australia as the primary security partner and excluding foreign military bases.

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/unicef-sanwo-olus-wife-editors-demand-joint-action-plan-to-tackle-nigerias-child-crisis/) reported that UNICEF, the Nigerian Guild of Editors, and the wife of the Lagos State Governor demanded a joint action plan to tackle Nigeria's child crisis.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/5000-lagos-pupils-benefit-from-childrens-day-outreach/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that nearly 5,000 Lagos public school pupils received school bags, books, and food packs in a Children's Day outreach by the Babajide Sanwo-Olu Foundation.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/cyber-threats-cbn-ncc-raise-alarm-over-ai-powered-attacks/) reported that the Central Bank of Nigeria and the Nigerian Communications Commission warned of rising artificial intelligence-powered cyber attacks.

On 21 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/world-childrens-day-60-lagos-pupils-benefit-from-educational-support/) reported that 60 pupils in Lagos State received educational support including scholarships, school kits, and shopping vouchers from a financial technology company on World Children's Day.

On 21 Nov 2026, [The Authority (Nigeria)](https://authorityngr.com/2026/11/21/stand-for-humanity-foundation-celebrates-childrens-day-in-imo-empowers-over-200-pupils/) reported that civil society organization Stand For Humanity Foundation empowered over 200 pupils in Imo and called for stronger protection of children's rights.

On 21 Nov 2026, [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/21/unicef-demands-action-not-promises-on-childrens-rights/) reported that UNICEF called on governments to uphold children's rights and ensure their voices are reflected.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/wcd-unicef-lagos-deepen-ties-to-safeguard-childrens-future/) reported that UNICEF reaffirmed its commitment to safeguarding the rights and future of children in partnership with the Lagos State Government.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/unicef-demands-action-on-childrens-rights/), [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/world-childrens-day-unicef-lagos-pledge-action-on-childrens-rights-welfare/), [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/unicef-lagos-raise-alarm-over-threats-to-childrens-rights/) reported that UNICEF and the Lagos State Government pledged stronger action to protect children's rights and welfare on World Children's Day.

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/bayelsa-boat-mishap-exposes-gaps-between-safety-interventions-enforcement/) reported that a wooden passenger boat carrying mourners from Ayama to Ukubie capsized near the river junction between Oweikorogha and O.
On 25 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/tears-as-victims-of-bayelsa-boat-mishap-get-mass-burial/) reported that victims of the Bayelsa boat mishap received a mass burial.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/fubara-commiserates-with-bayelsa-govt-over-boat-mishap/) reported that Rivers State Governor Siminalayi Fubara commiserated with Bayelsa State Governor Douye Diri over a boat accident that claimed lives.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/fubara-mourns-victims-of-bayelsa-boat-accident/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Rivers Governor Siminalayi Fubara commiserated with Bayelsa over the Southern Ijaw boat accident which killed 29 people.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/bayelsa-boat-tragedy-death-toll-rises-to-32-police-warn-operators/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the Bayelsa boat tragedy death toll rose to 32 as police warned operators and passengers against overloading and ignoring life-jacket rules.

On 23 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/lokpobiri-commiserates-with-bayelsa-state-over-tragic-boat-mishap/) reported that Minister of State for Petroleum Resources Heineken Lokpobiri expressed sorrow over the boat mishap at Ukubie.
On 23 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/bayelsa-boat-mishap-death-toll-rises-to-32-aig-visits-scene/) reported that the Bayelsa boat mishap death toll rose to 32.
On 23 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/bayelsa-boat-mishap-govt-deploys-crane-to-scene/) reported that the state government deployed a crane to the scene of the mishap.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/headlines/927360-bayelsa-boat-tragedy-exposes-questions-over-n844m-budgeted-for-boat-purchases.html) reported that questions are mounting over Bayelsa's spending on marine vessels following a boat accident resulting in 29 deaths.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/fg-orders-probe-into-deadly-bayelsa-boat-accident/) reported that the Federal Government ordered an immediate investigation into the boat accident that claimed several lives in Bayelsa State.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/fg-orders-probe-into-bayelsa-boat-mishap-demands-niwa-report/) reported that the Federal Government ordered an investigation into the Bayelsa boat mishap and demanded a NIWA report.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/oyetola-orders-probe-into-bayelsa-boat-accident/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Minister Adegboyega Oyetola directed NIWA to investigate the fatal Bayelsa boat accident in Southern Ijaw, citing missing life jackets and a manifest.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/bayelsa-boat-tragedy-atiku-demands-probe-overhaul-of-water-transport-safety/) reported that presidential candidate Atiku Abubakar called for an investigation and an overhaul of water transport safety following the Bayelsa boat tragedy.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/dickson-mourns-victims-of-bayelsa-boat-mishap-seeks-safety-measures/) reported that former Governor of Bayelsa State Henry Seriake Dickson commiserated with the families and friends of victims of the boat mishap along the Ayama/Ow.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/nema-recovers-24-bodies-from-bayelsa-boat-mishap/) reported that the National Emergency Management Agency recovered 24 bodies from the Bayelsa boat mishap.
On 21 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/bayelsa-boat-tragedy-death-toll-rises-to-26/) reported that the death toll from the boat accident in Bayelsa State climbed to 26.

On 21 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/bayelsa-boat-mishap-more-bodies-recovered-on-river/) reported that joint search and rescue efforts by the Bayelsa State government and security agencies recovered more bodies and rescued more survivors following a boat mishap.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/makinde-mourns-bayelsa-boat-tragedy-condoles-with-victims-families/) reported that Oyo State Governor Seyi Makinde commiserated with the Bayelsa State Government over the boat mishap.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/oborevwori-mourns-bayelsa-boat-mishap-victims-commiserates-with-diri-bereaved-families/) reported that Delta State Governor Sheriff Oborevwori expressed deep sorrow over the boat mishap in the Southern Ijaw Local Government Area.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/many-feared-killed-as-funeral-bound-barge-capsizes-in-bayelsa/) reported that a crowded barge carrying passengers to a funeral capsized near Ukubie in the Southern Ijaw area of Bayelsa State.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/bayelsa-boat-tragedy-govt-warns-operators-against-overloading/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the Bayelsa Government warned boat operators against overloading and reckless navigation following a boat mishap in Southern Ijaw.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/four-die-24-rescued-as-bayelsa-burial-boat-capsizes/) reported that four persons, including two children, died after a boat carrying passengers to a burial ceremony capsized in Southern Ijaw Local Government Area of Bayelsa State.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/four-mourners-die-in-bayelsa-boat-accident/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that four mourners, including two children, died when a boat capsized in Southern Ijaw, Bayelsa State, with police stating 24 passengers were rescued.

On 20 Nov 2026, [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/20/breaking-over-50-feared-dead-as-boat-capsizes-in-bayelsa-about-100-passengers-missing/) reported that over 50 people are feared dead and about 100 passengers are missing after a passenger boat capsized in Bayelsa.

On 20 Nov 2026, [The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/several-feared-missing-as-boat-carrying-mourners-capsizes-in-bayelsa/), [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/boat-capsizes-with-300-passengers-in-bayelsa/), [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/bayelsa-hundreds-of-people-feared-missing-in-boat-mishap/) reported that several people are feared missing after an overloaded boat carrying mourners capsized in Bayelsa State.

On 19 Nov 2026, [CBC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikwFBVV95cUxNUjJHS3F4cFgwQkk3TnZDV042WDVNR2JDdkk3RWRseWFhOU93eDBabWxPc3JGY1l4RXFFTUVTZUhCT0Zjdnc3V0xPR0ItZkQzR185OEtCcWZjVVRIRjJIRmgwVXRjTS00XzIwX1NEMi1wMS14Q3lKSVRCZ2VtNVQ3RVRvOExRVk1uTFF5OE11dy1wRlU?oc=5) reported that dozens are missing off Senegal as West African departures for Europe surge.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/19/canary-island-erects-field-hospital-amid-migrant-influx/) reported that authorities on Spain's Canary Island of El Hierro set up a field hospital at a temporary site to manage a sharp rise in migrant arrivals putting pressure on health services.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/18/migrant-boat-capsizes-off-senegal-leaving-at-least-one-dead?traffic_source=rss), [Arab News](https://www.arabnews.com/world/migrant-boat-capsizes-off-senegal-at-least-one-dead-3012792) reported that a migrant boat capsized off the coast of western Senegal, resulting in the death of at least one person.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/19/record-number-of-african-migrants-arrive-in-spains-canary-islands/) reported that official figures show more than 11,000 African migrants reached Spain's Canary Islands in the first 15 days of November.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/19/at-least-one-dead-in-latest-migrant-boat-disaster-off-senegals-coast/) reported that officials stated a wooden vessel carrying around 100 people struck a rocky outcrop and washed ashore.

On 17 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/spain-canary-islands-north-africa-el-hierro-pedro-sanchez-b3086710.html) reported that more than 11,000 migrants reached Spain's Canary Islands in the first half of November according to government figures.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/17/another-boat-carrying-migrants-arrives-at-el-hierro-in-spains-canary-islands/) reported that Spain’s maritime rescue service stated nearly 2,200 migrants arrived in the Canary Islands over the past two days.

On 16 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/canary-islands-spain-migration-emergency-b3085520.html) reported that Spain declared a migration emergency on the Canary Islands.

On 15 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261115-canaries-urge-government-action-after-2-200-migrants-reach-the-islands-in-48h-1) reported that nearly 2,200 migrants arrived by boat in the Canary Islands over the weekend, prompting calls for government action.

On 15 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/how-did-over-2-000-migrants-reach-the-canaries-in-just-48-hours) reported that the Atlantic Ocean route between West Africa and the Canary Islands saw over 2,000 migrants arrive in 48 hours.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/15/nearly-1500-migrants-reach-spains-canary-islands-in-one-day?traffic_source=rss) reported that nearly 1,500 migrants reached Spain's Canary Islands in a single day.

On 15 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/nearly-1-600-migrants-arrive-on-spain-s-canary-islands-in-one-day/a-79952941?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that the majority of migrants arriving on the islands came from Senegal, Gambia, and Guinea.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/svijet/Oko-1500-migranata-za-dan-stiglo-na-Kanarska-ostrva/992493) reported that nearly 1,500 migrants arrived at the Canary Islands in a 24-hour period.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/svijet/nastavlja-se-migrantska-kriza-u-spaniji-na-kanarska-ostrva-u-samo-jednom-danu-stiglo-gotovo-1500-ljudi/261115054), [Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/svijet/na-kanarska-ostrva-u-jednom-danu-stiglo-1-500-migranata-vlasti-nemaju-odgovor/), [Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/globus/1088127/drama-na-atlantiku-na-kanarska-ostrva-stiglo-1-488-migranata-medju-njima-i-deseci-djece) reported that 1,488 migrants arrived at the Spanish Canary Islands in 14 boats in a single day, setting a new record.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipAFBVV95cUxOR3hsQmM3QjN3aXVLQ0UzaF9LcVJMb2xHd0JsYXY5WTNtd2tZT1VFX3pydVprLTdiaktwelM0dlkyZldVR19yT3cwMlhGbk4wemc2ajU1NzBPd01PQi1zMkZFNVRKdnpUTE13X3RtYy04ZGduR00tb1NSMHFoWWFTeDdzT1RNd2FLZWtTYmNmbThmQ0FxdGxScWRYREJQRDUxN1FGSA?oc=5) reported that Spain stated nearly 2,200 migrants reached the Canary Islands in two days.
