stories.title: El Salvador’s leader Bukele reveals how 3 Salvadoran soldiers died fighting gangs in Haiti
stories.label: Haiti security operations by Salvadoran troops

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/26/world/americas/nayib-bukele-salvador-haiti.html) reported that El Salvador's president Nayib Bukele has widespread support among Haitians due to his efforts against gangs.

On 24 Nov 2026, [teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/el-salvador-formalizes-nayib-bukeles-candidacy-for-early-elections-in-2027/) reported that El Salvador’s Supreme Electoral Tribunal made official Nayib Bukele’s candidacy for early elections in 2027.

On 24 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/tv-shows/the-debate/20261124-the-bukele-method-will-salvadoran-leader-s-strong-arm-tactics-work-for-haiti) reported that citizens of Haiti are cheering the Salvadoran president's method.

On 24 Nov 2026, [The Rio Times](https://www.riotimesonline.com/el-salvador-clears-bukele-third-term/) reported that El Salvador’s Supreme Electoral Tribunal registered Bukele and Ulloa for the February 28, 2027 vote.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Diario Co Latino](https://www.diariocolatino.com/jovenes-se-manifiesta-para-exigir-inversion-social-y-rechazan-el-envio-de-tropas-a-haiti/) reported that young Salvadoran demonstrators took to the streets to demand social investment and reject the deployment of troops to Haiti.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/bukele-vira-heroi-no-haiti-com-guerra-a-gangues-apos-sumico-de-militares-envolto-em-misterio.shtml) reported that four Salvadoran military personnel who were members of an international gang-fighting force instituted by the UN in Haiti disappeared on October 18.

On 23 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/tribunal-electoral-salvadoreno-oficializa-la-candidatura-presidencial-de-bukele-para-buscar-tercer-mandato-33283296) reported that the Salvadoran electoral tribunal officialized Nayib Bukele's presidential candidacy to seek a third consecutive mandate.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/24/bukele-shares-details-on-deaths-of-salvadoran-troops-in-haiti-intervention?traffic_source=rss) reported that Bukele shared details on the deaths of Salvadoran troops in the Haiti intervention following the kidnapping of four technicians by gangs in October.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMingFBVV95cUxNSEV2cEFJbWwwUnh4OTBzdW1jQTlfdG5MdWxCN2YtaDNmSGpvN2c5MEZYLWwxTkdIYnUtQ0xQYXVYTktNV01Hc3hlTFgtVm9hQkV0ejhqV3pzSXluOFJ2X3RoWHRQLU1CZVR4R1dCVlNPc1pKTHZzMWRVVGlSVDJ5dWpydGFpUUUtaXpMSThxQVFsbV9YNXNDV3QyTDRTQQ?oc=5) reported that El Salvador's President Bukele revealed how three Salvadoran soldiers died fighting gangs in Haiti.
On 23 Nov 2026, [The Haitian Times](https://haitiantimes.com/2026/11/23/what-are-haiti-security-forces/) reported that six main forces are involved in the effort to fight gangs in Haiti.

On 22 Nov 2026, [La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/internacional/bukele-lleva-guerra-pandillas-haiti_202611226b027809c0d5c85b96c4490e.html) reported that Salvadoran President Nayib Bukele sent 2,500 soldiers to Haiti following the disappearance of four soldiers.

On 22 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/mundo/noticia/2026/11/22/operacao-militar-de-el-salvador-no-haiti-ignora-mandato-da-onu-e-exporta-modelo-bukele-sob-temor-de-excessos.ghtml) reported that thousands of Haitians marched in Port-au-Prince while El Salvador's military operation in Haiti ignores a UN mandate.

On 21 Nov 2026, [teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/bukele-for-third-consecutive-term-office/) reported that Nayib Bukele registered his candidacy to seek a third consecutive term as president of El Salvador in February 2027 following constitutional reform.

On 20 Nov 2026, [El Estímulo](https://elestimulo.com/internacionales/2026-11-20/bukele-ya-es-candidato-a-su-tercer-periodo-en-la-presidencia/), [Diario Co Latino](https://www.diariocolatino.com/bukele-se-inscribe-en-el-tse-para-un-tercer-periodo-presidencial/) reported that Salvadoran President Nayib Bukele registered his candidacy with the Supreme Electoral Tribunal for a third presidential term.

On 20 Nov 2026, [teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/salvadoran-military-is-teaching-haitis-gangs-a-lesson-bukele/), a Salvadoran state-media outlet, reported that approximately 2,500 Salvadoran soldiers are participating in a mission in Haiti.

On 20 Nov 2026, [The Haitian Times](https://haitiantimes.com/2026/11/20/nayib-bukele-third-term-el-salvador-haiti-troops/) reported that El Salvador President Nayib Bukele's deployment of 2,500 troops to Haiti draws scrutiny over security and democracy.

On 20 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/latinoamerica/nayib-bukele-va-por-un-tercer-mandato-en-el-salvador-asi-fue-el-camino-de-reformas-que-permitio-su-nueva-candidatura-necesitamos-seis-anos-mas-3602666) reported that Salvadoran President Nayib Bukele registered his candidacy for the February 2027 elections to seek a third presidential term.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/international/article/2026/11/20/salvador-le-president-bukele-profite-de-sa-reforme-constitutionnelle-pour-se-presenter-a-un-troisieme-mandat_6813581_3210.html) reported that Salvadoran President Nayib Bukele formalized his candidacy for a third presidential term after constitutional modifications in 2025.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/20/el-salvadors-bukele-expected-to-formalise-bid-for-third-presidential-term?traffic_source=rss), [Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisAFBVV95cUxPOFQyR3VjRGNVUmZDV3lMOGdubmRvbU1tbTZsMTNLQ2x2QkUwSzVSLUE3RThET0xBQ3RmVEVWZS10b1JKZGxZNUVNNUMzZjROUVN5Yk4xc2ZlbTdhZDlCVUxKX1FFYmctY1huMG9yejFxT3ZxbE92cno3V1RnYWJKUXVPZjRxZmZJRVBkVTNBU0hxNUFzNUJuWmY2d3VYSWlqRnFudXNvcVR6UmhURGRFNw?oc=5) reported that Salvadoran President Nayib Bukele seeks a third presidential term while his forces fight gangs in Haiti.

On 19 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/nayib-bukele-inscribe-su-candidatura-para-las-elecciones-de-2027-en-el-salvador-33223136), [Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/apos-retirar-limites-de-mandatos-bukele-registra-candidatura-para-se-manter-no-poder-em-el-salvador.shtml) reported that Salvadoran President Nayib Bukele registered his candidacy to run for a third term in the February 28 elections.

On 19 Nov 2026, [The Haitian Times](https://haitiantimes.com/2026/11/19/haitians-brooklyn-rally-bukele-haiti-gangs/) reported that Haitian demonstrators gathered in Brooklyn to support Salvadoran President Nayib Bukele as his forces continued military operations against gangs in Haiti.

On 19 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261119-haiti-salvador-s-bukele-publishes-video-of-attack-on-gang-leader-s-house) reported that Salvadoran President Nayib Bukele stated his troops demolished the lavish home of a prominent gang leader in Haiti known as Jeff Gwo Lwa.

On 19 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/latinoamerica/nayib-bukele-reacciona-a-las-multitudinarias-marchas-de-apoyo-en-haiti-y-promete-una-victoria-contra-las-pandillas-nunca-espere-algo-asi-3602255) El Tiempo reported that Salvadoran President Nayib Bukele reacted to large-scale marches of support in Haiti, promising victory against armed gangs.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/18/bukele-confirms-airstrike-on-haitian-gang-leader-jeffs-luxury-mansion) reported that Salvadoran President Nayib Bukele confirmed an airstrike destroying the luxury mansion of Haitian gang leader Jeff Larose.

On 18 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/bukele-anuncia-que-militares-salvadorenos-destruyeron-la-casa-de-un-jefe-pandillero-en-haiti-33197904) reported that Salvadoran President Nayib Bukele published a video showing military helicopters attacking the house of gang leader Jeff Gwo Lwa in Haiti.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/haiti-formaliza-acordo-com-el-salvador-enquanto-tropas-de-bukele-atacam-gangues.shtml) reported that Haiti formalized a cooperation agreement with El Salvador on the same day thousands marched in Port-au-Prince.

On 18 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/latinoamerica/miles-de-personas-marchan-en-haiti-en-respaldo-a-operaciones-de-tropas-militares-de-el-salvador-en-el-pais-presidente-nayib-bukele-reacciono-3601946) reported that thousands of people marched in Haiti in support of military troop operations by El Salvador.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipAFBVV95cUxPMVp1by1yclVIYnJfVnZTOEo0LWk2TFE4ampJMlFTdGVudVRMM2FROVpOUFp3WkZfTU5FVWZYMGx5OUE5d2M1TGU3UEMtUUk4Wk90cGdNeFA5dVJFT3BSSFhUeXM3azg2N1VYUEozVGRMNGw4ZlphRE9xZXRhZjlPZmJnbGx1V2c5WXZOV0pQcnktSGVHc0QtQXhzVkVGaFVURkhFdA?oc=5), [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/americas/article/3374964/el-salvadors-bukele-says-his-troops-destroyed-gang-leaders-mansion-haiti) reported that El Salvador’s President Nayib J. Bukele confirmed and celebrated that his troops had destroyed or demolished the home of a key Haitian gang leader known as Jeff.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Haitian Times](https://haitiantimes.com/2026/11/18/bukele-strikes-gang-leader-home-vertieres-day/) reported that the operation marks the second reported strike on a gang leader’s residence by Salvadoran forces, following a previous attack on the home of Wilson “Lanmò San Jou”.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/bukele-diz-que-militares-salvadorenhos-destruiram-casa-de-chefe-de-gangue-no-haiti.shtml) reported that Salvadoran President Nayib Bukele announced the destruction of a Haitian gang leader's house during an offensive.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/18/haitians-rally-in-celebration-of-el-salvadors-anti-gang-troop-deployment?traffic_source=rss), [Jamaica Observer](https://www.jamaicaobserver.com/2026/11/17/haitians-take-streets-support-el-salvador-troops/), [Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/18/haitians-demonstrate-in-support-of-el-salvadors-bukele-and-anti-gang-troops/) reported that thousands of Haitians took to the streets in Port-au-Prince to celebrate and thank El Salvador's anti-gang military troop deployment.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/18/haiti-formalises-security-pact-with-el-salvador-as-thousands-march-in-support-of-bukele) reported that Haiti formalised a security pact with El Salvador as thousands marched in support of Bukele, and noted the UN recorded 4,595 deaths and 2,050 injuries due to armed violence in Haiti in the first 10 months of 2026.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Korea Herald](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10941169) reported that thousands of people poured into the streets of Port-au-Prince and beyond to praise El Salvador's President Nayib Bukele.

On 18 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/americas/20261118-haitians-rally-behind-bukele-as-salvadoran-troops-battle-gangs) reported that thousands of Haitians took to the streets to urge El Salvador's President Nayib Bukele to continue fighting gangs as Salvadoran troops bolstered security forces.

On 18 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/latinoamerica/policias-militares-y-soldados-de-bukele-haiti-suma-fuerzas-contra-las-pandillas-pero-sigue-sin-saber-como-recuperar-el-control-3601736) reported that a Crisis Group report warned that a lack of coordination exposes the civilian population and called for strengthening Haitian institutions.

On 17 Nov 2026, [The Haitian Times](https://haitiantimes.com/2026/11/17/haitians-rally-bukele-salvadoran-troops-haiti/) reported that thousands of people in Port-au-Prince demonstrated to praise Nayib Bukele and Salvadoran troops, as a new report warned that Haiti lacks a long-term plan to confront gangs.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/haiti-praises-salvadoran-troop-deployment-ahead-of-bukele-talks-101794861044668.html) reported that Haiti praised the deployment of Salvadoran troops ahead of talks with President Nayib Bukele.

On 15 Nov 2026, [The Rio Times](https://www.riotimesonline.com/haiti-weighs-future-of-salvadoran-troops/) reported that Haiti's prime minister is due in El Salvador on November 16 and 17 to discuss Salvadoran troops, while a gang leader asks the UN for talks.

On 14 Nov 2026, [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/el-mundo/bukele-sera-el-salvador-de-haiti-los-riesgos-y-las-alertas-alrededor-de-su-ultima-gran-apuesta-nid14112026/) reported that Salvadoran President Nayib Bukele launched a mission with more than 2,000 soldiers in Haiti.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Haitian Times](https://haitiantimes.com/2026/11/14/el-salvador-bukele-model-haiti-gang-offensive/) reported that El Salvador deployed roughly 2,500 troops to Haiti as President Nayib Bukele exports his hard-line security model.

stories.title: Ukrainian Drones Hit 2 Major Oil Refineries in Samara as Putin Urges Oil Industry Shift East
stories.label: US, China, and Russia APEC summit meetings

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/2-russian-oil-facilities-reportedly-on-fire-in-bashkortostan-and-samara-oblast/) reported that photos and videos showed large plumes of smoke rising near Transneft industrial facilities in Bashkortostan and Samara Oblast following reported fires at two Russian oil facilities.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/25/ukrainian-drones-strike-russia-s-samara-region-killing-one-and-setting-two-rosneft-oil-refineries-ablaze), [The Moscow Times](https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/11/25/one-killed-in-samara-region-as-ukraine-strikes-oil-refinery-a94368), [UK Defence Journal](https://ukdefencejournal.org.uk/ukrainian-drones-set-two-rosneft-refineries-ablaze-in-samara/) reported that Ukrainian drones attacked Russia's Samara region, killing one person and setting two Rosneft-operated oil refineries ablaze.

On 25 Nov 2026, [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/ukraine-says-it-struck-two-oil-refineries-in-russias-samara-region/article71743934.ece) reported that Samara's governor stated local air defense forces intercepted 145 drones overnight.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/91079112) reported that Russian President Vladimir Putin accused Ukraine of continuing to attack oil refineries in Russia despite Donald Trump's calls for a halt, and warned that action is inevitable.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/25/8064516/) reported that explosions and fires have been reported near the Novokuibyshevsk and Syzran oil refineries in Russia's Samara Oblast following suspected drone attacks.
On 25 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/91110) reported that Ukraine’s overnight drone attack hit two major Russian oil refineries in Samara Region.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/svijet/putin-optuzio-ukrajinu-da-ignorise-zahtjev-trumpa-da-ne-napada-rafinerije-zaprijetio-odmazdom/261124335), [Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/globus/1090749/putin-zaprijetio-ukrajini-odmazdom-mjere-su-neizbjezne) reported that Russian President Vladimir Putin accused Ukraine of continuing attacks on Russian oil refineries despite a request from US President Donald Trump and threatened inevitable retaliation.

On 24 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2224239), a Russian state-media outlet, reported that Vladimir Putin stated Kiev does not stop strikes against Russian fuel and energy sector facilities.
On 24 Nov 2026, [TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/940463ac5ac5), a Turkish state-media outlet, reported that Putin said Russian retaliation over Ukrainian refinery strikes is inevitable.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/24/putin-says-kyiv-hit-russian-oil-plants-despite-trump-plea-vows-retaliation?traffic_source=rss) reported that Vladimir Putin stated retaliation is inevitable after Ukraine hit Russian oil plants.

On 24 Nov 2026, [The Moscow Times](https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/11/24/putin-says-ukraine-hits-russian-oil-plants-despite-trumps-requests-promises-retaliation-a94367) reported that several Russian regions introduced retail restrictions on gasoline and diesel following renewed Ukrainian refinery attacks.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/24/8064490/) reported that Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha advised Putin to stop complaining about refinery strikes and end the war instead.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Daily Maverick](https://www.dailymaverick.co.za/article/2026-11-23-why-the-trump-xi-putin-summit-was-no-yalta-and-what-it-means-for-sa/) reported that comparisons with Yalta were not justified regarding the Shenzhen meeting.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/90395702) reported that U.S. President Donald Trump sparked criticism across Europe and Washington after posting a Truth Social photo with Russian President Vladimir Putin.

On 22 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/politics/2026/nov/22/british-right-reform-tory-party-distances-itself-from-trump-putin-friend-post), [NZ Herald](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/world/donald-trump-posts-tribute-to-his-friend-vladimir-putin/VS6RTIZOCVGRFFBAWJWQT4LRRE/) reported that the post and photograph drew criticism from European allies and Democrats.

On 22 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/politics/2026/nov/22/british-right-reform-tory-party-distances-itself-from-trump-putin-friend-post) reported that a Reform UK deputy leader called the Russian leader a murderous dictator.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90836) reported that US President Donald Trump published a photograph shaking hands with Russian President Vladimir Putin captioned My Friend on Truth Social.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/20/8063799/), [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90722), [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/20/ukraine-clause-dropped-from-trump-putin-and-xi-s-peace-declaration-at-u-s-request-finland-s-president-says) reported that Finnish President Alexander Stubb revealed a section on Ukraine was dropped from the Trump-Putin-Xi peace declaration at the request of the United States.

On 19 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/xi-trump-y-putin-acuerdan-declaracion-de-paz-en-su-historica-reunion-en-china-33209323) El Sol de México reported that the presidents of China, US, and Russia agreed on a peace declaration in China aiming to reduce nuclear risks.

On 19 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/misterioso-maletin-nuclear-acompano-a-putin-hasta-china-33212916) El Sol de México reported that a nuclear briefcase accompanied Vladimir Putin to China.

On 19 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/asi-es-la-declaracion-de-paz-de-trump-xi-y-putin-que-dejo-fuera-las-guerras-de-ucrania-e-iran-33213399) El Sol de México reported that the four-point declaration proposed reforming the UN, increasing fuel supplies, and opening nuclear risk dialogues without addressing the wars in Ukraine and Iran.

On 19 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/eeuu-y-canada/donald-trump-vladimir-putin-y-xi-jinping-en-una-historica-cumbre-trilateral-desarme-nuclear-y-las-relaciones-comerciales-entre-los-temas-clave-3602258) reported that nuclear disarmament and commercial relations were among the key topics at the trilateral summit between Donald Trump, Vladimir Putin, and Xi Jinping.

On 19 Nov 2026, [El País](https://elpais.com/internacional/2026-11-19/trump-y-putin-interactuan-en-shenzhen-antes-de-las-reuniones-con-xi.html) reported that Donald Trump met with the Russian leader for 40 minutes in a citation that was not on the agenda.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/china-us-russia-issue-declaration-toward-peace-after-first-summit) reported that China, the United States, and Russia issued a 'Declaration toward Peace' after their leaders held an unprecedented summit.

On 19 Nov 2026, [24 Chasa](https://www.24chasa.bg/mezhdunarodni/article/23961306) reported that China, Russia, and the United States will continue working-level coordination following the summit between Presidents Xi Jinping, Vladimir Putin, and Donald Trump.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/svijet/Bijela-kuca-objavila-cetiri-kljucna-dogovora-Trampa-Putina-i-Sija-FOTO/993283), [Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/svijet/objavljena-cetiri-kljucna-dogovora-trumpa-putina-i-xija-nakon-sastanka/) reported that the White House published four key agreements reached by Donald Trump, Vladimir Putin, and Xi Jinping.

On 18 Nov 2026, [RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/fr/europe/20261118-%C3%A0-shenzhen-le-pr%C3%A9sident-russe-vladimir-poutine-s-affiche-au-centre-du-jeu-mondial) reported that Chinese, American, and Russian presidents held a meeting in Shenzhen.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/international/a-shenzhen-xi-jinping-s-affiche-en-pilier-d-un-nouvel-ordre-mondial-en-tutoyant-trump-et-en-menageant-poutine-20261119) reported that at the end of their meeting, the Chinese, American, and Russian presidents expressed commitment to peace and stability.

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-security/2026-11-26/ty-article/.premium/israeli-experts-say-defense-minister-is-inflating-irans-chemical-weapons-threat/000001a2-1694-de28-a3fb-d79e08480000) reported that experts and officials stated Tehran's efforts to develop chemical weapons have been known to Israeli intelligence for years.

On 24 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/defense-news/article-915996) reported that Avigdor Liberman and Israel Katz attempted to block the KAN broadcast of an IDF 'Mosquito Protocol' investigation.

On 24 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/middle-east/iran-news/article-916005) reported that Kasra Aarabi stated that Iran's chemical and biological weapons programs have spanned over four decades.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-security/2026-11-24/ty-article/.premium/katz-says-iran-is-developing-chemical-weapons-and-plotting-to-kill-trump/000001a2-0e94-dba8-adea-3e9e70230000) reported that Israeli Defense Minister Israel Katz stated Iran is developing chemical weapons and plotting to kill Trump.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261123-iran-accuses-countries-that-armed-saddam-hussein-of-leading-chemical-weapons-allegations-against-tehran/) reported that Iranian Deputy Foreign Minister Kazem Gharibabadi accused countries that allegedly helped supply Saddam Hussein's Iraqi forces of leading chemical weapons allegations against Tehran.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249640/Iran-is-the-world-s-largest-victim-of-chemical-weapons), a state-media outlet, reported that Kazem Gharibabadi stated Iran is the world's largest victim of chemical weapons.

On 23 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-915713) reported that Kataib Hezbollah commander Mohammad Dawood al-Saadi declared loyalty to Iran during a New York court hearing and denied terrorism charges.

On 21 Nov 2026, [IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86328560/Countries-that-supplied-Saddam-with-chemical-weapons-now-accuse), a state-media outlet, reported that Iranian Deputy Foreign Minister Kazem Gharibabadi criticized countries that supplied chemical weapons to Saddam Hussein for accusing Iran of developing them.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Tehran Times](https://www.tehrantimes.com/news/532341/Iran-rejects-US-allegations-of-chemical-and-biological-weapons) reported that Iranian Foreign Ministry Spokesperson Esmaeil Baqaei strongly rejected new US allegations that Iran is developing chemical or biological weapons.

On 20 Nov 2026, [El País](https://english.elpais.com/usa/2026-11-20/maga-turns-on-homeland-security-secretary-markwayne-mullin-after-us-systems-outages.html) reported that right-wing influencers intensified attacks against Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin and called for his dismissal following U.S. systems outages.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/iran-rejects-us-weapons-claims-cites-debunked-iraq-wmd-allegations-3725802) reported that Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesman Esmaeil Baqaei rejected US allegations that Tehran is developing biological or chemical weapons, citing Iraq WMD claims.

On 20 Nov 2026, [The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2641331/iran-rejects-trumps-bioweapons-claims-warns-against-repeat-of-disproved-allegations), [TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/4002c3287429) reported that Iran rejected US bioweapons claims and warned against repeating allegations similar to those made prior to the 2003 Iraq invasion.

On 20 Nov 2026, [teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/iran-dismisses-u-s-chemical-weapons-allegations-as-fraudulent-script/), a state-media outlet, reported that Iran dismissed U.S. chemical and biological weapons allegations as a fraudulent script.

On 19 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/middle-east/iran-news/article-915545) reported that Iran's Foreign Ministry spokesman asked whether the world had learned from 2003 or was about to let them deceive the public on a grand scale all over again.

On 19 Nov 2026, [IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86326383/Baqaei-declines-New-York-Times-interview-invitation-in-protest) reported that Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesperson Esmaeil Baqaei declined an interview invitation from The New York Times in protest of baseless claims about Iran.

On 19 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-915387) reported that ahead of meetings with Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin, Donald Trump warned of possible Iranian unconventional weapons threats.

On 18 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/world/2220799), a Russian state media outlet, reported that Markwayne Mullin stated during House of Representatives committee hearings that the US sees no threat of a dirty bomb attack by Iran.

On 18 Nov 2026, [IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86326096/Iran-Embassy-in-Athens-rejects-allegations-against-Tehran-as), [Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249528/Iranian-embassy-in-Athens-denies-terror-plot-allegations) reported that Iran's Embassy in Greece categorically rejected allegations regarding an alleged terrorist operation as entirely baseless Israeli propaganda.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/rubio-says-he-sees-no-imminent-threat-to-washington-after-cnn-report-3725732) reported that US Secretary of State Marco Rubio stated he does not believe an attack on Washington, DC is imminent after a CNN report.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixwFBVV95cUxOQVVnUzJMMDJJUTh1NTl4Vy1VU2U0bjEzVkRGWFBtamliVkRZQkZud2VuZ25YSDc0VzM5aXhQWWN2YTBFSTRaV1BSNUE3aWp5bmpsV0ZSMDMyT2YxcW5LekhIVEt6Tm9Od1ItNUs1U0ZOd2tfeTJSdkJhVVEtbUFzV2d0Z1NGa0doNGljVlhVOUJNS1UwYXFjVVRxMEY2OTRGY1lHQzcxRTlXR2VnVkh3QjRENEd0VTFPMjRJdmk3bVpXUEVWS3RV?oc=5) reported that US Secretary of State Marco Rubio stated there is no imminent threat to Washington following reports of a possible Iranian dirty bomb plot.
On 18 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-915256) reported that Rubio condemned intelligence leaks regarding the matter.

On 17 Nov 2026, [HuffPost World](https://www.huffpost.com/entry/iran-denies-dirty-bomb-plan_n_6afc87a1e4b0e902c23afc30) reported that an Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesperson denied allegations regarding a potential plan to detonate a dirty bomb in Washington, calling them baseless.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249497/Israeli-lobbyists-repackaging-Iraq-war-lies-to-target-Iran), [TASS](https://tass.com/world/2219943), a state outlet, reported that Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi refuted allegations about Iran's plans to use chemical weapons in the United States, calling the reports rubbish and Iraq War-style propaganda.

On 17 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/asia/southeast-asia/trump-philippines-china-visit-live-updates-b3086099.html), [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/trump-issues-stark-warning-to-iran-over-alleged-dc-dirty-bomb-plot-we-take-it-very-seriously-101794920834305.html), [The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/mena/2026/11/17/iran-will-pay-a-price-if-dirty-bomb-is-detonated-in-us/) reported that US President Donald Trump warned Iran it would pay an unprecedented price if a dirty bomb is detonated in Washington, DC.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261117-iran-rejects-reports-of-chemical-weapons-plot-in-washington/) reported that Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi and Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf denied reports that Tehran was plotting to use chemical weapons in Washington, DC.

On 17 Nov 2026, [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cq808vzd3nnpo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss), [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261117-trump-says-us-taking-possible-iranian-plot-targeting-washington-very-seriously/) reported that US President Donald Trump stated Washington is taking potential Iranian threats against Washington very seriously while Tehran rejected the claims as baseless.

On 17 Nov 2026, [CBC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxQc2ZYTGtvM0g3WWZBNzJJcEd5bElCMm4zUXR5NUczWnNQZWdEMGZWNklWaFQ1cWdjYlNVM0otemo1bjBXVmdENUNaUWVQeThvXzN2Zi1hekFzVG5ic2tvY256UjRZU1o3VFBGV2p3eFJqZTlvRHBReHo3MUFEZ1NqYmpGWnR2Xzg0bGJIQQ?oc=5), [Tehran Times](https://www.tehrantimes.com/news/532258/Iran-strikes-US-radar-system-in-Bahrain-as-Iran-downs-more-drones) reported that the Islamic Revolution Guards Corps stated it fired drones and struck a US radar system at Sheikh Isa Air Base in Bahrain.

On 17 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/iran-dismisses-report-of-alleged-dirty-bomb-attack-on-washington/a-79970741?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that Iran stated CNN's claim about a dirty bomb attack on Washington was an attempt to manufacture legitimacy to continue the war.

On 17 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/americas/20261117-trump-says-he-takes-possible-iran-bomb-threat-to-washington-very-seriously) reported that US President Donald Trump stated US authorities take any possible threats to Washington very seriously.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/203448/%D8%AA%D8%B1%D9%85%D8%A8-%D9%86%D8%AA%D8%AD%D9%82%D9%82-%D9%85%D9%86-%D8%AA%D9%82%D8%A7%D8%B1%D9%8A%D8%B1-%D8%B9%D9%86-%D9%85%D8%AE%D8%B7%D8%B7-%D8%A5%D9%8A%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%86%D9%8A-%D9%85%D8%AD%D8%AA%D9%85%D9%84-%D9%84%D8%AA%D9%81%D8%AC%D9%8A%D8%B1-%D9%82%D9%86%D8%A8%D9%84%D8%A9-%D9%82%D8%B0%D8%B1%D8%A9/) reported that US President Donald Trump stated he is verifying reports regarding a potential Iranian plot to carry out an attack on Washington using a dirty bomb.

On 17 Nov 2026, [The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2640780/us-intelligence-warns-of-iranian-dirty-bomb-or-chemical-attack-plot-targeting-trump-officials-cnn), [Egypt Independent](https://www.egyptindependent.com/exclusive-us-intel-indicates-iran-developing-plans-to-potentially-detonate-a-dirty-bomb-in-washington-sources-say/) reported that US intelligence sources indicated Iran is developing plans to target senior Trump administration officials with a dirty bomb or chemical weapon.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/us-news/2026-11-17/ty-article/iran-developing-plans-for-dirty-bomb-or-chemical-attack-in-d-c-report-says/000001a1-e8c8-d848-abeb-fac893430000) reported that according to CNN, US officials stated there was no evidence Tehran had decided to carry out an attack.

On 17 Nov 2026, [NZ Herald](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/world/iran-allegedly-plotting-to-target-trump-officials-in-washington-with-dirty-bomb/QMOGIIJGTJGGVCEOCJGKH4PW2E/), [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/iran-developing-plans-for-possible-dirty-bomb-attack-in-washington-says-us-intelligence/) reported that United States intelligence agencies uncovered information that Iran is developing plans to potentially attack senior Trump administration officials in Washington with a dirty bomb.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/us-intelligence-says-iran-explored-dirty-bomb-chemical-attack-scenarios-targeting-trump-officials-report-101794873460122.html) reported that new US intelligence prompted contingency planning in Washington, though the White House stated there are currently no credible threats to the US homeland.

On 17 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/middle-east/iran-news/article-915109) reported that sources familiar with the intelligence described the planning to CNN as an effort to give Iran additional options rather than evidence of an imminent attack.

stories.label: Estonia border closure and sabotage

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/world/2225421), a state-run outlet, reported that Estonian Interior Minister Igor Taro stated that part of the freed-up resources resulting from the closure of border checkpoints with Russia will be directed toward strengthening surveillance of the land border.

On 25 Nov 2026, [RT](https://rt-english.com/news/649355-baltic-states-divided-estonian-border-closure/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS) reported that Latvian Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs criticized Estonia's decision to close its border with Russia.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Baltic News Network](https://bnn-news.com/world/estonian-prime-minister-closing-the-railway-border-crossing-with-russia-could-be-the-next-step-ca83bu9) reported that Estonia's prime minister indicated that closing the railway border crossing with Russia could be the next step in response to threats from Moscow.

On 25 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/estonia-closing-border-russia-attacks-b3090839.html) reported that Estonia is closing its border with Russia on December 1 and urging Europe to take Vladimir Putin's aggression more seriously.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/91102) reported that Estonian Prime Minister Kristen Michal said Tallinn could suspend railway traffic with Russia as a further response to Moscow's hostile activities.

On 24 Nov 2026, [The Moscow Times](https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/11/24/latvia-mulls-possible-border-closure-with-russia-a94359) reported that Latvia is discussing a possible border closure with Russia as neighboring Estonia prepares to shutter its checkpoints in response to an alleged Russian sabotage plot.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Politico](https://www.politico.eu/article/estonia-foreign-minister-margus-tsahkna-close-border-russia/?utm_source=RSS_Feed&utm_medium=RSS&utm_campaign=RSS_Syndication), [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/feature/2026/11/24/why-is-estonia-closing-its-border-with-russia-estonian-foreign-minister-margus-tsahkna-explains-in-a-column-for-politico) reported that Estonian Foreign Minister Margus Tsahkna explained that Estonia is closing its land border crossings with Russia starting December 1 in response to an attempted arson attack.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/23/8064254/) reported that Russia summoned Estonia's chargé d'affaires to protest Tallinn's decision to close border crossings from December 1 following an attempted arson attack.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/23/8064275/) reported that Russia's Foreign Ministry claimed Estonia is deliberately allowing Ukrainian drones to use its airspace to target north-western Russia.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/24/russia-protests-estonia-s-planned-land-border-closure-and-again-accuses-it-of-letting-ukrainian-drones-use-its-airspace) reported that Russia summoned Estonia's acting chargé d'affaires Marek Juhtegi to lodge a strong protest over border closures and airspace accusations.

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/mena/2026/11/26/iraqi-court-jails-11-for-oil-smuggling-in-nationwide-crackdown/) reported that an Iraqi court jailed 11 individuals for oil smuggling in a nationwide crackdown.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Al Mada (Iraq)](https://almadapaper.net/462319/) reported that the Al-Anbar Provincial Council discussed mechanisms for returning displaced persons to areas including Jurf al-Sakhr and Al-Uweisat.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/204117/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%82-%D9%87%D9%84-%D8%AA%D8%B5%D8%A8%D8%AD-%D8%AC%D8%B1%D9%81-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B5%D8%AE%D8%B1-%D9%86%D9%85%D9%88%D8%B0%D8%AC%D8%A7-%D9%84%D8%AD%D8%B5%D8%B1-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B3%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%AD-%D8%A8%D9%8A%D8%AF-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AF%D9%88%D9%84%D8%A9/) reported that government forces entering Jurf al-Sakhr reflect institutional shifts in state control over security.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/204020/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%82-%D8%A5%D8%B9%D8%A7%D8%AF%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%86%D8%AA%D8%B4%D8%A7%D8%B1-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%82%D9%88%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%A8%D8%AC%D8%B1%D9%81-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B5%D8%AE%D8%B1-%D8%AA%D8%B3%D8%B1%D8%B9-%D8%AE%D8%B7%D9%88%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%AD%D8%B5%D8%B1-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B3%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%AD/) reported that the spokesperson for the Commander-in-Chief of the Iraqi Armed Forces stated that security formations in Jurf al-Sakhor are subject to unified command and control to accelerate weapons containment.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/203998/%D8%AC%D8%B1%D9%81-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B5%D8%AE%D8%B1-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%82%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%A5%D8%B9%D8%A7%D8%AF%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%86%D8%AA%D8%B4%D8%A7%D8%B1-%D8%A3%D9%85%D9%86%D9%8A-%D9%88%D8%A7%D9%86%D8%B3%D8%AD%D8%A7%D8%A8-%D9%83%D8%AA%D8%A7%D8%A6%D8%A8-%D8%AD%D8%B2%D8%A8-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%84%D9%87/) reported an Iraqi security redeployment and the withdrawal of Kataib Hezbollah battalions from Jurf al-Sakhor in Babylon province to prepare for the return of displaced persons.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Al Mada (Iraq)](https://almadapaper.net/461932/) reported that the director of the Ministry of Migration and Displaced branch in Anbar Governorate stated that 1430 displaced families from Jurf al-Sakhor are currently residing in informal settlements in the Bzeebiz camp.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/203816/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%82-%D9%8A%D8%B9%D9%8A%D8%AF-%D8%B1%D8%B3%D9%85-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B3%D9%8A%D8%B7%D8%B1%D8%A9-%D8%B9%D9%84%D9%89-%D8%AC%D8%B1%D9%81-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B5%D8%AE%D8%B1-%D9%85%D8%A7-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D9%82%D8%B1-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%B3%D9%8A%D8%B7%D8%B1/), [Al Mada (Iraq)](https://almadapaper.net/461886/) reported that the spokesperson for the Commander-in-Chief of the Armed Forces announced the establishment of a controlling headquarters in Jurf al-Sakhor north of Babylon province, subordinate to the Federal Police forces command.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Al Mada (Iraq)](https://almadapaper.net/461856/) reported that energy police commenced procedures to secure oil pipeline bundles in the Jurf al-Nasr area. [Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/203815/%D8%B1%D8%A6%D9%8A%D8%B3-%D9%88%D8%B2%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%A1-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%82-%D9%8A%D8%B7%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A8-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%82%D9%88%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D9%85%D9%86%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%A8%D8%AC%D8%B1%D9%81-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B5%D8%AE%D8%B1-%D8%A8%D8%B6%D8%A8%D8%B7-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%86%D9%81%D8%B3/) reported that Prime Minister Ali al-Zeidi asked security forces entering Jurf al-Sakhor to exercise self-restraint.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/20/kataib-hezbollah-faces-deadline-to-leave-iraqi-stronghold?traffic_source=rss) reported that Kataib Hezbollah faces a deadline to leave an Iraqi stronghold.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Al Mada (Iraq)](https://almadapaper.net/461787/), [Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/203784/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%82-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%82%D9%88%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D9%85%D9%86%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%AA%D9%81%D8%AA%D8%AA%D8%AD-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D9%82%D8%B1-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%B3%D9%8A%D8%B7%D8%B1-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%AC%D8%B1%D9%81-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B5%D8%AE%D8%B1/) reported that Iraqi authorities opened a controlling headquarters in the Jurf al-Sakhr area north of Babylon province.
On 20 Nov 2026, [Al Mada (Iraq)](https://almadapaper.net/461830/) reported that security forces began implementing a plan to reorganize the security file in Jurf al-Sakhr.
On 20 Nov 2026, [Al Mada (Iraq)](https://almadapaper.net/461835/) reported that energy police commenced duties to secure the oil pipeline in Jurf al-Nasr.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/203610/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%82-%D9%8A%D8%B9%D8%B2%D8%B2-%D8%AD%D8%B6%D9%88%D8%B1%D9%87-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D9%85%D9%86%D9%8A-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%AC%D8%B1%D9%81-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B5%D8%AE%D8%B1/) reported that Iraqi authorities initiated security procedures to reorganize military deployment in Jurf al-Sakhr north of Babylon province, with the Popular Mobilization Forces starting a troop rotation process.

On 19 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/iraq-s-risky-standoff-the-state-vs-iran-allied-militias/a-79995757?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that Iraqi security forces surrounded an area run by the Kataib Hezbollah militia in what onlookers described as a dangerous confrontation.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Al Mada (Iraq)](https://almadapaper.net/461820/) reported that a spokesperson for Kataib Hezbollah confirmed the group's refusal to surrender its weapons or leave the Jurf al-Sakhr area.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Al Mada (Iraq)](https://almadapaper.net/461813/) reported that Iraq's Ministry of Interior announced the participation of its security formations in redeployment arrangements in the Jurf al-Sakhr area.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/19/iraq-reaches-compromise-with-kataib-hezbollah-over-armed-group-stronghold?traffic_source=rss) reported that Iraq reached a compromise with Kataib Hezbollah to station forces including Popular Mobilisation Forces brigades in the armed group's stronghold.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/whats-behind-iraqs-standoff-kataib-hezbollah-militia) reported that the dispute over the Iran-backed group's presence in Jurf al-Sakhr tested Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi's efforts to rein in proxy groups.

On 19 Nov 2026, [The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/mena/2026/11/19/irgcs-esmail-qaani-holds-talks-with-kataib-hezbollah-as-showdown-with-iraqi-forces-averted/) reported that top IRGC commander Esmail Qaani held talks with Kataib Hezbollah while a showdown with Iraqi forces was averted.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Al Mada (Iraq)](https://almadapaper.net/461801/) reported that authorities arrested Ali Abdul Karim al-Moussawi, general manager of the Oil Pipelines Company, following judicial confessions regarding oil smuggling in Jurf al-Sakhar.
On 18 Nov 2026, [Al Mada (Iraq)](https://almadapaper.net/461733/) reported that Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi directed joint forces to deploy to Jurf al-Sakhar as the deadline approaches.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/203578/%D8%A8%D9%8A%D9%86-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AA%D8%B3%D9%88%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D9%88%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D9%88%D8%A7%D8%AC%D9%87%D8%A9-%D8%A8%D8%BA%D8%AF%D8%A7%D8%AF-%D8%AA%D9%88%D8%A7%D8%AC%D9%87-%D9%86%D9%81%D9%88%D8%B0-%D8%AD%D8%B2%D8%A8-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%84%D9%87-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%AC%D8%B1%D9%81-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B5%D8%AE%D8%B1/) reported that the Iraqi government is facing the Jurf al-Sakhar file between withdrawal deadlines and oil smuggling investigations through political settlement, military confrontation, or temporary containment.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/explainer-what-iraqs-kataib-hezbollah-militia) reported that Iraqi Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi made his riskiest move since coming to power six months ago, targeting Kataib Hezbollah.
On 18 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/middle-east/article-915335) reported that pro-Iranian militias including Kataib Hezbollah enjoy a semi-official status in Iraq.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Al Mada (Iraq)](https://almadapaper.net/461639/) reported that Prime Minister Ali Faleh Al-Zaidi approved joint forces of the army, police, and Popular Mobilization Forces to take control of Jurf al-Sakhar.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Al Mada (Iraq)](https://almadapaper.net/461501/) reported that economic researcher Ahmed Hadhal warned of continuing structural imbalances in Iraq's public finances as current expenditures in the 2027 draft budget absorb oil revenues.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/18/top-irgc-commander-in-iraq-for-talks-amid-kataib-hezbollah-tensions?traffic_source=rss) reported that the head of Iran's IRGC Quds Force attended meetings in Iraq over alleged oil smuggling linked to pro-Iranian armed groups.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/203449/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%82-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%AC%D8%B1%D9%81-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%86%D8%B5%D8%B1-%D9%85%D9%86-%D9%85%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%AD%D9%82%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AA%D9%87%D8%B1%D9%8A%D8%A8-%D8%A5%D9%84%D9%89-%D9%81%D8%B1%D8%B6-%D8%B3%D9%84%D8%B7%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AF%D9%88%D9%84%D8%A9/) reported that oil smuggling investigations in Jurf al-Sakhar led to broader Iraqi security measures and force deployments to assume security responsibility.

stories.title: Pacto Histórico congressional degree scandal

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/asi-habria-mentido-otra-congresista-del-pacto-historico-con-sus-titulos-CJ44091443) reported that another congresswoman from the Pacto Histórico coalition allegedly lied about her academic titles and documents.

On 25 Nov 2026, [El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/veronica-estrada-libreto-petro-para-defender-a-aliados-en-lios-judiciales-calumnia-y-persecucion-OE44043814) reported that Colombian President Gustavo Petro defended ally Luz Verónica Estrada amidst a scandal regarding false academic titles.

On 25 Nov 2026, [El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/catolica-congresista-claudia-romero-presento-diploma-califico-falso-estudiar-especializacion-FD44033305) reported that Universidad Católica stated that congresswoman Claudia Romero presented a diploma for a specialization that she qualified as false.

On 25 Nov 2026, [El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/gustavo-petro-veronica-estrada-pacto-historico-JC44023486) reported that former president Gustavo Petro defended Verónica Estrada and criticized the Procuraduría for suspending her.

On 24 Nov 2026, [El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/politica/suspenden-por-tres-meses-congresista-estrada-por-presuntos-titulos-falsos) reported that congresswoman Estrada was suspended for three months due to allegations of presenting a false engineering diploma and professional card.

On 23 Nov 2026, [El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/claudia-romero-congresista-pacto-historico-presento-diploma-falso-FM43920104) reported that the diploma presented by congresswoman Claudia Romero to the Chamber is not recognized by Pontifical Xavierian University.

On 23 Nov 2026, [El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/politica/representante-claudia-romero-es-investigada-por-presunto-diploma-falso) reported that the Attorney General's Office sent three inquiries concerning representative Claudia Romero to the Supreme Court of Justice.

On 23 Nov 2026, [El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/politica/es-falso-el-diploma-de-claudia-romero-esto-respondio-la-congresista) reported that congresswoman Claudia Romero stated she has been subject to intimidations during recent months.

On 24 Nov 2026, [El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/veronica-estrada-suspension-curul-pacto-historico-titulos-academicos-CI43966567) reported that a false diploma case involving representative Verónica Estrada has triggered a wave of reviews in Congress.

On 24 Nov 2026, [El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/politica/veronica-estrada-falta-reunion-del-pacto-historico-en-bogota) reported that Verónica Estrada missed an internal meeting of the Pacto Histórico in Bogotá.

On 24 Nov 2026, [El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/veronica-estrada-fue-suspendida-sin-sueldo-caso-titulos-falsos-MB44013906) reported that the Chamber of Representatives suspended Verónica Estrada for three months without pay following an order by the Procurator's Office.

On 23 Nov 2026, [El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/politica/procuraduria-suspende-congresista-veronica-estrada-por-diploma-falso) reported that the Attorney General's Office ordered the provisional suspension for three months of congresswoman Verónica Estrada over a false diploma.

On 22 Nov 2026, [El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/nacion/pacto-historico-andrea-vargas-admite-que-no-se-ha-graduado-de-abogada), [El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/congresista-pacto-lios-titulos-andrea-vargas-reconoce-graduo-presentaba-abogada-BG43891770) reported that Pacto Histórico congresswoman Andrea Vargas admitted she has not graduated as a lawyer, stating she is an ungraduated alumnus of the University of the Atlantic.

On 21 Nov 2026, [El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/veronica-estrada-presento-diploma-bachiller-congreso-colegio-es-falso-HG43890502) reported that Representative Luz Verónica Estrada presented another high school diploma to Congress, but the school stated it is false.

On 21 Nov 2026, [El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/veronica-estrada-antes-del-escandalo-por-sus-titulos-falsos-PI43874920) reported that Pacto Histórico requested Representative Luz Verónica Estrada to resign from her congressional seat amidst a scandal regarding false academic titles.

On 20 Nov 2026, [El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/veronica-estrada-fiscalia-cito-dos-veces-por-investigacion-titulo-falso-y-no-asistio-NM43836597) reported that the Prosecutor's Office summoned Pacto Histórico Representative Verónica Estrada twice in an investigation over a false academic degree, but she did not attend.

On 20 Nov 2026, [El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/politica/pacto-historico-pidio-renuncia-de-veronica-estrada-su-curul) reported that Pacto Histórico asked Verónica Estrada to resign from her congressional seat following allegations of falsified academic documents.

On 19 Nov 2026, [El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/luis-eduardo-llinas-pidio-oferta-veronica-estrada-contrato-dian-78-millones-KO43811319) reported that Luis Eduardo Llinás asked Luz Verónica Estrada to present an offer to sign a contract with DIAN in 2025.

On 19 Nov 2026, [El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/universidad-nacional-detecto-inconsistencias-titulo-veronica-estrada-fiscalia-PO43813639) reported that the National University received a request to verify Luz Verónica Estrada's university degree in October 2025.

On 19 Nov 2026, [El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/caso-luz-veronica-estrada-delitos-podria-enfrentar-falsificar-titulos-academicos-abogado-penalista-responde-DO43812100) reported that the case of Pacto Histórico Representative Luz Verónica Estrada reached judicial authorities following questions over her academic titles.

On 19 Nov 2026, [El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/consejo-ingenieria-denuncia-veronica-estrada-diploma-falso-KI43788174) reported that the National Council of Professional Engineering decided in February 2026 not to grant professional registration to Verónica Estrada and reported her to the Prosecutor's Office.

On 19 Nov 2026, [El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/politica/congresista-luz-estrada-habria-falsificado-diploma-de-la-u-nacional) reported that Representative Luz Estrada allegedly falsified a diploma from the National University.

On 19 Nov 2026, [El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/veronica-estrada-acta-grado-diploma-bachiller-antioquia-CJ43791074) El Colombiano reported that new documents raised questions regarding the high school diploma of Representative Luz Verónica Estrada.

On 19 Nov 2026, [El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/politica/congresista-veronica-estrada-suma-dudas-sobre-su-diploma-de-bachiller) El Nuevo Siglo reported that further doubts emerged concerning the academic credentials of the congressional representative from the Pacto Histórico coalition.

On 19 Nov 2026, [El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/veronica-estrada-pacto-historico-titulo-falso-canciller-GH43773324) reported that the National University confirmed that the university degree of congresswoman Juliana Guerrero was false.

On 19 Nov 2026, [El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/veronica-estrada-denuncia-corte-suprema-representante-pacto-historico-titulo-falso-MH43776912) reported that congresswoman Verónica Estrada was denounced before the Supreme Court over a false university degree.

On 19 Nov 2026, [El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/politica/como-habria-falsificado-titulo-universitario-congresista-del-pacto-historico) reported that former dean Verónica Botero ruled out internal complicity regarding the falsification of a university degree by a Pacto Histórico congresswoman.

On 19 Nov 2026, [El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/luz-veronica-estrada-titulo-falso-pacto-historico-investigara-caso-comite-etica-DI43785204) reported that the Pacto Histórico party asked its Ethics Committee to investigate the false university degree of Representative Verónica Estrada.

stories.label: Colombia car bombing

reports.text: On 25 Nov 2026, [teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/urban-violence-rises-through-colombia/) reported that November 2026 strikes in Cucuta and Villavicencio reflect urban violence and the human cost of stalled territorial development in Colombia.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/paz-com-as-farc-e-um-fracasso-na-colombia-diz-ex-refem-ingrid-betancourt.shtml) reported that former hostage Ingrid Betancourt stated that peace with the FARC is a failure in Colombia.
On 25 Nov 2026, [The Korea Herald](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10948947) reported that a bomb exploded outside regional government offices in Villavicencio, injuring 23 people.

On 24 Nov 2026, [El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/atentado-villavicencio-cilindros-bomba-marcados-farc-500-kilos-revolucion-CJ43971762) reported that military intelligence is analyzing whether a video featuring bombs signed by FARC dissident factions is linked to the car bomb attack in Villavicencio.

On 24 Nov 2026, [El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/no-habra-impunidad-por-el-carro-bomba-contra-la-gobernacion-del-meta-dice-vicepresidente-restrepo-FJ43972304) reported that Vice President José Manuel Restrepo joined voices of rejection regarding the car bomb attack against the headquarters of the Meta government in Villavicencio, stating there will be no impunity.

On 24 Nov 2026, [El País](https://elpais.com/america-colombia/2026-11-24/el-estallido-de-un-coche-bomba-en-colombia-da-alas-a-los-detractores-del-acuerdo-de-paz-con-las-farc.html) reported that the explosion of a car bomb in Colombia occurred hours before the commemoration of the tenth anniversary of the peace agreement.

On 24 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/colombia-car-bomb-attack-injures-at-least-23/a-80033956?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that a car bomb attack in Villavicencio injured at least 23 people and coincided with the tenth anniversary of a peace accord with FARC guerrillas.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/24/at-least-24-injured-after-car-bomb-detonates-in-central-colombia) reported that Colombian President Abelardo de la Espriella arrived in Villavicencio to hold a security meeting.

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [Nikkei Asia](https://asia.nikkei.com/techasia/china-made-shenzhen-a-showcase-for-tech-prowess-at-apec-summit) reported that China used Shenzhen as a technology showcase during the APEC summit.

On 21 Nov 2026, [CGTN](https://news.cgtn.com/news/2026-11-21/Vietnam-s-top-leader-calls-for-closer-cooperation-with-SW-China-1SfEgfipNjG/p.html?UTM_Source=cgtn&UTM_Medium=rss&UTM_Campaign=China), a state-media outlet, reported that Vietnam's top leader called for closer cooperation with southwest China.

On 20 Nov 2026, [CGTN](https://news.cgtn.com/news/2026-11-20/Experts-take-How-APEC-Shenzhen-meeting-shapes-regional-cooperation-1SdXVnAQysM/p.html?UTM_Source=cgtn&UTM_Medium=rss&UTM_Campaign=China), a state-media outlet, reported that Chinese President Xi Jinping outlined a vision for regional cooperation at the APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting in Shenzhen.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1584334/apec-leaders-urge-stronger-regional-trade-connectivity/) reported that APEC leaders called for stronger regional connectivity and fewer trade barriers following a two-day summit in China.

On 20 Nov 2026, [The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2641346/apec-leaders-call-for-stronger-connectivity-fewer-trade-barriers-at-china-summit), [TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/ac73cec29bdc) reported that APEC leaders called for stronger transport connectivity and fewer trade barriers at the summit in China.

On 19 Nov 2026, [teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/china-calls-for-greater-trade-cooperation-as-apec-leaders-gather-in-shenzhen/), a state-media outlet, reported that Chinese President Xi Jinping urged Asia-Pacific economies to strengthen trade ties and remove investment barriers at the APEC summit in Shenzhen.

On 18 Nov 2026, [RT](https://rt-english.com/news/649021-putin-trump-apec-meeting/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS) reported that the Kremlin stated Vladimir Putin and Donald Trump are expected to meet after the APEC plenary session.
On 18 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2220773) reported that Kremlin spokesperson Dmitry Peskov stated the Putin-Trump meeting will be brief due to a lack of time.

On 18 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/asia-pacific/20261118-xi-jinping-calls-for-global-cooperation-on-ai-and-free-trade-at-apec-summit) reported that Xi Jinping called for stronger global cooperation on artificial intelligence.
On 18 Nov 2026, [Yonhap](https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20261118003400315) reported that South Korean President Lee Jae Myung was set to hold talks with Xi Jinping on the sidelines of the APEC summit.

On 16 Nov 2026, [The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/trump-xi-putin-discuss-world-peace-china-says), [RT](https://rt-english.com/russia/648943-russia-china-us-summit/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS) reported that Xi Jinping, Donald Trump, and Vladimir Putin will meet in China to discuss topics including world peace, nuclear arms, Ukraine, Iran, and trade.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Yonhap](https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20261117010100315), [The Korea Herald](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10940356) reported that U.S. President Donald Trump stated North Korean leader Kim Jong Un would like to attend the APEC summit in China.

On 17 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2219413) reported that Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov stated no Putin-Musk meeting is planned on the sidelines of the APEC summit, and a full-format meeting with Takaichi is not scheduled.

On 17 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2219343), a Russian state-run outlet, reported that Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov noted leaders could select a venue for a brief conversation between Vladimir Putin and the South Korean leader at the APEC summit.

On 16 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/economy/2219129), a Russian state-run outlet, reported that a Kremlin aide announced an APEC leaders working meeting will be held on November 19, beginning with a welcome from the President of China and a joint photo session.

On 16 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/economy/2219097) reported that Kremlin aide Yury Ushakov stated Vladimir Putin will speak about Russian investment potential and the global economy at the APEC business summit.

On 16 Nov 2026, [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/china/diplomacy/article/3374652/putin-could-meet-north-koreas-kim-if-he-also-heads-china-apec-summit) reported that Interfax quoted Ushakov as saying Putin could meet North Korean leader Kim Jong-un if he travels to China for the summit.
On 16 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2219107) reported that a high-ranking delegation including seven ministers and corporate executives will accompany Putin.

reports.text: On 22 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/europe-sees-new-protests-over-rising-costs-inequality-and-public-services) reported that Sunday marked the third consecutive day of protests across Europe following demonstrations from Portugal to France.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/21/thousands-take-to-streets-in-portugal-france-and-spain-over-rising-living-costs) reported that thousands of people demonstrated in Portugal and France calling for higher wages and affordable housing.

On 21 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/thousands-protest-overs-prices-education-military-spending-in-france-and-europe), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/21/thousands-protest-across-europe-over-living-costs-and-housing?traffic_source=rss), [RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/en/france/20261121-students-and-unions-unite-for-sixth-weekend-of-protests-across-france) reported that thousands of demonstrators took to the streets across France and Europe for protests over the cost of living, housing, and government policies.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiswFBVV95cUxNT203dWpPR19PY3FGeGlGWkNqRklXMDA0cEtFTXBoY21LbVhhaEVNNzVXWTJfOUhUOURwUVVtQXBVazBOdjRjNmVnRktLOGxHam9tZ3ZneGp3bXNfQ2lHOU0yY0I2WF9qdnJxSkNrVm1Pc0REblNaMXJxRHZqRnpDcmY5MEhOdkNaeUZMUVFQYUxDUXRKbmhmckRvQnBHZUlXclh6ZEJJSUJQYll3SUNfdGJ5WQ?oc=5) reported that student protests were held across Europe with demands ranging from school funding to climate action.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/21/gen-z-protests-sweep-europe-over-wars-rising-costs-and-climate?traffic_source=rss) reported that thousands of Gen Z protesters rallied across 25 European countries over living costs, military spending, and climate.

On 20 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/europa/protestas-en-europa-la-militarizacion-y-el-costo-de-la-vida-vuelven-a-sacar-a-las-personas-a-las-calles-este-fin-de-semana-3602870) reported that Spain, Italy, and Austria experienced a new wave of demonstrations over militarization and the cost of living.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Jowhar](https://jowhar.com/young-demonstrators-take-to-streets-across-europe-in-widespread-protests/) reported that young Europeans poured into the streets from Milan to Berlin and London to protest high living costs, military spending, and climate issues.

On 20 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/mundo/noticia/2026/11/20/pelo-nosso-futuro-jovens-protestam-de-forma-coordenada-na-europa-contra-custo-de-vida-condicoes-de-ensino-e-gastos-militares.ghtml) reported that students and young workers took to the streets in over 20 European countries in coordinated protests.

On 20 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/20/young-people-europe-coordinated-protests-cost-of-living), [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/20/thousands-protest-across-europe-demanding-better-wages-and-services) reported that young people and activists across more than 20 European countries staged coordinated protests over the cost of living, learning conditions, and military spending.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/protestos-contra-gastos-militares-e-alta-do-custo-de-vida-mobilizam-jovens-na-europa-nesta-sexta.shtml), [O Dia](https://odia.ig.com.br/mundo-e-ciencia/2026/11/7324329-jovens-protestam-na-europa-contra-custo-de-vida-e-militarizacao.html) reported that young protesters demonstrated in European cities against the high cost of life and militarization.

On 20 Nov 2026, [RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/en/international/20261120-protesters-join-forces-across-europe-against-high-living-costs), [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261120-gen-z-protests-spread-across-europe-mass-rallies-over-cost-of-living-in-spain), [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/videos/c6dx12ppeqn4o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that protesters across Europe took to the streets in coordinated demonstrations against the rising cost of living.

On 20 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261120-italy-strike-draws-workers-students-into-nationwide-protests-over-wages-and-living-costs), [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/video/2026/11/20/italy-workers-and-students-stage-nationwide-strike-over-living-costs) reported that a nationwide strike in Italy disrupted schools, hospitals, and local transport.

stories.title: Malaysia: Najib Razak House Arrest and Ministerial Resignation

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/malaysia-next-general-election-national-day-anwar-6583951) reported that Malaysian Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim stated that the next general election is likely to be held either before or after National Day 2027.

On 24 Nov 2026, [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/week-asia/politics/article/3375596/not-true-anwar-denies-malaysian-government-leaked-najib-pardon-minutes) reported that Malaysian Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim denied that the government circulated Pardons Board minutes related to former leader Najib Razak's house arrest.

On 18 Nov 2026, [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/week-asia/people/article/3374928/malaysias-pardons-board-minutes-expose-legal-rift-over-najibs-house-arrest) reported that Malaysia's attorney general objected to former prime minister Najib Razak's house arrest on the grounds that it had no legal basis, though the king approved the arrangement.

On 18 Nov 2026, [CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/najib-razak-house-arrest-declassified-minutes-attorney-general-hannah-yeoh-6561556) reported that Pardons Board minutes showed Malaysia's AG warned that Najib's house arrest could affect political stability and the country's image, and that Federal Territories Minister Hannah Yeoh also opposed the move.

On 17 Nov 2026, [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/asia/article/3374689/foreigners-lose-homes-thailand-malaysias-melaka-elections-7-asia-highlights) reported on seven selected stories from coverage of Asia over the past week, including foreigners losing homes in Thailand and Malaysia's Melaka elections.

On 15 Nov 2026, [CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/melaka-poll-results-analysis-malaysia-general-election-challenges-6552746) reported that a BN-PN alliance achieved a landslide victory in Melaka.

On 14 Nov 2026, [CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/melaka-election-2026-bn-landslide-anwar-ph-pn-6551571) reported that the Barisan Nasional and Perikatan Nasional alliance won 24 seats in the Melaka polls.

On 15 Nov 2026, [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/week-asia/politics/article/3374453/malaysias-melaka-poll-shows-ethnic-lines-firming-can-anwar-turn-malay-nationalist-tide) reported that identity politics could decide the outcome of Malaysia's next national election.

On 14 Nov 2026, [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/week-asia/politics/article/3374416/malaysias-melaka-election-begins-anwars-ph-seeks-counter-resurgent-umno) reported that voters began casting ballots on Saturday morning to decide who will govern the southern Malaysian state of Melaka over the next five years.

On 12 Nov 2026, [CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/malaysia-melaka-state-election-bn-pn-najib-razak-6545381) reported that former Prime Minister Najib Razak's conditional pardon sparked concerns over preferential treatment among some voters.

On 12 Nov 2026, [CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/former-malaysia-pm-najib-razak-house-arrest-sentence-6545056) reported that Najib Razak had submitted a written request for a second residence to be included in his house arrest arrangements, but this was not approved.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/11/malaysias-ex-pm-transferred-to-house-arrest-for-1mdb-graft-sentence?traffic_source=rss) reported that former Malaysian Prime Minister Najib Razak was transferred from prison to his Kuala Lumpur home for house arrest.

On 10 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/former-malaysian-leader-najib-razak-returns-home-under-royal-pardon-but-faces-a-separate-15-year-prison-sentence/a-79913437?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that Najib Razak returned home under a royal pardon but still faces a separate 15-year prison sentence.

On 11 Nov 2026, [CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/malaysia-najib-razak-house-arrest-anwar-ibrahim-umno-6542426) reported that Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim's anti-corruption agenda has taken a perceived hit despite him not having the final say in former premier Najib Razak's house arrest.

On 11 Nov 2026, [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/week-asia/politics/article/3374042/taiwan-pauses-malaysia-investment-talks-after-anwar-remarks-spark-fury-taipei) reported that Malaysia is seeking to reassure Taiwanese investors that it remains a reliable destination for hi-tech manufacturing after Taipei suspended bilateral investment talks.

On 10 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/10/malaysian-court-clears-former-pm-najib-razak-for-house-arrest-transfer?traffic_source=rss) reported that a Malaysian court cleared former PM Najib Razak for a house arrest transfer.

On 10 Nov 2026, [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiygFBVV95cUxORXB4UWVtZXBzZXM1eGhQa0tGX21hamxBcVpnR2lfMUUxV1dyc0RvdXZGQk9KSGxNQ2ZrNjJZSmJrcjNJSjVlZXRkZkVSUjk0NERGWTZSN3RzWFNYWENwdERHZDlQS1lRaF9PaG0tRmNfMW5yeGYyYzI3ZEx0d3Mxb25jeWlMQXF5SzNkdDNLZEl4N05JdmlGVjNBSWxLUms5OWNkYkUyUkNXVEl3cm9iOV84eG0wQlVodHhabkVLR0s0TFdsTTRMeFJR?oc=5) reported that a Malaysia court cleared the way for ex-PM Najib to start house arrest, according to Bernama.

On 10 Nov 2026, [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/malaysian-court-clears-final-hurdle-for-former-pm-najib-razaks-transfer-to-house-arrest/article71686082.ece) reported that a Malaysian court cleared the final hurdle for former Prime Minister Najib Razak's transfer to house arrest.

On 10 Nov 2026, [CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/malaysia-transport-minister-anthony-loke-resignation-take-effect-immediately-najib-house-arrest-6538901) reported that Malaysian Transport Minister Anthony Loke's resignation takes effect immediately after the court granted Najib house arrest.

On 10 Nov 2026, [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/week-asia/people/article/3373950/malaysia-court-clears-najib-begin-house-arrest) reported that Malaysia's former prime minister Najib Razak arrived home after the High Court cleared the way for him to serve the remainder of his prison term under house arrest.

On 10 Nov 2026, [CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/malaysia-ex-pm-najib-razak-released-prison-house-arrest-royal-pardon-6538231) reported that Najib Razak arrived home in Kuala Lumpur to serve the remainder of his jail term under house arrest after being released from Kajang Prison.
