stories.label: Cross River APC primary dispute

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/2027-campaign-team-apc-debunk-disqualification-of-bayelsa-west-senatorial-candidate/) reported that the campaign team of High Chief Fidelis Agbiki and the APC debunked news regarding the disqualification of the Bayelsa West senatorial candidate.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/benue-apc-crisis-why-alia-akume-reconciliation-ll-not-work-factional-chair-agada/) reported that Benue State APC factional chairman Austin Agada declared that a reconciliation between Governor Hyacinth Alia and George Akume will not work.

On 24 Nov 2026, [The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/2027-court-sacks-agbo-as-apc-benue-south-senatorial-candidate-declares-alapa-winner/) reported that Justice Salim Ibrahim sacked Agbo as the APC Benue South senatorial candidate and declared Alapa the winner.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/benue-apc-crisis-alia-akume-attend-peace-meeting-in-abuja/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Governor Hyacinth Alia met APC stakeholders in Abuja at a reconciliation meeting convened by Ibrahim Shema's committee.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/927092-again-apc-moves-to-reconcile-akume-and-alia-in-benue.html) reported that Benue Governor Hyacinth Alia and SGF George Akume have a long-running dispute over party leadership in the state.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/alia-akume-suswam-others-meet-over-benue-apc-crisis/) reported that Benue State Governor Hyacinth Alia reiterated his commitment to reconciliation and unity within the All Progressives Congress.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/apc-cancels-cross-river-campaign-kick-off/) reported that the All Progressives Congress in Cross River cancelled its campaign kick-off and directed candidates to continue ward-to-ward campaigns.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/youths-will-decide-2027-election-outcome-osun-yp-senatorial-candidate/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Youth Party Osun Central senatorial candidate Ibrahim Adefila urged youths to unite and decide the 2027 elections.

On 20 Nov 2026, [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/20/apc-senatorial-candidate-pledges-to-connect-osun-central-to-opportunities/) reported that Osun Central Senatorial Candidate on the platform of the APC, Barrister Kunle Rasheed Adegoke, pledged to connect Osun Central to opportunities.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/kwara-south-apc-candidate-adewoye-confident-of-victory/) reported that Prince Olalekan Adewoye, the All Progressives Congress senatorial candidate for Kwara South in the 2027 general election, expressed confidence in victory.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/nnorth-east/926442-court-dismisses-suit-challenging-taraba-apc-chairmans-emergence.html) reported that a court dismissed a suit challenging the Taraba APC chairman's emergence, which was filed by chairmanship aspirant Abdulhadi Lau.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/just-in-court-upholds-yahaya-bellos-emergence-as-apc-senatorial-candidate/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web), [Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/headlines/926397-court-strikes-out-suit-challenging-yahaya-bellos-apc-senatorial-candidacy.html) reported that the Federal High Court in Abuja upheld Yahaya Bello as the APC candidate for Kogi Central, dismissing Momoh Obaro's suit.

On 18 Nov 2026, [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/18/apc-kwara-south-senatorial-candidate-adewoye-seeks-policies-to-protect-indigenous-investors/) reported that All Progressives Congress Kwara South senatorial candidate Prince Olalekan Adewoye called for policies to protect indigenous investors.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/kwara-south-apcs-adewoye-advocates-improved-security-framework/) reported that APC candidate Prince Lekan Adewoye advocated an improved security framework for Kwara South.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/benue-north-east-court-declares-suswam-as-apc-valid-senatorial-candidate/), [Punch](https://punchng.com/breaking-court-affirms-suswams-victory-in-benue-apc-primary/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web), [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/benue-court-affirms-gabriel-suswam-as-winner-of-apc-senatorial-primary/) reported that the Federal High Court in Abuja declared former Governor of Benue Gabriel Suswam as the valid candidate of the All Progressives Congress for the senatorial primary.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/supreme-court-reserves-judgment-in-zamfara-north-apc-senatorial-dispute/) reported that the Supreme Court reserved judgment in the legal dispute concerning the All Progressives Congress primary election for Zamfara North.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1741673-2027-election-court-takes-action-suit-challenging-cross-river-apc-candidate/) reported that a legal battle over the APC candidate in Cross River State took a new turn ahead of the 2027 election.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/emir-of-kano-congratulates-jaji-on-zamfara-apc-primary-victory/) reported that the Emir of Kano, Muhammadu Sanusi II, congratulated Aminu Sani Jaji on his victory in the Zamfara APC primary.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/nigeria/1741398-just-sanusi-reacts-winner-emerges-apc-rerun-primary/) reported that the Tijjaniyya of Nigeria commented on the outcome of the APC's rerun National Assembly primary election.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/jaji-wins-zamfara-apc-rerun-primary-with-26646-votes/), [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1741218-apc-announces-winner-zamfara-house-reps-rerun-primary/) reported that Aminu Sani Jaji won the All Progressives Congress court-ordered rerun primary in Zamfara State.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/criver-central-stakeholders-hail-affirmation-of-ewa-as-apc-primary-winner/) reported that APC stakeholders in Cross River State urged party members to unite behind Oden Ewa following affirmation of his primary win.

On 13 Nov 2026, [The Authority (Nigeria)](https://authorityngr.com/2026/11/13/court-affirms-oden-ewas-apc-senatorial-primary-victory/) reported that the Federal High Court in Abuja affirmed Oden Ewa as the APC candidate for the Cross River Central Senatorial District.

stories.title: Kilmar Ábrego García, a Salvadoran national mistakenly deported from the US, arrives in Spain
stories.label: Kilmar Abrego Garcia US departure

reports.text: On 25 Nov 2026, [NZ Herald](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/world/kilmar-abrego-garcia-arrives-in-spain-to-start-a-new-life/YCF4FG3KYVDBBHKKE5GLKCOECM/) reported that Spain allowed Salvadoran migrant Kilmar Abrego Garcia to stay for up to 90 days on a valid passport.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/25/kilmar-abrego-garcia-wrongfully-deported-from-us-arrives-in-spain?traffic_source=rss) reported that the lawyer for Abrego Garcia described the departure as temporary.

reports.text: On 25 Nov 2026, [RT](https://rt-english.com/news/649357-americans-want-iran-war-end-poll/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS), a Russian state outlet, reported that a University of Maryland-Ipsos poll found 55% of Americans want an immediate end to the Iran war while 18% back escalation.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249684/Most-Americans-want-Iran-conflict-to-end-Poll), a state-media outlet, reported that a survey conducted by the University of Maryland and Ipsos found that 55 percent of Americans want to end the war on Iran immediately.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/25/poll-finds-us-voters-want-government-to-end-iran-war-regardless-of-terms?traffic_source=rss), [The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/us/2026/11/24/iran-war-poll-democrats-funding/) reported that a survey found 55 percent of US voters want the war with Iran ended immediately regardless of terms.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Politico](https://www.politico.eu/article/ukraine-takes-war-russia-far-from-borders/?utm_source=RSS_Feed&utm_medium=RSS&utm_campaign=RSS_Syndication) reported that Kyiv admitted to striking Russian ships far from its borders.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/24/estonia-s-interior-minister-suggests-petitioning-putin-to-end-war-in-ukraine-after-narva-resident-launches-petition-to-keep-border-with-russia-open-for-family-visits) reported that an Estonian resident launched a petition asking Estonia to keep its border with Russia open for family visits.

On 22 Nov 2026, [The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/us/2026/11/22/us-and-iran-could-still-reach-deal-says-egyptian-foreign-minister/) reported that the Egyptian Foreign Minister stated the US and Iran could still reach a deal.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Tehran Times](https://www.tehrantimes.com/news/532392/Araghchi-Iran-s-enriched-uranium-to-be-used-solely-in-line-with), a state-media outlet, reported that Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi reaffirmed that Iran's enriched uranium stockpiles will remain under the country's control and be used in accordance with national needs.

On 21 Nov 2026, [The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/iran-wants-diplomacy-end-war-trump-says-terms-unacceptable) reported that Abbas Araghchi stated Tehran still hoped diplomacy could end its war with the United States, while Donald Trump said Iran's terms were unacceptable.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249560/Any-deal-must-be-honorable-lasting-prevent-a-return-to-war), a state-media outlet, reported that Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi stated Iran's uranium reserves are consumed in compatibility with the country's needs.

On 21 Nov 2026, [CGTN](https://news.cgtn.com/news/2026-11-21/Iran-signals-openness-to-diplomacy-as-Trump-rejects-its-terms-1SfbQV8Myxq/p.html?UTM_Source=cgtn&UTM_Medium=rss&UTM_Campaign=World) reported that Iranian Foreign Minister Seyed Abbas Araghchi stated Tehran hoped diplomacy could end its war with the US while Donald Trump rejected its terms.

On 21 Nov 2026, [The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/21/world/politics/iran-diplomacy-terms-unacceptable/) reported that Abbas Araqchi stated Tehran wanted guarantees that Washington was serious about negotiations.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/araqchi-says-iran-wants-diplomacy-end-war-trump-says-terms-unacceptable), [TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/a80616400e18), [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/middle-east/iran-news/article-915613) reported that Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araqchi stated that Tehran still hopes diplomacy can end its war with the United States and seeks guarantees against future war.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Arab News](https://www.arabnews.com/world/trump-says-putin-expressed-his-desire-for-end-of-ukraine-war-3013188) reported that US President Donald Trump said Russian President Vladimir Putin expressed a desire for a diplomatic end to the Ukraine war during their recent meeting.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/20/8063876/) reported that US President Donald Trump claimed the hatred between Vladimir Putin and Volodymyr Zelenskyy is substantial.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/19/8063562/) reported that during talks with Xi Jinping in Shenzhen, Donald Trump said the US and China wanted to help bring the war in Ukraine to an end.

On 19 Nov 2026, [The Moscow Times](https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/11/19/us-china-can-help-end-ukraine-war-trump-tells-xi-before-trilateral-with-putin-a94307) reported that Kremlin foreign policy aide Yury Ushakov said Vladimir Putin's mood after the meeting was simply excellent.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/trump-says-us-needs-no-help-from-china-russia-to-end-iran-war-3725749) reported that Donald Trump told Fox News in Shenzhen that Iran wants to make a deal.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Hasht-e Subh](https://8am.media/eng/nikki-haley-urges-us-allies-in-middle-east-to-help-end-iran-war/) reported that former US UN Ambassador Nikki Haley urged US allies in the Middle East to help end the war with Iran.

On 14 Nov 2026, [IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86321045/Russia-and-China-urge-immediate-end-to-war-against-Iran-stress), a state media outlet, reported that the Russian and Chinese ambassadors to the United Nations expressed concern over US and Israeli threats against Iran and urged an immediate end to the war.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1581471/russia-china-seek-diplomatic-solution-to-iran-conflict/) reported that Russia and China called for an immediate end to the war against Iran and urged diplomatic efforts.

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/article-916258) reported that Haredi protesters blocked the entrance to Ben-Gurion Airport and one person was arrested for allegedly attacking a police officer at separate protests in Jerusalem.

On 22 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/article-915697) reported that police moved to disperse ultra-Orthodox protesters blocking the Jerusalem light rail following the arrest of a draft dodger.

On 12 Nov 2026, [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/11/world/europe/spain-general-strike.html) reported that workers in Spain staged a general strike to protest rising rents and stagnant wages.

On 12 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/spain-general-strike-protesters-riot-police-clash-b3083461.html) reported that millions of workers took to the streets during the general strike in Spain over housing costs.

On 11 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/spain-housing-crisis-prompts-general-strike-mass-nighttime-protests/a-79915208?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that hundreds of thousands of citizens hit the streets to protest Spain's housing crisis after millions of union workers staged a general strike.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/12/spain-holds-its-first-general-strike-in-14-years-amid-mass-protests-and-police-charges) reported that riot police clashed with masked protesters in Madrid and Barcelona during Spain's first general strike in 14 years, leaving more than 70 people arrested.

On 12 Nov 2026, [RT](https://rt-english.com/news/648726-barcelona-protests-clashes-rally/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS) reported that masked rioters smashed windows, looted shops, and set fires after tens of thousands marched in Barcelona demanding affordable housing.

On 11 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/video/2026/nov/11/police-clash-with-protesters-during-spains-general-strike-video) reported that clashes erupted in the streets of Barcelona and Madrid as millions of Spanish workers took part in the general strike.

On 11 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/spain-general-strike-over-housing-costs-before-national-election) reported that millions of Spanish workers shut down businesses and public transportation in a protest over housing costs.

stories.title: Rutte Vows NATO Space Defense After Russia Nuclear Report
stories.label: Russian nuclear weapon in space deployment warning

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/26/what-would-be-the-fallout-from-a-nuclear-armed-satellite-detonated-into-space) reported that reports indicate Russia has assembled a nuclear-enabled satellite named Sputnik-S that could be launched in 60 days.

On 25 Nov 2026, [OilPrice](https://oilprice.com/Geopolitics/Europe/Could-Russias-Secret-Space-Weapon-Knock-Out-Starlink.html) reported that reports emerged that Russia is planning to launch a nuclear-armed satellite named Sputnik-S into space in the coming weeks.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/25/europe-tonight-russia-reportedly-prepares-nuclear-satellite-launch) reported that former NATO spokesperson Jamie Shea discussed reports of Russia preparing a nuclear satellite launch and its potential impact on satellite systems.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Pakistan Today](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixAFBVV95cUxOeFZfcUtRZnRGWmhSQnJhbDNWeE9vNFI2clBnS1NobkVNNTRYeGFlM1d3VzFQZEZoMS1BRHVRUG9kR1RuV1Q3eFZrcTk5QWZvOG00N2YzaVY3eXpHSTBZRUJETEs1YUhuZlVRSGQ4UHMtOHJ4eGV5eXIzNHI0Yng4Mzg1M19MN2N6bUVCQlQ4Q0VyWWpUTVBiSmpPTkZxbGoyRkhWRnd4SzcwOXREQzJZMjMzRE10X1VHSlhFRHZoZTdUTFBL?oc=5), [Defense News](https://www.defensenews.com/global/europe/2026/11/24/russia-may-launch-nuke-laden-satellite-by-years-end-german-report-warns/) reported that Western intelligence and a German report warn Russia could launch a nuclear-armed satellite by December or the end of the year.

On 24 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/what-happens-if-a-nuclear-weapon-explodes-in-space/a-80025827?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf), [RFE/RL](https://www.rferl.org/a/russia-sputnik-s-space-nuclear-weapons-reports-starfish-prime-emp/33905092.html) reported that reports have emerged regarding Russia potentially preparing to launch a nuclear satellite into orbit, prompting analysis of radiation effects on satellites.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/nato-chief-says-defense-pledge-covers-space-as-russia-reportedly-readies-nuclear-satellite-3725924) reported that German Chancellor Friedrich Merz stated reports of a possible Russian nuclear-armed satellite deployment are concerning.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/24/8064317/) reported that NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte reaffirmed the alliance's commitment to protecting its members against threats in space.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/medvedev-says-russia-has-right-in-some-cases-obligation-to-use-nuclear-weapons-3725901) reported that Russian Security Council Deputy Chairman Dmitry Medvedev stated Moscow has not seen a direct necessity to use nuclear weapons so far in the Ukraine war.

On 24 Nov 2026, [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c9x2er1ry2mzo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that German media said Russia planned to launch a satellite with a nuclear warhead into space in coming weeks.

On 23 Nov 2026, [The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/24/world/politics/russia-nuclear-space-weapon/) reported that allies stated Russia may launch a nuclear space weapon next month that could lead to the rapid destruction or degradation of thousands of satellites.
On 23 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-915803) reported that NATO believes Russia is ready to launch a nuclear-armed satellite, according to German media.

On 23 Nov 2026, [The Moscow Times](https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/11/23/kremlin-dismisses-reports-about-alleged-nuclear-armed-satellite-launch-a94349) reported that the Kremlin dismissed reports about an alleged nuclear-armed satellite launch called Sputnik-S planned for as early as December 2026.

On 23 Nov 2026, [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/russia-central-asia/article/3375522/nato-vows-space-defence-after-russia-nuclear-satellite-report) reported that NATO chief Mark Rutte stated the alliance would defend against threats in space when asked about the German media reports.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/russia-preparing-to-put-nuclear-weapons-in-space-german-media-investigation-claims/) reported that a German media investigation claimed the Sputnik-S has been fully assembled and in storage in the Moscow region for several years.

On 23 Nov 2026, [The Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/world/europe/2026/11/23/pearl-harbor-in-space-russia-plans-to-launch-nuclear-warhead-say-german-reports/) reported that leaked intelligence regarding Russian plans to launch a nuclear warhead will add to European anxiety over widening threats.

On 23 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/russia-satellite-nuclear-weapon-space-b3089665.html) reported that the Pentagon warned a nuclear detonation in space could disrupt communications and security on Earth.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90920) reported that western intelligence and military officials believe Russia could launch a nuclear-armed satellite before the end of 2026 according to a joint German investigation.

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/politique/soupcon-de-fuites-vers-le-rn-le-procureur-surpris-au-siege-du-parti-a-admis-qu-il-avait-connaissance-de-l-affaire-20261126) reported that Paris deputy prosecutor Christian de Rocquigny admitted he had transmitted a reviewed and corrected report in late July regarding suspicions of leaks to the National Rally.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/societe/article/2026/11/25/le-prefet-du-loiret-hugues-moutouh-demis-de-ses-fonctions-apres-la-revelation-de-soupcons-de-fuites-emanant-du-ministere-de-l-interieur-vers-le-rn_6815167_3224.html) reported that Loiret prefect Hugues Moutouh was dismissed from his post during a Council of Ministers meeting following suspicions of leaks from the Interior Ministry to the National Rally, and was replaced by Pierre Ory.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/politique/article/2026/11/25/budget-sebastien-lecornu-assure-qu-il-n-a-pas-de-volonte-de-passage-en-force-et-appelle-au-compromis_6815129_823448.html) reported that French Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu assured he has no intention of forcing legislation through and called for compromise with no red lines.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/actualite-france/ils-ne-me-font-pas-peur-le-prefet-demissionnaire-hugues-moutouh-veut-rendre-coup-pour-coup-20261125) reported that outgoing Loiret prefect Hugues Moutouh stated that he is not afraid and wants to fight back, as he believes he is the victim of a political operation.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/politique/article/2026/11/24/budget-un-premier-texte-adopte-par-le-parlement-sebastien-lecornu-reve-desormais-d-un-compromis-pour-2027_6814842_823448.html) reported that Parliament validated the management closure law for 2026.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/politique/budget-sebastien-lecornu-tend-la-main-aux-parlementaires-pour-un-compromis-sans-toucher-au-deficit-20261124) reported that Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu announced he will receive parliamentary group presidents next week to continue budget discussions.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/politique/soupcons-de-fuites-vers-le-rn-c-est-un-lynchage-mediatique-qui-est-commande-le-prefet-hugues-moutouh-annonce-deposer-plainte-20261123) reported that Central-Val de Loire prefect Hugues Moutouh, suspected of leaking investigation information to the National Rally, announced he is filing a complaint.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/politique/soupcons-de-fuites-au-profit-du-rn-un-mail-du-service-du-prefet-hugues-moutouh-decouvert-en-perquisition-chez-un-proche-de-marine-le-pen-20261122) reported that investigators discovered an email from the service of prefect Hugues Moutouh during a search at an associate of Marine Le Pen.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/politique/soupcons-de-fuites-vers-le-rn-marine-le-pen-dit-n-avoir-jamais-recu-d-information-confidentielle-de-la-part-du-prefet-hugues-moutouh-20261122) reported that Marine Le Pen stated she never received confidential information from prefect Hugues Moutouh.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/societe/article/2026/11/21/hugues-moutouh-le-prefet-soupconne-de-fuites-d-informations-confidentielles-vers-le-rn-a-demande-a-etre-releve-de-ses-fonctions_6814056_3224.html) reported that prefect Hugues Moutouh, suspected of leaking confidential information to the National Rally, asked to be relieved of his duties.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/actualite-france/soupcons-de-fuites-au-profit-du-rn-le-prefet-hugues-moutouh-dans-la-tempete-20261120) reported that Hugues Moutouh was summoned by Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez regarding suspicions he informed the National Rally on ongoing cases.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/actualite-france/en-direct-colere-sociale-laurent-nunez-appelle-les-prefets-a-la-vigilance-20261121) reported that Laurent Nuñez called on prefects to be vigilant ahead of a sixth day of social mobilization.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/societe/article/2026/11/20/fuites-en-provenance-du-ministere-de-l-interieur-vers-le-rn-des-faits-extremement-graves-s-ils-sont-averes-juge-laurent-nunez_6813604_3224.html), [Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/actualite-france/soupcons-de-fuites-au-profit-du-rn-si-les-faits-concernant-le-prefet-moutouh-sont-averes-ils-sont-tres-graves-reagit-laurent-nunez-20261120) reported that judicial authorities are investigating suspected leaks of ongoing investigation elements concerning the National Rally from the interior ministry, prompting Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez to call the facts extremely grave if proven.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/conjoncture/un-peu-plus-d-un-milliard-d-euros-le-cout-de-la-hausse-du-smic-et-des-bas-salaires-des-fonctionnaires-devoile-par-le-gouvernement-20261115), [Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/politique/article/2026/11/15/les-revalorisations-du-smic-et-des-bas-salaires-des-fonctionnaires-couteront-un-peu-plus-de-1-milliard-d-euros-aux-finances-publiques-selon-le-gouvernement_6811009_823448.html) reported that Public Accounts Minister David Amiel stated that the revaluation of the minimum wage and civil service low salaries will cost public finances just over 1 billion euros, impacting public service expenditures.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/politique/article/2026/11/13/salaires-des-fonctionnaires-les-mesures-d-urgence-du-gouvernement-jugees-insuffisantes-par-les-syndicats_6809348_823448.html) reported that trade unions deemed the French government's emergency measures regarding civil service salaries to be insufficient.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/politique/article/2026/11/13/mobilisations-sociales-sebastien-lecornu-ouvre-une-discussion-d-un-mois-avec-les-syndicats_6809324_823448.html) reported that Sébastien Lecornu opened a month-long discussion with civil service unions, following which the CFDT announced it will join a public strike and mobilization.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/actualite-france/ne-pas-baisser-la-garde-laurent-nunez-promet-un-gros-dispositif-reactif-et-percutant-pour-un-nouveau-samedi-de-colere-sociale-a-hauts-risques-20261113) reported that Laurent Nuñez promised a large security deployment for a new Saturday of social unrest.

reports.text: On 25 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/world/2224959) reported that US special envoy Jared Kushner stated Zelensky should speak more respectfully to Trump to secure security guarantees and that the White House may consider providing them if the right architecture is developed.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/25/zelensky-says-u-s-wants-peace-deal-by-january-trump-says-he-has-no-timeline-for-ending-war), [RT](https://rt-english.com/news/649338-trump-zelensky-peace-deadline/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS) reported that US President Donald Trump stated he is not under a timeline for ending the Russia-Ukraine war, responding to comments from Volodymyr Zelenskyy.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/25/8064529/) reported that US President Donald Trump responded to Volodymyr Zelenskyy's comments about peace agreement efforts by January, stating that ending the war depends on the parties involved.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/91101) reported that President Volodymyr Zelensky stated Ukraine would turn to the incoming Democrat-controlled US Congress if President Donald Trump's diplomatic efforts fail to end the war.

On 24 Nov 2026, [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/china/diplomacy/article/3375637/why-did-china-choose-retired-diplomat-welcome-sanae-takaichi-apec) reported that when Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi arrived and left the APEC host city Shenzhen, retired diplomat Zhang Qiyue greeted her on the red carpet.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4188059-zelensky-to-reach-out-to-new-us-congress-if-trump-fails-to-reach-deal-with-putin-to-end-war.html) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky plans to reach out to the new U.S. Congress to intensify pressure on Russia if Donald Trump fails to secure a deal.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Military.com](https://www.military.com/zelenskyy-wants-congress-to-pressure-putin-if-trump-cant-win-deal) reported that Ukraine will seek increased U.S. military aid and tougher sanctions if no acceptable peace deal is reached.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Arab News](https://www.arabnews.com/world/zelensky-says-china-summit-was-very-unsuccessful-for-russia-3013395) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky stated that the trilateral summit between the leaders of China, Russia, and the United States was very unsuccessful for Russia.

On 21 Nov 2026, [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/zelenskiy-says-china-summit-was-very-unsuccessful-for-russia/article71728572.ece), [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-915639) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy stated the summit between the US, Russia, and China was very unsuccessful for Vladimir Putin.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/trump-briefs-japans-takaichi-on-summit-with-chinas-xi-russias-putin-3725799) reported that Donald Trump told Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi about his trilateral summit with Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin in a 20-minute phone call.

On 20 Nov 2026, [The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/20/japan/politics/takaichi-xi-japan-china-protocol-analysis/) reported that a chilly reception for Takaichi at the APEC summit reflected China's growing strength and overshadowed dialogue attempts.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipgFBVV95cUxPX0R2ZlRoWHI5ZXpmMVFiWjRfLTBpXzNSek5GNmlOXzZzSVFkbERmWWF0TV9KdXE4R0hvTWZLN0FHWHpIaWJOdjBvQmR2SDNKUGNUSTFzNFBnS0g2LWdheXpMQy1pUGZmYkQwZE5iSnZNblM0bzI0R3NBc2dXck9TYktOX01nd01pTlNJdXBhbGtEdXpKWC1lamhsMGRJaUdpU0dXWDBR?oc=5), [Nikkei Asia](https://asia.nikkei.com/politics/international-relations/apec/apec-live-takaichi-says-japan-s-position-on-taiwan-remains-the-same) reported that Japanese Prime Minister Takaichi stated Japan's position on Taiwan has not changed.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilwFBVV95cUxPQkc0NXN2SVJPZXRqZFBwdWgtVkFCX1phSkRQSlNuM182U2t2aDRvVUNMSGduYl9veTV4cTdZQldnWVk1WUdaS2pnU1NCMFpxbUZ0N0pGMFAtZ3ZBRkUzTTFjV08wZXN5S2hqZ1U5Vk80ZUdzNDVUSHlqeWxTQVJKUlBvZGpJU29UVUljOHNITW42d2ZrczNv?oc=5) reported that Japanese Prime Minister Takaichi stated Russia and Japan will keep talking as ties remain chilled.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqAFBVV95cUxQOGFYWEJrZkpsMjh1dWNROWxsODdhQzUxYmR2WEhqNFIxRjNLM2l6QWlNZ2lHSlFIeGhQQnJBQTN4MGNpVXBIVkxSU1lLOVZkTk9LRXJfb0RDeXJKaFM5X245bFg5WnQ0WEtQQktxSzhGbjNPMVNFRmNLb25zM1JqcUE1Z1dFSXRjSjJUS1hzZXpEREFiejN4V1dWc05kbnA5Yi1sUjBUcjU?oc=5) reported that Japan stated Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi and Vladimir Putin held talks at the APEC summit in China.

On 18 Nov 2026, [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/week-asia/people/article/3374747/japans-takaichi-faces-icy-apec-summit-support-china-policy-slides) reported that Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi arrived at the Apec summit in Shenzhen with public backing for her China policy at its lowest since taking office.

On 13 Nov 2026, [CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/east-asia/japan-sanae-takaichi-first-china-trip-apec-summit-6548471) reported that Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi will attend the APEC summit in her first trip to China since taking office.

reports.text: On 25 Nov 2026, [Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/afrique/article/2026/11/25/comment-l-ukraine-perturbe-les-operations-russes-en-afrique-en-frappant-des-navires-de-transport-d-armes-en-mediterranee_6815117_3212.html) reported that Ukrainian naval drones attacked two Russian ships in Libyan waters on Sunday, November 22.

On 25 Nov 2026, [La Presse (Tunisia)](https://www.lapresse.tn/2026/11/25/benghazi-deux-soldats-libyens-tues-lors-des-attaques-ukrainiennes-contre-des-navires-russes/) reported that two Libyan soldiers were killed in attacks attributed to Ukraine against Russian ships off Benghazi.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/international/navires-russes-attaques-dans-les-eaux-libyennes-deux-militaires-libyens-succombent-a-leurs-blessures-20261125) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky claimed responsibility for attacks near Benghazi in which a corvette sank and a cargo ship was hit.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/international/live/2026/11/24/en-direct-guerre-en-ukraine-navires-russes-pris-pour-cibles-en-libye-l-italie-exprime-son-inquietude-a-l-ukraine_6814183_3210.html) reported that Italian Foreign Minister Antonio Tajani expressed concern to Ukraine over Russian ships targeted in Libya and emphasized the importance of avoiding the extension of the conflict to the Mediterranean.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Al Wihda (Chad)](https://www.alwihdainfo.com/libye-lunion-africaine-met-en-garde-contre-les-ingerences-exterieures/) reported that the African Union Commission president demanded an independent investigation and called for restraint following recent attacks signaled in the port of Benghazi.

On 24 Nov 2026, [La Presse (Tunisia)](https://www.lapresse.tn/2026/11/24/suite-aux-attaques-aux-drones-contre-le-port-de-benghazi-le-gouvernement-libyen-refuse-que-la-libye-soit-entrainee-dans-des-conflits-exterieurs/) reported that the Libyan government will file an official complaint with the United Nations and Security Council following the attacks against the port of Benghazi.

On 23 Nov 2026, [RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/fr/europe/20261123-direct-l-ukraine-dit-avoir-attaqu%C3%A9-deux-bateaux-russes-pr%C3%A8s-des-c%C3%B4tes-de-la-libye) reported that Russian strikes in the Kyiv region killed at least 15 people overnight, including 11 in a collapsed building.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/international/live/2026/11/23/en-direct-guerre-en-ukraine-un-cargo-russe-pris-pour-cible-dans-le-golfe-de-finlande-le-kremlin-denonce-l-expansion-de-l-activite-terroriste-en-mer-baltique_6814183_3210.html) reported that a Russian cargo ship was targeted in the Gulf of Finland while Russian bombardments killed three people in Zaporizhzhia and two in Kramatorsk.

On 23 Nov 2026, [RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/fr/podcasts/invit%C3%A9-afrique-midi/20261123-les-attaques-contre-des-navires-russes-%C3%A0-benghazi-mettent-en-difficult%C3%A9-la-strat%C3%A9gie-africaine-de-moscou), a French-language international outlet, reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky claimed responsibility for attacks against two Russian ships in Benghazi.

On 23 Nov 2026, [La Presse (Tunisia)](https://www.lapresse.tn/2026/11/23/zelensky-revendique-lattaque-contre-deux-navires-russes-au-large-des-cotes-libyennes/) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy claimed responsibility for an attack targeting two Russian ships off the coast of Libya.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/international/live/2026/11/22/en-direct-guerre-en-ukraine-les-secours-poursuivent-leurs-interventions-apres-l-attaque-d-un-immeuble-d-habitation-par-un-drone-russe-pres-de-kiev_6814183_3210.html) reported that an attack by a Russian drone on a five-story residential building in Dymer near Kyiv killed two people.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/international/la-corvette-a-ete-coulee-l-ukraine-revendique-deux-attaques-contre-des-navires-russes-au-large-de-la-libye-20261123) reported that Ukraine claimed two attacks against Russian ships off the coast of Libya using seven Ukrainian-manufactured maritime drones.

On 22 Nov 2026, [RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/fr/afrique/20261122-libye-deux-navires-dont-un-russe-attaqu%C3%A9s-pr%C3%A8s-de-benghazi), [Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/international/live/2026/11/22/en-direct-guerre-en-ukraine-deux-navires-dont-un-russe-cibles-par-des-attaques-de-drones-a-benghazi-en-libye-selon-les-autorites-locales_6814183_3210.html) reported that eastern Libyan authorities announced a second ship was targeted by a drone attack off Benghazi.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/international/libye-explosion-sur-un-navire-russe-dans-le-port-de-benghazi-apres-une-probable-attaque-de-drones-20261122) reported that a Russian ship en route to Russia caught fire in the port of Benghazi after a probable drone attack while making a refueling stop.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/international/live/2026/11/22/en-direct-guerre-en-ukraine-un-cargo-russe-attaque-en-mer-baltique-des-drones-ukrainiens-produits-au-royaume-uni-les-dernieres-informations_6814183_3210.html) reported that Ukrainian Defence Minister Ievheni Khmara and British counterpart Wes Streeting signed new agreements allowing production of British-designed Ukrainian drones in the UK.

On 20 Nov 2026, [La Presse (Tunisia)](https://www.lapresse.tn/2026/11/20/guerre-russo-ukrainienne-moscou-promet-des-represailles-aux-frappes-de-kiev-contre-le-pont-de-crimee/) reported that Vladimir Putin promised even more painful reprisals in response to Ukrainian strikes against the Crimean Bridge.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/international/article/2026/11/20/l-ukraine-mise-sur-l-isolement-strategique-de-la-crimee-occupee_6813616_3210.html) reported that a series of Ukrainian strikes on the Crimean bridge heavily damaged the structure.

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/svijet/donald-trump-na-tradicionalan-nacin-cestitao-dan-zahvalnosti-vrijedao-politicke-protivnike-spominjao-i-serijat/261126261) reported that US President Donald Trump published a Thanksgiving message on Truth Social insulting political opponents and mentioning Sharia.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/becirovic-i-filipovic-u-predsjednistvu-bih-organizovali-svecanost-povodom-dana-drzavnosti-stigle-brojne-zvanice/261125184) reported that Presidency members Denis Bećirović and Darijana Filipović hosted a formal reception in the Presidency building for Statehood Day, where Filipović stated that compromise is not betrayal.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/dijaspora/dan-drzavnosti-bosne-i-hercegovine-obiljezen-u-pragu-priznanje-dobio-i-amar-memic/261125160) reported that the embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in the Czech Republic marked Statehood Day in Prague and honored football player Amar Memić.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/kongresmen-wesley-bell-cestitao-dan-drzavnosti-bih-je-domovina-svih-njenih-ljudi/261125196) reported that US Congressman Wesley Bell congratulated Bosnia and Herzegovina on its Statehood Day.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/magazin/zanimljivosti/japanski-tiktoker-yuji-beleza-cestitao-dan-drzavnosti-bih-na-bosanskom-jeziku-sretan-25-novembar/261125222) reported that Japanese TikToker Yuji Beleza congratulated citizens in the Bosnian language.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/dragan-covic-cestitao-dan-drzavnosti-bosna-i-hercegovina-je-nasa-domovina-i-nas-dom/261125061), [Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/bih/1090827/covic-cestitao-dan-drzavnosti-bih-bosna-i-hercegovina-je-nasa-domovina-nas-dom) reported that HDZ BiH leader Dragan Čović issued a public congratulatory message celebrating Bosnia and Herzegovina's Statehood Day.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/becirovic-zavnobih-je-majka-nase-drzavnosti-bosna-i-hercegovina-je-nedjeljiva-drzava/261125188) reported that Presidency member Denis Bećirović delivered an address at a reception held in the presidency building for Statehood Day.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/dijaspora/spektakularan-prizor-u-kanadi-nijagarini-vodopadi-obasjani-u-cast-dana-drzavnosti-bih/261125042) reported that Niagara Falls in Canada was illuminated in yellow, blue, and white in honor of Bosnia and Herzegovina's Statehood Day.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/polozeno-cvijece-na-vise-lokacija-u-sarajevu-povodom-dana-drzavnosti-bih-ovo-je-drzava-svih-gradana/261125062) reported that delegations laid flowers at multiple locations in Sarajevo for Statehood Day, including the Eternal Flame and Kovači cemetery.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/kvadovi-prodefilovali-sarajevom-povodom-dana-drzavnosti-bih-zastave-dim-i-baklje-upotpunili-dogadaj/261125069) reported that quad bikes flying Bosnia and Herzegovina and RBiH flags paraded through Sarajevo for Statehood Day.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/bih/1090782/video-ceremonijom-podizanja-zastave-bih-na-brdu-hum-pocelo-obiljezavanje-dana-drzavnosti) reported that the marking of Statehood Day began with the raising of the flag of Bosnia and Herzegovina on Hum hill, with attendees including Presidency member Denis Bećirović.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/rubio-cestitao-dan-drzavnosti-bih-radujemo-se-saradnji-s-liderima-koje-ste-izabrali-u-oktobru/261125023) reported that U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio congratulated citizens of Bosnia and Herzegovina on their Statehood Day.

reports.text: On 25 Nov 2026, [The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2642283/us-cia-odni-suffer-cybersecurity-breach-of-some-unclassified-information-source-says) reported that unclassified information at other government agencies is also believed to have been exposed in the CIA and ODNI cybersecurity breach.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/us-treasury-departments-financial-crimes-enforcement-network-probes-cybersecurity-incident-after-reports-of-cia-odni-breaches-101795581239336.html) reported that the US Treasury Department's Financial Crimes Enforcement Network is probing a cybersecurity incident following reports of CIA and ODNI breaches.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Times of Malta](https://timesofmalta.com/article/unclassified-info-exposed-cia-cybersecurity-breach-report.1137618) reported that unclassified information was exposed in a CIA cybersecurity breach.

On 25 Nov 2026, [MercoPress](https://en.mercopress.com/2026/11/25/cia-and-us-intelligence-office-suffer-intrusion-exposing-unclassified-information?utm_source=feed&utm_medium=rss&utm_content=main&utm_campaign=rss) reported that the Central Intelligence Agency and the US Office of the Director of National Intelligence discovered a computer intrusion that exposed unclassified information.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/svijet/hakeri-prodrli-u-mrezu-cia-e-i-americkih-obavjestajaca-otkriveno-sta-su-trazili/) reported that hackers penetrated the network of the CIA and American intelligence personnel.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/svijet/novi-cybernapad-hakeri-upali-u-sistem-cia-e-i-ureda-sefa-americkih-obavjestajaca/261124326) reported that the Central Intelligence Agency and the Office of the Director of National Intelligence discovered a cyber attack exposing part of their systems.

On 24 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/la-cia-sufrio-una-intrusion-informatica-que-expuso-informacion-no-clasificada-segun-nyt-33294668) reported that US officials indicated the CIA suffered an information technology intrusion that exposed unclassified information.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimwFBVV95cUxORFJXS0ZrRlpQVzZydVYtcFMzeVpIYU1UeThIZzFsZkt0Y2dSeEszT3g5eWpqSk9UTnhFb0RYbFlrX1hDczI5cmk5XzRIdzZ5eDI1d0J2M2hwV2lnSG5xUjdBYk03V3k4Y1plVkpuTU41V21ZRGxHYkt0VlhvUjlKNlh4QnpRWWcxOFFQb1gwSmFTNkFheHFFWFdTRQ?oc=5) reported that a source stated an unclassified CIA system was breached in a cyberattack.

On 24 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/cia-cyber-attack-dni-breach-fbi-b3090993.html) reported that the CIA system breach comes days after an FBI crime database was hacked.

On 24 Nov 2026, [TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/472842593948), a state-media outlet, reported that the attack targeted an open-source intelligence network aggregating public material, social media content, satellite imagery, and commercially purchased data.

On 24 Nov 2026, [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/24/us/politics/spy-agencies-computer-network-breaches.html) reported that U.S. spy agencies suffered a breach of some unclassified information, affecting the C.I.A. and the Office of the Director of National Intelligence.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/us-intelligence-agencies-cia-and-odni-hit-by-cybersecurity-breach-unclassified-data-exposed-report-101795549890380.html) reported that the breach targeted a network used to identify intelligence insights from publicly available, unclassified information.

On 24 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-916018) reported that while compromised unclassified material was unclear, information at other government agencies was also believed to have been exposed.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Yonhap](https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20261122002700315), [The Korea Herald](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10945222) reported that the Korea Electric Power Corp. confirmed a data breach exposing personal information of approximately 1.52 million users.

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1743375-new-twist-atiku-told-delay-2027-election-presidential-bid/) reported that fresh counsel emerged urging ADC's Atiku Abubakar to delay his presidential ambition ahead of the 2027 general elections in Nigeria.

On 25 Nov 2026, [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/25/tinubu-celebrates-atiku-at-80-recalls-support-for-his-2007-presidential-bid/), [Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/927950-tinubu-celebrates-atiku-abubakar-at-80-recalls-support-for-ex-vps-2007-presidential-bid.html), [The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/political-differences-must-not-undermine-national-unity-tinubu-hails-atiku-at-80-recalls-support-for-2007-presidential-bid/) reported that President Bola Tinubu congratulated former Vice President Atiku Abubakar on his 80th birthday, recalling support for his 2007 presidential bid and declaring that political differences must not undermine national unity.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/2027-court-grants-inec-leave-to-amend-defence-in-doctors-suit/) reported that Justice Peter Kekemeke of the High Court of the Federal Capital Territory granted the Independent National Electoral Commission leave to amend its defence in a doctor's suit.

On 14 Nov 2026, [ABC Australia](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-15/climate-ambition-political-reality-cop31-albanese/107383424) reported that Australia's efforts at the UN climate change conference expose contradictions between its climate ambition and political reality.

On 14 Nov 2026, [ABC Australia](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-14/anthony-albanese-chris-bowen-hot-mic-gaffe-cop-31-climate-summit/107385964) reported that the Prime Minister's office stated Anthony Albanese and Chris Bowen were sharing a joke when a private conversation was inadvertently recorded at the COP31 summit.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/national/prime-minister-caught-in-hot-mic-moment-at-cop31-20261114-p61e68.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that Anthony Albanese and Chris Bowen were caught on camera joking about phone radiation and private parts during a break at the COP31 summit.

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/hronika/Oric-Sljiviceva-i-ostali-sprovedeni-u-KPZ-Banjaluka-Sud-obrazlozio-odluku-o-pritvoru/994438) reported that Naser Orić, Nikolina Šljivić, and others arrested in the 'Emisar' operation were brought to the Banja Luka penitentiary.

stories.title: Tinubu seeks reduction of 2026 budget to N65.176trn; Senate approves N10.79trn loan

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/26/house-approves-tinubus-28-2bn-e1-04bn-external-borrowing-requests/) reported that the House of Representatives approved external borrowing totalling $28,225,160,783.49 and €1,045,083,643.

On 25 Nov 2026, [AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611250175.html) reported that Nigerian senators approved loan requests previously withdrawn by President Bola Tinubu after considering a report from the Senate Committee on Local and Foreign Debts.

On 25 Nov 2026, [The Authority (Nigeria)](https://authorityngr.com/2026/11/25/tinubu-seeks-reps-approval-to-scrap-268-obsolete-federal-laws/) reported that President Bola Tinubu asked the House of Representatives to approve a revised compendium to repeal and scrap 268 obsolete federal laws.

On 25 Nov 2026, [The Authority (Nigeria)](https://authorityngr.com/2026/11/25/tinubu-seeks-reps-approval-for-n330bn-promissory-notes-to-settle-fg-debts/) reported that President Bola Tinubu asked the House of Representatives to approve the issuance of N330.08 billion in promissory notes to settle verified obligations.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/tinubu-seeks-reduction-of-2026-budget-to-n65-176trn-senate-approves-n10-79trn-loan/) reported that Tinubu reduced the 2026 budget from N68.3trn to N66.1trn while retaining the N31.4 trillion deficit and the N29.2 trillion borrowing plan.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/tinubu-seeks-reps-approval-of-reviewed-664-federal-laws-731-subsidiary-legislations/) reported that President Bola Tinubu sought the approval of the House of Representatives for the reviewed 664 federal laws and 731 subsidiary legislations.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/tinubu-seeks-reps-approval-for-n65-17tn-revised-2026-budget/) reported that aggregate expenditure stands at N65.176tn under the revised fiscal framework, down from N68.323tn.
On 24 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/tinubu-seeks-reps-approval-to-remove-268-obsolete-laws/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the revision removes 268 obsolete laws.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/headlines/927778-senate-approves-loan-requests-tinubu-withdrew.html) reported that the Senate approved loan requests presented by the Senate Committee on Local and Foreign Debts.

On 24 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/tinubu-seeks-%e2%82%a63-15tn-cut-in-2026-budget-retains-%e2%82%a631-46tn-deficit/) reported that President Bola Tinubu asked the National Assembly to approve a reduction of 3.15 trillion naira in the 2026 national budget, bringing proposed expenditure down while retaining a 31.46 trillion naira deficit.

stories.title: Mexico City General Development Plan debate

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/metropoli/reconoce-el-plan-general-de-desarrollo-el-derecho-del-cuidado/) reported that the General Development Plan document proposes a public system with services and infrastructure directed at children, older adults, people with disabilities, and priority groups.

On 24 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/metropoli/pan-en-congreso-cdmx-pide-3-meses-de-parlamento-abierto-para-analizar-plan-general-de-desarrollo-es-indispensable-que-ciudadania-lo-conozca/) reported that PAN in the Mexico City Congress requested a 3-month open parliament to analyze the General Development Plan.

On 25 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/metropoli/cesar-cravioto-califica-como-montaje-acusaciones-en-su-contra-tras-violencia-en-congreso-cdmx-pan-exige-su-renuncia/) reported that César Cravioto denied accusations of violence against him in the Mexico City Congress, calling them a montage, while the PAN demanded his resignation.

On 24 Nov 2026, [La Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/2026/11/24/capital/027n2cap?partner=rss) reported that as part of the General Development Plan discussion, the Iztapalapa mayor's office will deliver a study to the capital's Congress to regularize 28 settlements.

On 19 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/metropoli/congreso-cdmx-realizara-parlamento-abierto-sobre-plan-general-de-desarrollo-buscan-exponer-alcances-asi-como-recoger-opiniones-y-propuestas/) reported that Mexico City's congressional Jucopo president Xóchitl Bravo stated the General Development Plan sent to the local legislative power is a project and not the final document, and announced an open parliament to gather opinions and proposals.

On 18 Nov 2026, [La Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/2026/11/18/capital/030n2cap?partner=rss) reported that members of towns and neighborhoods of Mexico City alerted about modifications made to the general development plan project sent to Congress.

On 13 Nov 2026, [El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/politica/mininterior-alejandro-ordonez-radico-bases-del-plan-de-desarrollo) reported that Interior Minister Alejandro Ordoñez filed the bases of the Development Plan before Congress.

On 14 Nov 2026, [El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/politica/congreso-arranca-analisis-de-las-bases-del-plan-nacional-de-desarrollo) reported that the Congress planning commission has until January to issue its concept on the National Development Plan.

On 14 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/metropoli/titular-de-metropolis-pide-a-fuerzas-politicas-tener-dialogo-de-altura-por-plan-general-de-desarrollo-documento-ha-sido-bien-cuidado-considera/) reported that the head of Metrópolis called on political forces to have a high-level dialogue regarding the General Development Plan during an appearance before the local Congress.

On 12 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/metropoli/morena-acelera-ruta-legislativa-para-aprobar-plan-general-de-desarrollo-en-cdmx-33105225) reported that Morena is accelerating the legislative path to approve the General Development Plan.

On 12 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/metropoli/diputada-local-del-pan-asegura-que-no-tendran-prisa-por-aprobar-el-plan-de-desarrollo-este-ano-exige-consulta-ciudadana/) reported that a local PAN deputy demanded a citizen consultation and questioned land acquisition policies in the plan.

On 12 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/metropoli/plan-general-de-desarrollo-sera-aprobado-antes-del-15-de-diciembre-morena-cdmx-sera-el-regalo-de-navidad-para-nuestra-ciudad-dicen/) reported that Morena CDMX stated the plan will be approved before December 15 without entering a new public consultation process.

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [Yonhap](https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20261126012000320) reported that South Korean President Lee Jae Myung approved confirmation hearing requests for ministerial and spy chief nominees.

On 25 Nov 2026, [The Korea Herald](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10949442) reported that the US State Department reaffirmed the importance of its alliance with South Korea following President Lee Jae Myung's replacement of three key foreign policy and security officials.
On 25 Nov 2026, [Yonhap](https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20261125002100320) reported that exports of South Korean beauty, food, fashion, and culture hit a record high.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Yonhap](https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20261125000200315) reported that the US State Department stressed alliance cooperation following South Korea's appointment of new foreign and unification ministers and a spy chief.

On 23 Nov 2026, [The Korea Herald](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10945683) reported that South Korea's exports more than doubled during the first 20 days of November, with semiconductor shipments surging to a record high.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Yonhap](https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20261119007251315) reported that Unification Minister Chung Dong-young and US Ambassador met and reaffirmed the alliance as key to peace in their first talks.

On 19 Nov 2026, [The Korea Herald](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10943146) reported that semiconductors were the driving force behind South Korea's first $1 trillion in annual exports, as surging demand for AI memory chips and rising prices fueled the milestone.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivgFBVV95cUxQYjJyUW83NEllOTVXWDNHUnY0UW85MjF2dzVVQ1NxOVBGaW1EY0trbjRZZU5zZWFLUnZnQ1RGUkhiM3ZmZVA2VUxZNm5UQlpJR2F2OXotX0EzOUJJdHNkZlhCUXVnM2xqaEZ1Zmh6R19sSmUyelZzSVJSSkVTZHBvd2ZUQkNJOFZPaEZ6amhLd1BGWlcxd2M4N0pLa0J5Z28taFE2M293Z1puMWViY3FhZDh6WXd4SjFsNzg0dkZ3?oc=5) reported that South Korea became the fourth country globally to hit $1 trillion in exports on an AI chip boom.
On 19 Nov 2026, [The Korea Herald](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10942838) reported that South Korea joined Germany, the US, and China in reaching the milestone.

stories.title: Again, Brent Falls Below $90 as Iran Vows to Breach US Blockade
stories.label: Iran oil tanker convoy at Kharg Island

reports.text: On 23 Nov 2026, [IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86330512/Land-blockade-of-Iran-is-impossible-Araghchi), a state-media outlet, reported that Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi stated a land blockade of Iran is impossible given the country's size and extensive ties with neighboring countries.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Hasht-e Subh](https://8am.media/eng/araghchi-a-land-blockade-of-iran-is-almost-impossible/) reported that Iranian Foreign Minister Seyed Abbas Araghchi said imposing a land blockade on Iran is almost impossible because of its vast size and connections.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Echorouk](https://www.echoroukonline.com/%d9%85%d9%86%d8%b8%d9%85%d8%a9-%d8%a7%d9%84%d8%b5%d8%ad%d8%a9-%d8%a7%d9%84%d8%b9%d8%a7%d9%84%d9%85%d9%8a%d8%a9-%d8%aa%d8%ad%d8%b0%d9%91%d8%b1-4-%d9%81%d8%a6%d8%a7%d8%aa-%d8%a3%d9%83%d8%ab%d8%b1) reported that the World Health Organization warned of seasonal influenza risks and serious health complications leading to death for vulnerable groups.

reports.text: On 22 Nov 2026, [TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/e170364dd7eb) reported that Transport and Infrastructure Minister Abdulkadir Uraloglu stated that Turkey will issue a commemorative stamp honoring the KIZILELMA fighter jet to mark the first anniversary of its air-to-air missile test.
On 19 Nov 2026, [TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/cce2a2f0f270) reported that Turkish President Erdogan stated the Kizilelma unmanned fighter jet has joined the military inventory.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1584276/turkiye-hands-over-first-unmanned-fighter-jets-kizilelma-to-armed-forces/) reported that Turkiye officially handed over its first domestically produced unmanned fighter jets to the armed forces.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/turkeys-unmanned-kizilelma-fighter-jet-enters-military-service-what-know) reported that Turkey's unmanned Kizilelma fighter jet entered military service.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Anadolu Agency](https://www.aa.com.tr/tr/bilim-teknoloji/turkiye-nin-ilk-insansiz-savas-ucagi-kizilelma-envantere-girdi/4131193), [Sabah](https://www.sabah.com.tr/yasam/turkiye-kizilelmaya-kavustu-uc-kizilelma-envantere-girdi-7705258) reported that Turkey's first unmanned fighter jet, KIZILELMA, developed by Baykar, has entered the inventory of security forces after successfully completing acceptance tests.

stories.title: Tinubu: APC chieftain condemns attack on Rarara at Abuja mosque

reports.text: On 26 Nov 2026, [Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/more-news/928097-2027-apc-governorship-aspirant-warns-tinubu-over-alia-akume-rift.html) reported that a former Benue APC governorship aspirant accused Governor Hyacinth Alia of frustrating reconciliation efforts and urged President Bola Tinubu to enforce court judgments.

On 21 Nov 2026, [The Rio Times](https://www.riotimesonline.com/rarara-attacked-abuja-national-mosque/) reported that singer Rarara, a Tinubu supporter, was attacked by a crowd at Abuja's National Mosque.

On 21 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/2027-former-lp-presidential-candidate-condemns-attack-on-tinubu-praise-singer/) reported that former Labour Party factional presidential candidate Prince Kennedy Ahanotu strongly condemned the physical attack on Dauda Kahutu.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1742579-apc-chieftain-condemns-rararas-attack-abuja-mosque-warns-2027-elections/) reported that former Imo APC senatorial aspirant Belusochukwu Enwere condemned the attack on singer Rarara and urged security agencies to prevent political violence ahead of the 2027 elections.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/mob-attacks-tinubus-praise-singer-rarara-at-abuja-mosque/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Hausa musician Rarara was attacked by a mob at the National Mosque in Abuja, drawing condemnation from Kennedy Ahanotu and Paul Ibe.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1742532-breaking-mob-beats-tinubus-praise-singer-rarara-national-mosque-abuja-video-trends/) reported that President Bola Tinubu's praise singer Dauda Kahutu Rarara was reportedly beaten by a mob at the National Mosque in Abuja.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/tinubu-apc-chieftain-condemns-attack-on-rarara-at-abuja-mosque/) reported that an APC chieftain condemned the attack on Rarara at the Abuja mosque.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190589/%D8%B9%D8%B4%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%A2%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%81-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%81%D9%84%D8%B3%D8%B7%D9%8A%D9%86%D9%8A%D9%8A%D9%86-%D9%8A%D8%A4%D8%AF%D9%88%D9%86-%D8%B5%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AC%D9%85%D8%B9%D8%A9-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D9%82%D8%B5%D9%89) reported that tens of thousands of Palestinians performed Friday prayers at Al-Aqsa Mosque despite military barriers.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/925029-tinubu-booed-at-abuja-mosque-after-friday-prayers.html) reported that video clips showed people chanting slogans against President Tinubu as his convoy left an Abuja mosque after Friday prayers.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/estados-unidos/barein-afirma-que-ataque-de-iran-contra-sitio-industrial-civil-dejo-dos-heridos_0_I4F49PR0v4.html) reported that Bahrain stated an Iranian attack against a civil industrial site left two people injured.

On 24 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/24/israel-jail-palestinian-student-mahdi-tounsi-hebrew-university-without-trial) reported that Israel attempted to jail Palestinian student Mahdi Tounsi at Hebrew University without trial.

On 24 Nov 2026, [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/protests-jerusalem-after-palestinian-student-activists-arrest) reported that dozens of students and professors protested outside a Jerusalem court where a Palestinian student activist was tried after being arrested.

On 24 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/article-916010) reported that police stated the student was arrested under a court-issued warrant on suspicion of a connection to a terrorist act in an investigation conducted with the Shin Bet.

Gen. applauded the partnership with the Nigerian Army and sought sustained security during orientation exercise camp tours.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Authority (Nigeria)](https://authorityngr.com/2026/11/18/ndic-urges-corps-members-to-embrace-financial-discipline/) reported that the Nigeria Deposit Insurance Corporation urged corps members in Delta State to embrace financial discipline.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/nysc-pays-oyo-corps-members-delayed-allowances-blames-technical-glitch/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the National Youth Service Corps paid delayed October 2026 allowances to Oyo State corps members and blamed a technical glitch.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/more-news/925791-nysc-seeks-stronger-protection-for-corps-members-in-north-east.html) reported that the NYSC called for stronger security collaboration with the Nigerian Army to protect corps members serving in the North-east.

On 17 Nov 2026, [The Authority (Nigeria)](https://authorityngr.com/2026/11/17/reciprocate-youth-corps-contributions-to-states-with-befitting-orientation-camps-accommodation-lp-lawmaker-tells-governors/) reported that Benue State Labour Party leader Hon. Philip Agbese called on state governors to reciprocate Youth Corps contributions with orientation camps and accommodation.

On 16 Nov 2026, [The Authority (Nigeria)](https://authorityngr.com/2026/11/16/nysc-seeks-army-protection-for-corps-members-during-2027-polls/) reported that National Youth Service Corps Director-General Brigadier General Olakunle Nafiu sought Army protection for corps members during the 2027 polls.

On 15 Nov 2026, [The Authority (Nigeria)](https://authorityngr.com/2026/11/15/nysc-boss-urges-corps-members-to-embrace-vocational-skills-for-self-reliance/) reported that National Youth Service Corps Director-General Brigadier General Olakunle Nafiu urged corps members to embrace vocational skills.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/nysc-records-more-female-corps-members-since-2021-dg/) reported that the National Youth Service Corps has recorded a higher number of female corps members than males since 2021.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/gombe-gets-ultra-modern-nysc-permanent-orientation-camp/) reported that Gombe State Governor Muhammadu Inuwa Yahaya completed the construction of an ultra-modern permanent NYSC orientation camp in Boltongo.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/2027-nysc-dg-seeks-security-for-corps-members/) reported that NYSC Director-General Brigadier General Olakunle Nafiu solicited the support of the Nigerian Army in ensuring security for corps members.

On 12 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/nysc-dg-urges-state-governors-to-expand-orientation-camps/) reported that NYSC Director-General Brigadier General Olakunle Nafiu appealed to state governors to expand orientation camps.

On 12 Nov 2026, [The Authority (Nigeria)](https://authorityngr.com/2026/11/12/nysc-camp-congestion-centre-tasks-state-governors-to-rise-to-their-civic-responsibilities-improve-on-corp-members-welfare/) reported that CESJET expressed deep concern over persistent congestion and inadequate accommodation facilities at NYSC camps.

reports.text: On 22 Nov 2026, [Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/bih/1090178/video-snazno-nevrijeme-pogodilo-mostar-ulice-pod-vodom-moguc-nestanak-struje) reported that a severe storm hit Mostar, leaving streets underwater and risking power outages and structural damage.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/drustvo/Izdato-narandzasto-upozorenje-zbog-vjetra/993640), [Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/bih/udari-vjetra-do-75-kilometara-na-sat-izdato-narandzasto-upozorenje/) reported that an orange weather warning was issued in Bosnia and Herzegovina due to southern winds with gusts from 55 to 75 kilometers per hour.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/bih/1089372/snazno-nevrijeme-poharalo-bih-voda-preplavila-saobracajnice-vjetar-rusio-stabla-odroni-ugrozili-vozace-vise-gradova-ostalo-bez-struje), [Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/drustvo/Nevrijeme-izazvalo-probleme-sirom-BiH-Vjetar-odnio-krov-drvo-palo-na-vozilo/993372) reported that a severe storm with strong winds and heavy rain caused floods, downed trees, power outages, and damage across parts of Bosnia and Herzegovina.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/bih/olujni-vjetar-poharao-dijelove-bi-h-mjesta-ostala-bez-struje-stizu-prvi-detalji/) reported that a stormy wind battered parts of Bosnia and Herzegovina, leaving places without power.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/banjaluka/Jako-nevrijeme-u-Banjaluci-Kisa-pljusti-olujni-vjetar-polomio-drvo/993305) reported that a severe storm accompanied by strong wind gusts and heavy rain struck Banja Luka.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vremenska-prognoza/rhmz-se-oglasio-novim-upozorenjem-uskoro-stize-orkanski-vetar-jacine-110kmh/tm86eyx) reported that Serbia issued an urgent warning for severe weather expected during evening hours, with the Republic Hydrometeorological Institute forecasting hurricane-force winds up to 110 kilometers per hour.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/bih/1089219/olujni-vjetar-zahvata-bih-u-narednim-satima-ocekuju-se-olujni-i-orkanski-udari-vjetra-do-90-kilometara-na-sat) reported that stormy and hurricane-force wind gusts reaching up to 90 kilometers per hour are affecting Bosnia and Herzegovina, with heavier rain expected in Herzegovina and the south.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/drustvo/Stizu-pljuskovi-i-olujni-vjetar-RHMZ-izdao-upozorenje-za-Republiku-Srpsku/993168) reported that the Republic Hydrometeorological Institute issued a warning for the Republika Srpska regarding strong to stormy winds with powerful gusts in certain areas.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/bih/1088771/meteorolozi-upozorili-veceras-stizu-olujni-udari-juga-tokom-noci-ocekuje-se-kisa-sirom-bih) reported that meteorologists warned that stormy southern wind gusts will arrive, with rain expected across Bosnia and Herzegovina during the night.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/bih/u-narednim-satima-u-bi-h-stizu-olujni-udari-vjetra-ocekuje-se-i-kisa/) reported that BH Meteo issued warnings for upcoming stormy wind gusts and rain in Bosnia and Herzegovina.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/nauka-tehnologija/okolina/Toplo-ali-varljivo-Danas-u-BiH-udari-vjetra-do-70-kmh-uvece-stize-kisa/992743) reported that temperatures in Bosnia and Herzegovina would reach 19 degrees with southerly wind gusts up to 70 kilometers per hour, followed by evening rain.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/ekonomija/trziste/Ispunjeni-uslovi-da-gorivo-u-BiH-dodatno-pojeftini-Kada-stizu-nove-cijene/992635) reported that experts stated conditions are met for additional price drops for fuel in Bosnia and Herzegovina.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/bih/1088468/olujni-udari-juga-stizu-u-bih-poznato-kada-ce-vjetar-biti-najjaci) reported that stormy southerly wind gusts are arriving in Bosnia and Herzegovina, with the strongest winds expected on Tuesday and Thursday.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/bih/bi-h-ceka-velika-promjena-vremena-nakon-obilne-kise-i-olujnog-juga-stize-snijeg/) reported that Bosnia and Herzegovina is expecting a weather change from warm temperatures and stormy southerly winds to snow.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/drustvo/Nevrijeme-stize-u-BiH-Olujni-vjetar-do-90-kmh-obilna-kisa-i-snijeg/992176) reported that meteoalarm issued warnings for winds up to 90 km/h, heavy rain in Herzegovina, and snow in higher elevations.

reports.text: On 21 Nov 2026, [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/sociedad/ponernos-de-pie-los-vecinos-de-lanus-marchan-para-pedir-justicia-a-una-semana-de-la-tragica-nid21112026/) reported that residents of Lanús marched to demand justice one week after the gas explosion, coinciding with the patronal feast of the Virgin of the Rosary.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/sociedad/tragica-explosion-remedios-escalada-muertos-victimas-fatales_0_pAhLnCZKXm.html), [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/sociedad/explosion-y-muerte-fallecieron-otras-dos-personas-por-el-escape-de-gas-en-remedios-de-escalada-y-ya-nid21112026/) reported that two outsourced workers who were hospitalized following a gas pipe explosion in Remedios de Escalada died of their injuries, raising the death toll to four.

On 19 Nov 2026, [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/sociedad/entre-escombros-miedo-y-reclamos-asi-se-vive-a-una-semana-de-la-explosion-en-remedios-de-escalada-nid19112026/) reported that one week after the explosion in Remedios de Escalada, concerns persist regarding new leaks and suspended works.

On 19 Nov 2026, [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/sociedad/seis-dias-despues-de-la-explosion-el-adn-confirmo-que-la-primera-victima-fatal-es-el-operario-de-nid19112026/) reported that DNA testing confirmed that missing Metrogas worker Marcelo García was the first fatality in the Remedios de Escalada tragedy, alongside the death of another worker.

On 19 Nov 2026, [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/sociedad/explosion-en-remedios-de-escalada-murio-otro-operario-de-metrogas-y-ya-son-dos-las-victimas-fatales-nid19112026/) reported that a second Metrogas worker injured in the gas pipeline explosion in Remedios de Escalada died in a Buenos Aires clinic.

On 17 Nov 2026, [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/sociedad/metrogas-respondio-al-enojo-de-los-vecinos-tras-la-explosion-de-gas-y-defendio-el-trabajo-de-los-nid17112026/) reported that Metrogas responded to neighborhood anger following a gas explosion and defended the work of operators.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/sociedad/vivir-volcan-miedo-vecinos-remedios-escalada-animan-cocinar_0_GjkdF2xw94.html) reported that three days after a gas explosion that left one dead and 30 injured, fears and gas leak alarms persist among residents in Remedios de Escalada.

On 14 Nov 2026, [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/sociedad/es-un-desastre-protesta-y-enojo-de-los-vecinos-de-remedios-de-escalada-tras-la-explosion-de-gas-nid14112026/) reported that residents in Remedios de Escalada protested and expressed anger following a gas explosion, denouncing a lack of information and demanding assistance while entry to homes remains restricted.

On 14 Nov 2026, [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/sociedad/un-muerto-y-siete-heridos-graves-tras-la-explosion-en-remedios-de-escalada-confirman-que-el-incendio-nid14112026/) reported that Metrogas cut off the gas leak that caused the fire, allowing firefighters to extinguish it while the municipality organized the return of evacuated families.

On 13 Nov 2026, [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/sociedad/explosion-en-remedios-de-escalada-ordenaron-trasladar-a-dos-directivos-de-metrogas-nid13112026/) reported that the judiciary ordered the transfer of two Metrogas executives as part of the investigation into the Remedios de Escalada explosion.

On 13 Nov 2026, [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/sociedad/habia-muchisimo-olor-a-gas-el-dramatico-relato-de-los-vecinos-afectados-por-la-explosion-en-remedios-nid13112026/) reported that residents in Remedios de Escalada reported a strong smell of gas and feared an explosion hours before fires continued burning above commercial properties.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/sociedad/explosion-remedios-escalada-obra-haciendo-metrogas-derivo-incendio-20-heridos_0_JOS19K03yU.html), [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/sociedad/fuerte-explosion-en-remedios-de-escalada-estaban-trabajando-y-rompieron-un-cano-de-gas-nid13112026/) reported that a gas pipe was damaged during renovation work by Metrogas in Remedios de Escalada, triggering an explosion and fire that left at least 20 people injured.

reports.text: On 22 Nov 2026, [El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/mundo/nuevo-sismo-magnitud-5-siente-centro-peru-reporten-danos_1795391809) reported that a magnitude 5 earthquake was registered in central Peru without any damages reported.

On 22 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/peru-registra-sismo-de-51-durante-la-madrugada-es-el-segundo-temblor-en-menos-de-una-semana/) reported that Peru recorded a 5.1 magnitude earthquake during the early hours, following a 6.7 magnitude earthquake that affected Junín.

On 21 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/latinoamerica/por-que-duro-tanto-el-temblor-de-magnitud-6-7-en-peru-que-tambien-se-sintio-en-colombia-instituto-geofisico-explica-que-ocurrio-3603076) reported that the Geophysical Institute of Peru explained that the depth of the 6.7 magnitude earthquake allowed its waves to reach distant areas.
