On 21 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/reportan-al-menos-15-heridos-tras-sismo-de-67-en-peru-hay-decenas-de-viviendas-y-edificios-afectados/) reported that at least 15 injuries were reported following a 6.7 magnitude earthquake in Peru, with dozens of homes and buildings affected.

On 21 Nov 2026, [El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/mundo/menos-mujer-herida-39-viviendas-afectadas-sismo-magnitud-6-7-peru_1795260503) reported that at least one woman was injured and 39 homes were affected by a 6.7 magnitude earthquake in Peru, with some collapses in Lima's Independencia district and the Costa Verde.

On 21 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/latinoamerica/reportan-nuevo-temblor-de-magnitud-5-0-en-peru-este-sabado-21-de-noviembre-horas-despues-del-fuerte-sismo-de-6-9-profundidad-epicentro-y-detalles-3602958) reported that the Colombian Geological Service published a bulletin on a 5.0 magnitude earthquake registered in Peru.

On 21 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/latinoamerica/videos-del-fuerte-temblor-de-6-9-en-peru-la-noche-de-este-20-de-noviembre-que-se-sintio-en-bogota-y-varias-ciudades-de-colombia-asi-se-vivio-el-sismo-3602909) reported that Colombia's Ungrd discarded a tsunami threat after the strong movement.

On 20 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/sismo-de-6-7-de-magnitud-sacude-a-peru-sin-danos-por-el-momento-33237290), [El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/internacional/sismo-de-magnitud-67-con-epicentro-en-junin-sacudio-peru-este-viernes), [El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/mundo/sismo-6-7-sacude-centro-peru-siente-lima-danos-momento_1795221277) reported that a 6.7 magnitude earthquake struck Peru with an epicenter 30 kilometers northwest of Junin and a depth of 127 kilometers, with no immediate damages reported.

On 21 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/se-registra-sismo-de-69-en-los-andes-peru-no-se-reportan-danos-o-victimas-al-momento/) reported that a 6.9 magnitude earthquake was registered in the Andes with no immediate casualties.

reports.text: On 23 Nov 2026, [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/scitech/gaming/hakovao-gta-6-preko-hotelskog-televizora-tvorac-najveceg-curenja-u-historiji-videoigara-pusten-na-slobodu/261123270) reported that Arion Kurtaj, the hacker who leaked unreleased GTA 6 footage in 2022, was sentenced to seven years in prison and released on the same day.

reports.text: On 25 Nov 2026, [Kabul Now](https://kabulnow.com/2026/11/taliban-detain-four-female-journalists-and-two-radio-staff-members-in-eastern-afghanistan-ifj-says/) reported that the International Federation of Journalists stated Taliban morality police officials raided the office of Kawoon Ghazh Radio in eastern Afghanistan and detained four female journalists and two radio staff members.

On 20 Nov 2026, [Kabul Now](https://kabulnow.com/2026/11/how-the-taliban-use-the-law-to-take-land-a-legal-scholar-reads-the-omid-sabz-rulings/) reported that a Taliban court declared Kabul's Omid Sabz township state property, placing about 80,000 people at risk of losing their homes.

On 19 Nov 2026, [Hasht-e Subh](https://8am.media/eng/taliban-arrest-several-social-media-activists-in-nangarhar/), [Kabul Now](https://kabulnow.com/2026/11/taliban-detains-24-social-media-users-in-eastern-afghanistan-amid-intensified-crackdown/) reported that Taliban authorities in eastern Nangarhar province detained 24 young people over their social media activities, particularly on TikTok.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Hasht-e Subh](https://8am.media/eng/taliban-arrest-torture-former-military-officer-nimroz/) reported that Taliban intelligence officials arrested and beat a former military officer in Nimroz Province after his deportation from Iran.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Kabul Now](https://kabulnow.com/2026/11/taliban-detain-four-young-women-in-daikundi-central-afghanistan-for-not-wearing-burqas/), [Hasht-e Subh](https://8am.media/eng/sources-taliban-arrest-around-10-women-in-sang-e-takht-and-bandar-district-of-daikundi/) reported that Taliban morality police detained approximately 10 women in the Sangtakht-o-Bandar district of Daikundi province for not wearing burqas.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Hasht-e Subh](https://8am.media/eng/sources-two-omid-sabz-township-representatives-remain-in-taliban-custody-after-10-days/) reported that two representatives of Omid Sabz Township in western Kabul remain in Taliban custody nearly 10 days after their arrest.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Kabul Now](https://kabulnow.com/2026/11/taliban-arrest-two-shia-clerics-in-afghanistans-herat-province/) reported that Taliban authorities arrested two Shia clerics in Herat province following a mourning ceremony.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Kabul Now](https://kabulnow.com/2026/11/taliban-detains-four-shia-clerics-in-bamyan-amid-growing-pressure-on-community/) reported that Taliban intelligence authorities detained four Shia clerics in Bamyan province.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Hasht-e Subh](https://8am.media/eng/kabul-new-city-land-grab-taliban/) reported that Kabul residents said a businessman from Khost province claimed ownership of 20 hectares of land in Parcel 2.2 of Kabul New City and demolished structures.

stories.title: France weather orange alert and floods

reports.text: On 25 Nov 2026, [Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/planete/article/2026/11/25/vigilance-orange-dans-le-var-et-les-alpes-maritimes-reprise-attendue-des-pluies-apres-une-accalmie_6815053_3245.html) reported that Var and Alpes-Maritimes remained on orange rain-flood alert while expected precipitation resumed after a lull.

On 25 Nov 2026, [Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/meteo/verglas-dans-le-nord-pluies-orageuses-dans-le-sud-est-decouvrez-la-meteo-du-mercredi-25-novembre-20261124) reported that Météo-France placed the Alpes-Maritimes and Var departments on orange alert for rain and floods.

On 23 Nov 2026, [Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/climat/article/2026/11/23/la-corse-placee-en-vigilance-orange-pour-des-vents-violents-lundi-matin-la-canche-toujours-en-vigilance-orange-aux-crues-dans-le-pas-de-calais_6814193_1652613.html) reported that Météo-France recorded wind gusts generally between 130 and 170 km/h on Cape Corso, reaching up to 191 km/h at Cape Sagro, while Corsica was placed on orange alert for violent winds.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/climat/article/2026/11/22/la-corse-placee-en-vigilance-orange-pour-des-vents-violents-a-partir-de-lundi-l-ain-et-le-jura-touches-par-de-fortes-pluies-et-face-a-des-risques-d-inondations_6814193_1652613.html) reported that Corsica was placed on orange alert for violent winds with gusts up to 170 km/h, while Ain and Jura faced heavy rains and flood risks.

On 22 Nov 2026, [Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/climat/article/2026/11/22/l-ain-et-le-jura-places-en-en-vigilance-orange-pluies-inondations-dimanche-soir-la-canche-a-des-niveaux-toujours-eleves-dans-le-pas-de-calais_6814193_1652612.html) reported that the Ain and Jura departments were placed on orange alert for rain and floods, and the Canche remained at high levels in Pas-de-Calais.

On 21 Nov 2026, [Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/planete/article/2026/11/21/inondations-dans-le-pas-de-calais-la-canche-reste-en-vigilance-orange-pres-de-800-evacuations-depuis-jeudi-selon-la-prefecture_6813953_3244.html), [Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/actualite-france/inondations-dans-le-pas-de-calais-le-niveau-de-la-canche-a-atteint-son-maximum-pres-de-800-personnes-evacuees-20261121) reported that nearly 800 people have been evacuated due to floods in Pas-de-Calais, and Vigicrues warned that the Vire in Calvados and Manche would reach first overflow thresholds.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/planete/article/2026/11/17/pluie-et-inondations-le-pas-de-calais-et-la-somme-places-en-vigilance-orange-mardi-a-partir-de-23-heures_6813028_3244.html) reported that Pas-de-Calais and Somme were placed on orange weather alert for rain and floods, and several rail links in Hauts-de-France were suspended due to strong winds.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/planete/article/2026/11/14/pluie-et-inondations-les-departements-du-gard-de-l-herault-et-des-bouches-du-rhone-places-en-vigilance-orange-a-partir-de-samedi-soir_6810050_3245.html) reported that Gard, Hérault, and Bouches-du-Rhône were placed on orange weather alert for rain and floods.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/meteo/l-equivalent-de-deux-mois-et-demi-de-pluie-en-une-nuit-les-images-impressionnantes-des-inondations-dans-l-herault-20261115) reported that the equivalent of two and a half months of rain fell in Montpellier in a single night.

reports.text: On 25 Nov 2026, [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/hong-kong/law-and-crime/article/3375737/abby-chois-ex-husband-says-he-lacked-legal-advice-when-he-named-father-killer) reported that the ex-husband of slain Hong Kong socialite Abby Choi Tin-fung wrapped up his testimony in her murder trial, stating that his former lawyer did not properly advise him when he named his father as the killer.

On 19 Nov 2026, [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/hong-kong/law-and-crime/article/3375105/abby-chois-ex-husband-tells-trial-love-triangle-romance-and-sex-until-her-death) reported that the ex-husband of slain Hong Kong socialite Abby Choi Tin-fung testified that they were in a complicated relationship and remained romantically involved until her death.

On 18 Nov 2026, [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/hong-kong/law-and-crime/article/3374858/abby-chois-ex-father-law-tells-court-he-dismembered-and-disposed-her-body) reported that the former father-in-law of slain Hong Kong socialite Abby Choi Tin-fung told the High Court he takes full responsibility for dismembering and disposing of her body.

On 14 Nov 2026, [24 Chasa](https://www.24chasa.bg/mezhdunarodni/article/23932090) reported that American negotiators asked Kyiv whether Ukraine would withdraw from Donbas to join NATO.
